items.endogenous_note: Skin makes vitamin D3 photochemically: UVB at 290 to 315 nm opens 7-dehydrocholesterol to previtamin D3, which isomerises thermally, after which CYP2R1 in liver makes 25(OH)D and renal CYP27B1 makes the hormone 1,25(OH)2D. Because the first step needs photons rather than an enzyme, production collapses with latitude, season, time of day, skin pigmentation, sunscreen, clothing, indoor living and age, which is why deficiency is common despite a functioning pathway. The recovered entries split on the label, one scoring it FULL conditional on UVB exposure and another calling it the one true CONDITIONAL vitamin, and PARTIAL is taken here because the pathway routinely fails to cover requirement under real exposure conditions; supplementing is therefore genuine repletion of a synthesis shortfall, and serum 25(OH)D makes it targetable and monitorable.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 皮肤以光化学方式生成维生素 D3: 290 至 315 nm 的 UVB 使 7-dehydrocholesterol 开环成为 previtamin D3, 后者经热异构化, 随后肝脏 CYP2R1 生成 25(OH)D, 肾脏 CYP27B1 生成激素形式 1,25(OH)2D。第一步需要光子而非酶, 所以产量随纬度, 季节, 时段, 皮肤色素, 防晒霜, 衣着, 室内生活和年龄大幅下降, 这就是通路完好却仍常见缺乏的原因。恢复条目中的标签并不统一, 有的记为 FULL (以有 UVB 暴露为条件), 有的称它是唯一真正 CONDITIONAL 的维生素; 这里取 PARTIAL, 因为在真实日照条件下该通路经常覆盖不了需要量。补充属于对合成不足的真正补足, 血清 25(OH)D 使它可以有针对性并可监测。
items.pathway: 7-dehydrocholesterol (a mevalonate/cholesterol pathway intermediate and the DHCR7 substrate) plus UVB at 290-315 nm gives previtamin D3 by non-enzymatic photolysis in the epidermis, followed by thermal isomerisation to vitamin D3; DBP (GC) transports it to liver for 25-hydroxylation by CYP2R1 (and CYP27A1), then to kidney and extrarenal sites for 1-alpha-hydroxylation by CYP27B1 under PTH and FGF23 control; inactivation by CYP24A1 (24-hydroxylation); action through the nuclear receptor VDR.
items.pathway_zh: 表皮中的 7-dehydrocholesterol (mevalonate 与胆固醇通路的中间物, 也是 DHCR7 的底物) 在 290-315 nm 的 UVB 作用下经非酶光解生成 previtamin D3, 随后热异构为 vitamin D3; 由 DBP (GC) 运至肝脏, 经 CYP2R1 (以及 CYP27A1) 进行 25 位羟化; 再到肾脏和肾外部位, 由 CYP27B1 在 PTH 与 FGF23 调控下进行 1-alpha 位羟化; 由 CYP24A1 (24 位羟化) 失活; 通过核受体 VDR 起作用。
items.daily_amount: Cutaneous synthesis has no fixed daily figure because it is UVB-dependent, so NOT ESTABLISHED as a constant. Whole-body exposure to one minimal erythemal dose of UVB equates to roughly 10,000-25,000 IU (250-625 µg) cholecalciferol, and IOM cites an estimate that average summer cutaneous synthesis at northern latitudes equates to about 2,000 IU/d. Dietary reference values: RDA 600 IU (15 micrograms)/day for ages 1 to 70 and 800 IU/day above 70, UL 4,000 IU/day (IOM 2011).
items.daily_amount_zh: 皮肤合成没有固定的每日数值, 因为它依赖 UVB, 作为常量判为 NOT ESTABLISHED。全身暴露于一个最小红斑剂量的 UVB 相当于大约 10,000-25,000 IU (250-625 µg) cholecalciferol; IOM 引用的估计是北方纬度夏季平均皮肤合成量约相当于 2,000 IU/d。膳食参考值: 1 至 70 岁 RDA 600 IU (15 micrograms)/day, 70 岁以上 800 IU/day, UL 4,000 IU/day (IOM 2011)。
items.still_matters_when: Rickets and osteomalacia, exclusively breastfed infants, dark skin at high latitude, housebound or fully covered individuals, obesity (sequestration in adipose tissue), fat malabsorption and bariatric surgery, anticonvulsant or glucocorticoid therapy that induces catabolism, and chronic kidney disease, where activated forms are needed because CYP27B1 activity is lost. Excess causes hypercalcaemia, so mega-dosing is not a stronger version of adequacy, and intermittent very high doses performed worse than daily dosing in fracture and fall trials. Redundant for someone with regular summer sun on bare skin at low latitude.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 佝偻病和骨软化症, 纯母乳喂养的婴儿, 高纬度地区的深色皮肤人群, 居家不出或全身遮盖者, 肥胖 (脂肪组织的隔离作用), 脂肪吸收不良和减重手术后, 诱导分解代谢的抗癫痫药或糖皮质激素治疗, 以及慢性肾病 (因 CYP27B1 活性丧失而需要活化形式)。过量会引起高钙血症, 超大剂量并非更强的充足状态, 在骨折与跌倒试验中间断超大剂量给药的表现不如每日给药。对低纬度夏季经常裸露皮肤晒太阳的人, 它是多余的。
items.source: PMID 17634462 (Holick, N Engl J Med 2007;357:266-281, DOI 10.1056/NEJMra070553); IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium and Vitamin D (2011), NCBI Bookshelf NBK56070. Merged from the recovered entries Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol), Vitamin D (cholecalciferol) and Vitamin D (cholecalciferol) as a standalone supplement.

items.supplement: Vitamin E at or above 400 IU/d
items.endogenous_note: Alpha-tocopherol is entirely dietary: humans carry no tocopherol or tocotrienol biosynthetic pathway, and human enzymology handles absorption with dietary fat, hepatic selection of the alpha-tocopherol form and lipoprotein transport only. NONE here does imply a requirement, and a deficiency state exists, described in the recovered prose in fat malabsorption and abetalipoproteinaemia. The axis therefore supports correcting a documented shortfall and gives no argument for 400 IU/d and above, which is a pharmacological antioxidant dose to be judged on its own trial and risk record.
items.endogenous_note_zh: alpha-tocopherol 完全依赖膳食: 人体没有 tocopherol 或 tocotrienol 的合成通路, 人体酶学只负责随膳食脂肪的吸收, 肝脏对 alpha-tocopherol 形式的选择以及脂蛋白转运。这里的 NONE 确实意味着必需, 并且存在缺乏状态, 恢复文本把它写在脂肪吸收不良和 abetalipoproteinaemia 中。因此这条轴支持纠正有记录的不足, 对 400 IU/d 及以上没有任何依据, 那属于药理性抗氧化剂量, 应按其自身的试验与风险记录判断。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Humans have no tocopherol biosynthetic pathway; tocopherols and tocotrienols are made by plants and other photosynthetic organisms. Human handling covers intestinal absorption with dietary fat, hepatic selection of the alpha-tocopherol form and lipoprotein transport, with no synthetic step at any point.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。人体没有 tocopherol 合成通路, tocopherols 与 tocotrienols 由植物和其他光合生物合成。人体只处理随膳食脂肪的肠道吸收, 肝脏对 alpha-tocopherol 形式的选择以及脂蛋白转运, 全过程没有任何合成步骤。
items.daily_amount: 0 mg/day synthesised, since no human biosynthetic pathway exists. The 400 IU/d in the name is a supplement dose; the recovered prose quotes no dietary reference value for vitamin E, so none is asserted here.
items.daily_amount_zh: 合成量 0 mg/day, 人体不存在相应生物合成通路。名称中的 400 IU/d 是补充剂量; 恢复的文本没有给出维生素 E 的膳食参考值, 这里也不臆造。
items.still_matters_when: Documented vitamin E deficiency, which the recovered prose ties to fat malabsorption and abetalipoproteinaemia. During active cytotoxic chemotherapy the default is to hold high-dose antioxidant supplements: in SWOG S0221, self-reported use of any antioxidant supplement (vitamins A, C, E, carotenoids, CoQ10) both before and during treatment was associated with a higher recurrence rate (adjusted HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 to 2.04). For 400 IU/d and above in a well-nourished person, NEVER ON THIS AXIS.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 有记录的维生素 E 缺乏, 恢复文本把它与脂肪吸收不良和 abetalipoproteinaemia 联系在一起。细胞毒化疗期间的默认做法是暂停高剂量抗氧化补充剂: 在 SWOG S0221 中, 治疗前和治疗期间自报使用任一抗氧化补充剂 (维生素 A, C, E, 类胡萝卜素, CoQ10) 与更高复发率相关 (校正 HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 到 2.04)。对营养良好的人, 400 IU/d 及以上 NEVER ON THIS AXIS。
items.source: Derived using this dataset's classification rules (NONE = no human biosynthetic pathway) from two recovered entries: BCAAs sold separately, and B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate and vitamin E, which scores vitamin E NONE, and Antioxidants during chemotherapy, which states that alpha-tocopherol is entirely dietary and supplies the SWOG S0221 figures and the fat malabsorption and abetalipoproteinaemia deficiency settings.

items.supplement: Preformed vitamin A at or above 10,000 IU
items.endogenous_note: Retinol cannot be built from scratch at all, because human cells only cleave dietary provitamin A carotenoids to make it and there is no de novo retinoid pathway. NONE means required here, so ordinary vitamin A intake has a real target and deficiency is a genuine clinical state. The axis says nothing for 10,000 IU and above of preformed retinol, where the retinol load itself is the hazard, and high retinol doses are specifically to be avoided in pregnancy because of teratogenicity.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 视黄醇完全无法从头合成, 人体细胞只能裂解膳食中的维生素 A 原类胡萝卜素来获得它, 没有从头合成的类视黄醇通路。这里的 NONE 意味着必需, 所以常规维生素 A 摄入有真实的作用目标, 缺乏也是真实的临床状态。这条轴对 10,000 IU 及以上的预成型视黄醇没有任何依据, 那里的问题正是视黄醇负荷本身, 妊娠期尤其要避免高剂量视黄醇, 因为有致畸性。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for synthesis. Human cells only cleave dietary provitamin A carotenoids to retinoids; the remaining human enzymology handles absorption, storage and interconversion of dietary retinoids, with no synthetic step.
items.pathway_zh: 合成为 NOT APPLICABLE。人体细胞只能把膳食中的维生素 A 原类胡萝卜素裂解为类视黄醇; 其余人体酶学只负责膳食类视黄醇的吸收, 储存和相互转化, 没有合成步骤。
items.daily_amount: 0 IU/day synthesised, since humans have no retinoid biosynthetic pathway. The 10,000 IU in the name is a supplement dose; the recovered prose quotes no dietary reference value for preformed vitamin A, so none is asserted here.
items.daily_amount_zh: 合成量 0 IU/day, 人体没有类视黄醇的生物合成通路。名称中的 10,000 IU 是补充剂量; 恢复的文本没有给出预成型维生素 A 的膳食参考值, 这里也不臆造。
items.still_matters_when: Documented vitamin A deficiency and low-intake settings where a preformed or provitamin A source is needed. Not justified as a routine high-dose retinol source, and specifically to be avoided at high retinol doses in pregnancy because of teratogenicity, which is the recovered reason cod liver oil is a poor carrier and separate D3 plus fish or algal oil is the cleaner choice. High-dose vitamin A also sits in the antioxidant class the recovered prose says to hold during active cytotoxic therapy (SWOG S0221, adjusted HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 to 2.04).
items.still_matters_when_zh: 有记录的维生素 A 缺乏, 以及需要预成型或维生素 A 原来源的低摄入情形。把它当作常规高剂量视黄醇来源没有依据; 妊娠期尤其要避免高剂量视黄醇, 因为有致畸性, 这也是恢复文本判定鱼肝油是糟糕载体, 而分开使用 D3 加鱼油或藻油更干净的原因。高剂量维生素 A 同样属于恢复文本要求在细胞毒治疗期间暂停的抗氧化类 (SWOG S0221, 校正 HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 到 2.04)。
items.source: Derived using this dataset's classification rules from the recovered entry Cod liver oil, which scores retinol NONE, states that human cells only cleave dietary provitamin A carotenoids and flags teratogenicity at high retinol doses in pregnancy (Holick MF, N Engl J Med 2007;357(3):266-81, PMID 17634462 is that entry's cited source for the vitamin D component), together with Antioxidants during chemotherapy for the SWOG S0221 figures. IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin A, Vitamin K, Arsenic, Boron, Chromium, Copper, Iodine, Iron, Manganese, Molybdenum, Nickel, Silicon, Vanadium and Zinc is the reference volume cited elsewhere in the dataset for vitamin A.

items.endogenous_note: Humans synthesise no carotenoids whatsoever, so everything in the body reflects intake and there is no deficiency state for beta-carotene as such. The recovered set also carries a PARTIAL label for vitamin A from beta-carotene, and that PARTIAL describes the conversion of dietary beta-carotene into retinol rather than any synthesis of the carotenoid, so the two labels sit on different things and do not conflict. On this axis a beta-carotene supplement has no shortfall to correct, and it stands or falls on trial results for whatever endpoint is claimed.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 人体完全不合成任何类胡萝卜素, 所以体内的全部 beta-carotene 都反映摄入量, 也不存在针对 beta-carotene 本身的缺乏状态。恢复条目中还有一个标签把由 beta-carotene 得到的维生素 A 记为 PARTIAL, 那个 PARTIAL 说的是膳食 beta-carotene 向视黄醇的转化, 与类胡萝卜素本身的合成无关, 两个标签指向不同的东西, 并不冲突。在这条轴上, beta-carotene 补充剂没有可补的缺口, 成败完全取决于它所宣称终点的试验结果。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Humans have no carotenoid biosynthetic pathway and no homologue of any step in the algal, plant and microbial routes. Human enzymology is cleavage only, converting dietary provitamin A carotenoids into retinoids.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。人体没有类胡萝卜素生物合成通路, 藻类, 植物和微生物路线中的任何步骤在人体内都没有同源物。人体酶学只做裂解, 把膳食中的维生素 A 原类胡萝卜素转为类视黄醇。
items.daily_amount: 0 mg/day. Humans have no carotenoid biosynthetic pathway.
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 mg/day。人体没有类胡萝卜素生物合成通路。
items.still_matters_when: As a provitamin A source where vitamin A intake is low, which is a dietary argument rather than a synthesis one. High-dose beta-carotene sits in the carotenoid class the recovered prose says to hold during active cytotoxic therapy: in SWOG S0221, antioxidant supplement use (vitamins A, C, E, carotenoids, CoQ10) before and during treatment was associated with higher recurrence (adjusted HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 to 2.04). Otherwise NEVER ON THIS AXIS, since with no requirement and no deficiency state, dose selection is entirely empirical.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 作为维生素 A 摄入偏低时的维生素 A 原来源, 这属于膳食层面的理由, 与合成无关。高剂量 beta-carotene 属于恢复文本要求在细胞毒治疗期间暂停的类胡萝卜素一类: 在 SWOG S0221 中, 治疗前和治疗期间使用抗氧化补充剂 (维生素 A, C, E, 类胡萝卜素, CoQ10) 与更高复发率相关 (校正 HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 到 2.04)。除此之外 NEVER ON THIS AXIS, 既没有需要量也没有缺乏状态, 剂量选择完全是经验性的。
items.source: Derived using this dataset's classification rules from the recovered entry Astaxanthin (PMID 24402174, Ambati et al., Mar Drugs 2014;12:128-152), which states that humans synthesise no carotenoids whatsoever and gives 0 mg/day; the conversion side from Niacin, choline, omega-3 EPA and DHA, vitamin A from beta-carotene, vitamin K2 (MK-4), inositol and from Cod liver oil; the chemotherapy caution and SWOG S0221 figures from Antioxidants during chemotherapy.

items.endogenous_note: Humans cannot make the naphthoquinone ring, so vitamin K itself is strictly dietary, while UBIAD1 prenylates menadione derived from dietary phylloquinone (K1) to MK-4 in most tissues, which means the MK-4 in artery wall, bone and brain is already partly endogenous. MK-7 and the longer chains MK-7 to MK-13 are bacterial products that humans do not synthesise, and the colonic contribution is modest and hard to quantify because much of it stays unabsorbed. PARTIAL is the roll-up for the pair: supplementing MK-4 duplicates a conversion the body already runs on ordinary K1 intake, and the honest case for an MK-7 product is pharmacokinetic (a much longer half-life than K1) and dietary, for people eating little natto, cheese or leafy greens.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 人体无法合成萘醌环, 所以维生素 K 本身严格依赖膳食; 而 UBIAD1 在多数组织中把源自膳食 phylloquinone (K1) 的 menadione 异戊烯化为 MK-4, 因此动脉壁, 骨与脑中的 MK-4 已经部分是内源的。MK-7 以及 MK-7 至 MK-13 的长链形式是细菌产物, 人体不合成, 结肠的贡献不大且难以量化, 因为其中很大一部分留在结肠未被吸收。两者合起来的标签是 PARTIAL: 补充 MK-4 重复了身体在普通 K1 摄入下本就在做的转化, 而支持 MK-7 产品的合理理由在于药代动力学 (半衰期远长于 K1) 和膳食 (纳豆, 干酪或深色叶菜吃得很少的人)。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for the ring, since humans have no de novo vitamin K pathway. Conversion only: dietary phylloquinone K1 or menadione plus geranylgeranyl-PP to MK-4 by UBIAD1 in most tissues, after side-chain removal from phylloquinone. Function runs through the vitamin K cycle, where GGCX gamma-carboxylates glutamate residues in prothrombin and factors VII, IX, X, in osteocalcin and in matrix Gla protein, and VKORC1, the warfarin target, regenerates the hydroquinone form. Long-chain menaquinones MK-7 to MK-13 are made by colonic bacteria.
items.pathway_zh: 对萘醌环 NOT APPLICABLE, 人体没有维生素 K 的从头合成通路。只有转化: 在多数组织中, 膳食 phylloquinone K1 或 menadione 加 geranylgeranyl-PP 经 UBIAD1 生成 MK-4, phylloquinone 需先脱去侧链。功能通过维生素 K 循环实现: GGCX 对 prothrombin 与因子 VII, IX, X, 对 osteocalcin 以及 matrix Gla protein 中的 glutamate 残基进行 gamma 羧化, warfarin 的靶点 VKORC1 再生氢醌形式。MK-7 至 MK-13 的长链 menaquinones 由结肠细菌合成。
items.daily_amount: MK-4 formed endogenously in mg/d: NOT ESTABLISHED, and no established figure exists for the microbial contribution either. Vitamin K AI 120 micrograms/day for men and 90 micrograms/day for women as phylloquinone, with no UL set (IOM 2001). Typical supplement doses MK-4 1.5-45 mg/d and MK-7 90-360 µg/d, with common MK-7 products providing 90 to 180 micrograms/day.
items.daily_amount_zh: 内源生成的 MK-4 (mg/d): NOT ESTABLISHED, 微生物贡献同样没有既定数值。以 phylloquinone 计的维生素 K AI 为男性 120 micrograms/day, 女性 90 micrograms/day, 未设 UL (IOM 2001)。常见补充剂量为 MK-4 1.5-45 mg/d, MK-7 90-360 µg/d, 常见 MK-7 产品提供 90 至 180 micrograms/day。
items.still_matters_when: Newborns, who receive prophylactic vitamin K (K1 by injection) to prevent haemorrhagic disease of the newborn, and documented deficiency from fat malabsorption, cholestasis, cystic fibrosis, coeliac disease or bariatric surgery. Also prolonged broad-spectrum antibiotics with poor intake, and VKORC1 or GGCX defects. Bone and vascular calcification protocols exist but the trial evidence is mixed, and anyone on warfarin must not change vitamin K intake without clinician input, because the vitamin directly opposes the drug. Redundant as a way of obtaining MK-4 in anyone with adequate K1 intake and functioning UBIAD1.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 新生儿需接受预防性维生素 K (注射 K1) 以防新生儿出血症; 以及胆汁淤积, 囊性纤维化, 乳糜泻或减重手术导致的脂肪吸收不良所致的确诊缺乏。还包括长期广谱抗生素合并摄入不足, 以及 VKORC1 或 GGCX 缺陷。骨骼和血管钙化方面有相关方案, 但试验证据不一; 使用 warfarin 者不得在没有临床医生意见的情况下改变维生素 K 摄入, 因为该维生素与药物直接拮抗。对 K1 摄入充足且 UBIAD1 功能正常的人, 靠补充获得 MK-4 是多余的。
items.source: Nakagawa K, Hirota Y, Sawada N, et al. Identification of UBIAD1 as a novel human menaquinone-4 biosynthetic enzyme. Nature. 2010;468(7320):117-21. PMID 20953171; IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin A, Vitamin K, Arsenic, Boron, Chromium, Copper, Iodine, Iron, Manganese, Molybdenum, Nickel, Silicon, Vanadium and Zinc (2001). Merged from the recovered entries Vitamin K2 (menaquinone / MK-4, MK-7), Vitamin K2 as MK-4 and Vitamin D and vitamin K2 (MK-4).

items.endogenous_note: Humans have no folate biosynthetic pathway, so every microgram is dietary or supplemental, and NONE here does mean required, with megaloblastic anaemia as the described deficiency state. Colonic bacteria do synthesise folate, and this dataset counts bacterial output as exogenous supply because the human genome carries no such pathway; colonic absorption is limited and the contribution to human status is unquantified. Supplementation therefore fills a real gap when intake is low, and the strongest indication is periconceptional, where folic acid 400 micrograms/day prevents neural tube defects with outcome evidence behind it.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 人体没有叶酸的生物合成通路, 所以每一微克都来自膳食或补充剂; 这里的 NONE 确实意味着必需, 缺乏症为巨细胞性贫血。结肠细菌确实合成叶酸, 本数据集把细菌产物算作外源供应, 因为人类基因组不含相应通路; 结肠吸收有限, 对人体营养状态的贡献未被定量。因此摄入不足时补充在填补真实缺口, 最强的指征是孕前和围孕期, 叶酸 400 micrograms/day 可预防神经管缺陷, 并有结局证据支持。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for synthesis. Human enzymology handles absorption and use only: PCFT (SLC46A1) and the reduced folate carrier bring folate in, and 5-methyl-THF is the methyl donor for MTR, which remethylates homocysteine to methionine using vitamin B12. Bacterial folate synthesis in the colonic lumen sits outside the human genome and counts as exogenous supply in this dataset.
items.pathway_zh: 合成为 NOT APPLICABLE。人体酶学只负责吸收与利用: 叶酸经 PCFT (SLC46A1) 和还原型叶酸载体进入体内, 5-methyl-THF 是 MTR 的甲基供体, MTR 利用维生素 B12 把 homocysteine 再甲基化为 methionine。结肠腔内的细菌叶酸合成不在人类基因组之内, 在本数据集中算作外源供应。
items.daily_amount: 0 µg/d synthesised by human cells. The contribution of colonic microbial folate synthesis to human vitamin status is NOT ESTABLISHED in µg/d. Reference point: folate RDA 400 µg DFE/d.
items.daily_amount_zh: 人体细胞合成量 0 µg/d。结肠微生物合成的叶酸对人体维生素状态的贡献 (µg/d) NOT ESTABLISHED。参照点: 叶酸 RDA 400 µg DFE/d。
items.still_matters_when: Preconception and pregnancy, where folic acid 400 micrograms/day prevents neural tube defects and the outcome evidence is the strongest recovered for folate. Also documented deficiency with megaloblastic anaemia, malabsorption, and low intake. Broad-spectrum antibiotics and colectomy reduce whatever microbial contribution exists, which was never quantified in the first place.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 孕前和妊娠期, 叶酸 400 micrograms/day 预防神经管缺陷, 这是恢复文本中关于叶酸最有力的结局证据。还有伴巨细胞性贫血的确诊缺乏, 吸收不良, 以及摄入偏低。广谱抗生素和结肠切除会削弱本就存在的那部分微生物贡献, 而这部分从一开始就没有被定量。
items.source: Recovered entries BCAAs sold separately, and B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate and vitamin E (scores folate NONE; folic acid 400 micrograms/day periconceptionally with outcome evidence) and Nutrients made by colonic bacteria (menaquinones, biotin, folate and vitamin B12) (PCFT/SLC46A1 and reduced folate carrier; folate RDA 400 µg DFE/d); MTR and 5-methyl-THF from S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe). Label assigned per the dataset's definitions row.

items.endogenous_note: Humans have no cobalamin biosynthetic pathway, and the deficiency states are well described, megaloblastic anaemia and subacute combined degeneration. Bacteria in the human colon do make cobalamin and it cannot be absorbed there, because intrinsic factor dependent uptake by cubilin and amnionless is confined to the ileum, upstream of where the bacteria produce it, so colonic B12 synthesis contributes nothing to B12 status. That leaves supplementation as the clearest indication in nutrition for anyone whose dietary or absorptive route fails.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 人体没有钴胺素的生物合成通路, 缺乏症也很清楚, 即巨细胞性贫血与亚急性联合变性。人体结肠中的细菌确实生成钴胺素, 而它在那里无法被吸收, 因为依赖内因子, 由 cubilin 和 amnionless 介导的摄取只发生在回肠, 位于细菌产生它的部位之上游, 所以结肠 B12 合成对 B12 状态毫无帮助。这使得对膳食或吸收环节失效的人来说, 补充成为营养学中最明确的指征。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for synthesis. Host handling only: haptocorrin binding, release by gastric acid and pepsin, intrinsic factor from gastric parietal cells, cubilin and amnionless mediated uptake in the ileal epithelium, transcobalamin transport in blood and CD320 uptake by tissues, with no colonic step anywhere in the sequence. Inside cells B12 serves MTR, which remethylates homocysteine using 5-methyl-THF.
items.pathway_zh: 合成为 NOT APPLICABLE。只有宿主处理: 与 haptocorrin 结合, 由胃酸和胃蛋白酶释放, 胃壁细胞提供内因子, 在回肠上皮细胞由 cubilin 与 amnionless 介导摄取, 血中由 transcobalamin 转运, 组织经 CD320 摄取, 整个过程没有任何结肠环节。在细胞内, B12 服务于 MTR, 后者利用 5-methyl-THF 把 homocysteine 再甲基化。
items.daily_amount: 0 µg/d synthesised by human cells, and effectively 0 µg/d absorbable from colonic bacterial production. Reference point: vitamin B12 RDA 2.4 µg/d.
items.daily_amount_zh: 人体细胞合成量 0 µg/d; 结肠细菌产生的部分可吸收量实际为 0 µg/d。参照点: 维生素 B12 RDA 2.4 µg/d。
items.still_matters_when: Vegans and long-term vegetarians, pernicious anaemia, after gastrectomy or ileal resection, with metformin and long-term proton pump inhibitor use, and in older adults with atrophic gastritis; colonic bacterial production never substitutes for any of these. B12 is usually an absorption problem rather than a pure intake problem outside vegan diets, so the route and dose should follow the mechanism of failure. Broad-spectrum antibiotics and colectomy remove whatever microbial output exists, which was never absorbable anyway.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 纯素者和长期素食者, 恶性贫血, 胃切除或回肠切除后, 使用 metformin 和长期使用质子泵抑制剂者, 以及伴萎缩性胃炎的老年人; 结肠细菌的生成永远不能替代这些情形下的补充。除纯素饮食外, B12 通常是吸收环节的问题, 所以给药途径和剂量应当跟着失效机制走。广谱抗生素和结肠切除会去掉那部分微生物产量, 而它本来也无法被吸收。
items.source: Recovered entries Nutrients made by colonic bacteria (menaquinones, biotin, folate and vitamin B12) and BCAAs sold separately, and B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate and vitamin E. Ileal, intrinsic factor dependent B12 absorption via cubilin and amnionless: Nielsen MJ, Rasmussen MR, Andersen CB, Nexo E, Moestrup SK.

items.endogenous_note: Humans have no vitamin B6 biosynthetic pathway; human enzymology only absorbs the dietary vitamers, interconverts them and phosphorylates them to pyridoxal 5-phosphate, the cofactor form. NONE means required, and the recovered prose names seizures and dermatitis as the deficiency picture, so ordinary B6 intake has a real target. The axis supports correcting a shortfall and gives no argument for the high-dose part, which is pharmacological and has to be judged on its own trial and safety record.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 人体没有维生素 B6 的生物合成通路; 人体酶学只负责吸收膳食中的各种 vitamer, 在它们之间相互转化, 并磷酸化为辅因子形式 pyridoxal 5-phosphate。NONE 意味着必需, 恢复文本把缺乏表现写为癫痫发作与皮炎, 所以常规 B6 摄入有真实的作用目标。这条轴支持纠正不足, 对高剂量这一部分没有任何依据, 那属于药理用法, 应按其自身的试验与安全记录判断。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for synthesis. Human enzymology handles absorption, interconversion of the dietary vitamers and phosphorylation to pyridoxal 5-phosphate, which then serves as cofactor for kynureninase in the tryptophan to niacin equivalents route and for CBS in the transsulfuration of homocysteine.
items.pathway_zh: 合成为 NOT APPLICABLE。人体酶学只负责吸收, 膳食 vitamer 之间的相互转化, 以及磷酸化为 pyridoxal 5-phosphate; 后者随后作为 kynureninase 的辅因子参与色氨酸生成烟酸当量的路线, 并作为 CBS 的辅因子参与 homocysteine 的转硫途径。
items.daily_amount: 0 mg/day synthesised, since no human pathway exists. The recovered prose quotes no B6 reference intake figure, so none is asserted here; the comparison it does supply is functional, since B6 deficiency breaks the kynurenine conversion and produces functional niacin deficiency.
items.daily_amount_zh: 合成量 0 mg/day, 人体不存在相应通路。恢复的文本没有给出 B6 的参考摄入量数值, 这里也不臆造; 它给出的对照是功能层面的, B6 缺乏会破坏 kynurenine 转化, 造成功能性烟酸缺乏。
items.still_matters_when: Documented B6 deficiency, where seizures and dermatitis are the described picture; isoniazid therapy, which antagonises B6; and riboflavin or B6 deficiency states that break the kynurenine route to niacin equivalents, producing functional niacin deficiency. For the high-dose part specifically, NEVER ON THIS AXIS, since nothing about endogenous synthesis speaks to doses above requirement.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 有记录的 B6 缺乏, 表现为癫痫发作与皮炎; isoniazid 治疗, 它拮抗 B6; 以及破坏色氨酸经 kynurenine 生成烟酸当量的 riboflavin 或 B6 缺乏状态, 会造成功能性烟酸缺乏。就高剂量这一部分而言 NEVER ON THIS AXIS, 内源合成对超出需要量的剂量没有任何发言权。
items.source: Derived using this dataset's classification rules from the recovered entry BCAAs sold separately, and B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate and vitamin E, which scores B6 NONE and names seizures and dermatitis; pyridoxal 5-phosphate as cofactor for kynureninase from Niacin, choline, omega-3 EPA and DHA, vitamin A from beta-carotene, vitamin K2 (MK-4), inositol and from Niacin (vitamin B3, niacin equivalents), and for CBS from S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe). IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Thiamin, Riboflavin, Niacin, Vitamin B6, Folate, Vitamin B12, Pantothenic Acid, Biotin and Choline (1998) is the reference volume cited for this group in the dataset.

items.endogenous_note: Humans carry the terminal enzyme L-gulonolactone oxidase (GULO) only as a non-functional pseudogene, so synthesis is zero and the loss is genetic in origin (PMID 8175804); rats and dogs, which retain GULO, do not develop scurvy and we do. This is the reference case for what NONE means, and here the endogenous axis argues for intake, because a deficiency disease exists with a defined clinical picture. Every milligram is dietary, so supplementation is never redundant on this axis, and the case for a given dose rests on intake, losses and the plateau of tissue saturation.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 人类的终末酶 L-gulonolactone oxidase (GULO) 只以无功能假基因形式存在, 因此合成量为零, 这一缺失来自遗传层面 (PMID 8175804); 保留 GULO 的大鼠和狗不会得坏血病, 人会。这是理解 NONE 到底意味着什么的标杆案例, 在这里内源性这一维度支持摄入, 因为存在具有明确临床表现的缺乏病。每一毫克抗坏血酸都来自膳食, 所以在这一维度上补充永远不算多余, 具体剂量的理由取决于摄入量, 损失量和组织饱和的平台。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE in humans, because the terminal enzyme is a pseudogene. In species that retain it: glucose to UDP-glucuronate to D-glucuronate to L-gulonate to L-gulono-1,4-lactone, then GULO to L-ascorbate, hepatic in mammals and renal in birds and reptiles. Humans retain only downstream handling: SVCT1 (SLC23A1) for intestinal and renal uptake, SVCT2 (SLC23A2) for tissue uptake, with dehydroascorbate regenerated to ascorbate by glutathione and thioredoxin reductase. Ascorbate is the required reducing cofactor for the Fe(II)/2-oxoglutarate-dependent prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases of collagen maturation.
items.pathway_zh: 在人体中 NOT APPLICABLE, 终末酶是假基因。在保留该酶的物种中: 葡萄糖到 UDP-glucuronate 到 D-glucuronate 到 L-gulonate 到 L-gulono-1,4-lactone, 再由 GULO 生成 L-ascorbate, 哺乳动物在肝, 鸟类和爬行类在肾。人体只保留下游处理: SVCT1 (SLC23A1) 负责肠道和肾脏摄取, SVCT2 (SLC23A2) 负责组织摄取, 脱氢抗坏血酸由谷胱甘肽和硫氧还蛋白还原酶再生为抗坏血酸。抗坏血酸是胶原成熟所需的 Fe(II)/2-oxoglutarate 依赖型脯氨酰羟化酶和赖氨酰羟化酶的必需还原辅因子。
items.daily_amount: 0 mg/day endogenous synthesis. Dietary requirement instead: scurvy is prevented by roughly 10 mg/d; RDA 90 mg/day for men and 75 mg/day for women, plus 35 mg/day for smokers; plasma and neutrophil pools approach saturation near 200 mg/d; UL 2,000 mg/day (IOM DRI 2000, vitamin C chapter).
items.daily_amount_zh: 内源合成 0 mg/day。取而代之的是膳食需要量: 约 10 mg/d 即可预防坏血病; RDA 男性 90 mg/day, 女性 75 mg/day, 吸烟者再加 35 mg/day; 血浆和中性粒细胞池在约 200 mg/d 附近接近饱和; UL 2,000 mg/day (IOM DRI 2000, 维生素 C 章)。
items.still_matters_when: Scurvy and populations at risk of it: very low fruit and vegetable intake, alcohol use disorder, restrictive diets, institutionalised or isolated older people, smoking, haemodialysis and some malabsorption patients, where the response to repletion is rapid and unambiguous. Also relevant to collagen synthesis, which is why collagen peptide products depend on adequate vitamin C status. Gram doses for cold prevention in the general population are not requirement-based, and surplus is renally cleared with a rise in urinary oxalate; high-dose intravenous ascorbate in cancer treatment is a separate pharmacological question for the treating team.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 坏血病及其高危人群: 蔬果摄入极低, 酒精使用障碍, 限制性饮食, 被机构照护或独居的老年人, 吸烟, 血液透析和部分吸收不良患者, 这类情况下补足后的反应迅速且明确。它也与胶原合成相关, 因此胶原肽类产品依赖足够的维生素 C 营养状态。一般人群用克级剂量预防感冒并非以需要量为依据, 多余部分由肾脏清除, 同时尿草酸升高; 肿瘤治疗中的高剂量静脉抗坏血酸属于另一个药理学问题, 应交由主管治疗团队处理。
items.source: PMID 8175804 (Nishikimi et al., J Biol Chem 1994;269:13685-13688); GULO pseudogenisation (GULOP) and human dependence on dietary ascorbate: PMID 38683367 and PMID 40003647; Levine M, Conry-Cantilena C, Wang Y, et al.; IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin C, Vitamin E, Selenium, and Carotenoids (2000), vitamin C chapter. Merged from the recovered entries Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) and Vitamin C (ascorbate).

items.endogenous_note: This is a product category rather than a defined substance, so the axis cannot return one biochemical answer for it and the roll-up is NA. The parts do have answers: every mineral element in the bottle is NONE without exception, because no biological process transmutes elements; vitamin C, B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate, vitamin E and preformed vitamin A are NONE because no human biosynthetic pathway exists for any of them; vitamin D3 is PARTIAL through UVB-dependent cutaneous synthesis, vitamin K is PARTIAL through UBIAD1 conversion of dietary K1 to MK-4, and niacin is PARTIAL through the tryptophan route at 60 mg tryptophan per 1 mg niacin equivalent. A multivitamin therefore has a real target for whichever components a given person is short of and no target for the rest, so it has to be judged component by component against the doses on the label.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 这是一个产品类别, 并非界定明确的物质, 所以这条轴无法给出单一的生化答案, 整体判为 NA。它的各个组成部分有答案: 瓶里的每一种矿物元素一律为 NONE, 因为没有任何生物过程能进行元素转变; 维生素 C, B12, 叶酸, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate, 维生素 E 和预成型维生素 A 都是 NONE, 人体对它们都没有生物合成通路; 维生素 D3 因依赖 UVB 的皮肤合成而为 PARTIAL, 维生素 K 因 UBIAD1 把膳食 K1 转化为 MK-4 而为 PARTIAL, 烟酸因色氨酸路线 (60 mg tryptophan 折合 1 mg niacin equivalent) 而为 PARTIAL。因此复合维生素对使用者确实短缺的那些成分有真实目标, 对其余成分没有目标, 只能逐个成分对照标签剂量来判断。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE as a product category. Component pathways belong in their own rows: for every element human enzymology handles uptake, transport, storage and excretion only, and for the vitamins with no human pathway it handles absorption, activation and transport only. The two components with a genuine human route are vitamin D3 (non-enzymatic UVB photolysis of 7-dehydrocholesterol, then CYP2R1 and CYP27B1) and vitamin K (UBIAD1 prenylation of menadione to MK-4).
items.pathway_zh: 作为产品类别 NOT APPLICABLE。各成分的通路属于各自的条目: 对每一种元素, 人体酶学只负责摄取, 转运, 储存和排出; 对没有人体通路的那些维生素, 只负责吸收, 活化和转运。真正拥有人体路线的两个成分是维生素 D3 (7-dehydrocholesterol 经非酶 UVB 光解, 随后 CYP2R1 与 CYP27B1) 和维生素 K (UBIAD1 把 menadione 异戊烯化为 MK-4)。
items.daily_amount: NOT APPLICABLE for the product as a whole. Component reference points recovered in this dataset: vitamin C RDA 90 mg/day men and 75 mg/day women with UL 2,000 mg/day; folate RDA 400 µg DFE/d; vitamin B12 RDA 2.4 µg/d; biotin AI 30 µg/d; vitamin K AI 120 micrograms/day men and 90 micrograms/day women with no UL; vitamin D RDA 600 IU (15 micrograms)/day for ages 1 to 70 and 800 IU/day above 70 with UL 4,000 IU/day; niacin RDA 16 mg NE/day men and 14 mg NE/day women with UL 35 mg/day for supplemental forms; zinc 11 mg/day men and 8 mg/day women; magnesium 400 to 420 mg/day men and 310 to 320 mg/day women; copper RDA 900 µg/d with UL 10 mg/d.
items.daily_amount_zh: 作为整体产品 NOT APPLICABLE。本数据集中恢复到的各成分参照点: 维生素 C RDA 男性 90 mg/day, 女性 75 mg/day, UL 2,000 mg/day; 叶酸 RDA 400 µg DFE/d; 维生素 B12 RDA 2.4 µg/d; biotin AI 30 µg/d; 维生素 K AI 男性 120 micrograms/day, 女性 90 micrograms/day, 未设 UL; 维生素 D RDA 1 至 70 岁 600 IU (15 micrograms)/day, 70 岁以上 800 IU/day, UL 4,000 IU/day; 烟酸 RDA 男性 16 mg NE/day, 女性 14 mg NE/day, 补充形式 UL 35 mg/day; zinc 男 11 mg/day, 女 8 mg/day; magnesium 男 400 到 420 mg/day, 女 310 到 320 mg/day; copper RDA 900 µg/d, UL 10 mg/d。
items.still_matters_when: Where a named component has a documented shortfall or a defined loss: preconception and pregnancy (folic acid 400 micrograms/day), vegan diets and absorptive failure (B12), low UVB exposure (vitamin D), malabsorption, bariatric surgery, dialysis, restrictive diets and refeeding. Above requirement the direction reverses for several components, since zinc over 40 mg a day induces copper deficiency, selenium over 400 micrograms a day is toxic, iron is harmful in men who are not iron deficient, and preformed vitamin A carries teratogenic risk in pregnancy.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 某个具体成分存在有记录的不足或明确损失时: 孕前和妊娠期 (叶酸 400 micrograms/day), 纯素饮食和吸收失效 (B12), UVB 暴露不足 (维生素 D), 吸收不良, 减重手术, 透析, 限制性饮食和再喂养。超过需求后, 若干成分的方向反转: zinc 每天超过 40 mg 会诱发 copper 缺乏, selenium 每天超过 400 micrograms 有毒, 本不缺铁的男性补铁有害, 预成型维生素 A 在妊娠期有致畸风险。
items.source: Assembled under this dataset's rule that mixed commercial products whose contents are not a defined substance sit off the axis, from the recovered entries Classification rules for this dataset (definitions row, not a supplement), Mineral and element supplements (magnesium, zinc, iron, selenium, iodine, calcium, potassium and others), Zinc, magnesium and other mineral elements, Other mineral elements sold as supplements, BCAAs sold separately, and B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate and vitamin E, Nutrients made by colonic bacteria, Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol), Vitamin K2 (menaquinone / MK-4, MK-7), Vitamin C (ascorbate), Niacin (vitamin B3, niacin equivalents) and Cod liver oil.

items.supplement: High-dose folic acid plus B12 for cardiovascular prevention
items.endogenous_note: Both components are NONE on this axis: humans have no folate and no cobalamin biosynthetic pathway, so each has a real target whenever intake or absorption fails, and the colonic bacterial output of either counts as exogenous supply, with B12 not even absorbable at the site where bacteria make it. That settles nothing about the cardiovascular claim, which rests on lowering homocysteine, a surrogate in the methionine cycle, and the recovered prose carries no cardiovascular outcome data for this combination. Use the axis to confirm the two components are genuinely required nutrients, then judge the prevention claim on trial evidence, which this dataset does not supply.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 两个成分在这条轴上都是 NONE: 人体既没有叶酸也没有钴胺素的生物合成通路, 所以只要摄入或吸收出问题, 它们各自都有真实的作用目标; 结肠细菌对二者的产出都算外源供应, 而 B12 在细菌生成它的部位甚至无法被吸收。这一点对心血管这一说法没有任何裁定作用, 该说法依据的是降低 homocysteine, 那是甲硫氨酸循环中的一个替代指标, 而恢复的文本没有关于这个组合的心血管结局数据。先用这条轴确认两个成分确实是必需营养素, 再用试验证据判断预防说法, 而本数据集不提供这类证据。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for synthesis of either component. The shared biochemistry is the methionine cycle: methyl transfer yields S-adenosylhomocysteine, hydrolysed by AHCY to homocysteine, which MTR remethylates using 5-methyl-THF and vitamin B12, or BHMT remethylates using betaine, or CBS commits to transsulfuration with vitamin B6. Folate enters on PCFT (SLC46A1) and the reduced folate carrier; B12 enters by the haptocorrin, intrinsic factor, cubilin and amnionless route in the ileum, with transcobalamin transport in blood and CD320 uptake by tissues.
items.pathway_zh: 两个成分的合成都是 NOT APPLICABLE。共同的生化基础是甲硫氨酸循环: 甲基转移生成 S-adenosylhomocysteine, 由 AHCY 水解为 homocysteine, 后者或由 MTR 利用 5-methyl-THF 与维生素 B12 再甲基化, 或由 BHMT 利用 betaine 再甲基化, 或经 CBS 在维生素 B6 参与下进入转硫途径。叶酸经 PCFT (SLC46A1) 和还原型叶酸载体进入; B12 经 haptocorrin, 内因子, 回肠的 cubilin 与 amnionless 路线进入, 血中由 transcobalamin 转运, 组织经 CD320 摄取。
items.daily_amount: 0 synthesised for both components. Reference points: folate RDA 400 µg DFE/d and vitamin B12 RDA 2.4 µg/d, against high-dose products that sit well above both. Colonic microbial folate contribution NOT ESTABLISHED in µg/d; absorbable colonic B12 effectively 0 µg/d.
items.daily_amount_zh: 两个成分的合成量都是 0。参照点: 叶酸 RDA 400 µg DFE/d, 维生素 B12 RDA 2.4 µg/d, 而高剂量产品远高于这两个数值。结肠微生物的叶酸贡献 (µg/d) NOT ESTABLISHED; 结肠 B12 的可吸收量实际为 0 µg/d。
items.still_matters_when: Correcting documented folate or B12 deficiency, and periconceptional folic acid 400 micrograms/day for neural tube defect prevention, which has outcome evidence. Also the standard B12 settings: vegans, pernicious anaemia, gastrectomy, ileal resection, metformin, long-term proton pump inhibitors and atrophic gastritis. For cardiovascular prevention specifically, NEVER ON THIS AXIS; folate, B12 and B6 status is what is actually correctable in the methylation cycle, and a raised homocysteine is a reason to check that status.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 纠正有记录的叶酸或 B12 缺乏, 以及围孕期叶酸 400 micrograms/day 预防神经管缺陷, 后者有结局证据。还有 B12 的常规情形: 纯素者, 恶性贫血, 胃切除, 回肠切除, metformin, 长期质子泵抑制剂和萎缩性胃炎。就心血管预防而言 NEVER ON THIS AXIS; 甲基化循环中真正可纠正的是 folate, B12 与 B6 的营养状态, homocysteine 升高的意义在于提示去查这个状态。
items.source: Derived using this dataset's classification rules by combining the folate and B12 answers from Nutrients made by colonic bacteria (menaquinones, biotin, folate and vitamin B12) and BCAAs sold separately, and B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate and vitamin E, with the methionine cycle enzymology from S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe) (Mato, Martinez-Chantar & Lu, Semin Liver Dis 2010;30:180-197; Lu & Mato, Physiol Rev 2012;92:1515-1542) and Choline and betaine (TMG). No cardiovascular outcome trial data for this combination appears in the recovered prose, so none is quoted.

items.endogenous_note: Iron is chemical element 26, and no enzyme can build an element out of anything else, so every iron atom in haemoglobin arrived in food, water or a pill. The body compensates by hoarding: macrophages strip iron from dying red cells and return roughly 20-25 mg/d to plasma, while only about 1-2 mg/d is absorbed to cover obligatory losses. Recycling only reuses atoms already present, so iron supplements are never redundant on this axis and stand or fall entirely on measured status and losses, with no regulated route for excreting the surplus.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 铁是26号化学元素，没有任何酶能用别的物质造出一种元素，所以血红蛋白里的每一个铁原子都来自食物、水或药片。身体靠囤积来弥补：巨噬细胞从衰老红细胞中回收铁，每天向血浆返还大约 20-25 mg/d，而每天只吸收约 1-2 mg/d 来抵偿必然损失。回收只是重复利用体内已有的原子，因此在合成这一维度上补铁永远不算多余，其成立与否完全取决于实测的铁状态和损失量，而人体没有受调控的铁排泄途径，多余的铁只会积存下来。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE (chemical element, zero biosynthetic route). Downstream use only: haem is built in eight enzymatic steps split between two compartments, starting from glycine plus succinyl-CoA with ALAS2 in the erythroblast mitochondrion, continuing with ALAD, HMBS, UROS and UROD in the cytosol, then CPOX, PPOX and ferrochelatase (FECH) back in the mitochondrion, where the iron atom FECH inserts is entirely dietary. Absorption: duodenal cytochrome b (CYBRD1) reduces Fe3+, DMT1 (SLC11A2) carries Fe2+ into the enterocyte, and basolateral ferroportin (SLC40A1) exports it under hepcidin control, with ferritin as the store.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE（不适用：化学元素，没有任何生物合成途径）。只有下游利用：血红素由八步酶反应完成，分布在两个区室，起点是甘氨酸加琥珀酰辅酶A，第一步 ALAS2 位于成红细胞线粒体，随后 ALAD、HMBS、UROS、UROD 在胞质，再由 CPOX、PPOX 和亚铁螯合酶（FECH）回到线粒体，FECH 插入的那个铁原子完全来自膳食。肠腔侧吸收由十二指肠细胞色素 b（CYBRD1）把 Fe3+ 还原，DMT1（SLC11A2）把 Fe2+ 运进肠上皮细胞，基底侧由 ferroportin（SLC40A1）在 hepcidin 调控下外排，铁蛋白负责储存。
items.daily_amount: 0 mg/d synthesised. For scale, internal recycling returns about 20-25 mg Fe/d to plasma against obligatory losses of roughly 1-2 mg/d in adults; RDA 8 mg/d men, 18 mg/d premenopausal women.
items.daily_amount_zh: 合成量 0 mg/d。作为量级参照：体内回收每天向血浆返还约 20-25 mg Fe/d，成人必然损失约 1-2 mg/d；RDA 男性 8 mg/d，绝经前女性 18 mg/d。
items.still_matters_when: NEVER ON THIS AXIS as a redundancy argument, since synthesis is zero. Justification comes from intake or loss instead: menstrual or gastrointestinal blood loss, pregnancy, frequent blood donation, infant and adolescent growth, high-phytate or plant-based diets, malabsorption or post-bariatric surgery, documented low ferritin or transferrin saturation. Not justified in iron-replete adults, where surplus iron is stored and cannot be excreted.
items.still_matters_when_zh: NEVER ON THIS AXIS（在这一维度上永不成立）：合成为零，冗余论证无从谈起。理由只能来自摄入或损失：月经或胃肠道失血、妊娠、频繁献血、婴幼儿与青春期生长、高植酸或纯植物膳食、吸收不良或减重手术后、已记录的低铁蛋白或低转铁蛋白饱和度。铁储备充足的成人没有理由补，多出来的铁会被储存起来，排不出去。
items.source: Ganz T. Systemic iron homeostasis. Physiol Rev. 2013;93(4):1721-41. PMID 24137020, DOI 10.1152/physrev.00008.2013 (eight-enzyme haem pathway with mitochondrial and cytosolic steps, hepcidin and ferroportin control); IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin A, Vitamin K, Arsenic, Boron, Chromium, Copper, Iodine, Iron, Manganese, Molybdenum, Nickel, Silicon, Vanadium and Zinc (RDA 8 and 18 mg/d). Mapped from the recovered entry Iron, with transporter detail merged from the recovered mineral-element rows.

items.endogenous_note: Iodine is chemical element 53, so there is no synthetic route to it and thyroid hormone output falls when dietary supply stops. What the body does make is the hormone itself: thyroid peroxidase attaches dietary iodide to tyrosine residues on thyroglobulin to build T4 and T3, and deiodinases salvage iodide when hormone is degraded. The enzymatic machinery is endogenous while every iodine atom is dietary, so iodine supplementation is genuinely useful wherever intake is low and pointless once intake is adequate.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 碘是53号化学元素，不存在合成途径，膳食供应中断时甲状腺激素产量就会下降。身体自己造的是激素本身：甲状腺过氧化物酶把膳食碘化物接到甲状腺球蛋白的酪氨酸残基上，组装成 T4 和 T3，激素降解时脱碘酶再把碘化物回收。酶系统是内源的，而每个碘原子都来自膳食，所以在摄入不足的地方补碘确实有用，摄入充足之后补碘毫无意义。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE (chemical element). Downstream use only: the sodium-iodide symporter NIS (SLC5A5) traps iodide at the basolateral membrane of thyroid follicular cells, pendrin (SLC26A4) moves it across the apical membrane, DUOX2 with its maturation factor DUOXA2 supplies the H2O2 that thyroid peroxidase needs, and TPO iodinates thyroglobulin tyrosines in the follicular lumen. Salvage runs at two levels: iodotyrosine dehalogenase (IYD, also called DEHAL1) recovers iodide from MIT and DIT inside the follicular cell, while peripherally DIO1 is the main iodide-recycling deiodinase and DIO2 is the hormone-activating one.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE（不适用：化学元素）。只有下游利用：钠碘同向转运体 NIS（SLC5A5）在甲状腺滤泡细胞基底侧摄取碘化物，pendrin（SLC26A4）把它送过顶端膜，DUOX2 与其成熟因子 DUOXA2 提供甲状腺过氧化物酶所需的 H2O2，TPO 在滤泡腔内把甲状腺球蛋白的酪氨酸碘化。回收分两个层次：滤泡细胞内由碘酪氨酸脱卤酶（IYD，又称 DEHAL1）把 MIT 和 DIT 上的碘化物取回再用；外周则以 DIO1 为主要的碘回收脱碘酶，DIO2 是激素活化酶。
items.daily_amount: 0 µg/d synthesised. Reference points: thyroid iodine stores 15-20 mg in an iodine-sufficient adult; RDA 150 µg/d adults, 220 µg/d in pregnancy and 290 µg/d in lactation (IOM); WHO, UNICEF and ICCIDD recommend 250 µg/d in pregnancy and lactation; adult UL 1100 µg/d (IOM).
items.daily_amount_zh: 合成量 0 µg/d。参照点：碘充足成人的甲状腺碘储量 15-20 mg；RDA 成人 150 µg/d，妊娠 220 µg/d，哺乳 290 µg/d（IOM）；WHO、UNICEF 和 ICCIDD 建议妊娠与哺乳期均为 250 µg/d；成人 UL 1100 µg/d（IOM）。
items.still_matters_when: NEVER ON THIS AXIS. Justification is intake-based: pregnancy and lactation, diets excluding iodised salt, dairy and seafood (including many vegan diets), regions of endemic deficiency and goitre. Excess is actively harmful rather than merely wasteful, since high intakes can precipitate hypothyroidism or thyrotoxicosis (adult UL 1100 µg/d, IOM).
items.still_matters_when_zh: NEVER ON THIS AXIS（在这一维度上永不成立）。理由只能基于摄入：妊娠与哺乳、不含碘盐、乳制品和海产的膳食（包括许多纯素膳食）、地方性缺碘和地方性甲状腺肿地区。过量不只是浪费，还会直接造成伤害，高摄入可诱发甲状腺功能减退或甲状腺毒症（成人 UL 1100 µg/d，IOM）。
items.source: Zimmermann MB. Iodine deficiency. Endocr Rev. 2009;30(4):376-408. PMID 19460960, DOI 10.1210/er.2009-0011. DRI values (RDA 150, 220 and 290 µg/d; UL 1100 µg/d) from IOM; WHO, UNICEF and ICCIDD pregnancy and lactation figure 250 µg/d. Mapped from the recovered entry Iodine.

items.endogenous_note: Zinc is chemical element 30 and cannot be synthesised, so the many enzymes and transcription factors that depend on it require a continuous dietary supply, and there is no rapidly mobilisable store analogous to ferritin. Lozenges are a special case: they release ionic zinc into the mouth and throat for a local effect during a cold, so they act as a short-course topical drug and do not correct a systemic shortfall. With synthesis at zero zinc is never redundant on this axis, while long-term use at lozenge doses antagonises copper absorption and is harmful in its own right.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 锌是30号化学元素，无法合成，依赖它的众多酶和转录因子需要膳食持续供应，体内也没有类似铁蛋白那样可快速动员的专用储库。锭剂是特殊情形：它把离子锌释放到口腔和咽部，在感冒期间发挥局部作用，属于短程局部用药，并不纠正全身性不足。既然合成为零，在这一维度上锌永远不算多余，但按锭剂剂量长期服用会拮抗铜的吸收，本身就造成伤害。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE (chemical element). Transport and buffering only: ZIP family uptake transporters (SLC39, with ZIP4/SLC39A4 as the apical intestinal route lost in acrodermatitis enteropathica), ZnT efflux transporters (SLC30) and metallothionein binding, across intestine, liver and all tissues.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE（不适用：化学元素）。只有转运与缓冲：ZIP 家族摄取转运体（SLC39，其中 ZIP4/SLC39A4 是肠道顶端通路，肠病性肢端皮炎中功能丧失）、ZnT 外排转运体（SLC30）以及金属硫蛋白结合，分布于肠道、肝脏和所有组织。
items.daily_amount: 0 mg/d synthesised. Reference points: adult body content about 1.5-2.5 g, roughly 60% in skeletal muscle and 30% in bone; RDA 11 mg/d men, 8 mg/d women; UL 40 mg/d elemental zinc for adults, which most lozenge regimens exceed.
items.daily_amount_zh: 合成量 0 mg/d。参照点：成人体内含量约 1.5-2.5 g，约 60% 在骨骼肌，30% 在骨骼；RDA 男性 11 mg/d，女性 8 mg/d；成人元素锌 UL 40 mg/d，多数锭剂方案会超过这个上限。
items.still_matters_when: NEVER ON THIS AXIS. Justification is use-case or intake-based: documented deficiency, high-phytate or vegetarian diets, chronic diarrhoea, inflammatory bowel disease or post-bariatric malabsorption, sickle cell disease, acrodermatitis enteropathica (ZIP4/SLC39A4 loss of function, which needs systemic zinc salts and cannot be treated with lozenges), pregnancy and lactation. The common cold use case is contested: the Cochrane review Zinc for the common cold was retracted (PMID 25924708) and later reviews have been publicly challenged (Hemilä and Chalker, PMID 39478818 and PMID 40680659), so the evidence should be described as unsettled.
items.still_matters_when_zh: NEVER ON THIS AXIS（在这一维度上永不成立）。理由基于具体用途或摄入：已确诊的缺乏、高植酸或素食膳食、慢性腹泻、炎症性肠病或减重手术后吸收不良、镰状细胞病、肠病性肢端皮炎（ZIP4/SLC39A4 功能丧失，需要全身性锌盐，锭剂无法治疗）、妊娠与哺乳。感冒起病时短程使用这一用途的证据存在争议：Cochrane 综述 Zinc for the common cold 已撤稿（PMID 25924708），后续综述也受到公开质疑（Hemilä 与 Chalker，PMID 39478818 和 PMID 40680659），因此应说明证据尚未定论。
items.source: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Zinc Fact Sheet for Health Professionals (RDA 11/8 mg/d and UL 40 mg/d from IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin A, Vitamin K, Arsenic, Boron, Chromium, Copper, Iodine, Iron, Manganese, Molybdenum, Nickel, Silicon, Vanadium and Zinc); retracted Cochrane review PMID 25924708; Hemilä and Chalker PMID 39478818 and PMID 40680659. Mapped from the recovered entry Zinc lozenges.

items.endogenous_note: Selenium is chemical element 34, so none of it can be made, although its functional form is partly homemade: the body builds selenocysteine on its own tRNA and inserts it at recoded UGA codons, using selenium supplied entirely by diet. At 200 µg/d the limiting issue is saturation, since selenoprotein P was optimised at an estimated intake of 49 µg/d in 98 healthy Chinese adults whose baseline intake was only 14 µg/d, and 75 µg Se/d as l-selenomethionine is postulated rather than measured to allow full selenoprotein expression in US residents, so the extra 125 to 150 µg buys no further selenoprotein. Supplementing at this dose therefore makes sense only for documented deficiency, and above the plateau the dose is pharmacological, with type 2 diabetes incidence raised in the Nutritional Prevention of Cancer trial (overall hazard ratio 1.55) and high-grade prostate cancer in SELECT.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 硒是34号化学元素，本身完全无法合成，但它的功能形式部分是体内自制的：身体在自己的 tRNA 上组装硒代半胱氨酸，并把它插入被重新编码的 UGA 密码子，所用的硒全部来自膳食。在 200 µg/d 这个剂量上，关键问题是饱和：硒蛋白 P 在 98 名基线摄入仅 14 µg/d 的健康中国成年人中，估计摄入 49 µg/d 即可达到最优，而以 l-硒代甲硫氨酸形式 75 µg Se/d 可让美国居民完整表达硒蛋白（这是推定值，并非实测值），所以多出来的 125 至 150 µg 换不来更多硒蛋白。因此这个剂量只有在已确诊缺乏时才说得通，超过平台之后剂量已属药理范畴：Nutritional Prevention of Cancer 试验中2型糖尿病发生率升高（总体风险比 1.55），SELECT 中高级别前列腺癌增加。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for the element. For its functional form: dietary selenomethionine or selenite is reduced to selenide, SEPHS2 (with SEPHS1) makes selenophosphate, seryl-tRNA synthetase charges tRNA[Ser]Sec with serine, PSTK (phosphoseryl-tRNA kinase) phosphorylates it, SEPSECS converts O-phosphoseryl-tRNA[Ser]Sec to Sec-tRNA[Ser]Sec, and the SECIS-dependent recoding machinery (SECISBP2 with the dedicated elongation factor EEFSEC) inserts selenocysteine at UGA codons. Products include GPX1-4 and GPX6, TXNRD1-3, the deiodinases DIO1-3 and SELENOP as the plasma transport form.
items.pathway_zh: 对元素本身 NOT APPLICABLE（不适用）。对其功能形式：膳食中的硒代甲硫氨酸或亚硒酸盐先被还原为硒化物，SEPHS2（连同 SEPHS1）生成硒磷酸，丝氨酰-tRNA 合成酶把丝氨酸装载到 tRNA[Ser]Sec 上，PSTK（磷酸丝氨酰-tRNA 激酶）将其磷酸化，SEPSECS 把 O-磷酸丝氨酰-tRNA[Ser]Sec 转变为 Sec-tRNA[Ser]Sec，依赖 SECIS 的重编码机器（SECISBP2 及专用延伸因子 EEFSEC）把硒代半胱氨酸插入 UGA 密码子。产物包括 GPX1-4 和 GPX6、TXNRD1-3、脱碘酶 DIO1-3，以及作为血浆转运形式的 SELENOP。
items.daily_amount: 0 µg/d of the element. Mass of selenocysteine synthesised per day: NOT ESTABLISHED. Reference points: RDA 55 µg/d; selenoprotein P optimised at an estimated intake of about 49 µg/d in selenium-deficient Chinese adults (baseline 14 µg/d), about 75 µg/d postulated for full selenoprotein expression in US residents; UL 400 µg/d, based on selenosis as the critical adverse effect.
items.daily_amount_zh: 元素本身 0 µg/d。每日合成的硒代半胱氨酸质量：NOT ESTABLISHED（未确立）。参照点：RDA 55 µg/d；在缺硒的中国成年人中（基线 14 µg/d），估计摄入约 49 µg/d 可使硒蛋白 P 达到最优，约 75 µg/d 为美国居民完整表达硒蛋白的推定值；UL 400 µg/d，依据的关键不良效应是硒中毒。
items.still_matters_when: Justified only by low intake or loss: selenium-poor soil regions (historic Keshan and Kashin-Beck disease areas, parts of China, historically Finland), long-term parenteral nutrition without selenium, severe malabsorption, some critical-illness protocols under clinician direction. In all of those, doses near 50 to 75 µg/d cover the requirement, so 200 µg/d sits above the useful range for repletion and carries a documented metabolic and oncological cost in the already-replete: diabetes incidence in NPC and high-grade prostate cancer in SELECT.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 只有低摄入或额外损失才构成理由：土壤缺硒地区（历史上的克山病和大骨节病地区、中国部分地区、历史上的芬兰）、长期不含硒的肠外营养、严重吸收不良、临床医生指导下的部分危重症方案。在这些情形中，接近 50 至 75 µg/d 的剂量即可满足需要，因此 200 µg/d 高于补足所需的有用范围，对已经充足的人还带有明确的代谢和肿瘤学代价：NPC 试验中的糖尿病发生率，以及 SELECT 中的高级别前列腺癌。
items.source: Xia Y, Hill KE, Li P, et al. Am J Clin Nutr. 2010;92(3):525-31. PMID 20573787, DOI 10.3945/ajcn.2010.29642 (98 healthy Chinese adults, baseline intake 14 µg/d, selenoprotein P optimised at an estimated 49 µg/d, 75 µg/d postulated for US residents); IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin C, Vitamin E, Selenium, and Carotenoids (2000), selenium chapter, NCBI Bookshelf NBK225470 (RDA 55 µg/d, UL 400 µg/d with selenosis as the critical effect); NPC and SELECT trial results. Merged from the recovered entries Selenium at 200 µg/d and Selenium (element).

items.endogenous_note: Magnesium is chemical element 12 and cannot be synthesised, so all of the roughly 25 g in an adult body came from food. Bone holds 50 to 60% of it and the kidney adjusts reabsorption tightly, which buffers short-term intake gaps and is also why serum magnesium is a poor guide to total body stores. With synthesis at zero, the only question is whether habitual intake, drug use or renal and gastrointestinal losses justify supplementing, and for a large share of the population intake alone does.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 镁是12号化学元素，无法合成，成人体内约 25 g 镁全部来自食物。骨骼中占其 50 至 60%，肾脏对重吸收有紧密调节，这既缓冲了短期摄入缺口，也是血清镁不能代表全身储量的原因。合成为零，剩下的问题只有：习惯摄入量、用药、肾脏和胃肠道损失是否构成补充的理由。对相当大一部分人群来说，仅摄入量这一条就已经构成理由。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE (chemical element). Handling only: TRPM6 and TRPM7 channels for intestinal and distal tubular uptake, with TRPM6 activity regulated by EGF acting through EGFR, efflux by the CNNM proteins (CNNM2 in kidney and brain, CNNM4 in intestine) and SLC41, paracellular reabsorption through claudin-16 and claudin-19 in the thick ascending limb, and bone as the exchangeable reservoir.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE（不适用：化学元素）。只有体内处理：TRPM6 和 TRPM7 通道负责肠道和肾远曲小管的摄取，其中 TRPM6 的活性受 EGF 经 EGFR 调节；外排由 CNNM 蛋白（肾和脑中的 CNNM2，肠道中的 CNNM4）和 SLC41 承担；肾脏髓袢升支粗段通过 claudin-16 和 claudin-19 进行细胞旁重吸收；骨骼充当可交换储库。
items.daily_amount: 0 mg/d synthesised. Reference points: adult body content about 25 g, 50 to 60% of it in bone; RDA 400-420 mg/d men and 310-320 mg/d women; UL 350 mg/d for supplemental magnesium only, with food magnesium uncapped.
items.daily_amount_zh: 合成量 0 mg/d。参照点：成人体内含量约 25 g，其中 50 至 60% 在骨骼；RDA 男性 400-420 mg/d，女性 310-320 mg/d；UL 350 mg/d 只针对补充剂形式的镁，食物中的镁不设上限。
items.still_matters_when: Justified by intake or loss: habitual intake below the EAR, proton pump inhibitors, loop and thiazide diuretics, chronic alcohol use, type 2 diabetes, Crohn disease or coeliac disease, refeeding, documented hypomagnesaemia. Not justified as a routine add-on on an already adequate diet, where the main effect of surplus oral magnesium salts is osmotic diarrhoea.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 摄入或损失构成理由：习惯摄入低于 EAR、质子泵抑制剂、袢利尿剂和噻嗪类利尿剂、长期饮酒、2型糖尿病、克罗恩病或乳糜泻、再喂养、已记录的低镁血症。膳食本已充足时把它当常规附加品没有依据，多余的口服镁盐主要造成渗透性腹泻。
items.source: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Magnesium Fact Sheet for Health Professionals; IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium, Phosphorus, Magnesium, Vitamin D and Fluoride (RDA values and the 350 mg/d UL for supplemental magnesium). Mapped from the recovered entry Magnesium.

items.supplement: Calcium supplements on top of an adequate diet
items.endogenous_note: Calcium is chemical element 20, so none of the 1000 to 1200 g in an adult skeleton is manufactured and all of it is dietary in origin. The body defends blood calcium hard through PTH, calcitriol and bone turnover, and part of that defence is throttling absorption, since fractional intestinal absorption falls as intake rises, so a supplement added to an already adequate intake is absorbed inefficiently and largely excreted. That raised urinary calcium is the mechanism behind the excess kidney stones in the Women's Health Initiative calcium plus vitamin D trial (hazard ratio 1.17, 95% CI 1.02 to 1.34), so on an adequate diet the net account is a limited skeletal gain set against a real stone risk.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 钙是20号化学元素，成人骨骼中 1000 至 1200 g 钙没有一克是体内制造的，全部来自膳食。身体通过 PTH、骨化三醇和骨转换严密维持血钙，其中一环就是抑制吸收：摄入升高时肠道分数吸收率随之下降，因此在摄入已经充足的基础上再补钙，吸收效率低且大部分被排出。尿钙升高正是 Women's Health Initiative 钙加维生素D试验中肾结石增多的机制（风险比 1.17，95% CI 1.02 至 1.34），所以膳食充足时的总账是一点有限的骨骼收益，对应一份真实的结石风险。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE (chemical element). Handling only: TRPV6-mediated and paracellular intestinal absorption under calcitriol control (renal CYP27B1), with cytosolic shuttling by calbindin-D9k and basolateral export by NCX1 and PMCA1b, bone remodelling as the reservoir, and TRPV5-mediated renal reabsorption, all governed by PTH, the calcium-sensing receptor and FGF23.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE（不适用：化学元素）。只有体内处理：肠道经 TRPV6 和细胞旁途径吸收，受骨化三醇（肾脏 CYP27B1）调控，胞内由 calbindin-D9k 转运，基底侧由 NCX1 和 PMCA1b 输出；骨重建充当储库；肾脏经 TRPV5 重吸收。整个过程受 PTH、钙敏感受体和 FGF23 支配。
items.daily_amount: 0 mg/d synthesised. Reference points: adult skeletal content 1000-1200 g; RDA 1000 mg/d for adults 19-50 and men to 70, 1200 mg/d for women 51 and over and men 71 and over; UL 2000-2500 mg/d depending on age.
items.daily_amount_zh: 合成量 0 mg/d。参照点：成人骨骼含钙 1000-1200 g；RDA 19-50 岁成人及 70 岁以下男性 1000 mg/d，51 岁及以上女性和 71 岁及以上男性 1200 mg/d；UL 按年龄为 2000-2500 mg/d。
items.still_matters_when: Justified when intake is genuinely short or handling is broken: habitual intake below the EAR (common in older women and dairy avoiders), osteoporosis pharmacotherapy that presumes a calcium and vitamin D floor, hypoparathyroidism, malabsorption, chronic corticosteroid therapy, chronic kidney disease under specialist direction. On an adequate diet the marginal supplement adds little and carries stone risk, so food first is the better route; where a supplement is genuinely needed, the benefit in the WHI adherent-population analysis appeared at 1000 mg/d elemental calcium plus 400 IU vitamin D3 (hip BMD +1.06%, P<0.01; hip fracture hazard ratio 0.71, 95% CI 0.52 to 0.97).
items.still_matters_when_zh: 摄入确实不足或体内处理出问题时才有理由：习惯摄入低于 EAR（老年女性和回避乳制品者常见）、以钙和维生素D达标为前提的骨质疏松药物治疗、甲状旁腺功能低下、吸收不良、长期糖皮质激素治疗、专科指导下的慢性肾病。膳食充足时边际补充作用很小，还带来结石风险，食物优先是更好的路径；确需补充时，WHI 依从人群分析中的收益出现在 1000 mg/d 元素钙加 400 IU 维生素D3 这一剂量（髋部骨密度 +1.06%，P<0.01；髋部骨折风险比 0.71，95% CI 0.52 至 0.97）。
items.source: IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium and Vitamin D (2011), National Academies Press, NCBI Bookshelf NBK56070 (DRI values, adaptive fall in fractional absorption); Women's Health Initiative calcium plus vitamin D trial (36,282 postmenopausal women, 1000 mg elemental calcium as carbonate plus 400 IU vitamin D3, 7.0 years; kidney stones hazard ratio 1.17, 95% CI 1.02 to 1.34; hip BMD +1.06%, P<0.01; hip fracture in the adherent analysis hazard ratio 0.71, 95% CI 0.52 to 0.97). Mapped from the recovered entry of the same name.

items.endogenous_note: Humans can make EPA and DHA, yet only by remodelling a fatty acid they cannot make at all, the plant-derived precursor ALA, and the final steps are the bottleneck. In stable-isotope tracer work the fraction of ingested ALA reaching EPA is 21% in young women, while DHA reaches 9% in young women and stays undetectable in young men for 21 days after dosing, and FADS1 and FADS2 genotype is the largest single modifier between individuals. Because the pathway cannot be driven harder, tissue DHA tracks intake of preformed DHA and barely responds to ALA, so preformed EPA and DHA is one of the few supplements the endogenous route genuinely cannot make redundant.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 人体能合成 EPA 和 DHA，但只能通过改造一种自己完全无法合成的脂肪酸，即来自植物的前体 ALA，而最后几步是瓶颈。稳定同位素示踪研究显示，摄入的 ALA 转化到 EPA 的比例在年轻女性中为 21%，到 DHA 在年轻女性中为 9%，在年轻男性中给药后 21 天内始终检测不到，而 FADS1 和 FADS2 基因型是个体间转化效率最大的单一修饰因素。由于这条通路无法被推得更快，组织 DHA 跟随现成 DHA 的摄入变化，对 ALA 几乎没有反应，所以现成的 EPA 和 DHA 属于少数几种内源途径确实无法使之变得多余的补充剂。
items.pathway: ALA 18:3n-3 → FADS2 (delta-6 desaturase) → 18:4n-3 → ELOVL5 → 20:4n-3 → FADS1 (delta-5 desaturase) → EPA 20:5n-3 → ELOVL5 and ELOVL2 → DPA 22:5n-3 → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2 again (delta-6, the same enzyme reused) → 24:6n-3 → one round of peroxisomal beta-oxidation (ACOX1, D-bifunctional protein) → DHA 22:6n-3, then re-esterified in the endoplasmic reticulum. Mainly hepatic; linoleic acid competes for the same FADS2 step.
items.pathway_zh: ALA 18:3n-3 → FADS2（delta-6 去饱和酶）→ 18:4n-3 → ELOVL5 → 20:4n-3 → FADS1（delta-5 去饱和酶）→ EPA 20:5n-3 → ELOVL5 和 ELOVL2 → DPA 22:5n-3 → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → 再次用 FADS2（delta-6，同一个酶重复使用）→ 24:6n-3 → 一轮过氧化物酶体 beta 氧化（ACOX1，D-双功能蛋白）→ DHA 22:6n-3，随后在内质网重新酯化。主要发生在肝脏；亚油酸在同一个 FADS2 步骤上与之竞争。
items.daily_amount: Established as fractional conversion of ALA rather than as mg/d, and the figures are not commensurable because the denominators differ. Burdge and Wootton 2002: net fractional interconversion estimated within the plasma tracer pool (phosphatidylcholine, TAG and non-esterified fatty acids) over 21 days after a single 700 mg dose of 13C-ALA, young women EPA 21%, DPA 6%, DHA 9%. Burdge, Jones and Wootton 2002: in young men EPA and DPA appear while DHA stays undetectable to 21 days. Absolute mg/d of endogenous EPA and DHA: NOT ESTABLISHED.
items.daily_amount_zh: 这一项以 ALA 的分数转化率而非 mg/d 确立，下面几组数值的分母不同，彼此不可直接比较。Burdge 与 Wootton 2002：单次 700 mg 13C-ALA 给药后 21 天内，在血浆示踪池（磷脂酰胆碱、TAG 和非酯化脂肪酸）中估算的净分数转化，年轻女性 EPA 21%，DPA 6%，DHA 9%。Burdge、Jones 与 Wootton 2002：年轻男性只出现 EPA 和 DPA，21 天内检测不到 DHA。内源 EPA 和 DHA 的绝对量（mg/d）：NOT ESTABLISHED（未确立）。
items.still_matters_when: Justified for anyone not eating oily fish, and specifically in pregnancy and lactation for fetal and infant DHA accretion, in vegans and vegetarians, in adult men whose measured ALA to DHA conversion is effectively nil, and at pharmacological doses for hypertriglyceridaemia. Partial synthesis does not cover requirement here, so the supplement is doing real work.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 不吃多脂鱼的人都有理由使用，尤其是妊娠和哺乳期（为胎儿和婴儿累积 DHA）、纯素和素食者、实测 ALA 转 DHA 基本为零的成年男性，以及以药理剂量治疗高甘油三酯血症。部分合成在这里不足以覆盖需要量，补充剂确实在起作用。
items.source: Burdge GC, Wootton SA. Br J Nutr. 2002;88(4):411-20. PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689 (women: EPA 21%, DPA 6%, DHA 9%). Burdge GC, Jones AE, Wootton SA. Br J Nutr. 2002;88(4):355-63. PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002662 (men). Mapped from the recovered entry Omega-3 (EPA and DHA), with the men's citation completed from the parallel recovered omega-3 rows.

items.endogenous_note: Taken as a product the roll-up is PARTIAL, because its main actives are the same EPA and DHA the body can only build partially from dietary ALA, with limited EPA synthesis and DHA synthesis that is undetectable in young men. The exception is astaxanthin, which is NONE: vertebrates including humans have no carotenoid biosynthetic pathway and can only cleave or modify what they eat, unlike aphids, spider mites and some other arthropods that synthesise carotenoids using horizontally transferred genes. Nothing in the product duplicates something the body already makes in quantity, so the real caveat is dose rather than redundancy, since krill oil carries less EPA and DHA per gram than concentrated fish or algal oil and the milligrams on the label matter more than the phospholipid-form claim.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 作为产品整体判为 PARTIAL，因为它的主要活性成分就是身体只能从膳食 ALA 部分合成的 EPA 和 DHA：EPA 合成有限，DHA 合成在年轻男性中检测不到。例外是虾青素，它属于 NONE，脊椎动物（包括人）不具备类胡萝卜素生物合成通路，只能对吃进来的类胡萝卜素做裂解或修饰，而蚜虫、叶螨和另一些节肢动物则通过横向转移获得的基因能够从头合成。产品中没有任何成分重复身体已能充分制造的物质，所以真正需要提醒的是剂量而非冗余：磷虾油每克所含的 EPA 和 DHA 少于浓缩鱼油或藻油，标签上的毫克数比磷脂形式这套说法更重要。
items.pathway: For EPA and DHA, the same hepatic cascade as any omega-3: ALA → FADS2 (delta-6) → ELOVL5 → FADS1 (delta-5) → EPA → ELOVL5 and ELOVL2 → DPA → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2 (delta-6) → 24:6n-3 → peroxisomal beta-oxidation → DHA. The Sprecher C24 route is the principal and rate-limiting mammalian pathway; a direct delta-4 desaturase activity of the FADS2 product has been demonstrated in human cells, with its in vivo contribution not established. For astaxanthin: NOT APPLICABLE, humans have no carotenoid biosynthetic pathway and only cleave or modify dietary carotenoids.
items.pathway_zh: EPA 和 DHA 走与其他 omega-3 相同的肝内级联：ALA → FADS2（delta-6）→ ELOVL5 → FADS1（delta-5）→ EPA → ELOVL5 和 ELOVL2 → DPA → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2（delta-6）→ 24:6n-3 → 过氧化物酶体 beta 氧化 → DHA。Sprecher 的 C24 路线是哺乳动物的主要限速通路；FADS2 产物在人细胞中已被证实具有直接的 delta-4 去饱和酶活性，其体内定量贡献尚未确立。虾青素：NOT APPLICABLE（不适用），人体没有类胡萝卜素生物合成通路，只能裂解或修饰膳食中的类胡萝卜素。
items.daily_amount: Same conversion figures as for preformed EPA and DHA, with the same denominator caveat: EPA 21% and DHA 9% of ingested ALA as net fractional interconversion in the plasma tracer pool in young women, DHA undetectable in young men over 21 days, while studies expressing product formation as a proportion of total dietary ALA report DHA under 0.1% and under 0.01%. Endogenous astaxanthin 0 mg/d, and it has no reference intake.
items.daily_amount_zh: 转化数值与现成 EPA 和 DHA 相同，分母提醒也相同：在年轻女性血浆示踪池中，摄入 ALA 的净分数转化为 EPA 21%、DHA 9%；年轻男性 21 天内检测不到 DHA；而以占膳食 ALA 总量比例表达产物生成的研究给出 DHA 低于 0.1% 和低于 0.01%。内源虾青素 0 mg/d，它也没有参考摄入量。
items.still_matters_when: The same situations as preformed EPA and DHA: low or no oily fish intake, pregnancy and lactation, and adult men targeting DHA status. Astaxanthin has no established human requirement, so on this axis it is an added antioxidant claim rather than the correction of any deficit.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 适用情形与现成 EPA 和 DHA 相同：多脂鱼摄入很少或没有、妊娠与哺乳、以 DHA 水平为目标的成年男性。虾青素没有已确立的人体需要量，在这一维度上它属于附加的抗氧化宣称，谈不上纠正任何不足。
items.source: Conversion data: PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689 and PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002662. Absence of vertebrate carotenoid biosynthesis, cleavage-only metabolism in humans, and horizontally transferred carotenoid genes in aphids and spider mites. Mapped from the recovered entry Krill oil; the multi-part verdict in that entry is rolled up to PARTIAL here and the astaxanthin exception is stated in the note.

items.endogenous_note: As a product the roll-up is PARTIAL, since cod liver oil bundles three actives with three different verdicts and the body covers only part of what is in the bottle. Its EPA and DHA are partly synthesisable from dietary ALA (PARTIAL), its vitamin D3 is genuinely manufactured in your own skin from 7-dehydrocholesterol whenever UVB reaches it, with cutaneous synthesis alone able to meet requirement and no risk of toxicity because previtamin D3 photodegrades and CYP24A1 clears the active hormone (FULL, conditional on exposure), and its retinol cannot be built at all because human cells only cleave dietary provitamin A carotenoids (NONE). For anyone with real sun exposure the redundant part is the vitamin D, and the retinol load makes this a poor carrier, since plain D3 plus fish or algal oil gives the same benefit without pushing retinol towards the upper limit.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 作为产品整体判为 PARTIAL：鱼肝油把三种活性成分捆在一起，三者的结论各不相同，身体只能覆盖瓶子里的一部分。它的 EPA 和 DHA 只能从膳食 ALA 部分合成（PARTIAL）；它的维生素D3 确实由自己的皮肤用 7-脱氢胆固醇制造，只要 UVB 照到皮肤，单靠皮肤合成就能满足需要量，而且不会中毒，因为前维生素D3 会光降解，CYP24A1 会清除活性激素（FULL，以有日照为条件）；它的视黄醇则完全无法从头合成，人体细胞只能裂解膳食中的维生素A原类胡萝卜素（NONE）。因此对真正有日照的人来说，多余的那部分是维生素D，而视黄醇负荷让鱼肝油成为一个糟糕的载体：单纯的 D3 加鱼油或藻油能提供同样的好处，又不会把视黄醇推向上限。
items.pathway: EPA and DHA: FADS2 (delta-6) → ELOVL5 → FADS1 (delta-5) → EPA → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2 (delta-6) → 24:6n-3 → peroxisomal beta-oxidation → DHA, in hepatocytes; the Sprecher C24 route is the principal and rate-limiting mammalian pathway, and a direct delta-4 desaturase activity of the FADS2 product has been demonstrated in human cells with the in vivo contribution not established. Vitamin D3: epidermal 7-dehydrocholesterol → UVB photolysis → previtamin D3 → thermal isomerisation to vitamin D3 → hepatic 25-hydroxylation (CYP2R1) → renal 1-alpha-hydroxylation (CYP27B1) to calcitriol, with CYP24A1 as the clearance route. Retinol: NOT APPLICABLE, human cells only cleave dietary provitamin A carotenoids (BCO1).
items.pathway_zh: EPA 和 DHA：在肝细胞内 FADS2（delta-6）→ ELOVL5 → FADS1（delta-5）→ EPA → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2（delta-6）→ 24:6n-3 → 过氧化物酶体 beta 氧化 → DHA；Sprecher 的 C24 路线是哺乳动物的主要限速通路，FADS2 产物在人细胞中已被证实有直接的 delta-4 去饱和酶活性，体内定量贡献尚未确立。维生素D3：表皮 7-脱氢胆固醇 → UVB 光解 → 前维生素D3 → 热异构化为维生素D3 → 肝脏 25-羟化（CYP2R1）→ 肾脏 1-alpha-羟化（CYP27B1）生成骨化三醇，CYP24A1 负责清除。视黄醇：NOT APPLICABLE（不适用），人体细胞只能裂解膳食中的维生素A原类胡萝卜素（BCO1）。
items.daily_amount: Cutaneous vitamin D3 output varies with latitude, season, time of day, skin pigmentation and exposed surface area, so no single figure applies, but figures do exist: whole-body exposure to one minimal erythemal dose of UVB is equivalent to roughly 10,000-25,000 IU (250-625 µg) vitamin D3. Endogenous retinol 0 µg/d. EPA and DHA are conversion rather than synthesis: EPA 21% and DHA 9% of ingested ALA in young women, DHA undetectable in young men over 21 days; absolute mg/d NOT ESTABLISHED.
items.daily_amount_zh: 皮肤维生素D3 产量随纬度、季节、时段、皮肤色素和暴露面积变化，没有单一数值适用于所有情况，但确实存在可用数字：全身暴露于一个最小红斑剂量的 UVB 相当于大约 10,000-25,000 IU（250-625 µg）维生素D3。内源视黄醇 0 µg/d。EPA 和 DHA 是转化而非合成：年轻女性摄入 ALA 的 21% 到达 EPA，9% 到达 DHA，年轻男性 21 天内检测不到 DHA；绝对量（mg/d）NOT ESTABLISHED（未确立）。
items.still_matters_when: Justified where sun exposure is genuinely low (winter at high latitude, covered skin, housebound or institutionalised, darker skin at high latitude) together with low fish intake. Not justified as a routine high-dose vitamin A source, and specifically to be avoided at high retinol doses in pregnancy because of teratogenicity, where separate D3 plus fish or algal oil is the cleaner choice.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 日照确实很少（高纬度冬季、皮肤被遮盖、居家不出或住在机构、高纬度地区深色皮肤）并且鱼类摄入很低时才有理由使用。把它当作常规高剂量维生素A来源没有依据；妊娠期尤其要避免高剂量视黄醇，因为有致畸性，此时分开使用 D3 加鱼油或藻油是更干净的选择。
items.source: Holick MF. Vitamin D deficiency. N Engl J Med. 2007;357(3):266-81. PMID 17634462, DOI 10.1056/NEJMra070553 (cutaneous synthesis, hydroxylation steps, roughly 10,000-25,000 IU per minimal erythemal dose); conversion data PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689 and PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002662; IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium and Vitamin D (2011). Mapped from the recovered entry Cod liver oil; its three-part verdict is rolled up to PARTIAL here with the split named in the note.

items.supplement: ALA from flaxseed, chia or walnut oil
items.endogenous_note: The verdict for the substance actually in the bottle is NONE: humans lack the omega-3 (delta-15) desaturase that plants have, so ALA synthesis is zero, exactly as it is for the chemical elements. The exception is downstream, where the products people buy flax, chia or walnut oil for are PARTIAL: 21% of a labelled ALA dose reaches EPA and 9% reaches DHA in young women, while in young men EPA and DPA appear and DHA stays undetectable for 21 days, and most of the dose is simply burned as fuel. A precursor the body cannot make plus a conversion step that mostly fails means these oils are a defensible source of ALA itself and an unreliable route to DHA.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 瓶子里那种物质的结论是 NONE：人体缺少植物拥有的 omega-3（delta-15）去饱和酶，ALA 合成为零，与化学元素的判定一致。例外在下游，人们买亚麻籽油、奇亚籽油或核桃油真正想要的产物属于 PARTIAL：年轻女性中标记 ALA 剂量的 21% 到达 EPA，9% 到达 DHA；年轻男性中出现 EPA 和 DPA，21 天内检测不到 DHA，而大部分剂量直接被当燃料烧掉。前体身体无法合成，转化步骤又大半落空，所以这类油作为 ALA 本身的来源站得住，作为 DHA 的途径并不可靠。
items.pathway: ALA 18:3n-3 → FADS2 (delta-6) → 18:4n-3 → ELOVL5 → 20:4n-3 → FADS1 (delta-5) → EPA 20:5n-3 → ELOVL5 and ELOVL2 → DPA 22:5n-3 → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2 again (delta-6) → 24:6n-3 → peroxisomal beta-oxidation → DHA 22:6n-3, mainly in hepatocyte ER and peroxisome. The Sprecher C24 route is the principal and rate-limiting mammalian pathway. For ALA itself: NOT APPLICABLE, humans have no omega-3 (delta-15) desaturase, so the 18-carbon precursor is strictly dietary.
items.pathway_zh: ALA 18:3n-3 → FADS2（delta-6）→ 18:4n-3 → ELOVL5 → 20:4n-3 → FADS1（delta-5）→ EPA 20:5n-3 → ELOVL5 和 ELOVL2 → DPA 22:5n-3 → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → 再次用 FADS2（delta-6）→ 24:6n-3 → 过氧化物酶体 beta 氧化 → DHA 22:6n-3，主要发生在肝细胞内质网和过氧化物酶体。Sprecher 的 C24 路线是哺乳动物的主要限速通路。ALA 本身：NOT APPLICABLE（不适用），人体没有 omega-3（delta-15）去饱和酶，这个 18 碳前体只能来自膳食。
items.daily_amount: Endogenous synthesis of ALA itself: 0 mg/d. Net fractional conversion of ingested ALA within the plasma tracer pool over 21 days, young women: EPA 21%, DPA 6%, DHA 9%; in young men EPA and DPA only, with DHA undetectable to 21 days. Studies using total dietary ALA as the denominator report DHA under 0.1% (controlled-diet tracer study) and under 0.01% (hyperlipidaemic men), which is not the same measurement as the 9%. About 33% of the tracer appears as breath 13CO2 within 24 hours in men and about 22% in women; doubling dietary linoleic acid from 15 g/d to 30 g/d lowers conversion of the labelled 18:3n-3 and 18:2n-6 tracers by 40 to 54%.
items.daily_amount_zh: ALA 本身的内源合成量：0 mg/d。摄入 ALA 在血浆示踪池中 21 天内的净分数转化，年轻女性：EPA 21%，DPA 6%，DHA 9%；年轻男性只有 EPA 和 DPA，21 天内检测不到 DHA。以膳食 ALA 总量作分母的研究报告 DHA 低于 0.1%（受控膳食示踪研究）和低于 0.01%（高脂血症男性），这与 9% 测的不是同一件事。男性 24 小时内约 33% 的示踪剂以呼气 13CO2 形式出现，女性约 22%；把膳食亚油酸从 15 g/d 加倍到 30 g/d，会使标记的 18:3n-3 和 18:2n-6 示踪剂转化下降 40 至 54%。
items.still_matters_when: Justified as a source of the essential fatty acid ALA itself, which the body cannot make at all, as a plant n-3 baseline for vegans without access to algal oil, and where EPA rather than DHA is the target. Not adequate as the DHA source in pregnancy, lactation, infancy or for adult men, and its already small effect shrinks further as linoleic acid intake rises.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 作为必需脂肪酸 ALA 本身的来源是成立的，身体完全无法合成它；对拿不到藻油的纯素者，它可以作为植物性 n-3 的基础供给；目标是 EPA 而非 DHA 时也成立。在妊娠、哺乳、婴儿期或对成年男性，它不足以充当 DHA 来源；随着亚油酸摄入升高，它本来就不大的作用还会进一步缩小。
items.source: Burdge GC, Wootton SA. Br J Nutr. 2002;88(4):411-20. PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689 (women: EPA 21%, DPA 6%, DHA 9%; 22% breath 13CO2). Burdge GC, Jones AE, Wootton SA. Br J Nutr. 2002;88(4):355-63. PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002662 (men, 33% breath 13CO2, DHA undetectable). Mapped from the recovered entry of the same name; its two-part verdict is rolled up to NONE for the substance supplied, with the PARTIAL downstream arm named in the note.

items.endogenous_note: Algal oil delivers preformed DHA, and in newer products EPA as well, which is precisely the step human metabolism cannot deliver: the ELOVL2 elongation and second FADS2 desaturation that carry EPA through to DHA are the rate-limiting stretch, yielding 9% conversion in young women and nothing measurable in young men. Plasma and tissue DHA rise dose-dependently with preformed DHA and hardly at all with ALA, so taking DHA directly bypasses the bottleneck instead of duplicating something the body already does well. That makes algal oil a defensible supplement for anyone off oily fish, with plasma DHA approaching a maximum response at about 2 g/d.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 藻油提供现成 DHA，新一代产品还含 EPA，而这恰好是人体代谢无法完成的那一步：把 EPA 推到 DHA 的 ELOVL2 延长和第二次 FADS2 去饱和是限速段，年轻女性的转化率为 9%，年轻男性测不到。血浆和组织 DHA 随现成 DHA 剂量上升，对 ALA 几乎没有反应，所以直接补 DHA 是绕过瓶颈，并没有重复身体本来就做得好的事情。因此对不吃多脂鱼的人，藻油是站得住的补充剂，血浆 DHA 在约 2 g/d 附近接近最大反应。
items.pathway: The endogenous route the product bypasses: ALA → FADS2 (delta-6) → 18:4n-3 → ELOVL5 → 20:4n-3 → FADS1 (delta-5) → EPA → ELOVL5 and ELOVL2 → DPA → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2 (delta-6) → 24:6n-3 → peroxisomal beta-oxidation → DHA, in hepatocytes. The Sprecher C24 route is the principal and rate-limiting mammalian pathway; a direct delta-4 desaturase activity of the FADS2 product has been demonstrated in human cells, with the in vivo contribution not established.
items.pathway_zh: 产品绕过的内源途径：在肝细胞内 ALA → FADS2（delta-6）→ 18:4n-3 → ELOVL5 → 20:4n-3 → FADS1（delta-5）→ EPA → ELOVL5 和 ELOVL2 → DPA → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2（delta-6）→ 24:6n-3 → 过氧化物酶体 beta 氧化 → DHA。Sprecher 的 C24 路线是哺乳动物的主要限速通路；FADS2 产物在人细胞中已被证实具有直接的 delta-4 去饱和酶活性，体内定量贡献尚未确立。
items.daily_amount: Endogenous DHA from ALA: 9% net fractional conversion in the plasma tracer pool in young women, undetectable in young men over 21 days; studies using total dietary ALA as the denominator report under 0.1% in controlled-diet tracer studies, and the two numbers answer different questions. Plasma DHA response approaches maximum at a DHA dose of about 2 g/d. Absolute mg/d of endogenous DHA synthesis in adults: NOT ESTABLISHED.
items.daily_amount_zh: 由 ALA 生成的内源 DHA：年轻女性血浆示踪池净分数转化 9%，年轻男性 21 天内检测不到；以膳食 ALA 总量作分母的受控膳食示踪研究报告低于 0.1%，两个数字回答的是不同问题。血浆 DHA 反应在约 2 g/d 的 DHA 剂量下接近最大。成人内源 DHA 合成的绝对量（mg/d）：NOT ESTABLISHED（未确立）。
items.still_matters_when: Justified for vegans and vegetarians, fish allergy or aversion, pregnancy and lactation on plant-based diets, and adult men, whose measured ALA to DHA conversion is effectively zero. This is the clearest case in the omega-3 group where partial synthesis fails to meet requirement, so the supplement is not redundant with anything the body makes. One practical note for DHA-only products: supplemental DHA also raises EPA levels, which recent tracer work attributes to a slower rate of EPA elongation rather than the long-assumed retroconversion.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 适用于纯素和素食者、鱼类过敏或抗拒鱼类者、采用植物性膳食的妊娠和哺乳期，以及成年男性，后者实测的 ALA 转 DHA 基本为零。这是 omega-3 这组中部分合成最明显无法满足需要量的一例，补充剂与身体自制的任何东西都不重复。对只含 DHA 的产品还有一点实用提醒：补 DHA 同时会提高 EPA 水平，近期示踪研究把这一现象归因于 EPA 延长速率减慢，而长期以来被假定的逆转化并非主因。
items.source: Burdge GC, Wootton SA. Br J Nutr. 2002;88(4):411-20. PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689; Burdge GC, Jones AE, Wootton SA. Br J Nutr. 2002;88(4):355-63. PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002662. Mapped from the recovered entry Algal oil (vegan DHA and EPA), with the men's citation completed from the parallel recovered omega-3 rows.

items.endogenous_note: Your body builds creatine every day, on the order of 1 g in a young man (an inference from creatinine loss averaging about 2 g/day in 70 kg men aged 20 to 39, roughly half of it replaced by dietary creatine in omnivores), and a normal omnivorous diet covers the rest of the 1 to 3 g/day lost as creatinine. The catch is that this combined supply leaves muscle stores only around 60 to 80 percent saturated and synthesis is feedback-inhibited, so it will not rise to close the gap, while the synthesis that does run costs about 40 percent of the labile methyl groups carried by S-adenosylmethionine and 20 to 30 percent of the amidino groups of arginine. So 3 to 5 g/day adds to existing supply instead of duplicating it, which makes creatine one of the few endogenous compounds where this axis supports supplementing.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 身体每天都在合成 creatine, 年轻男性在 1 g 量级 (由肌酐流失推算: 70 kg, 20 到 39 岁男性每天约 2 g, 杂食者约一半由膳食 creatine 补回), 正常杂食饮食补上每天以肌酐形式流失的 1 到 3 g 中的其余部分。问题在于这两部分合起来仍只让肌肉储量停在约 60% 到 80% 饱和, 合成又受反馈抑制, 不会自行上调填平缺口; 而已在运行的合成代价不低, 占用 S-adenosylmethionine 提供的全部活性甲基约 40%, 并消耗 arginine 胍基的 20% 到 30%。所以 3 到 5 g/day 是在原有供应之外叠加, 并未重复, creatine 也因此成为这条轴支持补充的少数内源化合物之一。
items.pathway: Glycine plus the amidino group of arginine gives guanidinoacetate via AGAT (GATM), mainly in kidney and pancreas. Guanidinoacetate is methylated by GAMT using S-adenosylmethionine (methyl group from dietary methionine), mainly in liver. Creatine is exported and taken up against a gradient by muscle, heart and brain through the transporter CRT1 (SLC6A8), phosphorylated by creatine kinase isoforms and lost non-enzymatically as creatinine. The brain expresses AGAT and GAMT itself and makes most of its own creatine behind the blood-brain barrier, which is why the SLC6A8 transporter defect does not respond to oral creatine.
items.pathway_zh: glycine 与 arginine 的胍基经 AGAT (GATM) 生成 guanidinoacetate, 主要在肾和胰。guanidinoacetate 由 GAMT 用 S-adenosylmethionine 甲基化 (甲基来自膳食 methionine), 主要在肝。creatine 输出后由肌肉, 心脏和脑通过转运体 CRT1 (SLC6A8) 逆梯度摄取, 由肌酸激酶同工酶磷酸化, 并以非酶方式转为肌酐流失。脑自身也表达 AGAT 和 GAMT, 在血脑屏障内自产大部分 creatine, 这正是 SLC6A8 转运体缺陷对口服 creatine 无反应的原因。
items.daily_amount: Roughly 1 g/day of endogenous synthesis against about 2 g/day of total turnover in a 70 kg adult, with 1.5 to 2 percent of the creatine pool converted to creatinine daily (PMID 10893433). Creatinine loss averages about 2 g (14.6 mmol)/day in 70 kg men aged 20 to 39 and about half of that loss is replaced by dietary creatine in omnivores, implying endogenous synthesis on the order of 1 g/day (PMID 21387089); women and older people lose less with lower muscle mass and synthesise proportionally less, and that paper does not give the 0.75 g/day figure often quoted for women.
items.daily_amount_zh: 70 kg 成人内源合成约 1 g/day, 总周转约 2 g/day, 每天有 1.5% 到 2% 的肌酸池转为肌酐 (PMID 10893433)。70 kg, 20 到 39 岁男性每天肌酐流失平均约 2 g (14.6 mmol), 杂食者约一半由膳食 creatine 补回, 由此推算内源合成在 1 g/day 量级 (PMID 21387089); 女性和年长人群肌肉量较低, 流失更少, 合成量按比例下降, 该文献未给出 0.75 g/day 这一常被引用的女性数值。
items.still_matters_when: Vegetarians and vegans, who start with measurably lower muscle total creatine (117 versus 130 mmol/kg dry mass) and gain most from loading (PMID 14600563); repeated high-intensity and resistance work; probably older adults; and inborn errors of AGAT (GATM), GAMT or SLC6A8, where dosing is clinical and the response differs by defect, since the two synthetic defects respond to oral creatine and the transporter defect largely does not. Rising creatinine on supplementation reflects the enlarged creatine pool and carries no implication of kidney injury.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 素食者和纯素者, 其肌肉总 creatine 起点明显更低 (117 对 130 mmol/kg 干重), 从负荷期获益最大 (PMID 14600563); 反复高强度运动和抗阻训练; 老年人很可能受益; 以及 AGAT (GATM), GAMT 或 SLC6A8 的先天缺陷, 此时用药属临床决定, 两种合成酶缺陷对口服 creatine 有反应, 转运体缺陷基本没有。补充后血肌酐升高反映肌酸池扩大, 与肾损伤无关。
items.source: PMID 21387089 (Brosnan JT, da Silva RP, Brosnan ME, The metabolic burden of creatine synthesis, Amino Acids 2011;40:1325-31); PMID 10893433 (Wyss M, Kaddurah-Daouk R, Physiol Rev 2000;80:1107-1213); PMID 14600563. Merged from the recovered entries Creatine monohydrate, Creatine, and Creatine, CoQ10, glutathione and alpha-lipoic acid.
