items.endogenous_note: The roll-up is PARTIAL and it hides three tiers: nine amino acids have no human pathway to their carbon skeletons (histidine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, methionine, phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan, valine) and score NONE, five are built freely from central intermediates (alanine, aspartate, asparagine, glutamate, serine) and score FULL, and six sit in the IOM's conditionally indispensable middle tier (arginine, cysteine, glutamine, glycine, proline, tyrosine), made in health and needed from the diet in prematurity, trauma, sepsis or specific enzyme defects. Roughly 250 to 300 g of body protein is degraded and resynthesised per day, several times typical intake, so reutilisation dominates supply and the powder functions as a convenience format for hitting total daily protein. It therefore makes sense only when total intake sits below target, and above roughly 1.62 g/kg/day in resistance trainees it adds nothing.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 汇总标签是 PARTIAL, 下面藏着三个层级: 九种氨基酸的碳骨架人体无法合成 (histidine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, methionine, phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan, valine), 判为 NONE; 五种可由中心代谢中间体自由合成 (alanine, aspartate, asparagine, glutamate, serine), 判为 FULL; 另有六种落在 IOM 的条件性必需中间层 (arginine, cysteine, glutamine, glycine, proline, tyrosine), 健康时自产, 在早产, 创伤, 脓毒症或特定酶缺陷时需从饮食获得。成人每天降解并重新合成的体蛋白约 250 到 300 g, 是典型摄入量的数倍, 供应以再利用为主, 蛋白粉的角色是把每日总蛋白凑够的便利形式。所以只有在总摄入低于目标时才说得通, 抗阻训练者超过约 1.62 g/kg/day 之后它不再带来额外收益。
items.pathway: Dispensable amino acids come from central metabolism: alanine from pyruvate, glutamate and glutamine from alpha-ketoglutarate, aspartate from oxaloacetate, asparagine from aspartate via asparagine synthetase (ASNS), serine from 3-phosphoglycerate, glycine from serine via SHMT, proline from glutamate, cysteine from methionine sulfur plus the serine carbon skeleton by transsulfuration, tyrosine from phenylalanine, and arginine through the intestinal-renal citrulline axis. There is no human route to the carbon skeletons of the nine indispensable amino acids, so dietary protein is a genuine requirement that no supply of glucose or fat substitutes for.
items.pathway_zh: 可自身合成的氨基酸来自中心代谢: alanine 来自 pyruvate, glutamate 和 glutamine 来自 alpha-ketoglutarate, aspartate 来自 oxaloacetate, asparagine 由 aspartate 经 asparagine synthetase (ASNS) 生成, serine 来自 3-phosphoglycerate, glycine 由 serine 经 SHMT 生成, proline 来自 glutamate, cysteine 由 methionine 的硫加 serine 碳骨架经转硫途径生成, tyrosine 来自 phenylalanine, arginine 走肠肾 citrulline 轴。九种必需氨基酸的碳骨架没有人体合成路线, 所以膳食蛋白是真实需求, 葡萄糖或脂肪无法替代。
items.daily_amount: Roughly 250 to 300 g of body protein is degraded and resynthesised per day in an adult, several times typical Western intake, so amino acid reutilisation dominates supply (FAO/WHO/UNU 2007; IOM DRI 2005, standard turnover figures 3 to 4 g/kg/day). The adult dietary requirement is 0.8 g protein/kg/day, about 56 g for a 70 kg adult (IOM DRI 2005). Net synthesis of the nine indispensable amino acids is 0.
items.daily_amount_zh: 成人每天降解并重新合成的体蛋白约 250 到 300 g, 是典型西方摄入量的数倍, 因此氨基酸再利用主导供应 (FAO/WHO/UNU 2007; IOM DRI 2005, 常用周转值 3 到 4 g/kg/day)。成人膳食需求 0.8 g protein/kg/day, 70 kg 成人约 56 g (IOM DRI 2005)。九种必需氨基酸的净合成量为 0。
items.still_matters_when: Total daily protein below target, energy deficit, older adults with anabolic resistance, vegan diets low in leucine and lysine, clinical malnutrition, burns and recovery. For resistance trainees the meta-regression breakpoint is about 1.62 g/kg/day (95% CI 1.03 to 2.20), beyond which extra protein produced no further fat-free mass gain (PMID 28698222); above that intake the powder is redundant.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 每日总蛋白低于目标, 能量赤字, 存在合成抵抗的老年人, leucine 和 lysine 偏低的纯素饮食, 临床营养不良, 烧伤和康复期。抗阻训练者的 meta 回归拐点约 1.62 g/kg/day (95% CI 1.03 to 2.20), 超过该摄入后额外蛋白不再带来去脂体重增加 (PMID 28698222); 高于这个摄入量, 蛋白粉是多余的。
items.source: IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Energy, Carbohydrate, Fiber, Fat, Fatty Acids, Cholesterol, Protein, and Amino Acids, National Academies Press 2005; FAO/WHO/UNU 2007; PMID 28698222. Recovered entry Protein powder.

items.endogenous_note: Your liver does make beta-alanine as a by-product of breaking down the pyrimidine uracil (cytosine reaches the same route by deamination to uracil), and GADL1 makes some from aspartate in certain tissues, while the parallel thymine branch runs the same three enzymes and yields 3-aminoisobutyrate, so thymine contributes none. The amounts are small relative to what muscle could use, and beta-alanine availability is what limits muscle carnosine, since carnosine synthase (CARNS1) is not saturated at resting beta-alanine levels and the enzyme capacity is not the bottleneck. So this is a compound the body makes yet never accumulates to a functionally saturated level, which is why 4 to 6 g/day in divided doses raises muscle carnosine and why supplementing is not redundant.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 肝确实会生成 beta-alanine, 作为嘧啶 uracil 分解的副产物 (cytosine 经脱氨转为 uracil 后进入同一路线), 某些组织中 GADL1 也能由 aspartate 生成一部分; 并行的 thymine 分支用同样三个酶, 产物是 3-aminoisobutyrate, 对 beta-alanine 没有贡献。相对肌肉可用的量这些产量很小, 限制肌肉 carnosine 的是 beta-alanine 的可得量, 因为 carnosine synthase (CARNS1) 在静息 beta-alanine 水平下并未饱和, 酶活力并非瓶颈。所以这是一种身体会做却从不积累到功能饱和水平的物质, 4 到 6 g/day 分次服用能提高肌肉 carnosine, 补充并不多余。
items.pathway: Uracil (and cytosine via deamination to uracil) is reduced by dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPYD) to dihydrouracil, hydrolysed by dihydropyrimidinase (DPYS) to 3-ureidopropionate, then cleaved by beta-ureidopropionase (UPB1) to beta-alanine, mainly in liver; the parallel thymine branch uses the same three enzymes and ends at 3-aminoisobutyrate. Beta-alanine plus L-histidine is condensed to carnosine by carnosine synthase (CARNS1) in skeletal muscle, and ingested carnosine or anserine is hydrolysed first by serum carnosinase (CNDP1), which is why the effective oral form is beta-alanine itself. GADL1 supplies some beta-alanine from aspartate in certain tissues, and gut bacteria contribute part of the supply, which this dataset counts as exogenous.
items.pathway_zh: uracil (以及经脱氨转为 uracil 的 cytosine) 由 dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPYD) 还原为 dihydrouracil, 经 dihydropyrimidinase (DPYS) 水解为 3-ureidopropionate, 再由 beta-ureidopropionase (UPB1) 裂解生成 beta-alanine, 主要在肝; 并行的 thymine 分支用同样三个酶, 终点是 3-aminoisobutyrate。beta-alanine 与 L-histidine 在骨骼肌由 carnosine synthase (CARNS1) 缩合为 carnosine; 口服的 carnosine 与 anserine 会先被血清 carnosinase (CNDP1) 水解, 所以有效的口服形式是 beta-alanine 本身。某些组织中 GADL1 由 aspartate 提供一部分, 肠道细菌也贡献一部分, 本数据集把细菌产物计为外源供应。
items.daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED. No validated figure exists for human daily endogenous beta-alanine production; the literature characterises it only as small relative to demand. The sourced comparison is on the intake side: 4 to 6 g/day in divided doses of no more than 2 g, for at least 2 to 4 weeks, reliably raises muscle carnosine, and 3.2 to 6.4 g/day raises muscle carnosine by 40 to 80 percent over 4 to 10 weeks.
items.daily_amount_zh: NOT ESTABLISHED (尚无确证数据)。人体每日内源 beta-alanine 生成量没有经过验证的数值, 文献只把它描述为相对需求很小。有出处的对照来自摄入侧: 4 到 6 g/day, 单次不超过 2 g 分次服用, 持续至少 2 到 4 周能可靠提升肌肉 carnosine; 3.2 到 6.4 g/day 可在 4 到 10 周内把肌肉 carnosine 提高 40% 到 80%。
items.still_matters_when: High-intensity efforts lasting more than about 60 s, with the clearest effects in the 1 to 4 min range and in open-end-point tasks, where intracellular buffering limits performance; vegetarians and vegans, who carry lower muscle carnosine; older adults, in whom muscle carnosine declines. Histidine availability can co-limit carnosine synthesis, so very low protein intake blunts the response, and paraesthesia is dose-related and controllable with divided or sustained-release dosing. Endogenous synthesis exists here but sits far below the buffering ceiling, so supplementation is not redundant.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 持续超过约 60 s 的高强度运动, 效应最清楚的是 1 到 4 min 区间和开放终点任务, 此时细胞内缓冲能力限制表现; 素食者和纯素者, 肌肉 carnosine 较低; 老年人, 肌肉 carnosine 随年龄下降。histidine 的可得量可能共同限制 carnosine 合成, 蛋白摄入极低会削弱反应; 感觉异常与剂量相关, 可通过分次或缓释给药控制。内源合成在这里存在, 但远低于缓冲能力上限, 所以补充并不多余。
items.source: Trexler ET et al., ISSN position stand: beta-alanine, J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2015;12:30; Drozak J et al., Molecular identification of carnosine synthase as ATP-grasp domain-containing protein 1. Merged from the recovered entries Beta-alanine, Taurine, betaine (TMG), beta-alanine and carnosine, and Inositol, glucosamine, beta-alanine and HMB.

items.endogenous_note: Humans have no caffeine biosynthetic pathway: there is no caffeine synthase and no route from purine nucleotides to caffeine in any animal, so every milligram in your blood was eaten or drunk, and the human enzymology is purely disposal, dominated by hepatic CYP1A2. Note what NONE does and does not imply here, since caffeine is a drug and not a nutrient, so there is no deficiency to correct and no redundancy to worry about. This axis neither supports nor undermines it, and the decision rests entirely on pharmacology and dose.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 人体没有 caffeine 的生物合成通路: 没有 caffeine synthase, 任何动物体内也没有从嘌呤核苷酸到 caffeine 的路线, 所以血里的每一毫克都是吃进或喝进去的, 人体相关酶学纯属处置, 由肝内 CYP1A2 主导。要注意 NONE 在这里的含义: caffeine 属于药物, 不算营养素, 没有可纠正的缺乏, 也不存在与自身合成重复的问题。这条轴对它既不支持也不反驳, 判断完全落在药理学和剂量上。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE in humans. In Coffea and Camellia, xanthosine is methylated by 7-methylxanthosine synthase (XMT), the ribose is then removed by an N-methylnucleosidase to give 7-methylxanthine, which is methylated to theobromine by theobromine synthase (MXMT) and then to caffeine by caffeine synthase (DXMT), a bifunctional enzyme. Human enzymology covers disposal only, dominated by hepatic CYP1A2.
items.pathway_zh: 在人体 NOT APPLICABLE。在 Coffea 和 Camellia 中, xanthosine 由 7-methylxanthosine synthase (XMT) 甲基化, 再由一个 N-methylnucleosidase 去掉核糖得到 7-methylxanthine, 经 theobromine synthase (MXMT) 甲基化为 theobromine, 再由双功能酶 caffeine synthase (DXMT) 甲基化为 caffeine。人体只有处置一侧的酶学, 由肝内 CYP1A2 主导。
items.daily_amount: 0 mg/day, no endogenous synthesis. On the disposal side, CYP1A2 metabolises about 95 percent of ingested caffeine (PMID 29514871).
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 mg/day, 没有内源合成。在处置一侧, CYP1A2 代谢摄入 caffeine 的约 95% (PMID 29514871)。
items.still_matters_when: Whenever acute adenosine receptor antagonism is the goal: alertness, reduced perceived effort, endurance and sprint performance, typically 3 to 6 mg/kg. The endogenous axis is silent on caffeine; the real constraints are habitual tolerance, CYP1A2 genotype, sleep disruption and cumulative daily dose.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 凡以急性拮抗 adenosine 受体为目的时: 清醒度, 主观用力感下降, 耐力和冲刺表现, 常用 3 到 6 mg/kg。内源轴对 caffeine 无话可说; 真正的限制是习惯性耐受, CYP1A2 基因型, 睡眠干扰和每日累积剂量。
items.source: PMID 29514871 (Nehlig A, Pharmacol Rev 2018;70:384-411); Ashihara H, Sano H, Crozier A, Caffeine and related purine alkaloids: biosynthesis, catabolism, function and genetic engineering. Recovered entry Caffeine.

items.endogenous_note: Humans do produce nitrate in quantity: about 1 mmol/day appears from the oxidation of NO, roughly 37 percent of the total body nitrate pool against a dietary intake of about 1700 micromol/day, and that output is no inert waste, since it re-enters the enterosalivary circuit, is concentrated in saliva and is reduced back to nitrite and NO by the same route a beetroot dose exploits. Two limits carry the practical conclusion: endogenous appearance cannot be up-regulated on demand, and raising plasma nitrite enough to lower the O2 cost of exercise needs dietary loading well above endogenous turnover. Keep the two routes separate as well, since NO made from arginine by nitric oxide synthase is independent of the dietary nitrate to nitrite to NO route, so on this axis a nitrate dose is not redundant.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 人体确实以可观的量生成 nitrate: NO 氧化每天产生约 1 mmol, 约占全身 nitrate 池的 37%, 而膳食摄入约 1700 micromol/day; 这部分产物也不是惰性废物, 它重新进入唾液肠循环, 在唾液中被浓缩, 再沿甜菜根剂量所利用的同一路线还原为 nitrite 和 NO。两条限制支撑实用结论: 内源生成无法按需上调, 而要把血浆 nitrite 提高到足以降低运动氧耗的程度, 需要的膳食负荷远高于内源周转量。两条路线也要分开看, arginine 经 nitric oxide synthase 生成 NO 与膳食 nitrate 到 nitrite 到 NO 的路线彼此独立, 所以在这条轴上补充并不多余。
items.pathway: Endogenous nitrate arises from oxidation of NOS-derived NO through nitrite, with essentially all NOS output ending as nitrate, which is why endogenous nitrate appearance and NOS-dependent NO production are the same order of magnitude. Nitrate, ingested or endogenous, is concentrated in saliva by sialin (SLC17A5), with roughly 25 percent of an ingested dose entering the enterosalivary circuit and being reduced to nitrite by oral bacterial nitrate reductase; nitrite is then reduced to NO in the acid stomach and in hypoxic tissue by deoxyhaemoglobin and other nitrite reductases. That first reduction step is bacterial, which this dataset counts as exogenous supply.
items.pathway_zh: 内源 nitrate 来自 NOS 生成的 NO 经 nitrite 氧化, NOS 的产物几乎全部终结为 nitrate, 这就是内源 nitrate 出现量与 NOS 依赖的 NO 生成量处于同一数量级的原因。无论摄入的还是内源的 nitrate, 都由 sialin (SLC17A5) 浓缩进唾液, 摄入剂量约 25% 进入唾液肠循环, 由口腔细菌的 nitrate reductase 还原为 nitrite; nitrite 随后在胃酸环境和缺氧组织中由脱氧血红蛋白等亚硝酸还原途径转为 NO。第一步还原由细菌完成, 本数据集把它计为外源供应。
items.daily_amount: Endogenous nitrate appearance from NO oxidation is about 1 mmol/day (900 to 1280 micromol/day, roughly 56 to 79 mg) in participants held below 180 micromol nitrate intake, about 37 percent of body nitrate against a dietary contribution of about 1700 micromol/day.
items.daily_amount_zh: 在 nitrate 摄入控制在 180 micromol 以下的受试者中, NO 氧化带来的内源 nitrate 出现量约 1 mmol/day (900 到 1280 micromol/day, 约 56 到 79 mg), 约占全身 nitrate 的 37%, 膳食贡献约 1700 micromol/day。
items.still_matters_when: Endurance and repeated-sprint work at roughly 6 to 13 mmol nitrate (about 400 to 800 mg), lowering the O2 cost of exercise; hypoxia; blood pressure reduction; older adults and others with impaired NOS function. Antibacterial mouthwash blunts the effect because oral bacteria do the bulk of the first reduction. Nitrite is a separately supplemented species with different kinetics and a narrower margin (methaemoglobinaemia), so the two are not interchangeable, and despite the PARTIAL label supplementation is not redundant, because endogenous production cannot be raised on demand.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 耐力和反复冲刺项目, 剂量约 6 到 13 mmol nitrate (约 400 到 800 mg), 可降低运动氧耗; 缺氧; 降血压; NOS 功能受损的老年人及其他人群。抗菌漱口水会削弱效果, 因为第一步还原主要由口腔细菌完成。nitrite 是另一种可单独补充的物质, 动力学不同且安全边界更窄 (甲基血红蛋白症), 两者不可互换; 尽管标签为 PARTIAL, 补充仍不多余, 因为内源生成无法按需提高。
items.source: PMC8983853 (Ghasemi A, Quantitative aspects of nitric oxide production from nitrate and nitrite, EXCLI J 2022); PMID 18167491 (Lundberg JO, Weitzberg E, Gladwin MT). Recovered entry Dietary nitrate / beetroot.

items.endogenous_note: HMB is a normal human metabolite of leucine, made whenever leucine is metabolised, but only about 5 percent of whole-body leucine flux takes that branch, which comes to roughly 0.2 to 0.4 g/day in a 70 kg adult. The studied dose is 3 g/day, and reaching that from food would take about 60 g of leucine, over 600 g of high quality protein, so endogenous production is real yet roughly a tenth of the dose being tested. That makes supplementation a coherent premise on this axis and hardly a duplication, while whether 3 g/day does anything useful in healthy trained people is a separate and much weaker question, and the form matters, since the free acid and the calcium salt differ in absorption rate and peak plasma concentration.
items.endogenous_note_zh: HMB 是 leucine 的正常人体代谢产物, leucine 被代谢时就会生成, 但只有全身 leucine 通量的约 5% 走这个分支, 在 70 kg 成人相当于每天约 0.2 到 0.4 g。被研究的剂量是 3 g/day, 靠食物达到需要约 60 g leucine, 即超过 600 g 优质蛋白, 所以内源生成真实存在, 却只有受试剂量的十分之一左右。这使补充在这条轴上成为自洽的前提, 谈不上重复; 3 g/day 在健康训练人群里是否有用是另一个证据弱得多的问题, 剂型也有影响, 游离酸与钙盐在吸收速率和血浆峰浓度上不同。
items.pathway: Leucine is reversibly transaminated to alpha-ketoisocaproate (KIC) by mitochondrial branched-chain aminotransferase (BCAT2) in muscle. A minority of KIC is oxidised in the cytosol, largely in liver, to HMB by the enzyme identified as 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPD), so HMB production is a side activity of a tyrosine-catabolism enzyme. HMB is partly converted to HMG-CoA and enters cholesterol synthesis inside the myocyte.
items.pathway_zh: leucine 在肌肉中由线粒体 branched-chain aminotransferase (BCAT2) 可逆转氨为 alpha-ketoisocaproate (KIC)。少部分 KIC 在胞质中被氧化为 HMB, 主要在肝, 催化该反应的酶已鉴定为 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPD), 因此 HMB 的生成是一个 tyrosine 分解酶的副反应。HMB 部分转化为 HMG-CoA, 在肌细胞内进入胆固醇合成。
items.daily_amount: About 0.2 to 0.4 g/day in a 70 kg adult, varying with dietary leucine (Nissen S, Abumrad NN, J Nutr Biochem 1997;8:300-11; reviewed PMID 28493406). Roughly 5 percent of whole-body leucine flux is converted to HMB (PMID 28493406), against a studied dose of 3 g/day.
items.daily_amount_zh: 70 kg 成人每天约 0.2 到 0.4 g, 随膳食 leucine 变化 (Nissen S, Abumrad NN, J Nutr Biochem 1997;8:300-11; 综述见 PMID 28493406)。全身 leucine 通量的约 5% 转化为 HMB (PMID 28493406), 而受试剂量为 3 g/day。
items.still_matters_when: Catabolic and disuse states where the muscle-sparing data are strongest: bed rest, immobilisation, sarcopenia, cachexia, hypocaloric dieting and clinical recovery. In trained, well-fed lifters the effect sizes are small and contested. The axis does not rule HMB out, because supplemental doses are an order of magnitude above endogenous output.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 肌肉保护数据最强的分解代谢和失用状态: 卧床, 制动, 肌少症, 恶病质, 低热量饮食和临床康复期。在训练有素, 营养充足的举重者中, 效应量小且有争议。这条轴并不排除 HMB, 因为补充剂量比内源产量高出一个数量级。
items.source: PMID 1733247 (Van Koevering M, Nissen S, Am J Physiol 1992;262:E27-31, HMB derived from leucine via KIC); PMC3568064 (Wilson JM et al., ISSN position stand: HMB); PMID 28493406. Merged from the recovered entries HMB and Inositol, glucosamine, beta-alanine and HMB.

items.endogenous_note: Two different verdicts in one row, so the roll-up is PARTIAL and the split has to be named. Quercetin scores NONE: it is a plant flavonol, no animal synthesises flavonoids at all because the pathway requires chalcone synthase, which humans lack, so every microgram is dietary and there is no requirement and no deficiency state. Taurine scores PARTIAL: you make it from cysteine by three routes, CSAD, which has low activity in humans, GADL1, which decarboxylates cysteine sulfinate to hypotaurine, and the cysteamine route where cysteamine from coenzyme A degradation is oxidised to hypotaurine by cysteamine dioxygenase (ADO), and that limited overall capacity is why tissue and plasma taurine track intake of meat, fish and shellfish. So any case for quercetin has to be pharmacological and runs into poor bioavailability and heavy conjugation, while taurine has a genuine dietary contribution and a short list of states where it matters.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 一行里两个不同判断, 汇总为 PARTIAL, 并要说明拆分: quercetin 为 NONE, taurine 为 PARTIAL。quercetin 是植物黄酮醇, 任何动物都不合成类黄酮, 因为该通路需要人类没有的 chalcone synthase, 每一微克都来自饮食, 既无需求也无缺乏状态。taurine 由 cysteine 合成, 有三条路线: 人体活性偏低的 CSAD, 把 cysteine sulfinate 脱羧为 hypotaurine 的 GADL1, 以及辅酶 A 降解产生的 cysteamine 由 cysteamine dioxygenase (ADO) 氧化为 hypotaurine 的路线; 总体能力仍然有限, 所以组织和血浆 taurine 随肉, 鱼, 贝类的摄入而变化。因此 quercetin 的任何理由都只能是药理性的, 且会撞上生物利用度差和大量结合代谢, 而 taurine 有真实的膳食贡献和一份明确的适用状态清单。
items.pathway: Quercetin: NOT APPLICABLE in humans. Plants build it from phenylalanine via PAL, 4-coumaroyl-CoA, chalcone synthase, flavanone 3-hydroxylase and flavonol synthase; human enzymology is limited to conjugation and degradation (intestinal and hepatic UGT, SULT and COMT, plus gut microbial ring fission). Taurine: cysteine is oxidised by cysteine dioxygenase (CDO1) to cysteine sulfinate, decarboxylated by CSAD or GADL1 to hypotaurine and oxidised to taurine, with a parallel cysteamine route through ADO; liver is the main site, taurine is conjugated to bile acids by BAAT and held in tissue by the transporter SLC6A6 (TauT), which the kidney upregulates on low intake.
items.pathway_zh: quercetin: 在人体 NOT APPLICABLE。植物由 phenylalanine 经 PAL, 4-coumaroyl-CoA, chalcone synthase, flavanone 3-hydroxylase 和 flavonol synthase 合成; 人体酶学只限于结合与降解 (肠道和肝的 UGT, SULT, COMT, 以及肠道菌的环裂解)。taurine: cysteine 由 cysteine dioxygenase (CDO1) 氧化为 cysteine sulfinate, 经 CSAD 或 GADL1 脱羧为 hypotaurine, 再氧化为 taurine, 另有经 ADO 的 cysteamine 平行路线; 主要合成部位是肝, taurine 由 BAAT 与胆汁酸结合, 由转运体 SLC6A6 (TauT) 在组织中保留, 摄入低时肾脏上调该转运体。
items.daily_amount: Quercetin: 0 mg/day, no human synthesis. Taurine: NOT ESTABLISHED, there is no validated human de novo synthesis rate, and the evidence for the limitation is enzymatic, with CSAD the rate-limiting step and very low in activity in humans (PMC8153620). Intake-side reference points: roughly 40 to 400 mg/day in omnivores, close to zero on a strict vegan diet, supplement doses of 500 to 3,000 mg/day, and about 1,000 mg in a can of energy drink.
items.daily_amount_zh: quercetin: 0 mg/day, 人体不合成。taurine: NOT ESTABLISHED (尚无确证数据), 没有经过验证的人体从头合成速率, 支持其受限的证据来自酶学, CSAD 是限速步骤且在人体活性很低 (PMC8153620)。摄入侧参照: 杂食者约 40 到 400 mg/day, 严格纯素接近零, 补充剂量 500 到 3,000 mg/day, 一罐能量饮料约含 1,000 mg。
items.still_matters_when: Taurine: vegans and vegetarians with near-zero intake, preterm infants and long-term parenteral nutrition (which is why formula and PN solutions are taurine-fortified), SLC6A6 mutations causing retinal degeneration and cardiomyopathy, where it is treatment, and supervised clinical use in heart failure or hepatic disease; the CSAD-independent routes plus efficient renal reabsorption through TauT are why no deficiency syndrome appears in healthy omnivores. Quercetin: NEVER ON THIS AXIS, since there is no requirement and no deficiency, and at ordinary oral doses free aglycone barely reaches plasma.
items.still_matters_when_zh: taurine: 摄入接近零的纯素者和素食者, 早产儿, 长期肠外营养 (这也是配方奶和 PN 溶液强化 taurine 的原因), SLC6A6 突变导致的视网膜退化与心肌病 (此时补充属于治疗), 以及心力衰竭或肝病中的临床监督使用; 不依赖 CSAD 的路线加上经 TauT 的高效肾重吸收, 是健康杂食者不出现缺乏综合征的原因。quercetin: NEVER ON THIS AXIS (这条轴上永不适用), 既无需求也无缺乏, 常规口服剂量下游离苷元几乎进不了血浆。
items.source: PMC8153620 (novel assay for human cysteine sulfinic acid decarboxylase, 2021); PMID 28849475 (Park E et al., cysteine sulfinic acid decarboxylase knockout mouse); Winkel-Shirley B, Flavonoid biosynthesis, Plant Physiol 2001;126:485-93; Ripps H & Shen W, Mol Vis 2012;18:2673-2686. Merged from the recovered entries Quercetin and taurine, Quercetin, Taurine, and Taurine, citrulline and arginine.

items.endogenous_note: The roll-up is FULL: you build every collagen fibril in your body yourself, from glycine, proline and lysine, with vitamin C and copper as cofactors, and there is no dietary requirement for collagen as a molecule. Nothing you swallow is installed intact, since ingested collagen is digested to amino acids and short peptides before absorption, which makes oral collagen a weak premise as replacement therapy for a molecule you are not short of. The exception sits on the precursor side and carries a contested CONDITIONAL label: if the Melendez-Hevia calculation of a roughly 10 g/day glycine shortfall holds, precursor supply is conditional, and demand for glycine and proline rises in burns, major surgery and wound healing, the same structure that makes glutamine conditional. Two defensible mechanisms remain, supplying amino acids, where plain gelatine or glycine is cheaper, and signalling by absorbed Pro-Hyp and other hydroxyproline-containing dipeptides, which are measurable in plasma after a dose.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 汇总为 FULL: 体内每一根胶原纤维都由你自己用 glycine, proline 和 lysine 造出, vitamin C 和 copper 作辅因子, 作为分子的 collagen 没有膳食需求。吞下去的东西不会原样装上, 摄入的胶原在吸收前已被消化为氨基酸和短肽, 把口服胶原当作补充一种你并不缺的分子, 这个前提很弱。例外在前体一侧, 情况确实未定, 标签为有争议的 CONDITIONAL: 如果 Melendez-Hevia 关于每天约 10 g glycine 缺口的计算成立, 前体供应就属条件性, 而烧伤, 大手术和创伤愈合中 glycine 与 proline 需求上升, 结构与 glutamine 被列为条件性的情形相同。站得住的机制有两个, 一是提供氨基酸, 而普通明胶或 glycine 更便宜, 二是吸收的 Pro-Hyp 及其他含羟脯氨酸二肽对成纤维细胞的信号作用, 这类二肽在摄入后确实能在血浆中测到。
items.pathway: Fibroblasts, chondrocytes and osteoblasts assemble procollagen alpha chains at the rough ER from glycine (from serine via SHMT, which supplies more than 85 percent of glycine production), proline (from glutamate or ornithine) and lysine. Prolyl-4-hydroxylase (P4HA1-3), prolyl-3-hydroxylase (P3H1) and the lysyl hydroxylases (PLOD1-3) all require Fe2+, ascorbate and 2-oxoglutarate, and are followed by glycosylation, triple-helix assembly, secretion, propeptide cleavage and copper-dependent lysyl oxidase cross-linking. Ingested collagen is digested to amino acids and di- and tripeptides such as prolyl-hydroxyproline.
items.pathway_zh: 成纤维细胞, 软骨细胞和成骨细胞在粗面内质网上用 glycine (由 serine 经 SHMT 提供, 占 glycine 生成量的 85% 以上), proline (来自 glutamate 或 ornithine) 和 lysine 组装前胶原 alpha 链。prolyl-4-hydroxylase (P4HA1-3), prolyl-3-hydroxylase (P3H1) 和 lysyl hydroxylase (PLOD1-3) 都需要 Fe2+, 抗坏血酸和 2-氧化戊二酸; 之后进行糖基化, 三螺旋组装, 分泌, 前肽切除, 以及依赖 copper 的 lysyl oxidase 交联。摄入的胶原被消化为氨基酸和二肽三肽, 例如 prolyl-hydroxyproline。
items.daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED for whole-body collagen synthesis in g/day; collagen is roughly a quarter to a third of total body protein and skin and bone turnover proceed continuously. The nearest quantified constraint concerns a precursor: Melendez-Hevia and colleagues calculate that synthesis supplies about 3 g/day of glycine in a 70 kg adult and a typical diet 1.5 to 3.0 g/day, against a total demand including collagen synthesis that leaves the roughly 10 g/day shortfall their paper reports.
items.daily_amount_zh: 全身胶原合成的 g/day 数值 NOT ESTABLISHED (尚无确证数据), 胶原约占全身蛋白的四分之一到三分之一, 皮肤和骨的周转持续进行。最接近的定量约束在前体一侧: Melendez-Hevia 等人计算, 70 kg 成人每天由合成提供约 3 g glycine, 典型饮食提供 1.5 到 3.0 g/day, 与包括胶原合成在内的总需求相比, 该文给出约 10 g/day 的缺口。
items.still_matters_when: Vitamin C deficiency, where hydroxylation genuinely fails (scurvy, and humans depend on dietary ascorbate because GULO is a pseudogene); copper deficiency, where lysyl oxidase cross-linking fails; low total protein or a glycine-poor diet; wound healing, burns and major surgery, when demand for glycine and proline rises; and possibly as a cheap glycine and proline source if the Melendez-Hevia shortfall holds. What the axis rules out is the marketing premise that you are short of collagen itself. If a collagen peptide product is used, judge it on the specific hydrolysate and dose the trials used (2.5 to 10 g/day for skin and joint endpoints) and on how independent those trials were.
items.still_matters_when_zh: vitamin C 缺乏, 此时羟化确实失败 (坏血病, 而人类依赖膳食抗坏血酸是因为 GULO 是假基因); copper 缺乏, 此时 lysyl oxidase 交联失败; 总蛋白摄入低或 glycine 贫乏的饮食; 创伤愈合, 烧伤和大手术, 此时 glycine 和 proline 需求上升; 如果 Melendez-Hevia 的缺口成立, 它也可能作为便宜的 glycine 和 proline 来源。这条轴否掉的是营销前提, 即你缺胶原本身。若使用胶原肽产品, 应按试验用过的具体水解物和剂量判断 (皮肤和关节终点常用 2.5 到 10 g/day), 并看这些试验的独立性。
items.source: doi:10.1007/s12038-009-0100-9 (Melendez-Hevia E et al., J Biosci 2009;34:853-72); PMID 14623400 (Gelse K, Poschl E, Aigner T, Adv Drug Deliv Rev 2003;55:1531-46); Myllyharju J & Kivirikko KI, Trends Genet 2004;20:33-43. Merged from the recovered entries Collagen peptides, Collagen peptides and hyaluronic acid, and Fully endogenous small molecules sold as supplements.

items.endogenous_note: Cartilage manufactures both of these on site from glucose and glutamine: glucosamine-6-phosphate comes off the hexosamine branch of glycolysis, and chondroitin sulfate chains are polymerised and sulfated inside the chondrocyte Golgi, so chondroitin sulfate is FULL in the ordinary sense and glucosamine is FULL by substrate sufficiency. The glucosamine label needs one qualification, since what the pathway makes is glucosamine-6-phosphate committed to UDP-GlcNAc and the free glucosamine measurable in fasting plasma is spillover plus lysosomal salvage, so nobody has established what an adequate quantity of free glucosamine would be; the sufficient and correct version is that the chondrocyte is never short of substrate. Neither is a nutrient, neither has a deficiency state, and absorbed material joins the whole-body amino sugar pool instead of being directed to a particular knee, which makes this the clearest case on the axis of a premise that fails at the substrate step.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 软骨在原位用葡萄糖和 glutamine 制造这两种分子: glucosamine-6-phosphate 来自糖酵解的己糖胺分支, chondroitin sulfate 链在软骨细胞高尔基体内聚合并硫酸化, 所以 chondroitin sulfate 在通常意义上是 FULL, glucosamine 则按底物充足判为 FULL。glucosamine 这一侧要加一句限定: 通路产生的是定向进入 UDP-GlcNAc 的 glucosamine-6-phosphate, 空腹血浆中可测到的游离 glucosamine 属溢出加溶酶体回收, 没人确定过游离 glucosamine 的充足量是多少, 充分且正确的说法是软骨细胞从不缺底物。两者都不是营养素, 不存在缺乏状态, 吸收进来的物质并入全身氨基糖池, 不会被定向送到某个膝关节, 这是整条轴上前提失效最清楚的一例, 失效点在底物一侧。
items.pathway: Glucosamine: fructose-6-phosphate plus glutamine gives glucosamine-6-phosphate via GFAT (GFPT1/2), the rate-limiting step of the hexosamine biosynthetic pathway, then N-acetylation and UTP addition to UDP-GlcNAc; a second, GFAT-independent source is lysosomal salvage, where NAGK phosphorylates recovered GlcNAc straight back into the pathway. Chondroitin: UDP-glucose is oxidised by UGDH to UDP-glucuronate, and chondroitin sulfate chains are polymerised and sulfated inside the chondrocyte Golgi.
items.pathway_zh: glucosamine: fructose-6-phosphate 加 glutamine 经 GFAT (GFPT1/2) 生成 glucosamine-6-phosphate, 这是己糖胺生物合成通路的限速步骤, 随后 N 乙酰化并加 UTP 生成 UDP-GlcNAc; 另一条不依赖 GFAT 的来源是溶酶体回收, NAGK 把回收的 GlcNAc 磷酸化后直接送回通路。chondroitin: UDP-glucose 由 UGDH 氧化为 UDP-glucuronate, chondroitin sulfate 链在软骨细胞高尔基体内聚合并硫酸化。
items.daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED as a g/day synthesis figure for either molecule. Sourced anchors instead: the hexosamine pathway diverts roughly 2 to 5 percent of glucose-derived fructose-6-phosphate to UDP-GlcNAc (PMC12847842), endogenous free glucosamine is present in fasting human plasma (PMID 16168682), whole-body hexosamine flux is on the order of grams per day, and the usual oral dose of 1500 mg/day reaches synovial fluid only at low micromolar levels.
items.daily_amount_zh: 两种分子都 NOT ESTABLISHED (尚无确证的 g/day 合成数值)。可用参照: 己糖胺通路把葡萄糖来源的 fructose-6-phosphate 约 2% 到 5% 分流到 UDP-GlcNAc (PMC12847842); 空腹人血浆中存在内源游离 glucosamine (PMID 16168682); 全身己糖胺通量为每天克级; 常用口服剂量 1500 mg/day 在滑液中只达到低微摩尔级浓度。
items.still_matters_when: Very little on the substrate axis, since any real effect has to be pharmacological rather than nutritional. The largest independent trial (GAIT) found no benefit over placebo across the overall knee osteoarthritis population, with a signal for the glucosamine plus chondroitin combination in its prespecified moderate-to-severe pain subgroup that was exploratory and unconfirmed (PMID 16495392); GAIT used glucosamine hydrochloride while most positive European trials used crystalline glucosamine sulfate, which is the main explanation for the heterogeneity and the reason the two salts cannot be treated as equivalent. What remains defensible is a time-limited personal trial with a defined stopping point in a symptomatic individual, judged on 3 month symptom response, with attention to shellfish sourcing and to blood glucose at high doses.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 在底物这条轴上几乎没有, 任何真实效应只能是药理性的, 与营养无关。规模最大的独立试验 (GAIT) 在膝骨关节炎总体人群中未发现优于安慰剂的获益, 其预设的中重度疼痛亚组中 glucosamine 加 chondroitin 联合出现了信号, 属探索性且未被验证 (PMID 16495392); GAIT 用的是 glucosamine hydrochloride, 而多数阳性结果的欧洲试验用结晶 glucosamine sulfate, 这是异质性的主要解释, 也是两种盐不能当作等价物的理由。仍说得过去的用法, 是在有症状个体身上做有明确终止点的限期个人试用, 看 3 个月的症状反应, 并注意贝类来源和大剂量时对血糖的影响。
items.source: PMID 16168682 (Persiani S et al., Osteoarthritis Cartilage 2005;13:1041-9); PMC12847842 (GFAT in the pathology of diseases: a review); PMID 23774590 (Mikami T); PMID 16495392 (GAIT; Clegg DO et al., N Engl J Med). Merged from the recovered entries Glucosamine and chondroitin, Inositol, glucosamine, beta-alanine and HMB, and Taurine, choline and betaine, inositol, NAD precursors (NR, NMN), glucosamine and chondroitin.

items.endogenous_note: Glutamine is the most abundant free amino acid in the body, about 20 percent of the free amino acid pool in blood and 40 to 60 percent in muscle and liver, and whole-body endogenous production is 40 to 80 g/day, with skeletal muscle the dominant synthetic site and net exporter to enterocytes and immune cells while lung, liver, brain and adipose also contribute. A healthy adult eating normally is nowhere near short, so a 5 g scoop for leaky gut is a rounding error against the flux already arriving at the gut wall, and leaky gut is not a validated clinical entity in the first place, so the scoop has no defined target. Severe catabolic illness is where this changes, with demand exceeding synthesis and plasma glutamine falling, which is what CONDITIONAL means: self-sufficient in health and insufficient in named states.
items.endogenous_note_zh: glutamine 是体内含量最高的游离氨基酸, 约占血中游离氨基酸池的 20%, 在肌肉和肝占 40% 到 60%, 全身内源生成 40 到 80 g/day, 骨骼肌是主要合成部位和净输出者, 向肠上皮细胞和免疫细胞输送, 肺, 肝, 脑和脂肪组织也有贡献。正常进食的健康成人远谈不上缺乏, 为肠漏而吃的 5 g 一勺, 相对已抵达肠壁的通量只是舍入误差, 而肠漏本身也不是经过验证的临床实体, 这一勺没有明确的作用目标。严重分解代谢疾病中情况确实变化, 需求超过合成, 血浆 glutamine 下降, 这就是 CONDITIONAL 的含义: 健康时自给, 在点名的状态下不足。
items.pathway: Glutamate plus ammonia gives glutamine via ATP-dependent glutamine synthetase (GLUL), predominantly in skeletal muscle and also in liver, lung, brain and adipose tissue. Muscle holds about 80 percent of body glutamine and releases it to plasma, while enterocytes and lymphocytes consume it via glutaminase (GLS) as fuel and nitrogen donor. Two roles the gut-repair pitch ignores: glutamine is the body's ammonia shuttle, carrying nitrogen from peripheral tissue to the liver for urea synthesis, and to the kidney, where renal glutaminase releases ammonia for acid-base handling.
items.pathway_zh: glutamate 加氨在依赖 ATP 的 glutamine synthetase (GLUL) 作用下生成 glutamine, 主要在骨骼肌, 也在肝, 肺, 脑和脂肪组织。肌肉持有全身 glutamine 的约 80% 并向血浆释放; 肠上皮细胞和淋巴细胞通过 glutaminase (GLS) 把它当燃料和氮供体消耗。肠修复宣传忽略了两项功能: glutamine 是体内的氨穿梭载体, 把外周组织的氮送到肝进行尿素合成, 也送到肾, 肾 glutaminase 在此释放氨参与酸碱调节。
items.daily_amount: Whole-body endogenous production is 40 to 80 g/day by isotopic and pharmacokinetic estimates, with muscle the dominant site rather than the sole one (PMC6266414, Cruzat V et al., Nutrients 2018;10:1564).
items.daily_amount_zh: 根据同位素和药代动力学估算, 全身内源生成 40 到 80 g/day, 肌肉是主要部位, 并非唯一部位 (PMC6266414, Cruzat V et al., Nutrients 2018;10:1564)。
items.still_matters_when: Burns, major trauma, major surgery, sepsis, short bowel syndrome and long-term parenteral nutrition; sickle cell disease, where oral glutamine has a licensed indication. Dose and route are not neutral: high-dose glutamine given to unselected critically ill patients with multiorgan failure increased mortality in the REDOXS trial (PMID 23594003). For a healthy adult with digestive complaints, the 40 to 80 g/day figure is the reason not to buy it.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 烧伤, 严重创伤, 大手术, 脓毒症, 短肠综合征和长期肠外营养; 镰状细胞病, 口服 glutamine 在该病有获批适应症。剂量和给药途径并不中性: 在合并多器官功能衰竭的未筛选重症患者中, 高剂量 glutamine 在 REDOXS 试验中增加了死亡率 (PMID 23594003)。对有消化道不适的健康成人来说, 40 到 80 g/day 这个数字就是不必买的理由。
items.source: PMC6266414 (Cruzat V, Macedo Rogero M, Noel Keane K, Curi R, Newsholme P, Nutrients 2018;10:1564); PMID 23594003 (Heyland D et al., REDOXS, N Engl J Med 2013). Recovered entry L-glutamine for gut repair.

items.endogenous_note: NA because this is a commercial product category whose contents are not a defined substance, so the axis cannot be applied to the product itself; the recovered classification for its parts is FULL in healthy young men, CONDITIONAL in ageing, hypogonadism and HPG suppression, and NONE for the plant ingredients. A healthy man's testes already make about 7 mg of testosterone a day, output pinned where it is by LH feedback through the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis, so in a eugonadal man there is no idle synthetic capacity for a capsule to unlock, and the CONDITIONAL tier exists because total testosterone declines roughly 1 percent a year from midlife and the body demonstrably does not make enough in primary or secondary hypogonadism. Tribulus, fenugreek and ashwagandha withanolides score NONE with no requirement and no deficiency state attached, and the compounds that reliably move testosterone are drugs (anabolic steroids, SARMs, hCG, aromatase inhibitors) that work by overriding or suppressing that feedback loop, so no case for these products can be built on this axis.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 判为 NA, 因为这是商业产品类别, 内容物不是确定的物质, 这条轴无法作用于产品本身; 已研究的分类是健康年轻男性 FULL, 衰老, 性腺功能低下和 HPG 轴受抑制为 CONDITIONAL, 植物成分为 NONE。健康男性的睾丸每天已生成约 7 mg 睾酮, 产量由下丘脑垂体性腺轴的 LH 反馈固定在那个水平, 性腺功能正常的男性没有闲置的合成能力等一粒胶囊去解锁; CONDITIONAL 这一层的存在, 是因为总睾酮从中年起每年下降约 1%, 而在原发性或继发性性腺功能低下中身体确实造不够。tribulus, fenugreek 和 ashwagandha withanolides 判为 NONE, 这个 NONE 不含任何需求含义, 它们既无需求也无缺乏状态; 能可靠改变睾酮的化合物都是药物 (合成类固醇, SARMs, hCG, 芳香化酶抑制剂), 作用方式是压过或抑制那个反馈回路, 所以这些产品在这条轴上得不到支持。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE, since the category is not a defined substance and no animal synthesises the plant ingredients. The endogenous process these products claim to raise is testicular steroidogenesis: cholesterol is imported into the mitochondrion by StAR, the rate-limiting step, cleaved to pregnenolone by CYP11A1, the rate-limiting enzymatic conversion, then processed by 3-beta-HSD type 2 (HSD3B2) and CYP17A1 to androstenedione and reduced to testosterone by 17-beta-HSD type 3 (HSD17B3) in LH-driven Leydig cells; human Leydig cells favour the delta-5 route (pregnenolone, 17-hydroxypregnenolone, DHEA, androstenedione or androstenediol, testosterone) because the 17,20-lyase activity of human CYP17A1 is poor on delta-4 substrates. Smaller contributions come from the adrenal cortex (DHEA, DHEA-S, androstenedione) and from peripheral conversion.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE, 该类别不是确定的物质, 其植物成分也没有动物能合成。这些产品声称要提高的内源过程是睾丸类固醇生成: 胆固醇由 StAR 转入线粒体, 这是限速步骤, 由 CYP11A1 裂解为 pregnenolone, 这是限速的酶催化转化, 随后经 3-beta-HSD 2 型 (HSD3B2) 和 CYP17A1 生成 androstenedione, 由 17-beta-HSD 3 型 (HSD17B3) 还原为睾酮, 发生在受 LH 调控的 Leydig 细胞内; 人的 Leydig 细胞偏好 delta-5 路线 (pregnenolone, 17-hydroxypregnenolone, DHEA, androstenedione 或 androstenediol, 睾酮), 因为人 CYP17A1 的 17,20-lyase 活性对 delta-4 底物很差。少量额外来源是肾上腺皮质 (DHEA, DHEA-S, androstenedione) 和外周转化。
items.daily_amount: About 7 mg/day of testosterone in healthy adult men (NCBI Bookshelf NBK279031, Endotext), alongside smaller amounts of weaker androgens such as androstenedione and DHEA; the testes are the dominant source with small adrenal and peripheral contributions, and NBK279031 does not quantify that split, so the often-quoted over 95 percent figure is not used here. 0 mg/day for the plant ingredients, none of which any animal synthesises. No synthesis figure applies to the product category itself.
items.daily_amount_zh: 健康成年男性每天约 7 mg 睾酮 (NCBI Bookshelf NBK279031, Endotext), 同时生成较少量的弱雄激素如 androstenedione 和 DHEA; 睾丸是主要来源, 肾上腺和外周转化贡献很小, NBK279031 未对这一比例给出数值, 因此这里不采用常被引用的超过 95 percent 来自睾丸的数字。植物成分为 0 mg/day, 任何动物都不合成。产品类别本身没有可用的合成量数值。
items.still_matters_when: Diagnosed hypogonadism, which is treated with prescription testosterone and clinician monitoring rather than with a booster; correcting a measured deficiency of a real cofactor such as vitamin D or zinc; and repairing the inputs that suppress the axis, meaning sleep, energy availability, alcohol and body fat. An analysis of best-selling online testosterone-boosting supplements found most ingredient claims unsupported by human data, with some products carrying very large vitamin and mineral doses (PMID 30621919, J Sex Med 2019;16:203-12), and the concrete consumer risk is adulteration, since over-the-counter boosters are among the products most often found spiked with SARMs, aromatase inhibitors or actual steroids, which do move testosterone and do suppress the axis. For these products themselves: NEVER ON THIS AXIS.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 确诊的性腺功能低下, 治疗方式是处方睾酮加临床监测, 不靠增强剂; 纠正实测的真实辅因子缺乏, 例如 vitamin D 或 zinc; 以及修复压制该轴的输入, 也就是睡眠, 能量可得性, 酒精和体脂。一项对网络畅销睾酮增强补剂的分析发现, 多数成分主张缺乏人体数据支持, 部分产品含极大剂量的维生素和矿物质 (PMID 30621919, J Sex Med 2019;16:203-12); 具体的消费者风险是掺假, 非处方增强剂是最常被检出掺入 SARMs, 芳香化酶抑制剂或真正类固醇的产品之一, 这些东西确实会改变睾酮, 也确实会抑制该轴。对这些产品本身: NEVER ON THIS AXIS (这条轴上永不适用)。
items.source: NCBI Bookshelf NBK279031 (O'Donnell L, Smith LB, Endocrinology of the Testis and Spermatogenesis, Endotext); PMID 30621919 (Balasubramanian A et al., Testosterone imposters: an analysis of popular online testosterone boosting supplements, J Sex Med 2019;16:203-12); Payne AH, Hales DB, Overview of steroidogenic enzymes. NA assigned under the dataset rule that a mixed commercial product category is not a defined substance; tier detail merged from the recovered entries Bodybuilding and test-booster products, Testosterone (the target of test-booster products), and Test-booster plant ingredients (tribulus, fenugreek, ashwagandha withanolides).

items.endogenous_note: Cells make NMN every day as the middle step of the NAD+ salvage pathway: NAMPT joins nicotinamide to 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate to form NMN, and NMNAT enzymes then convert NMN into NAD+. There is no dietary requirement for NMN at any intake, and NAMPT is feedback inhibited by nicotinamide, NAD+ and ATP (PMID 36746631), so the supplement targets the exact step the body already regulates. Buying NMN means adding an internal intermediate to a self-regulating pathway, and the only genuine dietary need upstream of it is the ordinary niacin requirement of 14 to 16 mg NE/day, which a normal diet covers, so the case for supplementing has to rest on outcome trials and not on repletion.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 细胞每天自己合成 NMN, 它是 NAD+ 补救合成通路的中间步骤: NAMPT 把 nicotinamide 与 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate 连接成 NMN, 再由 NMNAT 系列酶把 NMN 转成 NAD+。任何摄入水平下都不存在 NMN 的膳食需要量, 而 NAMPT 受 nicotinamide、NAD+ 和 ATP 的反馈抑制 (PMID 36746631), 补充剂瞄准的正是这个被主动调控的步骤。买 NMN 等于往一条自我调节的通路里补它自己的中间物, 上游唯一真实的膳食需求是每日 14 到 16 mg NE 的常规烟酸需要量 (仅靠色氨酸提供 16 mg NE 需要约 960 mg 色氨酸, 而每日 60 到 80 g 蛋白质的摄入能提供数倍于此), 普通饮食已经覆盖, 所以补充的理由只能来自结局试验, 与补足缺乏无关。
items.pathway: Nicotinamide + 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate to NMN by NAMPT (rate-limiting; feedback inhibited by nicotinamide, NAD+ and ATP, PMID 36746631); nicotinamide riboside to NMN by NRK1/NRK2 (NMRK1/2); NMN to NAD+ by NMNAT1 (nucleus), NMNAT2 (cytosol/Golgi) and NMNAT3, whose textbook assignment to mitochondria is disputed. Two further routes feed the same NAD pool: de novo from tryptophan through the kynurenine pathway (TDO2 or IDO1, KMO, KYNU, HAAO) to quinolinate, then QPRT to nicotinic acid mononucleotide and NMNAT1-3 to NAD; and the Preiss-Handler route from nicotinic acid through NAPRT.
items.pathway_zh: Nicotinamide + 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate 由 NAMPT 生成 NMN (限速步骤, 受 nicotinamide、NAD+ 和 ATP 反馈抑制, PMID 36746631); nicotinamide riboside 由 NRK1/NRK2 (NMRK1/2) 生成 NMN; NMN 由 NMNAT1 (细胞核)、NMNAT2 (胞质和高尔基体) 以及 NMNAT3 转成 NAD+, NMNAT3 归入线粒体的教科书说法存在争议。另有两条通路汇入同一个 NAD 池: 色氨酸经 kynurenine 通路 (TDO2 或 IDO1、KMO、KYNU、HAAO) 生成喹啉酸, 再由 QPRT 生成烟酸单核苷酸, 经 NMNAT1-3 生成 NAD; 以及 nicotinic acid 经 NAPRT 的 Preiss-Handler 通路。
items.daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED for endogenous NMN production itself, and no human whole-body NAD synthesis rate exists, partly because supply is only interpretable against consumption by PARPs, sirtuins, CD38 and SARM1. Sourced anchors: niacin RDA 16 mg NE/day for men and 14 mg NE/day for women, with dietary tryptophan converting at about 60 mg tryptophan per 1 mg niacin equivalent (IOM 1998). Supplement doses of 250 to 1000 mg/day sit one to two orders of magnitude above that vitamin requirement.
items.daily_amount_zh: 内源性 NMN 自身的生成速率 NOT ESTABLISHED, 人体全身 NAD 合成速率也没有测定值, 部分原因在于供给只有对照 PARPs、sirtuins、CD38 和 SARM1 的消耗才有意义。有来源的参照值: 烟酸 RDA 男性 16 mg NE/day, 女性 14 mg NE/day, 膳食色氨酸按约 60 mg 色氨酸折算 1 mg 烟酸当量 (IOM 1998)。补充剂 250 到 1000 mg/day 的剂量比这一维生素需要量高出一到两个数量级。
items.still_matters_when: Genuine niacin deficiency states (pellagra, chronic alcohol use, isoniazid therapy, Hartnup disease, carcinoid), where plain nicotinamide or nicotinic acid at vitamin doses is the established and far cheaper correction. Inborn errors of NAD synthesis (HAAO, KYNU, NADSYN1) are a separate clinical situation. Pharmacological NAD raising in ageing or metabolic disease remains experimental and cannot be justified as correcting a deficiency.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 真正的烟酸缺乏状态 (pellagra、长期饮酒、isoniazid 治疗、Hartnup 病、类癌), 此时用维生素剂量的 nicotinamide 或 nicotinic acid 是既成熟又便宜得多的纠正办法。NAD 合成的先天性缺陷 (HAAO、KYNU、NADSYN1) 属于另一类临床情形。在衰老或代谢病中用药理手段提升 NAD 仍属实验性质, 不能作为补足缺乏的理由。
items.source: PMID 29685734 (Liu et al., Cell Metab 2018;27:1067-1080.e5; in vivo arm in C57BL/6 mice); PMID 36746631 (NAMPT feedback inhibition); IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Thiamin, Riboflavin, Niacin, Vitamin B6, Folate, Vitamin B12, Pantothenic Acid, Biotin, and Choline (1998). Merged from the recovered rows 'NMN (nicotinamide mononucleotide)', 'Niacin and NAD precursors (nicotinamide, nicotinamide riboside, NMN)' and 'NAD precursors (nicotinamide riboside, NMN)'.

items.endogenous_note: NR is also an internal NAD intermediate: the body generates it by stripping the phosphate off NMN using CD73 and alkaline phosphatases, and it circulates in human blood and appears in milk without anyone supplementing. The first-pass finding that oral NR is mostly broken down to nicotinamide in the liver comes from mouse tracer work (PMID 27721479 mouse arm; PMID 29685734 in C57BL/6 mice), so the species label matters, and the human evidence is pharmacokinetic. Supplementing does raise blood NAD metabolites measurably, which makes NR a real pharmacological agent, and it still corrects no deficiency in a person eating normally, since NR, NMN, nicotinamide and nicotinic acid all feed the same NAD pool and the two vitamin forms cost a fraction of the price.
items.endogenous_note_zh: NR 同样是体内的 NAD 中间物: 机体通过 CD73 和碱性磷酸酶把 NMN 上的磷酸去掉来生成它, 在无人补充的情况下它也存在于人血液循环并出现在乳汁中。口服 NR 在肝脏首过时大部分被降解为 nicotinamide, 这一结论来自小鼠示踪研究 (PMID 27721479 的小鼠部分; PMID 29685734 使用 C57BL/6 小鼠), 因此物种标注很重要, 人体证据属于药代动力学层面。补充确实能可测量地提高血中 NAD 代谢物, 这使 NR 成为一种真实的药理制剂, 但对饮食正常的人它并不纠正任何缺乏: NR、NMN、nicotinamide 和 nicotinic acid 都汇入同一个 NAD 池, 其中两种维生素形式的价格只有它的零头。
items.pathway: NR to NMN by nicotinamide riboside kinases NRK1/NRK2 (NMRK1/2), then NMN to NAD+ by NMNAT1-3. NR is formed endogenously by dephosphorylation of NMN (NT5E/CD73, alkaline phosphatases) and degraded to nicotinamide by purine nucleoside phosphorylase. The Preiss-Handler route runs in parallel, with nicotinic acid entering through NAPRT to nicotinic acid mononucleotide and then the shared terminal steps, which is what governs how NAD metabolite biomarkers in trials should be read; the de novo kynurenine route from tryptophan feeds the same pool.
items.pathway_zh: NR 由 nicotinamide riboside kinases NRK1/NRK2 (NMRK1/2) 转成 NMN, 再由 NMNAT1-3 把 NMN 转成 NAD+。NR 在体内由 NMN 去磷酸化生成 (NT5E/CD73、碱性磷酸酶), 并由 purine nucleoside phosphorylase 降解为 nicotinamide。Preiss-Handler 通路并行运行, nicotinic acid 经 NAPRT 生成烟酸单核苷酸后进入相同的末端步骤, 这决定了试验中 NAD 代谢物生物标志物该如何解读; 色氨酸经 kynurenine 的从头合成通路汇入同一个池。
items.daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED for endogenous NR turnover. Sourced anchors: niacin requirement 14 to 16 mg NE/day (IOM 1998); in human dosing, a single-subject pilot showed blood NAD+ rising up to 2.7-fold after one oral NR dose, and the first formal pharmacokinetic trial (100, 300 and 1,000 mg) showed dose-dependent rises in blood NAD metabolites. Marketed doses of 250 to 1000 mg/day are one to two orders of magnitude above the vitamin requirement.
items.daily_amount_zh: 内源性 NR 周转量 NOT ESTABLISHED。有来源的参照值: 烟酸需要量 14 到 16 mg NE/day (IOM 1998); 在人体给药中, 一项单个受试者的先导研究显示单次口服 NR 后血 NAD+ 最高升高 2.7 倍, 首个正式药代动力学试验 (100、300 和 1,000 mg) 显示血中 NAD 代谢物随剂量升高。市售 250 到 1000 mg/day 的剂量比维生素需要量高出一到两个数量级。
items.still_matters_when: The same niacin deficiency and inborn-error settings listed for NMN, where vitamin-dose nicotinamide is the standard fix. Beyond that, use rests on clinical trial endpoints for a named condition, since there is no NR deficiency state to treat.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 与 NMN 条目所列相同的烟酸缺乏和先天性缺陷情形, 此时维生素剂量的 nicotinamide 是标准处理。除此之外, 使用只能依据针对具体疾病的临床试验终点, 因为并不存在需要治疗的 NR 缺乏状态。
items.source: PMID 27721479 (Trammell et al., Nat Commun 2016;7:12948; 2.7-fold rise from a single-subject pilot, mouse arm for oral-versus-intravenous handling); PMID 29685734 (Liu et al., Cell Metab 2018; C57BL/6 mice); IOM (1998). Merged from the recovered rows 'Nicotinamide riboside (NR)' and 'NAD precursors (nicotinamide riboside, NMN)'.

items.endogenous_note: Resveratrol is a plant stress compound, a stilbene assembled by stilbene synthase from 4-coumaroyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA in grapevine, peanut and Polygonum. Humans have no stilbene synthase and no phenylpropanoid pathway at all, so every molecule in the body arrived from food or a capsule. The endogenous axis therefore gives resveratrol no free pass and no handicap: the whole case has to rest on clinical outcomes, and the practical obstacle is that absorbed resveratrol is conjugated almost immediately.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 白藜芦醇是植物的应激化合物, 属于芪类, 在葡萄藤、花生和 Polygonum 中由 stilbene synthase 以 4-coumaroyl-CoA 和 malonyl-CoA 为底物组装而成。人体既没有 stilbene synthase, 也完全没有 phenylpropanoid 通路, 所以体内的每一个分子都来自食物或胶囊。内源性这一维度对它既不加分也不减分: 全部论证只能落在临床结局上, 而现实障碍是被吸收的白藜芦醇几乎立刻被结合代谢。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant route only: phenylalanine to 4-coumaroyl-CoA via phenylalanine ammonia-lyase and downstream enzymes, then condensation with three malonyl-CoA by stilbene synthase. No human homologue of any step exists; human handling is limited to UGT and SULT conjugation and colonic microbial degradation.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。只有植物途径: 苯丙氨酸经 phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 及下游酶生成 4-coumaroyl-CoA, 再由 stilbene synthase 与三个 malonyl-CoA 缩合。上述任何步骤在人体内都没有同源物; 人体的处理仅限于 UGT 和 SULT 结合以及结肠微生物降解。
items.daily_amount: 0 mg/day. Humans possess no biosynthetic route to resveratrol.
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 mg/day。人体没有合成白藜芦醇的途径。
items.still_matters_when: Only where trial evidence supports a defined endpoint, and the published trials are mostly small with surrogate endpoints. Bioavailability is the binding constraint: absorption of a dietary-relevant 25 mg oral dose was at least 70% in 6 volunteers, with peak plasma resveratrol plus metabolites at 491 +/- 90 ng/mL (about 2 micromol/L), yet only trace unchanged resveratrol was detectable (under 5 ng/mL) because of rapid glucuronidation and sulfation. Typical supplement doses are 100 to 500 mg, and the absorbed fraction at those doses has not been established.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 仅在有试验证据支持某个明确终点时才有意义, 而已发表的试验多为小样本和替代终点。生物利用度是决定性约束: 在 6 名志愿者中, 与膳食水平相当的 25 mg 口服剂量吸收率至少为 70%, 血浆中白藜芦醇及其代谢物峰值为 491 +/- 90 ng/mL (约 2 micromol/L), 但由于快速葡糖醛酸化和硫酸化, 只能检出痕量的未变化白藜芦醇 (低于 5 ng/mL)。常见补充剂剂量为 100 到 500 mg, 该剂量下的吸收比例尚未确立。
items.source: PMID 15333514 (Walle et al., Drug Metab Dispos 2004;32:1377-1382; 25 mg dose, n=6). Merged with the recovered row 'Adaptogens, medicinal mushrooms and high-volume polyphenols' for the first-pass conjugation and trial-quality points.

items.endogenous_note: Spermidine synthase builds spermidine from putrescine plus an aminopropyl group donated by decarboxylated S-adenosylmethionine, with ornithine decarboxylase as the tightly regulated rate-limiting entry step, while arginine decarboxylase plus agmatinase (AGMAT) provide a second, agmatine-derived route into the putrescine pool. Cells hold polyamines at high micromolar to millimolar concentrations, recycle them continuously through SSAT and polyamine oxidases, and also absorb polyamines produced by gut bacteria, and how that supply splits between host synthesis, diet and microbiota has never been quantified in humans. The FULL label covers the host pathway only, and the practical reading is that a fixed daily dose is an awkward intervention against a homeostatic system the body makes on demand and regulates in both directions.
items.endogenous_note_zh: Spermidine synthase 以 putrescine 加上由脱羧 S-adenosylmethionine 提供的氨丙基合成亚精胺, ornithine decarboxylase 是受严格调控的限速起始步骤, arginine decarboxylase 加 agmatinase (AGMAT) 构成另一条经 agmatine 进入 putrescine 池的途径。细胞把多胺维持在高微摩尔到毫摩尔浓度, 通过 SSAT 和多胺氧化酶持续回收, 也吸收肠道细菌产生的多胺, 这一供给在宿主合成、膳食和菌群之间如何分配, 在人体中从未被定量。FULL 标签只针对宿主通路, 微生物来源单独计算; 实际含义是机体按需制造并双向调节这类物质, 对这样一个稳态系统施加固定日剂量属于别扭的干预。
items.pathway: Ornithine to putrescine by ODC1 (antizyme/AZIN regulated); arginine to agmatine by arginine decarboxylase, then agmatine to putrescine by agmatinase (AGMAT), a real human input the standard scheme omits; methionine to SAM to decarboxylated SAM by AMD1; putrescine + dcSAM to spermidine by spermidine synthase (SRM), then to spermine by spermine synthase. Recycling runs through SSAT acetylation and the polyamine oxidases, and gut bacterial polyamines are absorbed as an additional exogenous input.
items.pathway_zh: Ornithine 由 ODC1 生成 putrescine (受 antizyme/AZIN 调控); arginine 由 arginine decarboxylase 生成 agmatine, 再由 agmatinase (AGMAT) 生成 putrescine, 这条人体确实存在的输入常被标准图示遗漏; methionine 生成 SAM, 再由 AMD1 生成脱羧 SAM; putrescine 与 dcSAM 由 spermidine synthase (SRM) 生成亚精胺, 再由 spermine synthase 生成精胺。回收依靠 SSAT 乙酰化和多胺氧化酶, 肠道细菌产生的多胺作为额外的外源输入被吸收。
items.daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED. No human whole-body de novo polyamine synthesis rate has been measured by tracer methods. The usable exposure anchor is cohort intake: dietary spermidine ran at roughly 10 to 12 mg/day across the Bruneck cohort tertiles (PMID 29955838), and food-composition data come from Swedish dairy analyses, where mature cheese contained 1.2 mg/kg spermidine (PMID 21249159).
items.daily_amount_zh: NOT ESTABLISHED。人体全身多胺从头合成速率尚无示踪法测定值。可用的暴露参照来自队列摄入量: 在 Bruneck 队列的三分位中, 膳食亚精胺约为 10 到 12 mg/day (PMID 29955838); 食物含量数据来自瑞典乳制品分析, 其中成熟干酪的亚精胺为 1.2 mg/kg (PMID 21249159)。
items.still_matters_when: Inherited polyamine pathway disorders such as spermine synthase loss in Snyder-Robinson syndrome, which oral polyamines do not correct. Otherwise only trial-supported endpoints, and the human data are observational: all-cause mortality fell across thirds of increasing dietary spermidine, fully adjusted HR 0.76 per 1-SD, 95% CI 0.67 to 0.86, P < 0.001, and the paper translated top versus bottom third as equivalent to an age difference of 5.7 years, 3.6 to 8.1 years. Note also that the opposite strategy is under study, since polyamine depletion is a cancer chemoprevention approach, so more is not automatically better.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 遗传性多胺通路疾病, 例如 Snyder-Robinson 综合征中的 spermine synthase 缺失, 口服多胺并不能纠正。除此之外只看试验支持的终点, 而现有人体数据是观察性的: 随膳食亚精胺三分位升高, 全因死亡率下降, 完全校正后每 1-SD 的 HR 为 0.76, 95% CI 0.67 到 0.86, P < 0.001; 该论文把最高与最低三分位之间的差异折算为相当于 5.7 年, 3.6 到 8.1 年的年龄差。也要注意相反的策略同样在研究中, 多胺耗竭是一种癌症化学预防思路, 因此摄入越多并不自动越好。
items.source: PMID 27268251 (Pegg, J Biol Chem 2016;291:14904-14912); PMID 21249159 (Atiya Ali et al., Food Nutr Res 2011;55:5572, Swedish food analyses); PMID 29955838 (Kiechl et al., Bruneck cohort).

items.endogenous_note: Every human cell makes ubiquinone on the mevalonate pathway, attaching a decaprenyl tail made by PDSS1/PDSS2 to a 4-hydroxybenzoate ring via COQ2, then finishing the molecule with the COQ3 to COQ9 enzymes and reducing it to ubiquinol. Diet supplies only 3 to 5 mg a day, a small contribution next to the tissue pools that endogenous synthesis maintains, so a healthy person is not short of CoQ10 and this is the clearest case in the group of a supplement filling a gap that does not exist. The statin link is real at the level of plasma measurement, where CoQ10 falls by about 0.44 micromol/L on treatment, and its interpretation is limited because plasma CoQ10 is carried on LDL, so part of the fall simply tracks the lipoprotein concentration and tissue or muscle depletion has not been demonstrated; on the endogenous axis nothing here exposes a dietary deficiency to correct.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 人体每个细胞都通过 mevalonate 通路合成泛醌, 由 PDSS1/PDSS2 制造癸异戊烯基尾链, 经 COQ2 接到 4-hydroxybenzoate 环上, 再由 COQ3 至 COQ9 一系列酶完成分子并还原为泛醇。膳食每天只提供 3 到 5 mg, 相对于内源合成维持的组织池只是很小的一部分, 因此健康人并不缺 CoQ10, 在这一组条目中它最清楚地展示了一种补充剂在填补并不存在的缺口。他汀的关联在血浆测量层面确实存在, 治疗后 CoQ10 下降约 0.44 micromol/L, 但解读受限: 血浆 CoQ10 由 LDL 携带, 下降的一部分只是跟随载脂蛋白浓度, 组织或肌肉 CoQ10 耗竭尚未被证明; 就内源性这条轴而言, 这里没有暴露出任何需要纠正的膳食缺乏。
items.pathway: Acetyl-CoA to HMG-CoA to mevalonate to farnesyl-PP to decaprenyl-PP (PDSS1/PDSS2); condensation with 4-hydroxybenzoate derived from tyrosine/phenylalanine by COQ2, and the tyrosine-to-4-hydroxybenzoate transamination steps require pyridoxal 5'-phosphate, so vitamin B6 status feeds the ring supply; ring modification by COQ3, COQ5, COQ6, COQ7 and COQ9 with the COQ8A and COQ8B kinases at the inner mitochondrial membrane, then reduction to ubiquinol. HMG-CoA reductase, the statin target, sits upstream of the polyprenyl tail.
items.pathway_zh: Acetyl-CoA 到 HMG-CoA 到 mevalonate 到 farnesyl-PP 到 decaprenyl-PP (PDSS1/PDSS2); 由 COQ2 与来自 tyrosine/phenylalanine 的 4-hydroxybenzoate 缩合, 而 tyrosine 转成 4-hydroxybenzoate 的转氨步骤需要 pyridoxal 5'-phosphate, 因此维生素 B6 状态影响环结构的供给; 环修饰由 COQ3、COQ5、COQ6、COQ7 和 COQ9 连同 COQ8A、COQ8B 激酶在线粒体内膜完成, 最后还原为泛醇。他汀靶点 HMG-CoA reductase 位于多异戊烯尾链的上游。
items.daily_amount: Endogenous synthesis rate in humans NOT ESTABLISHED, though it proceeds in all tissues and is highest in heart, kidney and liver. Sourced comparators: average dietary intake 3-5 mg/day, about 64% of it from meat and poultry, with 14-32% destroyed by frying and no detectable destruction by boiling; total body content of roughly 0.5 to 1.5 g and plasma of roughly 0.6 to 1.9 micromol/L; no RDA, AI or UL exists. Across 8 pooled placebo-controlled treatment arms, statin therapy lowered plasma CoQ10 by -0.44 micromol/L versus placebo. Supplement doses are 100-300 mg/day, and 5-50 mg/kg/d in primary CoQ10 deficiency.
items.daily_amount_zh: 人体内源合成速率 NOT ESTABLISHED, 但所有组织都在进行, 心、肾、肝最高。有来源的对照数据: 膳食平均摄入 3-5 mg/day, 其中约 64% 来自肉类和禽类, 油炸破坏 14-32%, 水煮未检出破坏; 全身含量约 0.5 到 1.5 g, 血浆约 0.6 到 1.9 micromol/L; 没有 RDA、AI 或 UL。在 8 个汇总的安慰剂对照治疗组中, 他汀治疗使血浆 CoQ10 相对安慰剂降低 -0.44 micromol/L。补充剂量 100-300 mg/day, 原发性 CoQ10 缺乏症为 5-50 mg/kg/d。
items.still_matters_when: Primary CoQ10 deficiency caused by COQ2, COQ4, COQ6, COQ8A, COQ8B, COQ9, PDSS1 or PDSS2 variants, where high-dose supplementation is standard care, dosing is time-critical and early treatment changes outcome. Also specific secondary deficiencies in mitochondrial disease and mitochondrial myopathies, adjunctive use in heart failure (Q-SYMBIO), and clinician-supervised trials of statin-associated muscle symptoms, where results remain inconsistent and mostly negative. Absorption is poor and lipid-dependent, so any trial or personal trial should dose it with fat.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 由 COQ2、COQ4、COQ6、COQ8A、COQ8B、COQ9、PDSS1 或 PDSS2 变异引起的原发性 CoQ10 缺乏, 此时高剂量补充是标准治疗, 剂量有时间紧迫性, 早期治疗会改变结局。此外还包括线粒体病和线粒体肌病中的特定继发性缺乏、心力衰竭的辅助使用 (Q-SYMBIO), 以及在临床医生监督下针对他汀相关肌肉症状的试验, 这类结果仍不一致且多为阴性。吸收差且依赖脂质, 所以任何试用都应与脂肪同服。
items.source: PMID 20494114 (Bentinger, Tekle, Dallner, Biochem Biophys Res Commun 2010;396:74-79); PMID 9129255 (Weber et al., Int J Vitam Nutr Res 1997;67:123-129); PMID 27060254 (Acosta et al., Biochim Biophys Acta 2016;1857(8):1079-85); the pooled statin/plasma CoQ10 meta-analysis of 8 placebo-controlled arms cited in the recovered row (its PMID is cut off in the recovered source field). Merged from the recovered rows 'Coenzyme Q10 / ubiquinol', 'Coenzyme Q10 (ubiquinone)', 'CoQ10, glutathione and alpha-lipoic acid' and 'Melatonin, coenzyme Q10, glutathione (with NAC), alpha-lipoic acid, DHEA and pregnenolone and progesterone'.

items.endogenous_note: Human mitochondria make lipoic acid de novo: an octanoyl chain from the mitochondrial fatty acid synthase route is transferred onto a lysine residue of the target protein, and lipoyl synthase (LIAS) then inserts two sulfur atoms while the chain is already attached. The functional cofactor pool is protein-bound R-lipoyllysine on pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, BCKDH and the glycine cleavage H protein, and free lipoate is not a physiological cofactor form, although mammalian lipoamidase, the same protein as serum biotinidase, does hydrolyse lipoyl substrates (PMID 8484735, PMID 2225462), an activity present in human serum and milk (PMID 3168970, PMID 2127386). The FULL label applies to the endogenous cofactor and does not carry over to the capsule: swallowed free ALA is never loaded onto the dehydrogenase complexes, so a supplement works as a short-acting redox drug and not as repletion of a cofactor.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 人体线粒体能从头合成硫辛酸: 来自线粒体脂肪酸合成途径的辛酰基链先被转移到靶蛋白的赖氨酸残基上, 随后 lipoyl synthase (LIAS) 在链已连接的状态下插入两个硫原子。具有功能的辅因子池是结合在 pyruvate dehydrogenase、alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase、BCKDH 和甘氨酸裂解系统 H 蛋白上的蛋白结合型 R-lipoyllysine, 游离硫辛酸并非生理性的辅因子形式; 不过哺乳动物 lipoamidase 与血清 biotinidase 是同一个蛋白, 能水解 lipoyl 底物 (PMID 8484735, PMID 2225462), 该活性存在于人血清和乳汁中 (PMID 3168970, PMID 2127386)。FULL 这个标签针对的是内源辅因子, 它不能套用到胶囊上: 口服的游离 ALA 不会被装载到脱氢酶复合体上, 所以补充剂起的是短效氧化还原药物的作用, 与补足辅因子无关。
items.pathway: Mitochondrial FAS II generates octanoyl-ACP; LIPT2 transfers the octanoyl group onto the H protein lysine; LIAS, a radical-SAM iron-sulfur enzyme, inserts sulfur at C6 and C8; LIPT1 then relays lipoyl groups to the E2 subunits of the 2-oxo acid dehydrogenase complexes. LIAS activity depends on iron-sulfur cluster assembly machinery (NFU1, BOLA3, GLRX5, ISCA2, IBA57), the commonest genetic cause of human lipoylation failure and usually omitted from supplement-side accounts. The reactions sit in the mitochondrial matrix and run in all tissues.
items.pathway_zh: 线粒体 FAS II 生成 octanoyl-ACP; LIPT2 把辛酰基转移到 H 蛋白的赖氨酸上; LIAS 是一种 radical-SAM 铁硫酶, 在 C6 和 C8 位插入硫; 随后 LIPT1 把 lipoyl 基团转交给 2-氧代酸脱氢酶复合体的 E2 亚基。LIAS 活性依赖铁硫簇组装机器 (NFU1、BOLA3、GLRX5、ISCA2、IBA57), 这是人类脂酰化失败最常见的遗传原因, 在偏补充剂视角的叙述中通常被省略。反应位于线粒体基质, 存在于所有组织。
items.daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED. No measured human de novo lipoate synthesis rate exists. Food provides only protein-bound lipoyllysine in trace amounts, orders of magnitude below the free ALA content of a typical 200-600 mg supplement.
items.daily_amount_zh: NOT ESTABLISHED。人体从头合成硫辛酸的速率没有测定值。食物只提供痕量的蛋白结合型 lipoyllysine, 比典型 200-600 mg 补充剂中的游离 ALA 含量低几个数量级。
items.still_matters_when: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy, where 600 mg oral or intravenous ALA has trial support of mixed quality; that is a pharmacological indication, unrelated to correcting a deficiency. Inherited LIAS, LIPT1 and LIPT2 defects, and the Fe-S cluster defects (NFU1, BOLA3, GLRX5) that cause the same lipoylation failure, produce severe multisystem disease; in patient fibroblasts, treatment with lipoate and with mitochondria-targeted lipoate failed to correct the defect (PMID 24334290), and no registered clinical trial of oral lipoate exists in these patients, so that evidence is cell-level. Watch for reports of insulin autoimmune syndrome in susceptible HLA genotypes.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 糖尿病周围神经病变, 该适应症下 600 mg 口服或静脉 ALA 有质量不一的试验支持, 这属于药理学适应症, 与纠正缺乏无关。遗传性 LIAS、LIPT1 和 LIPT2 缺陷, 以及导致同样脂酰化失败的铁硫簇缺陷 (NFU1、BOLA3、GLRX5), 都会造成严重的多系统疾病; 在患者成纤维细胞中, 用硫辛酸以及靶向线粒体的硫辛酸处理都未能纠正该缺陷 (PMID 24334290), 目前没有针对这些患者口服硫辛酸的收录临床试验, 因此证据停留在细胞层面。使用时注意易感 HLA 基因型中胰岛素自身免疫综合征的报告。
items.source: PMID 29191830 (Solmonson & DeBerardinis, J Biol Chem 2018;293:7522-7530); PMID 19664690 (Shay et al., Biochim Biophys Acta 2009;1790:1149-1160); PMID 24334290 (patient fibroblast treatment); PMID 8484735, PMID 2225462, PMID 3168970, PMID 2127386 (lipoamidase/biotinidase). Merged with the recovered rows 'CoQ10, glutathione and alpha-lipoic acid' and 'Fully endogenous small molecules sold as supplements' for the free-versus-bound argument.

items.endogenous_note: Dimethyl sulfone is a normal trace constituent of human blood and cerebrospinal fluid in people taking no supplement, measured at 0 to 25 micromol/L, and host enzymes do produce it: thiol S-methyltransferase methylates methanethiol to dimethyl sulfide, and flavin-containing monooxygenases oxidise that to DMSO and then to dimethyl sulfone. What is not endogenous is the precursor supply, which comes mostly from bacterial methionine catabolism in the gut and from diet, and no human enzyme has MSM as its designated end product. There is no requirement, no deficiency state and no known physiological function, so the endogenous axis offers no repletion rationale at all and any claim has to stand on symptom trials.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 二甲基砜是未服用任何补充剂的人血液和脑脊液中的正常微量成分, 实测浓度为 0 到 25 micromol/L, 宿主的酶确实会生成它: thiol S-methyltransferase 把甲硫醇甲基化为二甲基硫, flavin-containing monooxygenases 再把它氧化为 DMSO, 进而氧化为二甲基砜。不属于内源的是前体供给, 它主要来自肠道细菌的 methionine 分解代谢和膳食, 而且没有任何人体酶以 MSM 作为其指定终产物。它没有需要量, 没有缺乏状态, 也没有已知生理功能, 所以内源性这一维度提供不了补足缺乏的理由, 任何主张只能依靠症状学试验。
items.pathway: No dedicated human biosynthetic pathway, though the terminal oxidation steps are host-catalysed. Methanethiol comes mainly from bacterial methionine catabolism in the gut and from the methionine transamination route; host thiol S-methyltransferase activity yields dimethyl sulfide, and further oxidation by flavin-containing monooxygenases gives DMSO and then dimethyl sulfone. Diet is a further source. A dimethyl sulfone finding was reported in 3 of 4 patients with severe methionine adenosyltransferase I/III deficiency (PMID 15996001), which is the human link between the pool and methionine handling.
items.pathway_zh: 人体没有专门的生物合成通路, 不过最后的氧化步骤由宿主酶催化。甲硫醇主要来自肠道细菌的 methionine 分解代谢和 methionine 转氨途径; 宿主 thiol S-methyltransferase 活性生成二甲基硫, 再经 flavin-containing monooxygenases 进一步氧化为 DMSO, 随后为二甲基砜。膳食是另一个来源。在 4 名重度 methionine adenosyltransferase I/III 缺乏症患者中有 3 名报告了二甲基砜相关发现 (PMID 15996001), 这是这一物质池与 methionine 代谢之间的人体证据。
items.daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED. Only circulating concentrations are documented: 0 to 25 micromol/L in plasma and CSF of healthy unsupplemented controls, against gram-scale supplement doses.
items.daily_amount_zh: NOT ESTABLISHED。已记录的只有循环浓度: 未补充的健康对照者血浆和脑脊液为 0 到 25 micromol/L, 而补充剂剂量在克级。
items.still_matters_when: Nothing on a repletion basis, because no requirement or deficiency exists. Use would have to rest on trial evidence for a specific symptom, and the usual claim (osteoarthritis pain) comes from small short trials.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 从补足缺乏的角度没有任何适用情形, 因为既无需要量也无缺乏状态。使用只能依据针对具体症状的试验证据, 而常见的主张 (骨关节炎疼痛) 来自规模小、周期短的试验。
items.source: PMID 15996001 (Engelke et al., NMR Biomed 2005;18:331-336; MAT I/III finding in 3 of 4 patients).

items.endogenous_note: Astaxanthin is a ketocarotenoid produced by microalgae such as Haematococcus pluvialis and by some bacteria and yeasts, using a beta-carotene ketolase (BKT/CrtW) plus a hydroxylase (CrtZ). Humans synthesise no carotenoids whatsoever and cannot convert beta-carotene into astaxanthin, and salmon and shrimp are pink from the astaxanthin in their food rather than from their own synthesis. Everything in a human body reflects intake, there is no deficiency state to correct and no provitamin A activity to fall back on, so the supplement stands or falls on trial results.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 虾青素是一种酮式类胡萝卜素, 由 Haematococcus pluvialis 等微藻以及部分细菌和酵母利用 beta-carotene ketolase (BKT/CrtW) 加羟化酶 (CrtZ) 生成。人体完全不合成任何类胡萝卜素, 也无法把 beta-carotene 转成虾青素; 三文鱼和虾呈粉色来自其食物中的虾青素, 它们自己也不合成。人体内的全部虾青素都反映摄入量, 没有需要纠正的缺乏状态, 也没有维生素 A 原活性可以退守, 因此这种补充剂的成败完全取决于试验结果。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Algal and microbial route: beta-carotene to echinenone to canthaxanthin by BKT/CrtW ketolase, with CrtZ/CrtR-b hydroxylation to adonirubin and astaxanthin. No human homologue of any step.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。藻类和微生物途径: beta-carotene 经 BKT/CrtW 酮化酶生成 echinenone, 再生成 canthaxanthin, 并由 CrtZ/CrtR-b 羟化生成 adonirubin 和虾青素。上述任何步骤在人体内都没有同源物。
items.daily_amount: 0 mg/day. Humans have no carotenoid biosynthetic pathway.
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 mg/day。人体没有类胡萝卜素生物合成通路。
items.still_matters_when: Only where trial evidence supports a defined endpoint. With no requirement and no deficiency state, dose selection is entirely empirical.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 仅在有试验证据支持某个明确终点时才有意义。既没有需要量也没有缺乏状态, 剂量选择完全是经验性的。
items.source: PMID 24402174 (Ambati et al., Mar Drugs 2014;12:128-152).

items.endogenous_note: Curcuminoids are plant polyketides: Curcuma longa builds them from feruloyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA using two type III polyketide synthases, diketide-CoA synthase and curcumin synthase. Humans have no phenylpropanoid pathway and no type III polyketide synthase, so curcumin is a xenobiotic the body can only absorb, conjugate and clear. Endogenous synthesis is irrelevant to the buying decision here, and the operative limit is pharmacokinetic: oral curcumin is glucuronidated and sulfated so fast that free plasma concentrations stay very low, which is why any case for it rests on trial evidence for a named indication and on the specific formulation used.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 姜黄素类是植物聚酮化合物: Curcuma longa 以 feruloyl-CoA 和 malonyl-CoA 为底物, 通过两种 III 型聚酮合酶 (diketide-CoA synthase 和 curcumin synthase) 合成。人体没有 phenylpropanoid 通路, 也没有 III 型聚酮合酶, 因此姜黄素是一种外源物, 机体只能吸收、结合和清除。内源合成与这里的购买决策无关, 真正起作用的限制是药代动力学: 口服姜黄素被葡糖醛酸化和硫酸化的速度极快, 游离血浆浓度始终很低, 所以任何理由都必须来自针对具体适应症的试验证据以及所用的具体制剂。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant route only: phenylalanine through phenylalanine ammonia-lyase to feruloyl-CoA, then DCS and CURS type III polyketide synthases in Curcuma longa rhizome. Human handling is limited to UGT and SULT conjugation and colonic microbial degradation.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。只有植物途径: 苯丙氨酸经 phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 生成 feruloyl-CoA, 随后在 Curcuma longa 根茎中由 DCS 和 CURS 两种 III 型聚酮合酶完成合成。人体的处理仅限于 UGT 和 SULT 结合以及结肠微生物降解。
items.daily_amount: 0 mg/day. Humans have no biosynthetic route to curcuminoids.
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 mg/day。人体没有合成姜黄素类的途径。
items.still_matters_when: Only on trial evidence for a specific indication, with attention to the formulation used in that trial, since plain extract is poorly bioavailable, and to interactions through CYP and UGT pathways for anyone on prescription medicines. Safety screening also covers herb-induced liver injury with high-dose enhanced-absorption curcumin, associated with HLA-B*35:01, and piperine co-formulation, which raises exposure to other drugs.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 只能依据针对具体适应症的试验证据, 同时要注意该试验所用的制剂形式 (普通提取物生物利用度很低), 以及对正在服用处方药的人经 CYP 和 UGT 通路产生的相互作用。安全性方面还要考虑高剂量强化吸收型姜黄素引起的草本性肝损伤 (与 HLA-B*35:01 相关), 以及与胡椒碱共配方会提高其他药物的暴露。
items.source: PMID 19258320 (Katsuyama et al., J Biol Chem 2009;284:11160-11170). Merged with the recovered row 'Adaptogens, medicinal mushrooms and high-volume polyphenols' for the HLA-B*35:01 liver injury and piperine interaction points.

items.endogenous_note: EGCG is a galloylated flavan-3-ol built in the tea plant by the shikimate and phenylpropanoid pathways plus chalcone synthase, with a dedicated epicatechin galloyltransferase adding the gallate group. Humans have none of those enzymes, starting with phenylalanine ammonia-lyase, so intake is the only source and no deficiency exists. On this axis EGCG is optional by definition, which shifts the whole question onto trial benefit and onto safety, where concentrated catechin extracts carry a documented liver injury signal that brewed tea does not.
items.endogenous_note_zh: EGCG 是一种没食子酰化的黄烷-3-醇, 在茶树中由莽草酸通路、phenylpropanoid 通路以及 chalcone synthase 合成, 并由专门的 epicatechin galloyltransferase 加上没食子酰基。人体从 phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 起就没有这些酶, 因此摄入是唯一来源, 也不存在缺乏。在这个维度上 EGCG 按定义就是可选项, 于是全部问题落到试验获益和安全性上, 而浓缩儿茶素提取物有明确记录的肝损伤信号, 冲泡茶饮没有。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Camellia sinensis route: phenylalanine through phenylalanine ammonia-lyase to 4-coumaroyl-CoA, chalcone synthase and the flavonoid branch to epigallocatechin, then galloylation by ECGT using galloyl-1-O-beta-D-glucose as donor.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Camellia sinensis 途径: 苯丙氨酸经 phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 生成 4-coumaroyl-CoA, 再经 chalcone synthase 和类黄酮分支生成 epigallocatechin, 随后由 ECGT 以 galloyl-1-O-beta-D-glucose 为供体完成没食子酰化。
items.daily_amount: 0 mg/day. Humans have no flavonoid biosynthetic pathway.
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 mg/day。人体没有类黄酮生物合成通路。
items.still_matters_when: Only trial-supported endpoints. Dose and form are the safety-relevant variables, and there are usable thresholds: EFSA concluded that 800 mg EGCG/day or more taken as a food supplement produces a statistically significant rise in serum transaminases, with no evidence of hepatotoxicity below that level for up to 12 months, while catechins from traditionally brewed green tea infusion are generally considered safe (EFSA Journal 2018;16(4):5239, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2018.5239). The USP assessment of case reports concluded that concentrated green tea extract can cause hepatotoxicity, particularly when taken on an empty stomach, and recommended a label caution. Both support cautious use rather than routine use.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 只看试验支持的终点。剂量和形式是与安全相关的变量, 而且有可用的阈值: EFSA 的结论是, 作为食品补充剂摄入 800 mg EGCG/day 或更多会使血清转氨酶出现统计学显著升高, 在此水平以下最长 12 个月未见肝毒性证据, 而按传统方式冲泡的绿茶中的儿茶素一般被认为是安全的 (EFSA Journal 2018;16(4):5239, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2018.5239)。USP 对病例报告的评估结论是浓缩绿茶提取物可导致肝毒性, 空腹服用时尤其如此, 并建议在标签上加注警示。两者都支持谨慎使用而非常规服用。
items.source: PMID 23132863 (Liu et al., J Biol Chem 2012;287:44406-44417); PMID 32140423 (Oketch-Rabah et al., Toxicol Rep 2020;7:386-402); EFSA Journal 2018;16(4):5239, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2018.5239.

items.endogenous_note: The label has to be PARTIAL, because the class as scoped here (vitamins A, C and E, carotenoids, CoQ10) contains nutrients the body cannot make at all: humans carry a non-functional GULO (L-gulonolactone oxidase) pseudogene and synthesise zero ascorbate (PMID 8175804), and alpha-tocopherol is entirely dietary, while CoQ10 is fully endogenous, which is the split inside the category. The enzymatic arm is endogenous but nutrient-dependent: every glutathione peroxidase and thioredoxin reductase is a selenoprotein requiring dietary selenium, and glutathione regeneration needs NADPH supplied through G6PD and the pentose phosphate pathway, on top of the substantial system the body runs by itself (millimolar intracellular glutathione, superoxide dismutases 1 to 3, catalase, glutathione peroxidases, peroxiredoxins and thioredoxins). For supplementing this means the endogenous defences are already running during treatment, so the default during active cytotoxic therapy is to hold high-dose antioxidant supplements unless a documented deficiency or the oncology team says otherwise.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 这里的标签必须是 PARTIAL, 因为按本条目界定的这一类物质 (维生素 A、C、E, 类胡萝卜素, CoQ10) 中包含机体完全无法合成的营养素: 人类携带失活的 GULO (L-gulonolactone oxidase) 假基因, 抗坏血酸合成量为零 (PMID 8175804), alpha-tocopherol 完全依赖膳食, 而 CoQ10 是完全内源的, 这就是这一类别内部的分歧所在。酶系这一支是内源的, 但依赖营养素: 所有 glutathione peroxidase 和 thioredoxin reductase 都是硒蛋白, 需要膳食硒, 谷胱甘肽的再生需要经 G6PD 和戊糖磷酸通路提供的 NADPH; 机体自身运行的部分也确实可观, 包括细胞内毫摩尔浓度的谷胱甘肽、superoxide dismutases 1 到 3、catalase、glutathione peroxidases、peroxiredoxins 和 thioredoxins。对补充的含义是: 治疗期间内源防御本就在运转, 所以在细胞毒治疗期间的默认做法是暂停高剂量抗氧化补充剂, 除非有记录的缺乏或主管肿瘤团队另有安排。
items.pathway: Glutathione: glutamate + cysteine to gamma-glutamylcysteine by GCLC/GCLM, then GSH by glutathione synthetase, in the cytosol of all cells with liver as the main exporter; regenerated by glutathione reductase using NADPH from the pentose phosphate pathway, with G6PD as the entry enzyme, so G6PD deficiency limits the regenerating arm. Enzymatic arm: SOD1/SOD2/SOD3, CAT, GPX1-8, PRDX and TXN systems, with the glutathione peroxidases and thioredoxin reductases dependent on dietary selenium. NOT APPLICABLE for the dietary members of the class: there is no human pathway to ascorbate (GULO pseudogene), to alpha-tocopherol or to carotenoids.
items.pathway_zh: 谷胱甘肽: glutamate + cysteine 由 GCLC/GCLM 生成 gamma-glutamylcysteine, 再由 glutathione synthetase 生成 GSH, 反应在所有细胞的胞质中进行, 肝脏是主要输出器官; 再生依靠 glutathione reductase 使用来自戊糖磷酸通路的 NADPH, 入口酶是 G6PD, 因此 G6PD 缺乏会限制再生这一支。酶系这一支: SOD1/SOD2/SOD3、CAT、GPX1-8、PRDX 和 TXN 系统, 其中 glutathione peroxidases 和 thioredoxin reductases 依赖膳食硒。对这一类别中的膳食成员则是 NOT APPLICABLE: 人体没有合成抗坏血酸 (GULO 假基因)、alpha-tocopherol 或类胡萝卜素的通路。
items.daily_amount: Whole-blood glutathione synthesis 747 +/- 216 micromol/L/day with a fractional synthesis rate of 0.65 +/- 0.13 per day and whole-blood GSH of 1,142 +/- 243 micromol/L in 7 healthy adult men on an adequate diet, falling to 579 +/- 135 micromol/L/day on a sulfur amino acid free diet. Two limits on reading that figure: it covers only the glutathione arm, and the dietary members of the class have a synthesis rate of 0 mg/day, so no single number describes the category.
items.daily_amount_zh: 在 7 名膳食充足的健康成年男性中, 全血谷胱甘肽合成为 747 +/- 216 micromol/L/day, 分数合成率为每天 0.65 +/- 0.13, 全血 GSH 为 1,142 +/- 243 micromol/L; 在无含硫氨基酸膳食下降至 579 +/- 135 micromol/L/day。解读这个数字有两点限定: 它只覆盖谷胱甘肽这一支, 而这一类别中的膳食成员合成速率为 0 mg/day, 所以没有单一数字能描述整个类别。
items.still_matters_when: Documented deficiency of the dietary antioxidant vitamins (vitamin C in scurvy, vitamin E in fat malabsorption or abetalipoproteinaemia), documented selenium deficiency affecting the selenoprotein arm, and supportive care specifically ordered by the treating oncology team. Otherwise the default during active cytotoxic therapy is to hold high-dose antioxidant supplements. In SWOG S0221 (self-reported supplement use observed within a randomised trial, so not randomised evidence), use of any antioxidant supplement (vitamins A, C and E, carotenoids, CoQ10) both before and during treatment was associated with a higher recurrence rate, adjusted HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 to 2.04.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 有记录的膳食抗氧化维生素缺乏 (坏血病中的维生素 C, 脂肪吸收不良或 abetalipoproteinaemia 中的维生素 E), 有记录的影响硒蛋白这一支的硒缺乏, 以及由主管肿瘤治疗团队明确开具的支持治疗。除此之外, 在细胞毒治疗期间的默认做法是暂停高剂量抗氧化补充剂。在 SWOG S0221 中 (随机试验内部观察到的自报补充剂使用情况, 因此不属于随机化证据), 在治疗前和治疗期间都使用任一抗氧化补充剂 (维生素 A、C、E, 类胡萝卜素, CoQ10) 与更高复发率相关 (校正 HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 到 2.04)。
items.source: PMID 10792033 (Lyons et al., Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 2000;97:5071-5076; 7 healthy men, whole-blood 13C-cysteine tracer); PMID 32231263 (Sies & Jones, Nat Rev Mol Cell Biol); PMID 8175804 (GULO pseudogene); SWOG S0221 (observational supplement use within a randomised trial).

items.endogenous_note: The pineal gland makes melatonin from tryptophan through TPH1, aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase, AANAT and ASMT, under suprachiasmatic nucleus control and suppressed by light, and nocturnal output is small. In a dose-ranging trial in adults over 50, 0.3 mg restored sleep efficiency and raised plasma melatonin to normal nocturnal levels, while 3.0 mg raised it above the physiological range, so common 3 to 10 mg capsules sit one to two orders of magnitude above the nightly physiological amount. There is no melatonin deficiency disease, so dose and timing are the whole discussion and repletion never enters into it.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 松果体以色氨酸为起点, 经 TPH1, aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase, AANAT 和 ASMT 合成褪黑素, 受视交叉上核控制并被光抑制, 夜间产量很小。在一项针对 50 岁以上成人的剂量探索试验中, 0.3 mg 恢复了睡眠效率并把血浆褪黑素提高到正常夜间水平, 而 3.0 mg 把它推到生理范围之上, 因此常见的 3 到 10 mg 胶囊比夜间生理量高出一到两个数量级。褪黑素没有缺乏病, 所以剂量和给药时间就是全部讨论内容, 与补足短缺无关。
items.pathway: Tryptophan to 5-hydroxytryptophan by TPH1, to serotonin by aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase (DDC), to N-acetylserotonin by AANAT (the rhythm-generating and light-suppressed step, driven by noradrenergic input from the suprachiasmatic nucleus via the superior cervical ganglion), then to melatonin by ASMT (HIOMT). Pinealocytes are the main source, with extrapineal synthesis in retina, gut and other tissues contributing little to circulating levels. Clearance is mainly hepatic CYP1A2 6-hydroxylation; receptors are MT1 and MT2.
items.pathway_zh: 色氨酸由 TPH1 生成 5-hydroxytryptophan, 由 aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase (DDC) 生成 serotonin, 由 AANAT 生成 N-acetylserotonin (产生节律并受光抑制的步骤, 由视交叉上核经颈上神经节的去甲肾上腺素输入驱动), 最后由 ASMT (HIOMT) 生成褪黑素。松果体细胞是主要来源, 视网膜, 肠道和其他组织的松果体外合成对循环水平贡献不大。清除主要经肝 CYP1A2 的 6 羟化; 受体为 MT1 和 MT2。
items.daily_amount: The dedicated row records total endogenous nightly output as NOT ESTABLISHED as a verified figure in this pass, with the dose-response as the usable sourced anchor: 0.1, 0.3 and 3.0 mg given orally 30 minutes before bedtime in adults over 50, where 0.3 mg restored sleep efficiency and raised plasma melatonin to normal levels and 3.0 mg produced supraphysiological levels (PMID 11600532). The merged rows quote roughly 10 to 80 micrograms secreted per night in adults, falling with age, against supplement doses of 0.5 to 10 mg, and about 38.5 microg over a night for a 70 kg adult.
items.daily_amount_zh: 专条把内源夜间总产量记为 NOT ESTABLISHED, 本轮没有经核对的数值, 可用的有来源参照是剂量反应: 在 50 岁以上成人中于睡前 30 分钟口服 0.1, 0.3 和 3.0 mg, 其中 0.3 mg 恢复了睡眠效率并把血浆褪黑素提高到正常水平, 而 3.0 mg 产生超生理水平 (PMID 11600532)。并入的条目给出成人每夜分泌约 10 到 80 micrograms 并随年龄下降, 补剂剂量为 0.5 到 10 mg, 70 kg 成人整夜约 38.5 microg。
