items.still_matters_when: Circadian timing problems where melatonin acts as a chronobiotic: jet lag, delayed sleep-wake phase disorder, shift work, free-running or non-24-hour rhythms in some blind people, neurodevelopmental conditions in children under supervision, and older adults, where prolonged-release 2 mg is licensed in the EU and UK. All of these depend on low doses given at the right time, and none of it is repletion, since no deficiency state exists. Timing errors and self-selected multi-milligram doses are the two practical failure modes.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 褪黑素作为时相调节剂发挥作用的昼夜节律问题: 时差, 睡眠时相延迟障碍, 轮班工作, 部分盲人的自由运转或非 24 小时节律, 监督下的儿童神经发育疾病, 以及老年人 (欧盟和英国获批 2 mg 缓释)。这些都依赖在正确时间给予低剂量, 其中没有任何补足缺乏的成分, 因为不存在缺乏状态。给药时间错误和自行选择的毫克级大剂量是两种常见的实际失败方式。
items.source: PMID 11600532 (Zhdanova et al., J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2001;86:4727-4730); merged with the melatonin content of the combined endogenous-molecule rows (Klein DC, Arylalkylamine N-acetyltransferase: the timezyme, J Biol Chem 2007;282:4233-7)

items.endogenous_note: Berberine is a protoberberine isoquinoline alkaloid made by plants such as Coptis chinensis, Berberis species and Hydrastis canadensis. Human cells do form the upstream benzylisoquinolines, since norlaudanosoline, 1(S)-reticuline and morphine were identified in human SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma and DAN-G pancreatic carcinoma cells and shown by labelled-precursor feeding to be of biosynthetic origin (PMID 15383669), but humans lack berberine bridge enzyme and the protoberberine steps beyond reticuline, so every milligram of berberine in the blood came from a plant or a factory. The endogenous axis can neither argue for nor against taking it, and the judgement falls to trial data, poor oral bioavailability and interaction burden.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 小檗碱是原小檗碱型异喹啉生物碱, 由 Coptis chinensis, Berberis 属和 Hydrastis canadensis 等植物合成。人细胞确实能生成上游的苄基异喹啉: 在人 SH-SY5Y 神经母细胞瘤细胞和 DAN-G 胰腺癌细胞中鉴定出 norlaudanosoline, 1(S)-reticuline 和吗啡, 并用标记前体喂养证明它们来自生物合成 (PMID 15383669), 但人缺 berberine bridge enzyme 以及 reticuline 之后的原小檗碱步骤, 所以血中每一毫克小檗碱都来自植物或工厂。因此内源合成这条轴既不能反对也不能支持它, 判断依据是试验数据, 很差的口服生物利用度和药物相互作用负担。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for berberine itself. The plant benzylisoquinoline route runs from L-tyrosine through (S)-norcoclaurine and (S)-reticuline, then berberine bridge enzyme to (S)-scoulerine and on to berberine. Humans reach reticuline as part of the endogenous morphine pathway (PMID 15383669) but have no berberine bridge enzyme and none of the protoberberine steps downstream of it.
items.pathway_zh: 对小檗碱本身 NOT APPLICABLE。植物苄基异喹啉途径从 L-tyrosine 经 (S)-norcoclaurine 和 (S)-reticuline, 再由 berberine bridge enzyme 生成 (S)-scoulerine 并继续生成小檗碱。人能走到 reticuline (内源吗啡途径的一部分, PMID 15383669), 但没有 berberine bridge enzyme, 也没有其下游的原小檗碱步骤。
items.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway for berberine)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有小檗碱的生物合成途径)
items.still_matters_when: Every dose is exogenous by definition, so this axis is silent. Screen instead on clinical effect size, the low and variable oral bioavailability, and drug interactions through P-glycoprotein and CYP inhibition.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 按定义每一剂都是外源的, 所以这条轴没有发言权。改用临床效应量, 低且波动的口服生物利用度, 以及通过 P-glycoprotein 和 CYP 抑制产生的药物相互作用来筛查。
items.source: PMID 27671811 (Cicero AF, Adv Exp Med Biol 2016, Berberine and Its Role in Chronic Disease); PMID 15383669 (Poeaknapo C, PNAS 2004;101:14091-6, endogenous formation of morphine in human cells)

items.endogenous_note: The active constituents are withanolides, steroidal lactones such as withaferin A and withanolide A, built in the plant from mevalonate-derived sterols. Humans make sterols but not withanolides, and there is no human enzyme that produces the withanolide lactone ring. Nothing about ashwagandha can be framed as replacing something the body has run short of.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 活性成分是 withanolides, 即 withaferin A 和 withanolide A 这类甾体内酯, 在植物体内由甲羟戊酸途径来源的甾醇构建。人能合成甾醇, 不能合成 withanolides, 也没有任何人类酶能生成 withanolide 的内酯环。因此不能把服用南非醉茄说成补充身体短缺的东西。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Withanolide biosynthesis proceeds in Withania somnifera from 24-methylenecholesterol through plant cytochrome P450 oxidations; absent from human tissue.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Withanolide 的生物合成在 Withania somnifera 中由 24-methylenecholesterol 经植物 cytochrome P450 氧化完成; 人体组织中不存在该途径。
items.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
items.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on trial quality for the claimed indication (stress, sleep, testosterone), extract standardisation to withanolide content, and reported hepatotoxicity and thyroid effects.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用所声称适应症 (压力, 睡眠, 睾酮) 的试验质量, 提取物按 withanolide 含量的标准化, 以及已报告的肝毒性和甲状腺影响来筛查。
items.source: PMID 37063285 (Bashir A, Front Pharmacol 2023, An updated review on phytochemistry and molecular targets of Withania somnifera)

items.endogenous_note: The marker compounds are salidroside, a tyrosol glucoside, plus the cinnamyl glycosides rosavin, rosin and rosarin, all made in the rhizome. Tyrosol itself occurs endogenously in humans as a metabolite of tyramine (tyramine to 4-hydroxyphenylacetaldehyde to tyrosol), and hydroxytyrosol arises the same way from dopamine, so the aglycone is present in humans; what is missing is the specific UDP-glucosyltransferase that forms the salidroside O-glucoside, since human phase II conjugation of phenols runs to glucuronides and sulfates, and there is no route to the cinnamyl glycosides. NONE stands for salidroside and the rosavins, so the axis gives neither a reason to take it nor a reason to reject it and the judgement falls entirely to clinical evidence.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 标志物是 salidroside (酪醇葡糖苷) 以及 cinnamyl 糖苷 rosavin, rosin 和 rosarin, 都在根茎中合成。酪醇本身在人体内源存在, 由 tyramine 代谢而来 (tyramine 经 4-hydroxyphenylacetaldehyde 生成酪醇), 羟基酪醇同样由多巴胺经这条路生成, 所以苷元在人体中是有的; 缺的是形成 salidroside O-葡糖苷的那个特定 UDP-glucosyltransferase, 因为人对酚类的二相结合走葡糖醛酸化和硫酸化, 而且也没有生成 cinnamyl 糖苷的途径。对 salidroside 和 rosavins 而言 NONE 成立, 所以这条轴既不给出服用的理由, 也不给出否定的理由, 判断完全落到临床证据上。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for salidroside and the rosavins. Plant phenylpropanoid and shikimate routes in Rhodiola rosea rhizome produce tyrosol, salidroside and the rosavins. Tyrosol is endogenous in humans via tyramine, but no human glucosyltransferase forms the salidroside O-glucoside and no human enzyme assembles the cinnamyl glycosides.
items.pathway_zh: 对 salidroside 和 rosavins 为 NOT APPLICABLE。Rhodiola rosea 根茎中的植物苯丙烷类和莽草酸途径生成酪醇, salidroside 和 rosavins。酪醇在人体经 tyramine 内源生成, 但没有人类 glucosyltransferase 形成 salidroside 的 O-葡糖苷, 也没有人类酶组装 cinnamyl 糖苷。
items.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway for salidroside or the rosavins)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有合成 salidroside 或 rosavins 的途径)
items.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on standardisation (typically 3 percent rosavins and 1 percent salidroside), frequent species substitution in commerce, and the modest and inconsistent trial evidence for fatigue and exercise performance.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用标准化 (通常 3% rosavins 和 1% salidroside), 商业上常见的物种冒充, 以及在疲劳和运动表现方面有限且不一致的试验证据来筛查。
items.source: PMID 37641937 (Tinsley GM, Br J Nutr 2024, Rhodiola rosea as an adaptogen to enhance exercise performance)

items.endogenous_note: Valerian's activity is attributed to valerenic acid and the valepotriates, sesquiterpenes whose carbon skeleton is built by a plant terpene synthase (valerenadiene synthase) found in Valeriana officinalis roots. Humans use farnesyl diphosphate for sterols, dolichol, the polyprenyl side chain of ubiquinone (CoQ10), the farnesyl group of heme A and protein farnesylation and geranylgeranylation, and have no sesquiterpene cyclase to close a valerenane ring. So nothing in a valerian capsule is endogenous, a deficiency framing is unavailable, and the modest and inconsistent insomnia evidence has to stand on its own.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 缬草的作用被归于 valerenic acid 和 valepotriates, 这些倍半萜的碳骨架由 Valeriana officinalis 根中的植物萜类合成酶 (valerenadiene synthase) 构建。人把 farnesyl diphosphate 用于甾醇, dolichol, 泛醌 (CoQ10) 的多聚异戊烯侧链, heme A 的法尼基基团以及蛋白的法尼基化和香叶基香叶基化, 但没有能闭合 valerenane 环的倍半萜环化酶。所以缬草胶囊里没有任何内源成分, 缺乏这套说法用不上, 有限且不一致的失眠证据只能自己站住。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Farnesyl diphosphate is cyclised by the plant sesquiterpene synthase valerenadiene synthase in Valeriana officinalis, then oxidised to valerenic acid. Human farnesyl diphosphate goes to sterols, dolichol, ubiquinone, heme A and prenylated proteins; there is no human sesquiterpene cyclase.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。在 Valeriana officinalis 中, farnesyl diphosphate 由植物倍半萜合成酶 valerenadiene synthase 环化, 再氧化为 valerenic acid。人的 farnesyl diphosphate 去向是甾醇, dolichol, 泛醌, heme A 和异戊烯化蛋白; 人体没有倍半萜环化酶。
items.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
items.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on the weak and heterogeneous insomnia trial data, wide variation in valerenic acid content between products, and additive sedation with alcohol and benzodiazepines.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用薄弱且异质的失眠试验数据, 不同产品间 valerenic acid 含量的巨大差异, 以及与酒精和苯二氮类的镇静叠加来筛查。
items.source: PMID 34898176 (Zinck GE, Biochemistry 2021, Structurally Guided Reprogramming of Valerenadiene Synthase)

items.endogenous_note: Standardised extracts contain flavonol glycosides of quercetin and kaempferol plus the terpene trilactones ginkgolide A, B, C, J and bilobalide, a group of molecules found only in Ginkgo biloba. No human tissue produces flavonoids or ginkgolides, so intake is entirely exogenous. That removes any deficiency-correction claim and leaves the outcome trials, which have been largely negative for preventing cognitive decline.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 标准化提取物含槲皮素和山奈酚的黄酮醇糖苷, 以及萜类三内酯 ginkgolide A, B, C, J 和 bilobalide, 这组分子只见于 Ginkgo biloba。人体任何组织都不产生类黄酮或银杏内酯, 所以摄入完全是外源的。这样一来纠正缺乏的说法就不成立, 只剩结局试验, 而这些试验在预防认知衰退上大体为阴性。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Flavonoids arise from the plant phenylpropanoid pathway and the terpene trilactones from plant terpenoid biosynthesis unique to Ginkgo biloba; neither pathway exists in humans.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。类黄酮来自植物苯丙烷类途径, 萜类三内酯来自 Ginkgo biloba 特有的植物萜类生物合成; 这两条途径人体都没有。
items.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
items.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on the negative large prevention trials, extract standardisation (EGb 761 type: 24 percent flavone glycosides, 6 percent terpene lactones), and bleeding risk with antiplatelet and anticoagulant drugs.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用大型预防试验的阴性结果, 提取物标准化 (EGb 761 型: 24% 黄酮糖苷, 6% 萜内酯), 以及与抗血小板和抗凝药合用的出血风险来筛查。
items.source: PMID 26604665 (Nash KM, Integr Med Insights 2015, Current Perspectives on the Beneficial Role of Ginkgo biloba in Neurological and Cerebrovascular Disorders)

items.endogenous_note: The active fraction is the bacosides, dammarane-type triterpenoid saponins from the plant. Humans cyclise 2,3-oxidosqualene through the protosteryl cation to lanosterol and then to cholesterol and have no dammarenediol synthase, so the dammarane skeleton is never formed at all, and no human glycosyltransferase attaches the bacoside sugar chains. There is no endogenous pool to top up, so the case rests on the cognition trials, which show a small effect on memory acquisition after weeks of dosing.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 活性组分是 bacosides, 属植物来源的达玛烷型三萜皂苷。人把 2,3-oxidosqualene 经原甾醇正离子环化为 lanosterol 再到胆固醇, 没有 dammarenediol synthase, 所以达玛烷骨架在人体中根本不会形成, 也没有人类 glycosyltransferase 接上 bacoside 的糖链。没有内源池可补, 所以判断靠认知试验, 而这些试验显示连续给药数周后对记忆获得有小幅作用。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant triterpenoid saponin biosynthesis in Bacopa monnieri routes 2,3-oxidosqualene through the dammarenyl cation via dammarenediol synthase, then glycosyltransferases. Human oxidosqualene cyclase routes the same substrate through the protosteryl cation to lanosterol, so no dammarane intermediate exists in humans.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Bacopa monnieri 的植物三萜皂苷合成把 2,3-oxidosqualene 经达玛烯基正离子由 dammarenediol synthase 处理, 再经 glycosyltransferases 糖基化。人的 oxidosqualene cyclase 把同一底物经原甾醇正离子导向 lanosterol, 所以人体中不存在达玛烷中间体。
items.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
items.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on the small measured effect (chiefly delayed word recall), the 12 week timescale before any effect appears, bacoside standardisation, and gastrointestinal side effects.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用实测效应之小 (主要是延迟词语回忆), 起效需要 12 周的时间尺度, bacoside 标准化, 以及胃肠道不良反应来筛查。
items.source: PMID 24252493 (Kongkeaw C, J Ethnopharmacol 2014, Meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials on cognitive effects of Bacopa monnieri extract)

items.endogenous_note: The compounds of interest are hericenones from the fruiting body, polyketide-terpenoid hybrids (meroterpenoids) built on a polyketide-derived resorcinol or benzaldehyde core carrying an added prenyl or geranyl chain and a fatty acyl group, and erinacines, cyathane diterpenoids, from the mycelium. These are fungal metabolites; human cells produce neither, and human cells also do not need them for anything. Any benefit has to come from the pharmacology of an ingested fungal compound, and the human evidence is one small trial in mild cognitive impairment (30 subjects, 16 weeks of dosing) with scores falling back 4 weeks after stopping.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 受关注的成分是子实体中的 hericenones, 属聚酮与萜类的杂合分子 (meroterpenoids), 核心是聚酮来源的间苯二酚或苯甲醛结构, 上面带异戊烯或香叶基链和脂肪酰基; 以及菌丝体中的 erinacines, 属 cyathane 二萜。这些都是真菌代谢物; 人细胞既不产生它们, 也不需要它们做任何事。任何益处只能来自摄入真菌化合物的药理作用, 而人体证据是一项轻度认知障碍的小型试验 (30 名受试者, 给药 16 周), 停药 4 周后评分回落。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Hericenones are fungal polyketide-terpenoid hybrids (meroterpenoids) and erinacines are cyathane diterpenoids, both made in Hericium erinaceus; no human pathway to either.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Hericenones 是真菌聚酮萜类杂合物 (meroterpenoids), erinacines 是 cyathane 二萜, 两者都在 Hericium erinaceus 中生成; 人体对两者都没有合成途径。
items.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
items.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on the thin human evidence base (30 subjects, 16 weeks, benefit lost 4 weeks after cessation), whether a product is fruiting body or grain-based mycelium, and the fact that nerve growth factor induction is a cell and rodent finding rather than a human one.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用人体证据之薄 (30 名受试者, 16 周, 停药 4 周后获益消失), 产品是子实体还是谷物基菌丝体, 以及神经生长因子诱导只是细胞和啮齿类的发现, 尚无人体证据, 来筛查。
items.source: PMID 18844328 (Mori K, Phytother Res 2009, Improving effects of the mushroom Yamabushitake (Hericium erinaceus) on mild cognitive impairment)

items.endogenous_note: The relevant constituents are hypericin, a naphthodianthrone, and hyperforin, a prenylated phloroglucinol, both made only by Hypericum perforatum. Humans synthesise neither, so nothing here is replacement. On this one the axis being silent matters less than the interaction profile: hyperforin activates PXR and induces CYP3A4, which cuts blood levels of oral contraceptives, ciclosporin, warfarin and HIV protease inhibitors.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 相关成分是 hypericin (一种萘骈二蒽酮) 和 hyperforin (一种异戊烯化间苯三酚), 只由 Hypericum perforatum 合成。人两者都不合成, 所以这里谈不上替代。这一条上, 这条轴无话可说的意义远小于相互作用特征: hyperforin 激活 PXR 并诱导 CYP3A4, 会降低口服避孕药, 环孢素, 华法林和 HIV 蛋白酶抑制剂的血药水平。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant polyketide and phloroglucinol pathways in Hypericum perforatum; no human homologue.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Hypericum perforatum 中的植物聚酮和间苯三酚途径; 人体没有同源途径。
items.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
items.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. The screening question is drug interaction, not deficiency: CYP3A4 induction by hyperforin plus serotonergic additivity with SSRIs and triptans. Also check hyperforin content, since low-hyperforin extracts induce far less.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。筛查要问药物相互作用, 与缺乏无关: hyperforin 诱导 CYP3A4, 加上与 SSRI 和曲普坦的血清素能叠加。还要看 hyperforin 含量, 低 hyperforin 提取物的诱导作用弱得多。
items.source: PMID 13129991 (Markowitz JS, JAMA 2003;290:1500-4, Effect of St John's wort on drug metabolism by induction of cytochrome P450 3A4 enzyme)

items.endogenous_note: Every serotonin-producing cell makes its own 5-HTP continuously from dietary tryptophan, and none of it accumulates because aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase converts it straight to serotonin. The recovered row labelled it INTERMEDIATE because 5-HTP is an obligate transient intermediate with no storage pool, no dietary requirement and no measurable body pool; on this enum it rolls up to FULL, since the human pathway is complete and covers basal need in health. Tryptophan hydroxylase is the rate-limiting and regulated step, and swallowing 5-HTP forces the pathway past that control point, producing serotonin wherever aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase sits, mainly the gut, where most body serotonin already is.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 每个产血清素的细胞都在用膳食色氨酸持续生成自己的 5-HTP, 而且不会积累, 因为 aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 立刻把它转成血清素。原条目标为 INTERMEDIATE, 理由是 5-HTP 是必经的瞬时中间体, 没有储存池, 没有膳食需要量, 也没有可测的体内池; 在本枚举下归入 FULL, 因为人体通路完整且健康时覆盖基础需要。tryptophan hydroxylase 是限速且受调控的一步, 口服 5-HTP 会把途径推过这个控制点, 在任何有 aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 的地方生成血清素, 主要是肠道, 而全身大部分血清素本来就在那里。
items.pathway: L-tryptophan to 5-HTP by tryptophan hydroxylase (TPH1 in gut and pancreatic enterochromaffin cells, pinealocytes, mast cells, mononuclear leukocytes, spleen, thymus, pancreatic beta cells and peripheral tissues including heart, lung, kidney, duodenum, adrenal and female reproductive tract; TPH2 in raphe neurons), then 5-HTP to serotonin by aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase. TPH is rate-limiting and subsaturated, because its Km for tryptophan is near or above actual tissue tryptophan concentrations. The liver is not a TPH1 site: hepatic serotonin comes from platelets and gut.
items.pathway_zh: L-tryptophan 经 tryptophan hydroxylase 生成 5-HTP (TPH1 分布于肠道和胰腺的嗜铬细胞, 松果体细胞, 肥大细胞, 单核白细胞, 脾, 胸腺, 胰腺 beta 细胞, 以及心, 肺, 肾, 十二指肠, 肾上腺和女性生殖道等外周组织; TPH2 在中缝核神经元), 再由 aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 生成血清素。TPH 限速并处于亚饱和状态, 因为它对色氨酸的 Km 接近或高于组织中实际的色氨酸浓度。肝不是 TPH1 的部位: 肝内血清素来自血小板和肠道。
items.daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED. 5-HTP is an obligate transient intermediate with no storage pool, and whole-body synthesis flux has not been quantified in humans. Flux anchor for scale: only about 1 to 2 percent of tryptophan flux enters the hydroxylase branch and over 90 percent goes down the kynurenine pathway, so a 100 mg oral dose sits far above the physiological branch it feeds.
items.daily_amount_zh: NOT ESTABLISHED。5-HTP 是必经的瞬时中间体, 没有储存池, 全身合成通量在人体中未被定量。用于把握量级的通量参照: 色氨酸通量只有约 1% 至 2% 进入羟化酶这条支路, 超过 90% 走 kynurenine 途径, 所以 100 mg 的口服剂量远高于它所进入的那条生理支路。
items.still_matters_when: Only where bypassing tryptophan hydroxylase regulation is the deliberate aim, and preferably with a peripheral decarboxylase inhibitor such as carbidopa to steer conversion centrally, as used in research settings. Otherwise NEVER ON THIS AXIS: tryptophan intake is the physiological lever, and unopposed 5-HTP alongside an SSRI or MAOI is a serotonin toxicity risk.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 只在刻意要绕过 tryptophan hydroxylase 调控时才有意义, 并且最好像研究场景那样合用外周脱羧酶抑制剂 (例如 carbidopa) 把转化引向中枢。其他情况 NEVER ON THIS AXIS: 色氨酸摄入才是生理杠杆, 而在使用 SSRI 或 MAOI 时单独加 5-HTP 有血清素毒性风险。
items.source: PMID 16023217 (Turner EH, Pharmacol Ther 2006;109:325-38, Serotonin a la carte: supplementation with the serotonin precursor 5-hydroxytryptophan). Enum note: the recovered label INTERMEDIATE was mapped to FULL under the dataset's four-label definitions row.

items.supplement: Saffron, SAMe and other mood botanicals
items.endogenous_note: Saffron's constituents are apocarotenoids, the crocins plus crocetin, picrocrocin and safranal, cleaved from zeaxanthin in Crocus sativus stigmas, and human tissue makes no part of them, which holds for the other plant members of this group too, so the roll-up for the bundle is NONE. The one member at the opposite end of the axis is SAMe, which is FULL: the body's universal methyl donor, made in every cell from methionine and ATP and most heavily in the liver, with a CONDITIONAL carve-out in chronic liver disease and cholestasis where MAT1A activity and hepatic SAMe fall. For the botanicals the axis is silent and the case rests on trial evidence; for SAMe an oral dose is pharmacology, since a healthy person eating normal protein cannot be deficient.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 藏红花的成分是脱辅基类胡萝卜素, 即 crocins 以及 crocetin, picrocrocin 和 safranal, 由 Crocus sativus 柱头中的玉米黄质裂解而来, 人体组织不合成其中任何部分, 本组其他植物成分同理, 所以整条的汇总标签是 NONE。处在这条轴另一端的成员只有 SAMe, 它是 FULL: 全身通用的甲基供体, 每个细胞都能用 methionine 和 ATP 合成, 肝脏合成量最大; 有一个 CONDITIONAL 的例外, 慢性肝病和胆汁淤积时 MAT1A 活性和肝内 SAMe 下降。对植物成分这条轴无话可说, 判断依赖试验证据; 对 SAMe, 口服属药理剂量, 因为蛋白摄入正常的健康人不会缺它。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for saffron and the other botanicals: apocarotenoids are cleaved from zeaxanthin by carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase (CCD2) in Crocus sativus stigmas and then glycosylated to crocins, with no human counterpart. SAMe: L-methionine plus ATP, catalysed by methionine adenosyltransferase (MAT1A in liver, MAT2A in other tissues); the liver metabolises about 50 percent of dietary methionine and hosts up to 85 percent of all transmethylation reactions. SAMe donates its methyl group to give S-adenosylhomocysteine, hydrolysed by AHCY to homocysteine, which is either remethylated by MTR with 5-methyl-THF and vitamin B12 or by BHMT with betaine, or committed to transsulfuration by CBS with vitamin B6.
items.pathway_zh: 对藏红花和其他植物成分为 NOT APPLICABLE: 在 Crocus sativus 柱头中由 carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase (CCD2) 从玉米黄质裂解出脱辅基类胡萝卜素, 再糖苷化为 crocins, 人体没有对应通路。SAMe: L-methionine 加 ATP, 由 methionine adenosyltransferase 催化 (肝为 MAT1A, 其他组织为 MAT2A); 肝代谢约 50% 的膳食 methionine, 并承担全身多达 85% 的转甲基反应。SAMe 交出甲基后生成 S-adenosylhomocysteine, 由 AHCY 水解为同型半胱氨酸, 后者或由 MTR 用 5-methyl-THF 和 vitamin B12 再甲基化, 或由 BHMT 用甜菜碱再甲基化, 或由 CBS 在 vitamin B6 参与下进入转硫途径。
items.daily_amount: 0 for saffron and the other botanicals (no human biosynthetic pathway). SAMe is not directly measured as a synthesis rate; it is bounded by measured whole-body methionine transmethylation flux, which stable-isotope tracer work puts on the order of several grams of SAM turnover per day in adults with hepatic synthesis dominant, and no single consensus figure is established. Supplement doses are 400 to 1,600 mg/day.
items.daily_amount_zh: 藏红花和其他植物成分为 0 (人体没有生物合成途径)。SAMe 没有作为合成速率被直接测定, 可由已测得的全身 methionine 转甲基通量给出上界, 稳定同位素示踪研究对应成人每日 SAMe 周转量在数克量级, 以肝内合成为主, 尚无统一共识数值。补充剂量为 400 到 1,600 mg/day。
items.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis for the botanicals: screen saffron on trial size and independence (small trials, several from the same groups), on adulteration of one of the world's most expensive spices with dyed safflower, turmeric or other Crocus material, on the 28 to 30 mg/day extract dose used in trials, and on serotonergic additivity. For SAMe, chronic liver disease and cholestasis, where MAT activity and hepatic SAMe are genuinely reduced, is the one setting with a mechanistic replacement case; the mood indication is pharmacological, with caution in bipolar disorder because of switch to mania and with serotonergic drugs.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 就植物成分而言这条轴上没有理由: 藏红花改用试验规模和独立性 (样本小, 多项出自同一批研究者), 这种世界上最贵香料被染色红花, 姜黄或其他 Crocus 材料掺假的情况, 试验所用 28 至 30 mg/day 的提取物剂量, 以及血清素能叠加来筛查。对 SAMe, 慢性肝病和胆汁淤积中 MAT 活性和肝内 SAMe 确实降低, 这是唯一有机制依据的替代场景; 情绪适应症属药理用途, 双相障碍者要防转躁, 与血清素能药物合用要谨慎。
items.source: Merged from the saffron rows and the SAMe row: PMID 25384672 (Lopresti AL & Drummond PD, Hum Psychopharmacol 2014, Saffron for depression); PMID 23073625 (Lu SC & Mato JM, Physiol Rev 2012;92:1515-42, DOI 10.1152/physrev.00047.2011); PMID 23396728 (Mato JM, Ann Hepatol 2013;12:183-9)

items.endogenous_note: Psyllium is a highly branched arabinoxylan that no human enzyme can cleave, which is the operational meaning of dietary fibre. Being non-digestible is the mechanism: the husk holds water into a viscous gel and the gel does the work on stool form and transit. So the axis has nothing to say against it, and psyllium is the one fibre with reasonable randomised support in IBS.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 车前子壳是高度分支的阿拉伯木聚糖, 人体没有酶能切开它, 这就是膳食纤维的操作性含义。不可消化本身就是机制: 壳把水保持成粘性凝胶, 凝胶作用于大便形态和转运。所以这条轴没有反对它的理由, 而车前子是在 IBS 中拥有较合理随机证据的那一种纤维。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Dietary fibre is defined by resistance to human digestive enzymes; humans lack the glycoside hydrolases that would depolymerise the arabinoxylan backbone.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。膳食纤维的定义就是耐受人体消化酶; 人缺少能把阿拉伯木聚糖主链解聚的糖苷水解酶。
items.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway; intake is the only variable)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有生物合成途径; 摄入量是唯一变量)
items.still_matters_when: Every gram must be eaten, so intake is the whole question. In primary care IBS (n=275: 85 psyllium, 97 bran, 93 placebo, ages 18 to 65), 10 g/day psyllium gave adequate symptom relief in 57 percent versus 35 percent on placebo at month 1 (RR 1.60, 95 percent CI 1.13 to 2.26), also favoured psyllium at month 2 (59 percent versus 41 percent, RR 1.44, 95 percent CI 1.02 to 2.06), and reduced the symptom severity score by 90 points at 3 months against 49 for placebo (P=0.03). Start low and titrate, since gas and bloating are dose-related.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 每一克都得吃进去, 所以摄入量就是全部问题。在基层医疗的 IBS 人群中 (n=275: 车前子 85 例, 麦麸 97 例, 安慰剂 93 例, 年龄 18 至 65 岁), 10 g/day 车前子在第 1 个月使 57% 的人症状得到充分缓解, 安慰剂为 35% (RR 1.60, 95% CI 1.13 至 2.26); 第 2 个月同样占优 (59% 对 41%, RR 1.44, 95% CI 1.02 至 2.06); 3 个月时症状严重度评分下降 90 分, 安慰剂为 49 分 (P=0.03)。从小剂量开始逐步加量, 因为胀气和腹胀与剂量相关。
items.source: PMID 19713235 (Bijkerk CJ, BMJ 2009;339:b3154, Soluble or insoluble fibre in irritable bowel syndrome in primary care?); PMID 24725724 (Jones JM, Nutr J 2014)

items.supplement: Wheat bran and insoluble fibre supplements for IBS
items.endogenous_note: Insoluble bran is non-digestible by definition, so nothing about it is endogenous and every gram is eaten. Here the axis being silent is no licence, and the trial record has to be reported in full: in the same primary care trial that supported psyllium, 10 g/day bran beat placebo at month 3 in the primary analysis (adequate relief 57 percent versus 32 percent, RR 1.70, 95 percent CI 1.12 to 2.57) but not in the worst-case sensitivity analysis of that same result (RR 1.45, 95 percent CI 0.97 to 2.16), and it reduced symptom severity by only 58 points versus 49 for placebo (P=0.61), with symptoms often worse in the first weeks and the highest dropout of the three arms (completion: psyllium 64 percent, bran 56 percent, placebo 60 percent). Coarse natural fibre is not a reason in itself, and the bran signal is weaker and less stable than psyllium's.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 不可溶麦麸按定义不可消化, 所以其中没有内源成分, 每一克都靠吃。这里这条轴无话可说并不等于放行, 而试验结果要完整报告: 在支持车前子的同一项基层医疗试验中, 10 g/day 麦麸在第 3 个月的主分析里优于安慰剂 (充分缓解 57% 对 32%, RR 1.70, 95% CI 1.12 至 2.57), 但在同一结果的最差情形敏感性分析中不显著 (RR 1.45, 95% CI 0.97 至 2.16); 症状严重度只下降 58 分, 安慰剂为 49 分 (P=0.61), 头几周症状常加重, 三组中脱落最多 (完成率: 车前子 64%, 麦麸 56%, 安慰剂 60%)。天然粗纤维本身仍不构成理由, 麦麸的信号比车前子更弱也更不稳定。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Insoluble cellulose, hemicellulose and lignin resist human digestive enzymes; no human synthesis and no human requirement for this specific material.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。不可溶的纤维素, 半纤维素和木质素耐受人体消化酶; 人体不合成它, 对这类具体材料也没有需要量。
items.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
items.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis, and the trial evidence for bran in IBS is inconsistent: significant at month 3 in the primary analysis, null in the worst-case analysis, no effect on symptom severity, early worsening and the highest dropout. Insoluble fibre still has a role in ordinary constipation and general diet quality; in IBS, prefer a soluble gel-forming fibre.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由, 而麦麸在 IBS 中的试验证据不一致: 第 3 个月主分析显著, 最差情形分析为阴性, 对症状严重度无效, 早期加重, 脱落率最高。不可溶纤维在普通便秘和整体膳食质量上仍有作用; 在 IBS 中优先选可溶性成胶纤维。
items.source: PMID 19713235 (Bijkerk CJ, BMJ 2009;339:b3154); PMID 24725724 (Jones JM, Nutr J 2014)

items.endogenous_note: Inulin and fructo-oligosaccharides are beta(2->1) fructans, and commercial galacto-oligosaccharides are galactose oligomers of DP2 to DP6 usually carrying a terminal glucose, produced by beta-galactosidase transgalactosylation of lactose. The 2017 ISAPP consensus defines a prebiotic as a substrate selectively utilized by host microorganisms conferring a health benefit, and imposes no non-digestibility requirement, so the operative criteria are selective utilisation plus a demonstrated benefit; non-digestibility remains a practical property of the common fructans and of GOS at DP3 and above, which is why they reach the colon to be fermented. Nothing here is endogenous, so the real question is dose tolerance, because the fermentation that produces the benefit also produces gas.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 菊粉和低聚果糖是 beta(2->1) 果聚糖, 商品化的低聚半乳糖是 DP2 至 DP6 的半乳糖寡聚物, 末端通常带一个葡萄糖, 由 beta-galactosidase 对乳糖进行转半乳糖基化制得。2017 年 ISAPP 共识把益生元定义为被宿主微生物选择性利用并带来健康益处的底物, 并未要求不可消化, 所以实际判据是选择性利用加上已证实的健康益处; 不可消化性仍然是常见果聚糖和 DP3 及以上 GOS 的实际性质, 也是它们能到结肠被发酵的原因。这里没有内源成分, 所以真正的问题是剂量耐受性, 因为产生益处的发酵同时产生气体。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE, with a degree-of-polymerisation caveat. Humans lack inulinase and beta-fructofuranosidase, and 96 +/- 25 percent of FOS with DP>=2 is recovered intact at the distal ileum. GOS at DP3 to DP6 also passes unchanged, but most GOS DP2 is hydrolysed by host brush-border enzymes in a linkage-dependent way, roughly 77 to 81 percent for beta(1<->1), beta(1->2) and beta(1->3) and roughly 32 to 56 percent for beta(1->4) and beta(1->6).
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE, 但要按聚合度加限定。人缺 inulinase 和 beta-fructofuranosidase, DP>=2 的 FOS 有 96 +/- 25% 在远端回肠被完整回收。DP3 至 DP6 的 GOS 也原样通过, 但大部分 DP2 的 GOS 被宿主刷状缘酶按键型差异水解, beta(1<->1), beta(1->2) 和 beta(1->3) 约 77% 至 81%, beta(1->4) 和 beta(1->6) 约 32% 至 56%。
items.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway; intake is the only variable). Note that the ISAPP 2017 definition imposes no non-digestibility requirement, so the axis argument here rests on the measured ileal recovery figures rather than on the definition itself.
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有生物合成途径; 摄入量是唯一变量)。注意 ISAPP 2017 定义并未要求不可消化, 所以这条轴上的论证依据是实测的回肠回收率, 而非定义本身。
items.still_matters_when: All intake is dietary, so dose is the lever. Reasonable where the aim is to shift colonic fermentation, discounting the GOS DP2 fraction as host-digested, with the caveat that fermentable oligosaccharides are the F in FODMAP and often provoke bloating and pain in IBS at the doses used in studies.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 全部摄入来自膳食, 所以剂量是杠杆。若目标是改变结肠发酵, 使用是合理的, 计算时要把被宿主消化的 GOS DP2 部分扣掉; 需注意可发酵寡糖正是 FODMAP 里的 F, 在研究所用剂量下常在 IBS 中引起腹胀和腹痛。
items.source: PMID 28611480 (Gibson GR, Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2017;14:491-502, ISAPP consensus statement on the definition and scope of prebiotics); PMC11440495 (GOS digestibility by linkage and degree of polymerisation)

items.endogenous_note: The synthesis axis does not fit here at all, because these are living organisms and not molecules, which is why the label is NA: forcing NONE would make a live organism look like a plant alkaloid on a screening table. Human cells cannot manufacture a bacterium, and the resident microbiome is acquired at birth and from the environment and then renews itself, so nobody is deficient in a strain the way someone is deficient in a vitamin. The honest test for a probiotic is strain-level trial evidence for a named indication, since effects do not transfer between strains, let alone between species.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 合成这条轴在这里完全不适用, 因为对象是活体生物, 不是分子, 所以标签用 NA: 硬套 NONE 会让活菌在筛查表上看起来像一种植物生物碱。人细胞无法制造细菌, 常驻菌群在出生时和从环境中获得, 之后自我更新, 所以没人会像缺某种维生素那样缺某一个菌株。对益生菌诚实的检验标准是针对具体适应症的菌株级试验证据, 因为效应在菌株之间不能移植, 跨物种更不行。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Microorganisms are acquired, not synthesised. The resident microbiota is self-renewing and is defined by colonisation history rather than by any host biosynthetic capacity.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。微生物靠获得, 不靠合成。常驻菌群自我更新, 由定植史决定, 与宿主的任何生物合成能力无关。
items.daily_amount: 0 (human cells cannot synthesise a microorganism). No daily requirement exists; the resident microbiota replaces itself.
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人细胞无法合成微生物)。不存在每日需要量; 常驻菌群自我替换。
items.still_matters_when: Where a specific, fully identified strain has randomised evidence for a specific indication, and in settings of documented disruption such as after antibiotics. Ingested strains are generally transient passengers and are cleared within days to weeks of stopping, so any benefit lasts only as long as dosing.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 当某个完全鉴定到菌株水平的具体菌株对具体适应症有随机证据时, 以及在有明确菌群扰动的场景 (例如抗生素之后)。摄入的菌株一般只是过路乘客, 停用后数天到数周内被清除, 所以获益只维持在持续服用期间。
items.source: PMID 24912386 (Hill C, Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2014;11:506-14, ISAPP consensus statement on the scope and appropriate use of the term probiotic)

items.endogenous_note: Same axis mismatch as any probiotic, since these are living organisms, with an additional problem specific to blends: labels that name only genus and species carry no evidence, because probiotic effects are strain-specific. Laboratory checking of commercial products supports that concern, though the cited evidence is one survey: Kesavelu 2020 tested 20 products sold in India (8 single-strain, 12 multi-strain) and reported poor correlation between label and laboratory values for viable count, genus and species identification and contaminants, without giving a numeric mismatch rate. A blend cannot inherit the trial record of a product it does not actually contain, so more strains on the label does not mean more evidence.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 与任何益生菌一样存在轴不匹配的问题, 因为对象是活体生物; 复方还多一层麻烦: 只写属和种的标签不带任何证据, 因为益生菌效应是菌株特异的。对市售产品的实验室检测支持这一担忧, 但所引证据只有一项调查: Kesavelu 2020 检测了在印度销售的 20 个产品 (8 个单菌株, 12 个复方), 报告标签值与实验室值在活菌数, 属种鉴定和污染物方面相关性差, 未给出量化的不符率。复方不能继承一个它实际并不含有的产品的试验记录, 标签上菌株更多也不等于证据更多。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Microorganisms are acquired, not synthesised.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。微生物靠获得, 不靠合成。
items.daily_amount: 0 (human cells cannot synthesise a microorganism)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人细胞无法合成微生物)
items.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on strain-level identification with deposited strain designations, independent verification of viable counts at end of shelf life, and whether any trial used the exact formulation being sold.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用是否有保藏编号的菌株级鉴定, 保质期末活菌数的独立验证, 以及是否有试验用的正是在售的这个配方来筛查。
items.source: PMID 33173652 (Kesavelu D, Cureus 2020;12:e11334, Composition and Laboratory Correlation of Commercial Probiotics in India; single-country 20-product survey)

items.endogenous_note: This is a live organism, so the synthesis axis does not apply and the body never makes bacteria under any circumstances. Whole-genome sequencing and core-genome phylogenetic taxon assignment reclassified the strain from Bifidobacterium infantis to Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum 35624, a common adult coloniser, so the infant-coloniser and adult colonisation-gap argument built on the old name does not apply and has been dropped. What distinguishes 35624 is the trial record: a fully identified single strain tested against placebo at a stated dose, which is the standard the rest of the category should be held to, and the reclassification does not affect those strain-specific results.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 这是活体生物, 合成这条轴不适用, 人体在任何情况下都不制造细菌。全基因组测序和核心基因组系统发生分类把该菌株从 Bifidobacterium infantis 重新归类为 Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum 35624, 这是成人常见的定植菌, 所以建立在旧名称上的婴儿定植菌和成人定植缺口论证不成立, 已删除。35624 的特点在于试验记录: 一个完全鉴定的单一菌株在明确剂量下与安慰剂对照, 这正是这一类别其余产品应达到的标准; 重新分类不影响这些菌株特异的结果。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Acquired by colonisation or ingested as a live product; not synthesised by host tissue. Taxonomy: Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum by whole-genome core-genome phylogeny, revised from the earlier subsp. infantis assignment.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。通过定植获得或作为活菌产品摄入; 宿主组织不合成。分类学: 按全基因组核心基因组系统发生分析为 Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum, 由早先的 subsp. infantis 归类修订而来。
items.daily_amount: 0 (human cells cannot synthesise a microorganism)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人细胞无法合成微生物)
items.still_matters_when: IBS symptom relief on the strength of a randomised trial in 362 primary care IBS patients, all of them women, where 1 x 10^8 cfu/mL for 4 weeks was significantly superior to placebo for abdominal pain and the composite symptom score and exceeded placebo by more than 20 percent on global assessment (P<0.02), while 1 x 10^6 and 1 x 10^10 cfu/mL were not. The 10^10 arm's failure is generally attributed to formulation problems (capsule agglomeration and gelling), so part of that dose conclusion is a formulation conclusion. The effect depends on continued dosing.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 用于 IBS 症状缓解, 依据是一项纳入 362 名基层医疗 IBS 患者 (全部为女性) 的随机试验: 1 x 10^8 cfu/mL 服用 4 周在腹痛和综合症状评分上显著优于安慰剂, 总体评估上超过安慰剂 20% 以上 (P<0.02), 而 1 x 10^6 和 1 x 10^10 cfu/mL 没有。10^10 组失败通常被归因于配方问题 (胶囊团聚和胶凝), 所以这个剂量结论有一部分是配方结论。效果依赖持续服用。
items.source: PMID 16863564 (Whorwell PJ, Am J Gastroenterol 2006;101:1581-90, Efficacy of an encapsulated probiotic Bifidobacterium infantis 35624 in women with irritable bowel syndrome); PMID 27656878 and Altmann, PLOS One 2016, PMC5033381 (reclassification to B. longum subsp. longum)

items.endogenous_note: Both enzymes are made by the body, and both have named states in which that synthesis stops being sufficient, which is what makes them genuine replacement therapy. Lactase is made by small-intestinal enterocytes and its decline after weaning is the normal human pattern, with adult retention the derived trait set by regulatory variants upstream of the LCT gene; pancreatic enzymes are made by acinar cells, and replacement exists precisely because that synthesis fails in pancreatic disease. So these products are correct in the person with the named condition and pointless in everyone else.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 这两种酶身体都能合成, 而且都有明确的状态使合成不再够用, 这就是它们属于真正替代治疗的原因。乳糖酶由小肠上皮细胞合成, 断奶后活性下降是人类的常态, 成年后仍保留才是衍生性状, 由 LCT 基因上游的调控变异决定; 胰酶由腺泡细胞合成, 替代疗法之所以存在, 正因为胰腺疾病使这种合成失效。所以这些产品对有明确诊断的人是对的, 对其他所有人没有意义。
items.pathway: Lactase-phlorizin hydrolase (LCT) synthesised by enterocytes of the jejunal brush border; adult expression is controlled by MCM6 enhancer variants: -13910C>T in Europeans, -13915T>G in Arabian populations, and -13907C>G and -14010G>C in African populations, so genotyping -13910C>T alone misclassifies most lactase-persistent Africans and Middle Easterners. Pancreatic lipase, colipase, amylase, trypsinogen and chymotrypsinogen are synthesised by pancreatic acinar cells and secreted into the duodenum under CCK and secretin control.
items.pathway_zh: Lactase-phlorizin hydrolase (LCT) 由空肠刷状缘上皮细胞合成; 成年期表达由 MCM6 增强子变异决定: 欧洲人群为 -13910C>T, 阿拉伯人群为 -13915T>G, 非洲人群为 -13907C>G 和 -14010G>C, 所以只检测 -13910C>T 会把大多数乳糖酶持续的非洲和中东人误判为不持续。胰脂肪酶, 共脂肪酶, 淀粉酶, 胰蛋白酶原和胰凝乳蛋白酶原由胰腺腺泡细胞合成, 在 CCK 和 secretin 调控下分泌入十二指肠。
items.daily_amount: Pancreatic lipase secreted in response to a test meal in healthy volunteers: 253.5 +/- 95.5 mg (liquid meal) and 202.9 +/- 96.1 mg (solid meal), against 21.6 +/- 14.5 mg and 15.2 +/- 5.1 mg respectively for gastric lipase (PMID 11040182). Lactase: NOT ESTABLISHED as a daily amount.
items.daily_amount_zh: 健康志愿者对试验餐分泌的胰脂肪酶: 液体餐 253.5 +/- 95.5 mg, 固体餐 202.9 +/- 96.1 mg; 同条件下胃脂肪酶分别为 21.6 +/- 14.5 mg 和 15.2 +/- 5.1 mg (PMID 11040182)。乳糖酶: 作为每日量 NOT ESTABLISHED。
items.still_matters_when: Lactase tablets in lactase non-persistence, which is the majority phenotype worldwide. Pancreatic enzyme replacement in exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, where steatorrhoea appears only once enzyme secretion falls below roughly 10 percent of normal, with AGA advising at least 40,000 USP units of lipase with each meal, half that with snacks, and noting that doses above 120,000 units per meal are seldom needed. For a lactase-persistent person with a normal pancreas, NEVER ON THIS AXIS.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 乳糖酶片用于乳糖酶不持续者, 这在全球是多数表型。胰酶替代用于外分泌胰腺功能不足, 只有当酶分泌降到正常值约 10% 以下才出现脂肪泻; AGA 建议每餐至少 40,000 USP units 脂肪酶, 加餐用其一半, 并指出每餐超过 120,000 units 很少必要。对乳糖酶持续且胰腺功能正常的人, NEVER ON THIS AXIS。
items.source: PMID 11788828 (Enattah NS, Nat Genet 2002;30:233-7, Identification of a variant associated with adult-type hypolactasia); PMID 11040182 (Carriere F, Gastroenterology 2000;119:949-60); PMID 33887513 (Catanzaro R, Nutr Res)

items.endogenous_note: This is a product category rather than a defined substance, so the axis label is NA and the split has to be read ingredient by ingredient. The amylase, protease and lipase in these blends duplicate what a working pancreas already secretes in large excess, so for those three the axis reads FULL and the capsule is redundant; the same capsule usually also carries enzyme functions the human gut lumen does not perform, namely fungal alpha-galactosidase for raffinose-family oligosaccharides, fungal cellulase, and the plant proteases bromelain and papain, which read NONE. Humans do make an alpha-galactosidase, the lysosomal alpha-galactosidase A encoded by GLA whose deficiency causes Fabry disease, plus alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase (NAGA), and what is missing is a luminal or brush-border alpha-galactosidase, so a blend has no coherent target in a person with a normal pancreas.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 这是产品类别, 不是一种确定的物质, 所以轴标签为 NA, 拆分要按成分逐项读。复方里的淀粉酶, 蛋白酶和脂肪酶重复了功能正常的胰腺本已大量过剩分泌的东西, 这三者在这条轴上读作 FULL, 胶囊是多余的; 同一个胶囊通常还含人肠腔并不执行的酶功能, 即用于棉子糖族寡糖的真菌 alpha-galactosidase, 真菌纤维素酶, 以及植物蛋白酶菠萝蛋白酶和木瓜蛋白酶, 这些读作 NONE。人确实合成一种 alpha-galactosidase, 即由 GLA 编码的溶酶体 alpha-galactosidase A (其缺陷导致 Fabry 病), 另有 alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase (NAGA); 缺的是肠腔或刷状缘的 alpha-galactosidase, 所以对胰腺功能正常的人, 这类复方没有连贯的作用靶点。
items.pathway: Pancreatic amylase, proteases and lipase are synthesised in pancreatic acinar cells and secreted into the duodenum, as in the lactase and pancreatic enzyme row. Alpha-galactosidase: humans have the lysosomal GLA enzyme and NAGA but no luminal digestive alpha-galactosidase, and the supplement enzyme is Aspergillus niger derived. Cellulase: fungal, with no human enzyme at all. Bromelain and papain: plant cysteine proteases, absent as such from humans, who nonetheless express papain-family (clan CA) cathepsins.
items.pathway_zh: 胰淀粉酶, 胰蛋白酶类和胰脂肪酶由胰腺腺泡细胞合成并分泌入十二指肠, 与乳糖酶和胰酶那一行相同。Alpha-galactosidase: 人有溶酶体 GLA 酶和 NAGA, 但没有肠腔消化用的 alpha-galactosidase, 补充剂中的酶来自 Aspergillus niger。纤维素酶: 真菌来源, 人体完全没有对应酶。菠萝蛋白酶和木瓜蛋白酶: 植物半胱氨酸蛋白酶, 人体没有这两种酶本身, 但表达木瓜蛋白酶家族 (clan CA) 的组织蛋白酶。
items.daily_amount: Pancreatic lipase output 253.5 +/- 95.5 mg per liquid test meal and 202.9 +/- 96.1 mg per solid test meal in healthy volunteers (PMID 11040182). Do not compare that mass against a capsule's labelled activity units, because they are different quantities; use the specific activities given in the same paper for the conversion (43 to 47 micromol/min/mg for the liquid meal, 12 to 15 micromol/min/mg for the solid meal). For the fungal and plant enzymes in the blend, 0 (no human synthesis).
items.daily_amount_zh: 健康志愿者的胰脂肪酶输出为液体试验餐 253.5 +/- 95.5 mg, 固体试验餐 202.9 +/- 96.1 mg (PMID 11040182)。不要把这个质量与胶囊标注的活性单位相比, 两者是不同的量; 用同一篇论文给出的比活性换算 (液体餐 43 至 47 micromol/min/mg, 固体餐 12 至 15 micromol/min/mg)。复方中的真菌酶和植物酶为 0 (人体不合成)。
items.still_matters_when: Documented exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, where a prescription enteric-coated product dosed from at least 40,000 USP units of lipase per meal (half with snacks, above 120,000 units per meal seldom needed) is the right answer and an unregulated OTC blend is not. Lactase for lactase non-persistence, and fungal alpha-galactosidase for legume-related gas, are separate non-endogenous cases with a real target. For bloating in someone with a normal pancreas, NEVER ON THIS AXIS.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 有明确诊断的外分泌胰腺功能不足, 正确做法是处方肠溶制剂, 每餐从至少 40,000 USP units 脂肪酶起 (加餐用一半, 每餐超过 120,000 units 很少必要), 不受监管的 OTC 复方不是答案。乳糖酶用于乳糖酶不持续, 真菌 alpha-galactosidase 用于豆类相关胀气, 这是两种另有真实靶点的非内源情形。对胰腺功能正常者的腹胀, NEVER ON THIS AXIS。
items.source: PMID 11040182 (Carriere F, Gastroenterology 2000;119:949-60, including the lipase specific activities used for the unit conversion); PMID 37737818 (Whitcomb DC, AGA guidance on exocrine pancreatic insufficiency). Enum note: the recovered label MIXED was mapped to NA as a blended product category.

items.endogenous_note: These are living organisms, so the synthesis axis does not apply, and in the ICU the argument runs the other way entirely. The largest randomised trial found no reduction in ventilator-associated pneumonia with Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG, and genomic work traced bloodstream isolates in critically ill patients back to the probiotic capsules they had been given. A compromised gut barrier converts a harmless commensal into an exposure, so the absence of endogenous synthesis is no argument for adding one.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 这些是活体生物, 合成这条轴不适用, 而在 ICU 里论证方向完全相反。规模最大的随机试验发现 Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG 并未降低呼吸机相关肺炎, 基因组学工作把危重患者血流分离株追溯到他们服用的益生菌胶囊。肠屏障受损会把无害的共生菌变成一种暴露, 所以没有内源合成并不构成加用的理由。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Microorganisms are acquired, not synthesised.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。微生物靠获得, 不靠合成。
items.daily_amount: 0 (human cells cannot synthesise a microorganism)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人细胞无法合成微生物)
items.still_matters_when: Not on this axis, and arguably not at all outside a trial protocol in critical illness: probiotic-strain bacteraemia has been genomically confirmed in ICU patients, and the largest RCT showed no benefit for ventilator-associated pneumonia. Central lines, mucosal injury and immunosuppression are the reasons to withhold rather than to dose.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由, 而且在危重病中除临床试验方案外基本都不该用: ICU 患者中益生菌菌株血流感染已获基因组学确认, 规模最大的 RCT 在呼吸机相关肺炎上没有获益。中心静脉导管, 黏膜损伤和免疫抑制是停用的理由, 与给药无关。
items.source: PMID 34546300 (Johnstone J, JAMA 2021;326:1024-33, Effect of Probiotics on Incident Ventilator-Associated Pneumonia in Critically Ill Patients); PMID 31700189 (genomic tracing of probiotic-strain bacteraemia)

items.endogenous_note: These are plant materials, mainly yohimbe bark, Epimedium, maca and Tribulus, so nothing in them is endogenous and the synthesis axis cannot screen them at all; the endogenous members once grouped here, L-citrulline, L-arginine and DHEA, sit in their own rows. The screening question that does discriminate is adulteration: analytical surveys of herbal sexual enhancers repeatedly recover undeclared synthetic PDE5 inhibitors, including sildenafil and tadalafil and unlicensed structural analogues. That makes an unregulated capsule an undisclosed prescription drug, with the nitrate interaction and cardiac risk that go with it.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 这类产品是植物材料, 主要是 yohimbe 树皮, Epimedium, 玛卡和蒺藜, 其中没有任何内源成分, 合成这条轴对它们完全无法筛查; 曾归在此处的内源成员 L-citrulline, L-arginine 和 DHEA 已另列专行。真正能区分的筛查问题是掺假: 对草本性功能产品的分析调查反复检出未申报的合成 PDE5 抑制剂, 包括 sildenafil, tadalafil 以及未获批的结构类似物。这使一粒不受监管的胶囊成为隐藏的处方药, 并带来相应的硝酸酯类相互作用和心脏风险。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant alkaloid, prenylflavonoid and saponin pathways; no human synthesis of yohimbine, icariin or the declared or undeclared PDE5 inhibitors.
items.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。植物生物碱, 异戊烯基黄酮和皂苷途径; 人体不合成 yohimbine, icariin, 也不合成申报或未申报的 PDE5 抑制剂。
items.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)
items.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
items.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on documented adulteration with undeclared PDE5 inhibitors and their analogues, contraindication with nitrates and alpha-blockers, yohimbine's pressor and anxiogenic effects, and the fact that erectile dysfunction is a cardiovascular warning sign that warrants clinical assessment.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用已记录的未申报 PDE5 抑制剂及其类似物掺假, 与硝酸酯类和 alpha 受体阻滞剂的禁忌, yohimbine 的升压和致焦虑作用, 以及勃起功能障碍本身是需要临床评估的心血管警示信号来筛查。
items.source: PMID 27338710 (Skalicka-Wozniak K, Food Chem Toxicol 2017;108:355-64, Adulteration of herbal sexual enhancers and slimmers); merged from the two recovered sexual-enhancement rows, which agree on NONE

items.endogenous_note: This is a blended product category whose actual contents are not a defined substance, so the axis label is NA and the split has to be stated: caffeine, synephrine, green tea catechins and yohimbine are plant compounds with no human biosynthetic route and read NONE, while the same blends routinely include L-carnitine, which is endogenously synthesised and CONDITIONAL in its own right, and sometimes CLA, whose c9,t11 isomer has a partial human route. The axis is also the wrong screen for this category, where the recurring analytical finding is undeclared pharmaceuticals, including the withdrawn anorectic sibutramine and banned stimulants, in products marketed as herbal slimmers.
items.endogenous_note_zh: 这是复方产品类别, 实际内容物并不是一种确定的物质, 所以轴标签为 NA, 拆分必须写明: 咖啡因, 辛弗林, 绿茶儿茶素和 yohimbine 是植物化合物, 人体没有合成途径, 读作 NONE; 而这类复方常含 L-carnitine, 它属内源合成, 本身状态为 CONDITIONAL, 有时还含 CLA, 其 c9,t11 异构体在人体有部分生成途径。这条轴也不是这一类别的正确筛查工具, 该类别反复出现的分析发现是未申报药物, 包括已撤市的减食欲药西布曲明和禁用兴奋剂, 出现在以草本减肥为卖点的产品中。
items.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for the botanical stimulants and catechins. L-carnitine is synthesised in four steps from protein-derived trimethyllysine: TMLHE hydroxylates it to hydroxytrimethyllysine, aldolytic cleavage gives 4-trimethylaminobutyraldehyde, oxidation gives gamma-butyrobetaine, then BBOX1 (gamma-butyrobetaine dioxygenase) makes carnitine; BBOX1 is expressed in liver, kidney and brain and not in skeletal or cardiac muscle, which therefore import carnitine.
items.pathway_zh: 植物兴奋剂和儿茶素为 NOT APPLICABLE。L-carnitine 由蛋白来源的 trimethyllysine 经四步合成: TMLHE 羟化为 hydroxytrimethyllysine, 醛缩裂解生成 4-trimethylaminobutyraldehyde, 氧化生成 gamma-butyrobetaine, 再由 BBOX1 (gamma-butyrobetaine dioxygenase) 生成肉碱; BBOX1 表达于肝, 肾和脑, 骨骼肌和心肌不表达, 所以这两处依赖转运摄取。
items.daily_amount: 0 for caffeine, synephrine, catechins and yohimbine. Endogenous L-carnitine synthesis is about 1.2 micromol/kg body weight/day, that is 84 micromol/day and about 13.5 mg/day for a 70 kg adult at MW 161.2, measured in strict vegetarians; in omnivores most body carnitine comes from the diet.
items.daily_amount_zh: 咖啡因, 辛弗林, 儿茶素和 yohimbine 为 0。内源 L-carnitine 合成约 1.2 micromol/kg body weight/day, 即 84 micromol/day, 按 MW 161.2 折算 70 kg 成人约 13.5 mg/day, 该数据在严格素食者中测得; 杂食者体内肉碱大部分来自膳食。
items.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis for the stimulants and catechins. Screen on undeclared sibutramine and stimulants, cumulative stimulant load on blood pressure and heart rhythm, herb-induced liver injury, and the small and short-lived weight effects even when the labelled ingredients are all that is present. For the carnitine content, diet already supplies most body carnitine in omnivores, so it adds little there, while in strict vegetarians and in the deficiency states listed in the carnitine row it is more than filler.
items.still_matters_when_zh: 就兴奋剂和儿茶素而言, 这条轴上没有理由。改用未申报的西布曲明和兴奋剂, 兴奋剂累积负荷对血压和心律的影响, 草本引起的肝损伤, 以及即便产品只含标注成分时体重效应也很小且短暂来筛查。至于其中的肉碱, 杂食者体内肉碱大部分已由膳食供给, 这一群体加它意义很小; 在严格素食者以及肉碱行列出的缺乏状态中, 它另有作用。
items.source: PMID 27338710 (Skalicka-Wozniak K, Food Chem Toxicol 2017;108:355-64, Adulteration of herbal sexual enhancers and slimmers); carnitine biosynthesis rate 1.2 micromol/kg body weight/day from the L-carnitine row. Enum note: the recovered label MIXED was mapped to NA as a blended product category.

wrong_class.supplement: Saffron, SAMe and other mood botanicals
wrong_class.why: The row bundles saffron apocarotenoids (genuinely NONE) with SAMe, which has a complete human biosynthetic route: methionine adenosyltransferase (MAT1A in liver, MAT2A elsewhere) condenses L-methionine with ATP, and the liver hosts up to 85 percent of all transmethylation reactions. NONE is therefore false for a named member of the row, and the row contradicts itself: its own endogenous_note states SAMe is FULL with a CONDITIONAL carve-out in chronic liver disease and cholestasis, and its pathway field spells out the MAT1A/MAT2A synthesis in full. The source corpus scores SAMe FULL in two separate recovered entries (all_entries.json: 'SAMe (S-adenosylmethionine)' and 'S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe)'), while the two recovered saffron rows are saffron-only ('Saffron and other plant mood botanicals', 'Saffron and other mood botanicals', both NONE). The label was carried over from the saffron-only rows when SAMe was folded into the name. PARTIAL is the roll-up this dataset uses everywhere else for a bundle of named substances with divergent verdicts (Quercetin NONE plus taurine PARTIAL gives PARTIAL; krill oil PARTIAL plus astaxanthin NONE gives PARTIAL; cod liver oil PARTIAL plus FULL plus NONE gives PARTIAL). NA does not apply, since NA is reserved for commercial product categories whose contents are not a defined substance, and these contents are named. The cleaner fix is to split SAMe into its own row as FULL, matching the corpus.

check.verdict:
COVERAGE: clean. The five files carry 66 target_names with no duplicates (vitamins 11, minerals-omega 11, performance 11, longevity 11, neuro-gut 22). The dataset has exactly 66 entries. Nothing missing, nothing extra, no duplicate supplement names, exact string match on all 66 including the U+00B5 micro sign in "Selenium at 200 µg/d".

ENUM: clean. All 66 endogenous values are exactly one of the five permitted tokens, no trailing qualifiers of the kind that survive in the recovered entries (e.g. "FULL (not interchangeable with the supplement form)", "NONE (quercetin) / PARTIAL (taurine)", "PARTIAL for all four", "MIXED"). Distribution: NONE 33, PARTIAL 14, FULL 9, NA 8, CONDITIONAL 2.

BIOCHEMISTRY: one classification error, reported above (Saffron, SAMe and other mood botanicals labelled NONE while containing SAMe).

The four targeted probes otherwise pass. (1) Chemical elements: iron, iodine, zinc, selenium, magnesium and calcium are all NONE, and each correctly separates the element (no synthetic route) from the endogenous machinery built around it, so haem synthesis, thyroid hormone iodination and selenocysteine/tRNA[Ser]Sec recoding are described in the notes without inflating the label. (2) Plant secondary metabolites: resveratrol, curcumin, EGCG, astaxanthin, berberine, ashwagandha, rhodiola, valerian, ginkgo, bacopa, lion's mane, St John's wort and the sexual-enhancement botanicals are all NONE. (3) FULL labels: collagen, glucosamine/chondroitin, NMN, NR, spermidine, CoQ10, alpha-lipoic acid, melatonin and 5-HTP are all genuinely made in adequate quantity in health, and the two that could be argued carry explicit qualifications (collagen names a contested CONDITIONAL glycine-precursor carve-out; glucosamine is FULL by substrate sufficiency with the free-glucosamine caveat stated). (4) NONE labels with a real human route: every one of the eight routes named in the brief is handled correctly. Vitamin D3 PARTIAL, creatine PARTIAL, CoQ10 FULL, melatonin FULL, glutamine CONDITIONAL, collagen FULL, alpha-lipoic acid FULL, and SAMe is the single failure.

Checked and cleared, not errors: "Quercetin and taurine" = PARTIAL. Quercetin alone would be NONE, but taurine is genuinely PARTIAL (CSAD, GADL1 and the ADO/cysteamine route, with low overall capacity), and the note names the split. Under this dataset's bundle convention PARTIAL is the correct roll-up, and it is the same convention that fixes the SAMe row. The residual hazard is presentational: on a screening table a row headed by a plant flavonol reads as partly endogenous. "Multivitamin / multimineral" = NA despite containing mineral elements is correct under the dataset's stated rule that mixed products whose contents are not a defined substance sit off the axis, and its note states every element is NONE.

Three secondary defects that do not change any label but should be fixed: (a) the Cod liver oil row contradicts the dedicated Vitamin D3 row on the same substance, asserting vitamin D3 is "FULL, conditional on exposure" with "cutaneous synthesis alone able to meet requirement", while the Vitamin D3 row explicitly considers and rejects FULL in favour of PARTIAL because "the pathway routinely fails to cover requirement under real exposure conditions"; the same FULL wording also appears in the Vitamin D3 row's own history of recovered labels, so this is a stale fragment. (b) Dangling cross-references to rows that do not exist in this dataset: the Sexual-enhancement products note says L-citrulline, L-arginine and DHEA "sit in their own rows", and the Weight-loss blends note refers to "the deficiency states listed in the carnitine row"; neither row exists here and neither is in target_names. (c) Two rows disclose an enum remap in their source field ("the recovered label MIXED was mapped to NA", "the recovered label INTERMEDIATE was mapped to FULL") while a third such remap, the one that produced the Saffron/SAMe row, is undocumented, which is consistent with the label having been copied rather than re-derived.

pairs.supplement: Vitamin K1 (phytomenadione) and vitamin K2 (menaquinone, MK-4 and MK-7; includes vitamin D3 plus K2 combination capsules, green-leaf and greens powders, green tea, some multivitamins)
pairs.supplement_zh: 维生素K1(植物甲萘醌)和维生素K2(甲基萘醌类, MK-4与MK-7; 包括维生素D3+K2复方胶囊, 绿叶菜粉和青汁粉, 绿茶, 部分复合维生素)
pairs.what_happens: The INR falls and the blood becomes less thin, so protection against clots and stroke is lost. There are no symptoms, only a lower INR on the blood test. Vitamin K2 as MK-7 acts the same way at microgram doses and stays in the blood far longer than K1, so a vitamin D3 plus K2 capsule carries the same risk even though the label never mentions vitamin K1.
pairs.what_happens_zh: INR下降, 血液抗凝程度减弱, 对血栓和中风的保护随之丧失。过程中没有任何症状, 只在化验单上表现为INR偏低。维生素K2中的MK-7在微克剂量下就有同样作用, 且在血中停留时间远长于K1, 所以维生素D3+K2复方胶囊的风险相同, 即使标签上从不出现维生素K1。
pairs.mechanism: Supplemental vitamin K supplies substrate that bypasses the warfarin-inhibited VKOR step: it is reduced to KH2 by a warfarin-insensitive NAD(P)H-dependent quinone reductase, which restores gamma-glutamyl carboxylase (GGCX) mediated gamma-carboxylation of clotting factors II, VII, IX and X. VKORC1 is the recycling enzyme warfarin blocks; the carboxylation itself is catalysed by GGCX.
pairs.mechanism_zh: 补充的维生素K提供底物, 绕过被华法林抑制的VKOR环节: 它由不受华法林影响的NAD(P)H依赖性醌还原酶还原为KH2, 从而恢复由gamma-glutamyl carboxylase(GGCX)催化的凝血因子II、VII、IX、X的gamma-羧化。VKORC1是华法林阻断的循环再生酶, 羧化反应本身由GGCX完成。
pairs.action: Do not stop or start a vitamin K containing supplement on your own. Tell the anticoagulant clinic before any change and ask for an INR check within 1 to 2 weeks; a steady daily intake is safer than swinging between none and a lot. Read labels for menaquinone, MK-4 or MK-7 as well as for vitamin K1.
pairs.action_zh: 不要自行停用或开始服用含维生素K的补充剂。任何变动前先告知抗凝门诊, 并要求在1到2周内复查INR; 每天摄入量稳定比在完全不吃和大量吃之间摆动更安全。看标签时除了维生素K1, 还要找menaquinone、MK-4或MK-7。
pairs.evidence: Established pharmacology plus randomised trials of low-dose vitamin K to stabilise anticoagulation (Sconce et al, Blood 2007;109:2419-23). Dose-dependent and reproducible. Volunteer data show MK-7 interferes with warfarin anticoagulation at doses as low as 45 micrograms a day (Theuwissen et al, Blood 2013).

pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草(贯叶连翘, Hypericum perforatum)
pairs.what_happens: Within one to two weeks the INR drops and clot protection is lost. Stopping St John's wort later swings the INR the other way and can cause bleeding.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 在一到两周内INR下降, 抗血栓保护丧失。之后停用圣约翰草又会让INR朝反方向摆动, 可能引起出血。
pairs.mechanism: PXR activation induces CYP2C9 (clears S-warfarin), CYP3A4 and CYP1A2 (clear R-warfarin), plus P-glycoprotein
pairs.mechanism_zh: 激活PXR, 诱导CYP2C9(清除S-warfarin)、CYP3A4和CYP1A2(清除R-warfarin), 同时诱导P-glycoprotein
pairs.action: Do not start St John's wort while on warfarin. If you are already taking it, do not stop abruptly either; tell the anticoagulant clinic so the INR is checked before and after the change.
pairs.action_zh: 服用华法林期间不要开始服用圣约翰草。如果已经在吃, 也不要突然停掉; 告知抗凝门诊, 在变动前后各查一次INR。
pairs.evidence: PMID 15089812 (Jiang et al, Br J Clin Pharmacol 2004) crossover study in healthy subjects: reduced S- and R-warfarin AUC with a measurable fall in INR. Supported by multiple case reports and EU regulator class warnings.

pairs.supplement_zh: 鱼油/omega-3(EPA与DHA)
pairs.what_happens: Bruising, nosebleeds and bleeding gums become more likely while the INR usually stays the same, so the routine blood test does not warn you. A few case reports describe an INR rise after a fish oil dose increase.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 淤青、鼻出血和牙龈出血更容易发生, 而INR通常不变, 所以常规化验不会给出预警。有少数病例报告在增加鱼油剂量后出现INR升高。
pairs.mechanism: EPA and DHA reduce platelet aggregation and thromboxane A2 production; a platelet effect, not an effect on clotting factors
pairs.mechanism_zh: EPA和DHA降低血小板聚集和thromboxane A2生成, 作用在血小板层面, 与凝血因子无关
pairs.action: Doses up to about 1 g a day of combined EPA plus DHA are usually fine. Check the label, because a 1 g fish oil capsule typically holds only about 300 mg of EPA plus DHA. Ask the prescriber before using 3 g a day or more of EPA plus DHA, and report bruising, nosebleeds or bleeding gums rather than waiting for the next INR.
pairs.action_zh: EPA与DHA合计每天约1 g以内通常没问题。要看标签, 因为1 g的鱼油胶囊里EPA加DHA一般只有约300 mg。EPA加DHA每天达到3 g或以上前先问开药医生, 出现淤青、鼻出血或牙龈出血要立即报告, 不要等下一次INR。
pairs.evidence: Mechanistic platelet data. The largest randomised evidence (Javaid M et al, systematic review and meta-analysis of 11 trials and 120,643 patients, J Am Heart Assoc 2024;doi:10.1161/JAHA.123.032390) found no significant excess of major bleeding overall, including alongside antithrombotics, but noted that high-dose purified EPA may carry additional bleeding risk of very modest clinical significance, tracking EPA dose rather than background antiplatelet use. That caveat is what justifies the 3 g/day threshold here.

pairs.supplement_zh: 银杏(叶提取物)
pairs.what_happens: Reported bleeding events include bruising, eye bleeds and bleeding into the brain. The INR is usually unchanged, so nothing shows on the blood test.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 已报告的出血事件包括淤青、眼内出血和脑内出血。INR通常不变, 化验上看不出任何异常。
pairs.mechanism: Ginkgolides antagonise platelet-activating factor, giving a mild antiplatelet effect
pairs.mechanism_zh: 银杏内酯拮抗血小板活化因子(platelet-activating factor), 产生轻度抗血小板作用
pairs.action: Do not start ginkgo without telling the anticoagulant clinic. If you already take it, keep the dose the same every day and report any unusual bruising or bleeding that will not stop. An INR check cannot detect this platelet effect, so a normal INR is not reassurance. Stop ginkgo at least 36 hours before planned surgery.
pairs.action_zh: 开始服用银杏前一定告知抗凝门诊。如果已经在吃, 每天保持同样剂量, 出现异常淤青或止不住的出血要报告。查INR无法发现这种血小板层面的作用, 所以INR正常不能当作安全的凭据。计划手术前至少36小时停用银杏。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS ONLY for harm: about 15 published reports of a temporal link to bleeding, judged low quality. Controlled trials of standardised EGb 761 found no effect on coagulation and no pharmacodynamic interaction with warfarin or aspirin.

pairs.supplement: Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol, above 400 IU/day; the real concern is 800 IU/day or more)
pairs.supplement_zh: 维生素E(alpha-生育酚, 每天超过400 IU; 真正需要担心的是每天800 IU或以上)
pairs.what_happens: Easier bruising and prolonged bleeding from small cuts; at very high doses the INR itself can rise.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 更容易出现淤青, 小伤口出血时间延长; 在极高剂量下INR本身也可能上升。
pairs.mechanism: High-dose alpha-tocopherol inhibits platelet aggregation and, at large doses, interferes with vitamin K-dependent clotting factor activity
pairs.mechanism_zh: 大剂量alpha-生育酚抑制血小板聚集, 剂量很大时还会干扰维生素K依赖性凝血因子的活性
pairs.action: Keep vitamin E at 400 IU a day or less, a dose used for 3 years in a randomised trial without a bleeding excess, and treat 800 IU a day or more as the level that needs discussion with the prescriber. Tell the anticoagulant clinic if you start it and ask for an INR check 1 to 2 weeks later. Report bruising or bleeding that takes longer than usual to stop.
pairs.action_zh: 维生素E控制在每天400 IU以内, 这个剂量在一项随机试验中连用3年未见出血增加; 每天800 IU或以上才是需要与开药医生商量的水平。开始服用时告知抗凝门诊, 1到2周后复查INR。出现淤青或止血时间比平时长要报告。
pairs.evidence: Mechanistic plus small crossover studies and case reports; reviewed by Medsafe Prescriber Update, June 2022 (Can Vitamin E cause bleeding?). Reported bleeding cases and prothrombin time effects cluster at markedly higher intakes, roughly 800 to 1200 IU/day and above, while Bairati's randomised trial used 400 IU/day for 3 years with no bleeding excess reported. No dedicated randomised trial in warfarin users.

pairs.supplement_zh: 蔓越莓(果汁、浓缩液或胶囊)
pairs.what_happens: The INR can climb, sometimes sharply, with nosebleeds, heavy periods or bleeding into the gut. Large or variable intakes are the pattern linked to these reports.
pairs.what_happens_zh: INR可能上升, 有时上升很快, 伴随鼻出血、经量增多或胃肠道出血。相关报告中的共同特点是摄入量大或者摄入量忽多忽少。
pairs.mechanism: Proposed inhibition of CYP2C9 by cranberry flavonoids, reducing S-warfarin clearance; the mechanism has not been confirmed in volunteer studies
pairs.mechanism_zh: 推测是蔓越莓中的类黄酮抑制CYP2C9, 降低S-warfarin的清除; 该机制在志愿者研究中未被证实
pairs.action: Keep cranberry intake steady rather than swinging between none and a lot, and tell the anticoagulant clinic if you start or stop a cranberry product so an INR check can be arranged within 1 to 2 weeks. Large daily volumes of juice or concentrate are the pattern worth avoiding.
pairs.action_zh: 蔓越莓的摄入量保持稳定, 避免在完全不吃和大量吃之间摆动; 开始或停用蔓越莓产品时告知抗凝门诊, 以便在1到2周内安排复查INR。真正值得避免的是每天大量喝果汁或浓缩液。
pairs.evidence: Regulator communication (UK MHRA/CSM 2004 advice to avoid cranberry juice with warfarin) based on spontaneous reports of raised INR and bleeding. Several volunteer pharmacokinetic studies were negative, so this is case reports plus a regulatory warning, not trial data.

pairs.supplement_zh: 氨基葡萄糖(单独或与硫酸软骨素合用)
pairs.what_happens: The INR rises, sometimes markedly, within days to a few weeks, with bruising, nosebleeds or bleeding gums. It settles again after the glucosamine is stopped.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 在几天到几周内INR升高, 有时升幅明显, 伴随淤青、鼻出血或牙龈出血。停用氨基葡萄糖后INR会回落。
pairs.mechanism: Not established. The effect is reproducible on rechallenge in reported cases, and an antiplatelet or anticoagulant contribution from glucosamine and chondroitin has been proposed.
pairs.mechanism_zh: 机制尚未确立。已报告的病例中再次服用可重复出现该效应, 有推测认为氨基葡萄糖和硫酸软骨素本身带有抗血小板或抗凝作用。
pairs.action: Do not start glucosamine while on warfarin without telling the anticoagulant clinic. If you do start it, ask for an INR check within 1 to 2 weeks, and again after you stop it.
pairs.action_zh: 服用华法林期间不要在未告知抗凝门诊的情况下开始服用氨基葡萄糖。如果确实要吃, 在1到2周内复查INR, 停用之后再查一次。
pairs.evidence: Regulator signal plus a substantial spontaneous report series: UK MHRA and other agencies have warned of raised INR in warfarin users taking glucosamine, with dose response and positive rechallenge in some reports. CASE REPORTS AND REGULATORY SIGNAL; small volunteer studies were negative, so magnitude is uncertain. Included because it is a top-selling supplement in the same older population that takes warfarin.

pairs.supplement_zh: 辅酶Q10(ubiquinone, ubiquinol)
pairs.what_happens: The INR can fall, so clot protection is quietly reduced with no symptoms. Many people meet this supplement because it is marketed for statin muscle aches, so it often arrives alongside a statin rather than on its own.
pairs.what_happens_zh: INR可能下降, 抗血栓保护在没有任何症状的情况下被削弱。很多人接触这个补充剂是因为它被宣传用于缓解他汀引起的肌肉酸痛, 所以它往往和他汀一起出现。
pairs.mechanism: Coenzyme Q10 is structurally similar to vitamin K2 and is thought to have a weak vitamin K-like procoagulant effect
pairs.mechanism_zh: 辅酶Q10的结构与维生素K2相似, 一般认为它带有微弱的类维生素K促凝作用
pairs.action: Tell the anticoagulant clinic before you start or stop coenzyme Q10, keep the dose the same every day, and ask for an INR check within 1 to 2 weeks of any change.
pairs.action_zh: 开始或停用辅酶Q10前告知抗凝门诊, 每天保持同样剂量, 任何变动后1到2周内复查INR。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS of reduced INR plus the structural similarity to vitamin K2; small randomised crossover studies found no significant INR change, so the effect is inconsistent and probably small. The direction matters more than the magnitude, because a fall in INR produces no symptoms.

pairs.supplement: Cannabidiol (CBD oils, capsules and gummies sold as supplements)
pairs.supplement_zh: 大麻二酚(CBD, 以补充剂形式售卖的油剂、胶囊和软糖)
pairs.what_happens: The INR climbs over days to weeks, in published cases above 5, with bruising and bleeding. Reported patients needed the warfarin dose cut by roughly 30 percent.
pairs.what_happens_zh: INR在几天到几周内上升, 已发表病例中超过5, 伴随淤青和出血。报告中的患者需要把华法林剂量下调约30 percent。
pairs.mechanism: CBD inhibits CYP2C19 and, in vitro, CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, so clearance of S-warfarin falls and the INR rises. The same inhibition raises apixaban and rivaroxaban exposure, where no INR exists to reveal it.
pairs.mechanism_zh: CBD抑制CYP2C19, 体外还抑制CYP2C9和CYP3A4, 因此S-warfarin清除下降, INR升高。同样的抑制作用也会提高apixaban和rivaroxaban的暴露量, 而那类药没有INR可以反映出来。
pairs.action: Tell the anticoagulant clinic before using any CBD product, and ask for an INR check within 1 to 2 weeks of starting it, changing brand or changing dose, because product strength varies widely. Report bruising or bleeding that will not stop.
pairs.action_zh: 使用任何CBD产品前告知抗凝门诊, 开始服用、换品牌或改剂量后1到2周内复查INR, 因为不同产品的含量差别很大。出现淤青或止不住的出血要报告。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS AND CASE SERIES of substantial INR rises with CBD in warfarin users requiring dose reduction, plus well-documented CYP2C19 inhibition from prescription cannabidiol studies. No controlled interaction trial in warfarin users. Included because CBD is now one of the most widely used unlicensed supplements.

pairs.supplement: Danshen (Salvia miltiorrhiza) and dong quai (Angelica sinensis), including Chinese herbal mixtures containing them
pairs.supplement_zh: 丹参(Salvia miltiorrhiza)和当归(Angelica sinensis), 包括含这两味药的中药复方
pairs.what_happens: The INR rises sharply, in reported cases above 5, with bruising, nosebleeds or serious internal bleeding. Because these herbs are usually taken inside multi-herb prescriptions, the trigger is often not obvious to the patient.
pairs.what_happens_zh: INR急剧上升, 已报告病例中超过5, 伴随淤青、鼻出血或严重内出血。由于这两味药通常出现在多味药的复方里, 患者往往看不出问题出在哪里。
pairs.mechanism: Danshen reduces warfarin clearance and has its own antiplatelet and antithrombin activity; dong quai contains coumarin derivatives and also inhibits platelet aggregation
pairs.mechanism_zh: 丹参降低华法林清除, 本身还有抗血小板和抗凝血酶作用; 当归含香豆素类成分, 同时抑制血小板聚集
pairs.action: Do not take danshen or dong quai, or Chinese herbal mixtures containing them, while on warfarin. If you have taken any, tell the anticoagulant clinic and ask for an INR check now, and bring the packaging or the prescription list so the ingredients can be identified.
pairs.action_zh: 服用华法林期间不要用丹参、当归或含这两味药的中药复方。如果已经服用过, 告知抗凝门诊并立即复查INR, 同时带上包装或药方以便核对成分。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS of markedly raised INR and bleeding with both herbs, supported by animal pharmacokinetic studies showing reduced warfarin clearance with danshen. No controlled human trial.

pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草(贯叶连翘, Hypericum perforatum)
pairs.what_happens: Drug levels fall and the protection against stroke or clot is lost silently, because there is no routine blood test for these drugs.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 药物浓度下降, 对中风和血栓的保护在无声中丧失, 因为这类药没有常规化验可以监测。
pairs.mechanism: Induction of intestinal P-glycoprotein (all four drugs) and CYP3A4 (apixaban, rivaroxaban) lowers drug exposure
pairs.mechanism_zh: 诱导肠道P-glycoprotein(四种药都受影响)和CYP3A4(apixaban、rivaroxaban), 使药物暴露量下降
pairs.action: Do not take St John's wort with a DOAC. Ask the prescriber for a different treatment for low mood, and tell them if you have already been taking it.
pairs.action_zh: 不要把圣约翰草和DOAC一起服用。情绪低落请找开药医生换其他治疗方式, 如果已经在吃也要告知医生。
pairs.evidence: Product information for apixaban, rivaroxaban, edoxaban and dabigatran warns against or contraindicates strong P-gp/CYP3A4 inducers; supported by volunteer induction pharmacokinetic studies and case reports of thrombotic events. No randomised outcome trial.

pairs.supplement_zh: 鱼油/omega-3(EPA与DHA)
pairs.what_happens: Slightly more bruising and minor bleeding on top of an already thinned blood; no test will show it.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 在血液本已抗凝的基础上, 淤青和轻微出血略有增加; 没有任何化验能反映这一点。
pairs.mechanism: Platelet inhibition adds to factor Xa or thrombin inhibition (pharmacodynamic, additive)
pairs.mechanism_zh: 抑制血小板的作用叠加在factor Xa或凝血酶抑制之上(药效学叠加)
pairs.action: Stay at 1 g a day or less of combined EPA plus DHA unless the prescriber agrees to more; a 1 g fish oil capsule usually contains only about 300 mg of EPA plus DHA, so read the label. Seek urgent advice for black stools, blood in urine, or bleeding that will not stop after 10 minutes of pressure.
pairs.action_zh: 除医生同意外, EPA与DHA合计控制在每天1 g以内; 1 g的鱼油胶囊通常只含约300 mg的EPA加DHA, 所以要看标签。出现黑便、尿中带血, 或按压10分钟仍止不住的出血, 立即就医。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC plus indirect: the 2024 randomised-trial meta-analysis in J Am Heart Assoc (doi:10.1161/JAHA.123.032390) found no significant bleeding excess with omega-3 including alongside antithrombotics, with a small extra risk signal at high purified EPA doses. No dedicated DOAC combination trial exists.

pairs.supplement_zh: 银杏(叶提取物)
pairs.what_happens: Bruising and minor bleeding on top of an already thinned blood, with no INR or other routine test to pick it up. High-dose vitamin E behaves the same way, and both are often assumed to matter only with warfarin.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 在血液本已抗凝的基础上出现淤青和轻微出血, 而且没有INR或其他常规化验能发现。大剂量维生素E的表现相同, 这两者常被误以为只和华法林有关。
pairs.mechanism: Platelet-activating factor antagonism by ginkgolides adds to factor Xa or thrombin inhibition (pharmacodynamic, additive)
pairs.mechanism_zh: 银杏内酯拮抗血小板活化因子的作用叠加在factor Xa或凝血酶抑制之上(药效学叠加)
pairs.action: Tell the prescriber before starting ginkgo with a DOAC. Report bruising or bleeding that will not stop, seek urgent advice for black stools or blood in urine, and stop ginkgo at least 36 hours before planned surgery.
pairs.action_zh: 在服用DOAC期间开始用银杏前先告知开药医生。出现淤青或止不住的出血要报告, 出现黑便或尿中带血立即就医, 计划手术前至少36小时停用银杏。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS AND MECHANISTIC ONLY: the additive platelet effect is the same one described with warfarin and antiplatelets, and controlled trials of standardised EGb 761 found no effect on coagulation. No DOAC-specific study. Included because the absence of a bleeding-supplement entry for DOACs would otherwise read as safety by omission, and because no laboratory test can detect the effect.

pairs.supplement: Concentrated garlic (allicin or aged garlic capsules)
pairs.supplement_zh: 浓缩大蒜制剂(大蒜素或陈蒜提取胶囊)
pairs.what_happens: Longer bleeding from cuts and more bruising, most clearly around surgery or dental work.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 伤口出血时间延长, 淤青增多, 在手术或牙科操作前后最为明显。
pairs.mechanism: Ajoene and related organosulfur compounds inhibit platelet aggregation irreversibly, adding to factor Xa or thrombin inhibition
pairs.mechanism_zh: 阿藿烯(ajoene)等有机硫化合物不可逆地抑制血小板聚集, 与factor Xa或凝血酶抑制叠加
pairs.action: Garlic in cooking is fine. Stop concentrated garlic capsules 7 to 10 days before any operation or dental extraction, tell the surgeon or dentist you were taking them, and do not stop the DOAC yourself.
pairs.action_zh: 做菜用的大蒜没问题。任何手术或拔牙前7到10天停用浓缩大蒜胶囊, 并告知手术医生或牙医你一直在吃, 同时不要自行停用DOAC。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC plus CASE REPORTS from the warfarin and antiplatelet setting (including spontaneous spinal epidural haematoma). No DOAC-specific trial.

pairs.supplement_zh: 纤溶酶类补充剂(纳豆激酶、沙雷肽酶、蚓激酶)
pairs.what_happens: Extra bruising and bleeding, with case reports of serious bleeds including into the brain and the eye. Nattokinase products also vary widely in strength, and some carry vitamin K2 (MK-7) from the fermentation, which pushes the INR the other way on warfarin.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 淤青和出血增多, 有严重出血的病例报告, 包括脑内和眼内出血。纳豆激酶产品的强度差异很大, 部分产品因发酵工艺带有维生素K2(MK-7), 在华法林患者中会让INR朝相反方向变化。
pairs.mechanism: Nattokinase and related enzyme products have fibrinolytic and antiplatelet activity in vitro and lower fibrinogen, so the effect adds to the prescribed drug. Product strength is not standardised.
pairs.mechanism_zh: 纳豆激酶等酶类产品在体外具有纤溶和抗血小板活性, 并降低纤维蛋白原, 作用与处方药叠加。这类产品的强度没有统一标准。
pairs.action: Do not combine fibrinolytic enzyme supplements with an anticoagulant or antiplatelet without asking the prescriber. If you take a nattokinase product on warfarin, check whether the label declares MK-7 and ask for an INR check.
pairs.action_zh: 未询问开药医生前, 不要把纤溶酶类补充剂与抗凝药或抗血小板药合用。如果在用华法林期间服用纳豆激酶产品, 查看标签是否标注MK-7, 并要求复查INR。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS plus in-vitro fibrinolytic data. No controlled interaction trial, and product content is poorly standardised, which is itself part of the hazard.

pairs.supplement_zh: 银杏(叶提取物)
pairs.what_happens: Reported harms are bruising and, rarely, bleeding inside the skull or eye. Nothing shows on routine blood tests.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 已报告的危害是淤青, 少数情况下出现颅内或眼内出血。常规化验上看不出任何变化。
pairs.mechanism: Platelet-activating factor antagonism by ginkgolides adds to COX-1 or P2Y12 blockade
pairs.mechanism_zh: 银杏内酯拮抗血小板活化因子, 与COX-1或P2Y12阻断作用叠加
pairs.action: Do not start ginkgo while on aspirin or clopidogrel without asking the prescriber. Report bleeding that takes longer than usual to stop, and stop ginkgo at least 36 hours before planned surgery, which is the standard perioperative interval for ginkgo (the 7 day interval applies to garlic and ginseng).
pairs.action_zh: 在用阿司匹林或clopidogrel期间, 未询问开药医生前不要开始服用银杏。出现止血时间比平时长要报告, 计划手术前至少36小时停用银杏, 这是银杏的标准术前停药间隔(7天的间隔适用于大蒜和人参)。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS ONLY: about 15 low-quality published reports including subdural and intracerebral haemorrhage. Randomised trials of standardised EGb 761 with aspirin showed no bleeding excess and no effect on coagulation parameters. The 36 hour preoperative interval follows Ang-Lee et al, JAMA 2001.

pairs.supplement: Concentrated garlic (allicin or aged garlic capsules)
pairs.supplement_zh: 浓缩大蒜制剂(大蒜素或陈蒜提取胶囊)
pairs.what_happens: Longer bleeding from cuts and more bruising; the main documented harm is unexpected bleeding around surgery.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 伤口出血时间延长, 淤青增多; 记录最明确的危害是手术前后的意外出血。
pairs.mechanism: Ajoene and related organosulfur compounds inhibit platelet aggregation irreversibly
pairs.mechanism_zh: 阿藿烯(ajoene)等有机硫化合物不可逆地抑制血小板聚集
pairs.action: Garlic in cooking is fine. Stop concentrated garlic capsules 7 to 10 days before any operation or dental extraction and tell the surgeon or dentist you were taking them.
pairs.action_zh: 做菜用的大蒜没问题。任何手术或拔牙前7到10天停用浓缩大蒜胶囊, 并告知手术医生或牙医你一直在吃。
pairs.evidence: Platelet function studies in volunteers plus CASE REPORTS (including spontaneous spinal epidural haematoma). No randomised trial has shown a bleeding excess.

pairs.drug_class_zh: 需活化的抗血小板前药(clopidogrel)
pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草(贯叶连翘, Hypericum perforatum)
pairs.what_happens: This pair runs opposite to every other St John's wort entry here: platelet inhibition becomes stronger, so bruising and bleeding are more likely, and people who responded poorly to clopidogrel can become full responders.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 这一组与本表中其他圣约翰草条目方向相反: 血小板抑制增强, 淤青和出血更容易发生, 原先对clopidogrel反应不佳的人可能变成完全有反应。
pairs.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 induction speeds conversion of the clopidogrel prodrug into its active thiol metabolite, so platelet inhibition increases
pairs.mechanism_zh: 诱导CYP3A4和CYP2C19, 加快clopidogrel前药转化为活性硫醇代谢物, 血小板抑制随之增强
pairs.action: Do not start or stop St John's wort without telling the prescriber, because both directions change how much clopidogrel is activated. Report unusual bruising or bleeding.
pairs.action_zh: 开始或停用圣约翰草都要告知开药医生, 因为两个方向都会改变clopidogrel的活化程度。出现异常淤青或出血要报告。
pairs.evidence: SMALL VOLUNTEER AND PATIENT STUDIES of platelet reactivity showing improved response in clopidogrel non-responders after St John's wort. Mechanistically consistent, no outcome trial. Included because it breaks the pattern that St John's wort always lowers drug effect.

pairs.drug_class_zh: SSRI类及其他血清素类药物
pairs.drug_examples: sertraline, fluoxetine, citalopram, venlafaxine, duloxetine, tramadol, triptans
pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草(贯叶连翘, Hypericum perforatum)
pairs.what_happens: Serotonin syndrome: agitation, sweating, shivering, muscle twitching, diarrhoea, fast heartbeat and confusion, sometimes within hours of the first combined dose.
