pairs.what_happens_zh: 血清素综合征: 躁动、出汗、发冷发抖、肌肉抽动、腹泻、心跳加快和意识混乱, 有时在两药合用的头几个小时内就出现。
pairs.mechanism: Hyperforin-mediated inhibition of synaptic serotonin reuptake adds to the prescribed drug's serotonergic effect
pairs.mechanism_zh: 贯叶金丝桃素(hyperforin)抑制突触血清素再摄取, 与处方药的血清素作用叠加
pairs.action: Never take the two together. If you want to switch in either direction, ask the prescriber to plan a washout gap first. Get urgent medical help for shivering, sweating, twitching muscles and confusion.
pairs.action_zh: 两者绝不可同时服用。若要在两者之间更换, 先请开药医生安排洗脱间隔。出现发冷发抖、出汗、肌肉抽动和意识混乱要立即就医。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS ONLY for the syndrome itself (repeated published reports, particularly in older patients on SSRIs), plus regulator warnings (UK MHRA 2000 St John's wort interaction advice) and clear mechanistic data.

pairs.drug_class_zh: SSRI类及其他血清素类药物
pairs.supplement_zh: 5-HTP(5-羟色氨酸)
pairs.what_happens: Potential serotonin syndrome: restlessness, sweating, tremor, diarrhoea, fast heartbeat and confusion.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 可能出现血清素综合征: 烦躁不安、出汗、手抖、腹泻、心跳加快和意识混乱。
pairs.mechanism: 5-HTP is the immediate precursor of serotonin and bypasses the rate-limiting tryptophan hydroxylase step, so brain serotonin rises regardless of reuptake
pairs.mechanism_zh: 5-HTP是血清素的直接前体, 绕过限速的tryptophan hydroxylase环节, 所以无论再摄取如何, 脑内血清素都会升高
pairs.action: Do not take 5-HTP alongside an antidepressant. If you are already taking both, stop the 5-HTP and tell the prescriber; get urgent help if you develop shivering, twitching or confusion.
pairs.action_zh: 不要在服用抗抑郁药的同时吃5-HTP。如果两者都在吃, 停掉5-HTP并告知开药医生; 出现发冷发抖、肌肉抽动或意识混乱要立即就医。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC ONLY in humans plus animal models (malignant serotonin syndrome in rats given 5-HTP with MAOIs or SSRIs). Human serotonin syndrome with 5-HTP is essentially unreported apart from one case involving linezolid, and one case of mania with an MAOI (PMC3253963).

pairs.drug_class_zh: SSRI类及其他血清素类药物
pairs.supplement_zh: L-色氨酸
pairs.what_happens: Agitation, restlessness, nausea, sweating and poor sleep, up to full serotonin syndrome.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 躁动、烦躁不安、恶心、出汗和睡眠变差, 严重时发展为完整的血清素综合征。
pairs.mechanism: Extra substrate for serotonin synthesis combined with blocked serotonin reuptake
pairs.mechanism_zh: 额外提供血清素合成底物, 同时血清素再摄取被阻断
pairs.action: Do not add tryptophan to an antidepressant unless a specialist prescribes it and reviews you; buy nothing labelled as a sleep or mood amino acid without checking the ingredient list against your prescription.
pairs.action_zh: 除专科医生开具并随访外, 不要在抗抑郁药之外加用色氨酸; 买任何标称助眠或改善情绪的氨基酸产品前, 先把成分表和自己的处方对一遍。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS ONLY: published reports of agitation and serotonin syndrome with fluoxetine plus tryptophan (Steiner and Fontaine, 1986 case series of 5 patients) and with MAOIs. No controlled trial.

pairs.supplement_zh: 褪黑素
pairs.what_happens: Melatonin blood levels rise many-fold on the same dose, giving heavy sedation, a hangover feeling and slow reactions the next morning.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 同样剂量下褪黑素的血药浓度升高数倍, 造成明显困倦、次日晨起像宿醉一样以及反应变慢。
pairs.mechanism: Fluvoxamine is a potent CYP1A2 inhibitor and CYP1A2 is the main route of melatonin clearance, so exposure to an unchanged melatonin dose can rise by up to about 20-fold
pairs.mechanism_zh: fluvoxamine是强效CYP1A2抑制剂, 而CYP1A2是褪黑素清除的主要途径, 所以在褪黑素剂量不变的情况下暴露量最多可升高约20倍
pairs.action: Avoid melatonin with fluvoxamine, or use the smallest dose (0.5 to 1 mg) only if the prescriber agrees. Do not drive or use machinery the next morning until you know how the combination affects you.
pairs.action_zh: 服用fluvoxamine期间避免用褪黑素, 若医生同意, 只用最小剂量(0.5到1 mg)。在了解合用后的反应之前, 次日上午不要开车或操作机械。
pairs.evidence: CONTROLLED VOLUNTEER PHARMACOKINETIC DATA: fluvoxamine raises melatonin AUC many-fold (Hartter et al, Clin Pharmacol Ther 2000 and related work). Included because it is the one melatonin interaction with a large, well-characterised pharmacokinetic effect.

pairs.supplement: Tyramine-generating and pressor supplements (fermented soy products, yeast extract, aged protein concentrates, broad bean pod extract; L-tyrosine as a precaution)
pairs.supplement_zh: 会产生酪胺或有升压作用的补充剂(发酵豆制品、酵母提取物、陈化蛋白浓缩物、蚕豆荚提取物; L-酪氨酸按预防原则一并列入)
pairs.what_happens: Hypertensive crisis: sudden severe throbbing headache, neck stiffness, chest pain, racing heart, and risk of stroke.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 高血压危机: 突发剧烈搏动性头痛、颈部僵硬、胸痛、心跳极快, 并有中风风险。
pairs.mechanism: Irreversible non-selective MAO inhibition removes gut and liver breakdown of tyramine, which then displaces noradrenaline from nerve endings. Three separate mechanisms sit inside this supplement group: a tyramine load from bacterial decarboxylation of tyrosine in fermented soy and yeast extract; levodopa content in broad bean (fava) pod extract, which drives a pressor response of its own; and L-tyrosine, which is not itself a pressor amine and is a precautionary concern only.
pairs.mechanism_zh: 不可逆非选择性MAO抑制使肠道和肝脏无法分解酪胺, 酪胺随后把去甲肾上腺素从神经末梢置换出来。这一组补充剂里其实有三种不同机制: 发酵豆制品和酵母提取物中酪氨酸经细菌脱羧形成的酪胺负荷; 蚕豆荚提取物所含左旋多巴, 本身即可引起升压反应; 以及L-酪氨酸, 它本身不是升压胺, 只是出于预防才列入。
pairs.action: Do not take supplements containing tyramine, fermented soy, yeast extract or broad bean pod extract while on one of these drugs, and for 2 weeks after stopping, because the enzyme block is irreversible. Treat L-tyrosine as precautionary and ask the prescriber. Call emergency services for a sudden severe headache with a pounding heartbeat.
pairs.action_zh: 服用这几种药期间, 以及停药后2周内, 不要服用含酪胺、发酵豆制品、酵母提取物或蚕豆荚提取物的补充剂, 因为酶的阻断是不可逆的。L-酪氨酸按预防处理, 先问开药医生。突发剧烈头痛伴心跳剧烈时呼叫急救。
pairs.evidence: Long-established pharmacology plus a large published case literature (the cheese reaction). Well characterised, though the modern evidence base is case reports rather than trials. The L-tyrosine component is precautionary rather than established, and the broad bean hazard is a levodopa effect.

pairs.drug_class: Reversible MAO-A inhibitor and MAO-B selective agents
pairs.drug_class_zh: 可逆性MAO-A抑制剂与MAO-B选择性药物
pairs.drug_examples: moclobemide, oral selegiline 10 mg/day, selegiline transdermal 6 mg/24 h and 9 mg/24 h
pairs.supplement: Tyramine or tyrosine containing supplements (L-tyrosine, fermented soy, yeast extract, broad bean pod extract)
pairs.supplement_zh: 含酪胺或酪氨酸的补充剂(L-酪氨酸、发酵豆制品、酵母提取物、蚕豆荚提取物)
pairs.what_happens: At licensed doses these drugs do not require tyramine restriction and a hypertensive reaction is unlikely. The risk appears as the dose rises: oral selegiline loses MAO-B selectivity at higher doses, and the 12 mg/24 h patch does carry a dietary restriction while 6 and 9 mg/24 h do not.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 在批准剂量下, 这几种药不需要限制酪胺, 高血压反应不大可能出现。风险随剂量上升而出现: 口服selegiline在较高剂量下失去对MAO-B的选择性, 12 mg/24 h的贴剂需要饮食限制, 而6和9 mg/24 h不需要。
pairs.mechanism: Moclobemide inhibits MAO-A reversibly and is displaced by a tyramine load, so gut breakdown of tyramine continues. Low-dose selegiline inhibits MAO-B, leaving MAO-A available to clear tyramine; that selectivity is dose-dependent.
pairs.mechanism_zh: moclobemide对MAO-A的抑制是可逆的, 酪胺负荷会把它置换下来, 因此肠道对酪胺的分解仍在进行。低剂量selegiline抑制MAO-B, 留下MAO-A继续清除酪胺; 这种选择性随剂量升高而丧失。
pairs.action: No tyramine or cheese restriction is needed at standard moclobemide doses or at oral selegiline 10 mg a day. Keep to the prescribed dose, and check with the prescriber before large tyrosine or fermented-supplement doses, or if the selegiline dose or patch strength goes up. Moclobemide washout is roughly 24 hours, so the 2 week rule for irreversible MAOIs does not apply here.
pairs.action_zh: 在moclobemide常规剂量或口服selegiline每天10 mg的情况下, 不需要限制酪胺或奶酪。按处方剂量服用, 若要大剂量补充酪氨酸或发酵类补充剂, 或selegiline剂量和贴剂强度上调, 先问开药医生。moclobemide的洗脱期约24小时, 不可逆MAOI的2周规则在这里不适用。
pairs.evidence: Established class pharmacology and product information: moclobemide requires no dietary tyramine restriction at licensed doses, and the selegiline transdermal system carries no dietary restriction at 6 mg/24 h or 9 mg/24 h. No case series of tyramine crisis at these doses. Split out from the irreversible MAOI entry, where a single AVOID rating with a 2 week washout was wrong for these agents.

pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草(贯叶连翘, Hypericum perforatum)
pairs.what_happens: Serotonin syndrome or a hypertensive reaction: sweating, tremor, confusion, high blood pressure, fast heartbeat.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血清素综合征或高血压反应: 出汗、手抖、意识混乱、血压升高、心跳加快。
pairs.mechanism: Additive monoamine effects; MAO inhibition prevents breakdown of the extra serotonin and noradrenaline available
pairs.mechanism_zh: 单胺作用叠加; MAO被抑制后, 多出来的血清素和去甲肾上腺素无法被分解
pairs.action: Do not combine. Leave at least 2 weeks between stopping an irreversible MAOI and starting St John's wort, and have the prescriber confirm the gap for your specific drug.
pairs.action_zh: 不要合用。停用不可逆MAOI后至少间隔2周再开始服用圣约翰草, 具体间隔请开药医生按你所用的药确认。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC ONLY plus isolated case reports. No controlled human data; the combination is avoided on the basis of the MAOI class hazard.

pairs.drug_class_zh: 钙调神经磷酸酶抑制剂
pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草(贯叶连翘, Hypericum perforatum)
pairs.what_happens: Trough drug levels fall by roughly half within about two weeks and the transplanted organ can be rejected. Rejection may show as fever, pain over the graft, less urine or rising creatinine.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 约两周内谷浓度下降大约一半, 移植器官可能发生排斥。排斥表现可以是发热、移植部位疼痛、尿量减少或肌酐上升。
pairs.mechanism: PXR activation induces hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 plus intestinal P-glycoprotein, cutting both absorption and half-life
pairs.mechanism_zh: 激活PXR, 诱导肝脏和肠道CYP3A4以及肠道P-glycoprotein, 同时降低吸收和缩短半衰期
pairs.action: Never take St John's wort after a transplant. If you have taken any, contact the transplant team the same day and ask for an urgent trough level; do not adjust your own dose.
pairs.action_zh: 移植后绝不可服用圣约翰草。若已服用, 当天联系移植团队并要求紧急测谷浓度; 不要自行调整剂量。
pairs.evidence: PMID 12580993 (Bauer et al, 2003): ciclosporin Cmax, Cmin and AUC fell 42%, 41% and 46%. Case series of 45 kidney and liver recipients with a mean 49% fall in levels; acute rejection case reports including PMID 10683008 (heart transplant).

pairs.drug_class_zh: 钙调神经磷酸酶抑制剂
pairs.supplement_zh: 小檗碱(黄连素)
pairs.what_happens: Drug levels climb, bringing tremor, headache, high blood pressure and kidney damage (rising creatinine on blood tests). The graft is at risk from toxicity in the same way it is from under-dosing.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 药物浓度升高, 出现手抖、头痛、血压升高和肾损伤(化验可见肌酐上升)。毒性对移植器官的威胁和剂量不足一样严重。
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein reduces clearance and increases absorption
pairs.mechanism_zh: 抑制CYP3A4和P-glycoprotein, 降低清除并增加吸收
pairs.action: Do not add berberine without the transplant team agreeing first. If it has already been started, ask for a trough level and kidney function test within one week.
pairs.action_zh: 未经移植团队同意不要加用小檗碱。如果已经开始服用, 一周内查谷浓度和肾功能。
pairs.evidence: Small pharmacokinetic studies in renal transplant recipients showing raised ciclosporin exposure, plus in-vitro CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inhibition data (PMC7600264). SMALL PK STUDIES AND MECHANISTIC, no outcome trial. Rated AVOID rather than MONITOR to match the graft-jeopardy consequence and the row's own instruction that no unsupervised change is acceptable in transplant patients.

pairs.supplement: Calcium supplements (carbonate, citrate, acetate; includes calcium-based antacids)
pairs.supplement_zh: 钙补充剂(碳酸钙、柠檬酸钙、乙酸钙; 含含钙抗酸剂)
pairs.what_happens: About 20 to 25 percent less thyroid hormone is absorbed, so TSH rises and tiredness, weight gain, constipation and cold intolerance return.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 甲状腺激素吸收减少约20到25 percent, TSH上升, 乏力、体重增加、便秘和怕冷再次出现。
pairs.mechanism: Calcium binds levothyroxine in the gut to form a poorly absorbed complex
pairs.mechanism_zh: 钙在肠道内与左甲状腺素结合, 形成难以吸收的复合物
pairs.action: Take levothyroxine with water on an empty stomach and leave at least 4 hours before any calcium supplement or calcium-containing antacid. Keep the same routine every day.
pairs.action_zh: 左甲状腺素空腹用水服下, 与任何钙补充剂或含钙抗酸剂间隔至少4小时。每天保持同样的服药习惯。
pairs.evidence: Two separate sources. Zamfirescu & Carlson (Thyroid 2011) measured the 20 to 25 percent fall in levothyroxine absorption using 500 mg elemental calcium given as carbonate, citrate or acetate, so all three salts listed here behave the same way. Singh, Singh & Hershman (JAMA 2000) was a 3-month prospective cohort in 20 patients with no AUC measurement: free T4 fell from 17 to 15 pmol/L, TSH rose from 1.6 to 2.7 mIU/L, and 20 percent of patients went above the TSH reference range. Reflected in the licensed product information.

pairs.supplement_zh: 铁剂(硫酸亚铁、富马酸亚铁、葡萄糖酸亚铁)
pairs.what_happens: Absorption falls by a variable and sometimes large amount. In a controlled study TSH rose from 1.6 to 5.4 mIU/L over 12 weeks, with return of hypothyroid symptoms.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 吸收下降, 幅度不固定, 有时相当大。在一项对照研究中, 12周内TSH从1.6升到5.4 mIU/L, 甲减症状重新出现。
pairs.mechanism: Ferrous iron chelates levothyroxine in the gut lumen, forming an insoluble complex
pairs.mechanism_zh: 亚铁在肠腔内与左甲状腺素螯合, 形成不溶性复合物
pairs.action: Take levothyroxine first thing with water and take the iron at lunchtime or bedtime, at least 4 hours apart. Ask for a TSH check 6 to 8 weeks after starting or stopping iron.
pairs.action_zh: 左甲状腺素清晨用水服下, 铁剂放在午餐时或睡前, 两者间隔至少4小时。开始或停用铁剂后6到8周复查TSH。
pairs.evidence: Controlled trial by Campbell NR, Hasinoff BB, Stalts H, Rao B, Wong NC, Ann Intern Med 1992: ferrous sulfate 300 mg with levothyroxine raised mean TSH from 1.6 +/- 0.4 to 5.4 +/- 2.8 mU/L (P<0.01) and produced a variable reduction in thyroxine efficacy. The study reports no single absorption percentage, so no fixed figure is quoted here.

pairs.supplement: Other gut binders: magnesium supplements, aluminium- and magnesium-containing antacids, soy protein isolate, and fibre supplements (psyllium/ispaghula, glucomannan)
pairs.supplement_zh: 其他会在肠道内结合药物的产品: 镁补充剂、含铝和含镁抗酸剂、大豆分离蛋白, 以及膳食纤维补充剂(洋车前子壳/ispaghula、魔芋葡甘聚糖)
pairs.what_happens: The same loss of absorption as with calcium and iron: TSH rises and hypothyroid symptoms return while the prescribed dose has not changed.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 和钙、铁一样造成吸收下降: 处方剂量没变, 但TSH上升, 甲减症状重新出现。
pairs.mechanism: Polyvalent cations bind levothyroxine in the gut, while soy protein and viscous fibre trap it in the gut contents so less reaches the mucosa
pairs.mechanism_zh: 多价阳离子在肠道内与左甲状腺素结合, 大豆蛋白和黏性纤维则把药物困在肠内容物中, 使到达肠黏膜的药量减少
pairs.action: Take levothyroxine with water on an empty stomach and leave at least 4 hours before magnesium or aluminium antacids, soy protein powders or fibre supplements. Keep the routine identical every day and ask for a TSH check 6 to 8 weeks after any change.
pairs.action_zh: 左甲状腺素空腹用水服下, 与镁剂或含铝抗酸剂、大豆蛋白粉、纤维补充剂间隔至少4小时。每天的时间安排保持一致, 任何变动后6到8周复查TSH。
pairs.evidence: Established absorption pharmacokinetics plus product information warnings for cation antacids, soy and fibre, supported by case reports of levothyroxine requirements rising on soy or fibre and falling again on withdrawal. Added because the levothyroxine cluster previously covered only calcium and iron.

pairs.drug_class_zh: 甲状腺用药及其他影响甲状腺的药物
pairs.supplement: Iodine-containing supplements (kelp, bladderwrack, seaweed powders, high-dose potassium iodide, some multivitamins)
pairs.supplement_zh: 含碘补充剂(海带、墨角藻、海藻粉、大剂量碘化钾、部分复合维生素)
pairs.what_happens: Thyroid function swings in either direction: an iodine load can cause hypothyroidism (tiredness, weight gain, cold intolerance) or thyrotoxicosis (palpitations, weight loss, tremor), and it destabilises a levothyroxine or antithyroid dose that was previously steady. Risk is higher with amiodarone, which already delivers a large iodine load, and with lithium, which itself blocks thyroid hormone release.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 甲状腺功能可能向两个方向摆动: 碘负荷可以引起甲减(乏力、体重增加、怕冷)或甲状腺毒症(心慌、体重下降、手抖), 并让原本稳定的左甲状腺素或抗甲状腺药剂量失去稳定。amiodarone本身带来大量碘负荷, lithium本身抑制甲状腺激素释放, 这两类患者风险更高。
pairs.mechanism: Excess iodine transiently blocks organification and hormone release (Wolff-Chaikoff effect) and, in nodular glands, can drive autonomous hormone production (Jod-Basedow). Kelp iodine content is usually undeclared and varies widely between batches.
pairs.mechanism_zh: 过量碘会短暂阻断碘的有机化和激素释放(Wolff-Chaikoff效应), 在有结节的甲状腺中又可能驱动自主性激素分泌(Jod-Basedow现象)。海带类产品的碘含量通常不标注, 批次之间差别很大。
pairs.action: Do not take kelp, seaweed or iodine supplements if you take levothyroxine, carbimazole, propylthiouracil, amiodarone or lithium. If you have already been taking them, stop and ask for a TSH and free T4 check; do not change the prescribed dose yourself.
pairs.action_zh: 正在服用levothyroxine、carbimazole、propylthiouracil、amiodarone或lithium的人, 不要服用海带、海藻或含碘补充剂。若已经在吃, 停用并要求查TSH和游离T4; 不要自行更改处方剂量。
pairs.evidence: Case reports and case series of kelp-induced hypothyroidism and thyrotoxicosis, product surveys showing large and undeclared iodine content, and established iodine physiology. No trial data. Added because the matrix covered levothyroxine absorption thoroughly and iodine load not at all.

pairs.supplement_zh: 南非醉茄(印度人参, Withania somnifera)
pairs.what_happens: Thyroid hormone levels can rise on an unchanged levothyroxine dose, giving palpitations, tremor, sweating, weight loss and anxiety; published cases include frank thyrotoxicosis. Ashwagandha also carries its own liver injury signal.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 在左甲状腺素剂量不变的情况下甲状腺激素水平可能升高, 出现心慌、手抖、出汗、体重下降和焦虑; 已发表病例中有明确的甲状腺毒症。南非醉茄本身还带有肝损伤信号。
pairs.mechanism: Ashwagandha raises T4 and T3 in animal and human reports, so its effect adds to the prescribed hormone. Withanolides separately carry a hepatotoxicity signal that has nothing to do with the thyroid effect.
pairs.mechanism_zh: 动物和人体报告显示南非醉茄可升高T4和T3, 作用与处方激素叠加。醉茄内酯类另有独立的肝毒性信号, 与甲状腺作用无关。
pairs.action: Tell the prescriber if you take ashwagandha with levothyroxine and ask for a TSH and free T4 check. Stop it and seek advice for palpitations, tremor or weight loss, and also for jaundice, dark urine or pain under the right ribs.
pairs.action_zh: 服用左甲状腺素期间使用南非醉茄要告知开药医生, 并要求查TSH和游离T4。出现心慌、手抖或体重下降要停用并就医, 出现皮肤发黄、尿色深或右侧肋下疼痛同样要就医。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS: published thyrotoxicosis with ashwagandha, including in patients on levothyroxine, plus a growing herb-induced liver injury literature (LiverTox). No controlled interaction study. Added because it is a high-volume supplement that was absent from the matrix.

pairs.drug_class_zh: 左甲状腺素(甲功监测环节)
pairs.drug_examples: levothyroxine dose decisions based on TSH and free T4
pairs.supplement: High-dose biotin (vitamin B7; hair, skin and nail products up to 20 mg)
pairs.supplement_zh: 大剂量生物素(维生素B7; 护发护甲类产品可达20 mg)
pairs.what_happens: ASSAY ARTEFACT rather than a drug interaction: the blood test reads falsely low TSH and falsely high free T4, mimicking an overactive thyroid or overtreatment, so a correct dose may be wrongly cut.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 这是化验干扰, 属于分析层面的问题, 与体内药物相互作用无关: 化验结果显示TSH假性偏低、游离T4假性偏高, 看起来像甲状腺功能亢进或用药过量, 于是本来合适的剂量可能被错误下调。
pairs.mechanism: Biotin in the sample saturates the streptavidin-biotin capture step used by many immunoassays; the drug and the supplement never interact in the body
pairs.mechanism_zh: 样本中的生物素占满了许多免疫分析所用的streptavidin-biotin捕获环节; 药物和补充剂在体内从未发生相互作用
pairs.action: Stop biotin at least 2 days before a thyroid blood test, or 3 to 7 days if you take 5 mg a day or more, and tell whoever takes the blood that you use it. Do not accept a dose change based on a test taken while you were still on biotin.
pairs.action_zh: 甲功抽血前至少停用生物素2天, 每天5 mg或以上的人停3到7天, 并告知采血人员你在服用。不要接受基于仍在服用生物素期间所抽血样的剂量调整。
pairs.evidence: Regulator communications: FDA Safety Communications 28 Nov 2017 and 5 Nov 2019, and FDA guidance Testing for Biotin Interference in In Vitro Diagnostic Devices. Multiple published cases of biotin-induced pseudo-Graves biochemistry. Analytical interference, not pharmacology. Same mechanism and same remedy as the troponin entry, which is the higher-consequence version.

pairs.drug_class: Immunoassay-based blood tests (assay artefact, not a drug class)
pairs.drug_class_zh: 基于免疫分析的血液检验(化验干扰, 并非药物类别)
pairs.drug_examples: cardiac troponin, TSH, hCG, ferritin, vitamin D and other streptavidin-biotin immunoassays
pairs.supplement_zh: 大剂量生物素(维生素B7)
pairs.what_happens: ASSAY ARTEFACT rather than a drug interaction: troponin can read falsely LOW, which can hide a heart attack; other tests read falsely high or low depending on assay design. This is the higher-consequence of the two biotin entries, since the FDA has linked a death to a falsely low troponin.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 这是化验干扰, 属于分析层面的问题, 与体内药物相互作用无关: 肌钙蛋白(troponin)可能假性偏低, 从而掩盖心肌梗死; 其他项目视方法设计而假性偏高或偏低。两条生物素条目中这一条后果更严重, 因为FDA已把一例死亡与假性偏低的troponin结果关联起来。
pairs.mechanism: Excess biotin competes with the biotinylated reagent for streptavidin binding sites; sandwich assays such as troponin are pushed down, competitive assays are pushed up
pairs.mechanism_zh: 过量生物素与生物素化试剂竞争streptavidin结合位点; 像troponin这类夹心法结果被压低, 竞争法结果被推高
pairs.action: Tell any clinician or phlebotomist that you take biotin, including in an emergency with chest pain, and ask for a repeat sample after stopping it or for a biotin-insensitive assay. Stop biotin at least 2 days before planned blood tests, or 3 to 7 days at 5 mg a day or more. Do not let a normal troponin reassure you if you are still taking high-dose biotin.
pairs.action_zh: 向任何医生或采血人员说明你在服用生物素, 包括因胸痛急诊时; 要求在停用后重抽, 或改用不受生物素影响的方法。计划性抽血前至少停2天, 每天5 mg或以上停3到7天。仍在服用大剂量生物素时, 不要把troponin正常当作安全的凭据。
pairs.evidence: Regulator communication: FDA Safety Communication 5 Nov 2019, which reported one death linked to a falsely low troponin result; FDA testing guidance for biotin interference. Analytical interference, explicitly not a pharmacological interaction. Severity aligned with the thyroid entry, since the mechanism and the remedy are identical.

pairs.supplement_zh: 维生素B12(氰钴胺)
pairs.what_happens: Body stores of B12 fall over years, causing tiredness, sore tongue and numbness or pins and needles in the hands and feet; the blood count may show large red cells.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 体内B12储备在多年间下降, 造成乏力、舌痛、手足麻木或针刺感; 血常规可能显示红细胞体积增大。
pairs.mechanism: Metformin impairs calcium-dependent uptake of the B12-intrinsic factor complex in the terminal ileum
pairs.mechanism_zh: 二甲双胍损害末段回肠对B12与内因子复合物的钙依赖性摄取
pairs.action: If you have taken metformin for several years, or you have numbness or tingling in hands or feet, ask for a vitamin B12 blood test. Do not stop metformin; oral or sublingual B12 replacement usually fixes it.
pairs.action_zh: 服用二甲双胍已有数年, 或出现手足麻木、针刺感, 就要求查血维生素B12。不要停用二甲双胍; 口服或舌下含服B12通常可以纠正。
pairs.evidence: Prevalence studies in long-term users report deficiency from 5.8% up to 48.9%, and they disagree on dose and duration: PMID 37732117 (Al Quran et al, Front Endocrinol 2023) found 48.9% prevalence with no association with metformin dose or duration, while long-term follow-up of the Diabetes Prevention Program Outcomes Study found risk rising with continued use. Treat the dose and duration relationship as unsettled, which is why no fixed year threshold is quoted in the action.

pairs.supplement_zh: 小檗碱(黄连素)
pairs.what_happens: Blood glucose drops further than expected. Metformin on its own rarely causes hypoglycaemia, so the shakiness, sweating, hunger and dizziness picture belongs mainly to people also taking a sulfonylurea or insulin.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血糖比预期下降得更多。二甲双胍单用很少引起低血糖, 所以发抖、出汗、饥饿感和头晕这一组表现主要出现在同时用磺脲类或胰岛素的人身上。
pairs.mechanism: Berberine activates AMPK and suppresses hepatic glucose output, an additive pharmacodynamic effect. Metformin undergoes no hepatic metabolism and is cleared unchanged by the kidney through OCT1/OCT2 and MATE transporters, so berberine's CYP inhibition has no bearing on metformin exposure.
pairs.mechanism_zh: 小檗碱激活AMPK并抑制肝糖输出, 属于药效学叠加。二甲双胍不经肝脏代谢, 以原形经肾脏通过OCT1/OCT2和MATE转运体清除, 所以小檗碱对CYP的抑制与二甲双胍的暴露量无关。
pairs.action: Test your own blood glucose more often for the first 2 weeks and tell the diabetes team you have started it. Do not combine berberine with metformin plus a sulfonylurea or insulin without medical advice.
pairs.action_zh: 开始服用后头2周更频繁地自测血糖, 并告知糖尿病团队。在没有医嘱的情况下, 不要把小檗碱与二甲双胍加磺脲类或胰岛素三者合用。
pairs.evidence: Randomised trials show berberine lowers glucose as monotherapy and adds to metformin; the excess-hypoglycaemia signal itself is inferred pharmacodynamically and from case reports rather than a dedicated safety trial.

pairs.drug_class_zh: 胰岛素、磺脲类与二甲双胍
pairs.supplement_zh: 烟酸(nicotinic acid, 每天1 g或以上)
pairs.what_happens: Blood glucose and HbA1c drift upwards despite unchanged diabetes treatment, and people without diabetes can cross into it.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 糖尿病治疗没有变动, 但血糖和HbA1c逐渐上升, 原本没有糖尿病的人也可能因此发病。
pairs.mechanism: Gram doses of nicotinic acid increase insulin resistance and hepatic glucose output, working against the glucose-lowering drugs
pairs.mechanism_zh: 克级剂量的烟酸增加胰岛素抵抗和肝糖输出, 与降糖药的作用相反
pairs.action: Do not take gram doses of niacin for cholesterol if you have diabetes unless the prescriber agrees, and check glucose more often for the first 4 to 8 weeks. Nicotinamide and the small amounts in a multivitamin are not the issue.
pairs.action_zh: 糖尿病患者除医生同意外, 不要为降胆固醇服用克级烟酸, 开始后头4到8周更频繁测血糖。烟酰胺以及复合维生素里的小剂量不属于这个问题。
pairs.evidence: Randomised trial evidence: HPS2-THRIVE reported excess new-onset diabetes and worsened glycaemic control with extended-release niacin plus laropiprant, and earlier niacin trials showed HbA1c rises. Consistent and trial-based. Added because niacin already appears in the statin entry, so the exposure is known to be common.

pairs.supplement: Red yeast rice (Monascus purpureus, monacolin K)
pairs.supplement_zh: 红曲(Monascus purpureus, monacolin K)
pairs.what_happens: Effectively a double statin dose: muscle pain and weakness, and rarely rhabdomyolysis with dark urine and kidney failure, plus liver injury.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 效果相当于把他汀剂量加倍: 肌肉疼痛和乏力, 少数情况下出现横纹肌溶解伴尿色变深和肾衰竭, 还有肝损伤。
pairs.mechanism: Monacolin K in lactone form is chemically identical to lovastatin, so it adds directly to the prescribed statin's HMG-CoA reductase inhibition
pairs.mechanism_zh: 内酯形式的monacolin K在化学上与lovastatin完全相同, 因此直接叠加在处方他汀对HMG-CoA reductase的抑制之上
pairs.action: Never take red yeast rice alongside a prescribed statin. Stop it and contact a doctor the same day if you get muscle pain or weakness, or dark cola-coloured urine.
pairs.action_zh: 绝不可在服用处方他汀的同时服用红曲。出现肌肉疼痛、乏力或可乐色尿, 当天停用并联系医生。
pairs.evidence: Regulator assessments: EFSA scientific opinions 2018 (doi:10.2903/j.efsa.2018.5368) and 2025 (doi:10.2903/j.efsa.2025.9276) found serious adverse effects including rhabdomyolysis and liver injury from monacolin K doses as low as 3 mg/day. Commission Regulation (EU) 2022/860 of 1 June 2022 amended Annex III to Regulation (EC) No 1925/2006 as regards monacolins from red yeast rice, and as of March 2026 the Commission has notified the WTO of a draft moving monacolins to Annex III Part A, a full prohibition in foods. Adverse-event reporting plus label pharmacology.

pairs.supplement_zh: 烟酸(nicotinic acid, 每天1 g或以上)
pairs.what_happens: Muscle aches and weakness become more likely, with a rise in creatine kinase on blood tests; flushing and itching are separate nuisance effects.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 肌肉酸痛和乏力更容易出现, 化验可见creatine kinase升高; 潮红和皮肤发痒是另一类令人不适的反应。
pairs.mechanism: Additive myotoxicity; the precise mechanism is not established
pairs.mechanism_zh: 肌毒性叠加; 确切机制尚未确立
pairs.action: Do not take gram doses of niacin with a statin unless the prescriber agrees and checks a creatine kinase level. Report muscle pain or weakness. No-flush inositol hexanicotinate is not a proven safe substitute.
pairs.action_zh: 除开药医生同意并复查creatine kinase外, 不要把克级烟酸与他汀合用。出现肌肉疼痛或乏力要报告。所谓无潮红的inositol hexanicotinate并没有被证明是安全替代品。
pairs.evidence: Randomised trial evidence of harm without benefit. The myopathy excess comes from HPS2-THRIVE alone: roughly a four-fold excess of any myopathy when extended-release niacin with laropiprant was added to simvastatin 40 mg, with or without ezetimibe, concentrated in Chinese participants, alongside excess new-onset diabetes, infection (8% vs 6.6%) and bleeding (2.5% vs 1.9%). AIM-HIGH is cited only for the absence of cardiovascular benefit; it did not show a significant myopathy excess. Also carried as a statin label warning.

pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草(贯叶连翘, Hypericum perforatum)
pairs.what_happens: The cholesterol-lowering benefit shrinks: LDL cholesterol creeps back up on the next blood test, with no symptoms in the meantime.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 降胆固醇的效果减弱: 下一次化验时LDL胆固醇又慢慢回升, 期间没有任何症状。
pairs.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction accelerates clearance of simvastatin and atorvastatin; pravastatin and rosuvastatin are not CYP3A4 substrates
pairs.mechanism_zh: 诱导CYP3A4, 加快simvastatin和atorvastatin的清除; pravastatin和rosuvastatin不是CYP3A4底物
pairs.action: Tell the prescriber if you take St John's wort so cholesterol is rechecked, and ask whether switching to pravastatin or rosuvastatin would avoid the problem.
pairs.action_zh: 服用圣约翰草要告知开药医生以便复查血脂, 并询问改用pravastatin或rosuvastatin能否避开这个问题。
pairs.evidence: Volunteer pharmacokinetic study (Sugimoto et al, Clin Pharmacol Ther 2001): simvastatin hydroxy acid AUC(0-24) fell to 0.48 of placebo, about a 50% reduction, and Cmax to 0.72, about 28%; pravastatin was unaffected. Atorvastatin was not studied there and is inferred from its shared CYP3A4 dependence, with a smaller reported effect. Surrogate endpoint only, no outcome data.

pairs.supplement_zh: 小檗碱(黄连素)
pairs.what_happens: Statin blood levels rise, which brings muscle pain and weakness and, rarely, rhabdomyolysis with dark urine.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 他汀血药浓度升高, 引起肌肉疼痛和乏力, 少数情况下出现横纹肌溶解伴尿色变深。
pairs.mechanism: Berberine inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, the same inhibition that raises ciclosporin exposure, so clearance of simvastatin and atorvastatin falls
pairs.mechanism_zh: 小檗碱抑制CYP3A4和P-glycoprotein, 与提高ciclosporin暴露量的是同一种抑制作用, 因此simvastatin和atorvastatin的清除下降
pairs.action: Tell the prescriber before combining berberine with simvastatin or atorvastatin, and report muscle pain, weakness or dark urine. Pravastatin and rosuvastatin do not depend on CYP3A4, so ask whether a switch makes sense if you want to keep taking berberine.
pairs.action_zh: 把小檗碱与simvastatin或atorvastatin合用前先告知开药医生, 出现肌肉疼痛、乏力或尿色变深要报告。pravastatin和rosuvastatin不依赖CYP3A4, 如果想继续吃小檗碱, 可以问医生是否换药。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC plus small pharmacokinetic data: berberine's CYP3A4 and P-gp inhibition is documented in vitro and in transplant patients on ciclosporin (PMC7600264), and simvastatin exposure rises with other CYP3A4 inhibitors. No dedicated berberine and statin interaction trial. Added because the same inhibition is already credited elsewhere in this matrix.

pairs.drug_examples: cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, cisplatin, paclitaxel, and concurrent radiotherapy
pairs.supplement: High-dose antioxidants (vitamin C 1 g or more, vitamin E, beta-carotene, N-acetylcysteine)
pairs.supplement_zh: 大剂量抗氧化剂(维生素C 1 g或以上、维生素E、beta-胡萝卜素、N-乙酰半胱氨酸)
pairs.what_happens: Treatment may work less well: the tumour is less well controlled and cancer is more likely to come back. Nothing feels different at the time.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 治疗效果可能变差: 肿瘤控制不佳, 复发风险上升。当时身体没有任何异常感觉。
pairs.mechanism: Many cytotoxics and radiotherapy kill cells partly through reactive oxygen species, which high-dose antioxidants can quench
pairs.mechanism_zh: 许多细胞毒药物和放疗部分依靠活性氧杀灭细胞, 而大剂量抗氧化剂可以清除这些活性氧
pairs.action: Do not take antioxidant supplements above the normal daily requirement during chemotherapy or radiotherapy. Bring every bottle to the oncology team. There is no established safe washout schedule between cycles, so ask them what to do rather than assuming a gap between cycles makes it safe.
pairs.action_zh: 化疗或放疗期间, 抗氧化补充剂不要超过日常需要量。把所有瓶子带给肿瘤科团队看。疗程之间并没有已确立的安全洗脱方案, 所以要问医生怎么办, 不要假定隔开时间就安全。
pairs.evidence: RANDOMISED plus observational. Bairati et al randomised 540 patients with stage I or II head and neck cancer to alpha-tocopherol 400 IU/day plus beta-carotene 30 mg/day during radiotherapy and for 3 years after: local recurrence HR 1.37 (95% CI 0.93-2.02), adverse effects on second primary cancers and cancer-free survival (JNCI 2005), and increased all-cause mortality (2006), while acute mucosal toxicity was reduced, so benefit and harm ran in opposite directions. Cohort data also report increased overall mortality and reduced recurrence-free survival with concurrent antioxidant use, and a 2025 systematic review (PMC12279893) found the wider evidence inconsistent. Note the cross-reference: the 400 IU/day alpha-tocopherol dose Bairati used is the dose treated as acceptable in the vitamin E and warfarin entry, where the endpoint is bleeding rather than tumour control.

pairs.drug_class: Cytotoxic chemotherapy and oral anticancer drugs
pairs.drug_class_zh: 细胞毒性化疗与口服抗肿瘤药
pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草(贯叶连翘, Hypericum perforatum)
pairs.what_happens: Active drug levels drop, by roughly 40 percent for irinotecan and imatinib and less for docetaxel, so the treatment is effectively underdosed and the cancer is less well controlled.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 活性药物浓度下降, irinotecan和imatinib约下降40 percent, docetaxel下降幅度较小, 相当于治疗剂量不足, 肿瘤控制变差。
pairs.mechanism: CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein induction increases clearance of the parent drug and of active metabolites such as SN-38
pairs.mechanism_zh: 诱导CYP3A4和P-glycoprotein, 加快母药以及SN-38等活性代谢物的清除
pairs.action: Stop St John's wort at least 2 weeks before chemotherapy starts and tell the oncology team you were taking it, because the planned dose may need reviewing.
pairs.action_zh: 化疗开始前至少2周停用圣约翰草, 并告知肿瘤科团队你曾服用, 因为原定剂量可能需要重新评估。
pairs.evidence: Patient pharmacokinetic study (Mathijssen et al, J Natl Cancer Inst 2002): SN-38 AUC reduced by 42% in patients on irinotecan. Imatinib exposure falls a similar amount, roughly 30 to 43% (Frye 2004; Smith 2004), while the docetaxel reduction is much smaller, on the order of 10 to 15%. Controlled human PK data.

pairs.supplement: Iron (ferrous sulfate, fumarate, gluconate); zinc supplements chelate in the same way
pairs.supplement_zh: 铁剂(硫酸亚铁、富马酸亚铁、葡萄糖酸亚铁); 锌补充剂以同样方式螯合
pairs.what_happens: Much less antibiotic is absorbed, so the infection or acne fails to clear and a second course is needed.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 抗生素吸收大幅减少, 感染或痤疮没有清除, 需要再来一个疗程。
pairs.mechanism: Iron chelates the tetracycline ring system, forming an insoluble complex that is not absorbed; zinc, calcium, magnesium and aluminium bind at the same site
pairs.mechanism_zh: 铁与四环素环系螯合, 形成无法吸收的不溶性复合物; 锌、钙、镁和铝结合在同一位点
pairs.action: Take the antibiotic either 2 hours before or 4 hours after any iron or zinc supplement, for the whole course. Check multivitamins too, most contain iron or zinc.
pairs.action_zh: 整个疗程内, 抗生素与任何铁剂或锌剂间隔为服药前2小时或服药后4小时。也要看复合维生素, 大多含铁或锌。
pairs.evidence: Established chelation pharmacokinetics showing large falls in bioavailability; reflected in every product label and in NHS Scotland guidance on tetracycline and fluoroquinolone interactions (2023). Zinc is added here because it binds at the same site and is present in most multivitamins.

pairs.supplement: Calcium supplements (including calcium-fortified drinks and antacids), also zinc, magnesium and aluminium antacids
pairs.supplement_zh: 钙补充剂(含强化钙的饮品和抗酸剂), 以及锌、镁和含铝抗酸剂
pairs.what_happens: How much is lost depends on the drug: tetracycline hydrochloride absorption falls by about half or more with milk or calcium, while doxycycline and minocycline are less affected, roughly 20 to 30 percent. Even that can be enough for the infection to persist or relapse.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 损失多少取决于具体药物: tetracycline hydrochloride与牛奶或钙同服时吸收下降约一半甚至更多, doxycycline和minocycline受影响较小, 大约20到30 percent。即便如此, 也可能足以让感染迁延或复发。
pairs.mechanism: Divalent and trivalent cations chelate the antibiotic in the gut, forming a poorly absorbed complex
pairs.mechanism_zh: 二价和三价阳离子在肠道内与抗生素螯合, 形成难以吸收的复合物
pairs.action: Take the antibiotic 2 hours before or 4 hours after calcium, zinc or magnesium supplements, milk-based supplement drinks or antacids. Plain water only with the tablet.
pairs.action_zh: 抗生素与钙剂、锌剂、镁剂、牛奶类营养饮品或抗酸剂间隔为服药前2小时或服药后4小时。服药时只用清水。
pairs.evidence: Established chelation pharmacokinetics with agent-specific magnitude; standard label instruction and NHS Scotland tetracycline/fluoroquinolone interaction guidance (2023). Treatment failure documented. Minocycline and zinc added here so the two tetracycline entries list the same agents and the same chelators.

pairs.supplement: Magnesium (also zinc, iron and calcium supplements, and magnesium- or aluminium-containing antacids)
pairs.supplement_zh: 镁剂(还包括锌剂、铁剂、钙剂, 以及含镁或含铝抗酸剂)
pairs.what_happens: Almost the whole dose can be lost, and the infection is not treated.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 几乎整个剂量都可能失效, 感染得不到治疗。
pairs.mechanism: Magnesium chelates the 3-carboxyl and 4-oxo groups of the quinolone, forming an insoluble complex; zinc, iron, calcium and aluminium bind at the same two groups
pairs.mechanism_zh: 镁与喹诺酮的3-羧基和4-氧基螯合, 形成不溶性复合物; 锌、铁、钙和铝结合在同样这两个基团上
pairs.action: Take the antibiotic 2 hours before or 6 hours after magnesium, zinc, iron or calcium supplements and antacids. Never swallow them at the same time, and check multivitamins, which usually contain zinc, iron or magnesium.
pairs.action_zh: 抗生素与镁、锌、铁、钙补充剂及抗酸剂间隔为服药前2小时或服药后6小时。绝不要同时服下, 也要查复合维生素, 里面通常含锌、铁或镁。
pairs.evidence: Pharmacokinetic studies showing Cmax and AUC each reduced by up to 85% when a magnesium and aluminium antacid was taken minutes before ciprofloxacin; established label instruction. Zinc is added because it chelates at the same site and is a common multivitamin component.

pairs.supplement: Calcium supplements (including calcium plus vitamin D combinations), and also iron, magnesium and zinc supplements and magnesium- or aluminium-containing antacids
pairs.supplement_zh: 钙补充剂(含钙加维生素D的复方), 以及铁剂、镁剂、锌剂和含镁或含铝抗酸剂
pairs.what_happens: The bisphosphonate tablet is effectively wasted, so bone protection is lost while you still believe you are treated.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 这片双膦酸盐基本白吃, 骨骼保护实际上没有实现, 而患者以为自己在接受治疗。
pairs.mechanism: Oral bisphosphonate bioavailability is under 1 percent and is abolished by binding to divalent and trivalent cations in the gut
pairs.mechanism_zh: 口服双膦酸盐的生物利用度不到1 percent, 一旦在肠道内与二价或三价阳离子结合, 这点吸收就完全消失
pairs.action: Take the bisphosphonate on an empty stomach with plain tap water and stay upright: wait at least 30 minutes for alendronate and risedronate, and at least 60 minutes for ibandronate, before any calcium, iron, magnesium, zinc or antacid. Taking those at a different time of day is simplest.
pairs.action_zh: 双膦酸盐空腹用清水服下并保持直立: alendronate和risedronate至少等30分钟, ibandronate至少等60分钟, 再服钙、铁、镁、锌或抗酸剂。最简单的办法是把这些放到一天中的其他时间。
pairs.evidence: Established pharmacokinetics reflected in the dosing instructions of every oral bisphosphonate product information; the interaction is near total when taken together. The ibandronate interval is 60 minutes rather than the 30 minutes that applies to alendronate and risedronate, and the other cations block absorption in the same way calcium does.

pairs.drug_class: ACE inhibitors, ARBs and potassium-sparing diuretics
pairs.drug_examples: ramipril, lisinopril, losartan, candesartan, spironolactone, eplerenone, amiloride
pairs.supplement: Potassium supplements and potassium-based salt substitutes (LoSalt and similar)
pairs.supplement_zh: 钾补充剂和以钾为主的代盐产品(LoSalt及同类)
pairs.what_happens: Blood potassium rises, which can cause muscle weakness, palpitations, and a dangerous heart rhythm with no warning symptoms beforehand.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血钾升高, 可引起肌肉无力、心慌以及危险的心律失常, 事前往往没有任何预警症状。
pairs.mechanism: These drugs reduce aldosterone-driven renal potassium excretion, so an added potassium load is not cleared. Risk concentrates in reduced kidney function (CKD stage 3 or worse), older age, diabetes, and combinations of two of these drugs.
pairs.mechanism_zh: 这些药降低醛固酮驱动的肾脏排钾, 因此额外的钾负荷无法被排出。风险集中在肾功能下降(CKD 3期或更重)、高龄、糖尿病, 以及同时使用其中两种药的人。
pairs.action: Do not take potassium supplements or potassium-containing salt substitutes with these medicines unless a doctor has specifically prescribed them and is checking your potassium. Ask what your eGFR and potassium were at the last check, because risk is highest with reduced kidney function or older age. Get urgent help for new muscle weakness or palpitations.
pairs.action_zh: 除医生专门开具并监测血钾外, 不要在服用这些药期间使用钾补充剂或含钾代盐。问清上次检查的eGFR和血钾数值, 因为肾功能下降或年龄较大时风险最高。新出现肌肉无力或心慌要立即就医。
pairs.evidence: Population data after RALES showed a rise in hyperkalaemia admissions and deaths when spironolactone was added to ACE inhibitors (Juurlink et al, N Engl J Med 2004), and product labels warn against potassium supplements with potassium-sparing agents; Medsafe prescriber reminder, September 2016. A meta-analysis of spironolactone added to ACEi/ARB (Villa-Zapata et al, Am J Health Syst Pharm 2021, PMID 34013341) found only a modest mean rise of under 0.20 mEq/L and studied a drug-drug pair rather than potassium supplements, so it carries little weight for this entry.

pairs.supplement: Liquorice root / glycyrrhizin (supplements, teas, liquorice confectionery)
pairs.supplement_zh: 甘草根/甘草酸(补充剂、茶饮、甘草糖果)
pairs.what_happens: Blood pressure creeps back up despite the tablets, with ankle swelling, and potassium falls causing cramps and weakness.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 尽管在服药, 血压仍慢慢回升, 伴踝部水肿, 血钾下降引起肌肉痉挛和乏力。
pairs.mechanism: Glycyrrhetinic acid inhibits 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2, so cortisol acts on mineralocorticoid receptors, causing sodium retention and potassium loss
pairs.mechanism_zh: 甘草次酸抑制11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2, 使皮质醇作用于盐皮质激素受体, 造成钠保留和失钾
pairs.action: Stop liquorice-containing supplements, teas and sweets if your blood pressure is rising. If you keep using them, ask for a blood pressure and potassium check within 2 to 4 weeks.
pairs.action_zh: 血压有上升趋势时, 停用含甘草的补充剂、茶饮和糖果。若继续使用, 在2到4周内查血压和血钾。
pairs.evidence: Dose-response volunteer studies and a large case literature of pseudohyperaldosteronism; European advice limits glycyrrhizin to under about 100 mg a day. Mechanism well established, interaction evidence is volunteer studies plus case reports.

pairs.supplement_zh: 甘草根/甘草酸(补充剂、茶饮、糖果)
pairs.what_happens: Steroid effects are amplified: more fluid retention and puffiness, higher blood pressure, higher blood glucose, and low potassium with cramps and weakness.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 激素作用被放大: 水钠潴留和面部浮肿加重、血压升高、血糖升高, 血钾降低并引起痉挛和乏力。
pairs.mechanism: Glycyrrhetinic acid inhibits 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2, the enzyme that normally inactivates cortisol and prednisolone, so active steroid persists longer and mineralocorticoid effects increase
pairs.mechanism_zh: 甘草次酸抑制11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2, 这个酶本来负责使皮质醇和prednisolone失活, 被抑制后活性激素存留更久, 盐皮质激素样作用增强
pairs.action: Stop liquorice supplements, teas and heavy liquorice sweet intake while on steroids. If you keep using them, ask for a blood pressure and potassium check within 2 to 4 weeks, and report ankle swelling, cramps or muscle weakness.
pairs.action_zh: 使用激素期间停用甘草类补充剂、茶饮, 并减少大量吃甘草糖果。若继续使用, 在2到4周内查血压和血钾, 出现踝部水肿、痉挛或肌肉无力要报告。
pairs.evidence: Volunteer studies showing glycyrrhizin prolongs prednisolone half-life and raises its exposure, plus the established 11-beta-HSD2 mechanism and a large pseudohyperaldosteronism case literature. No outcome trial. Added because liquorice appeared three times in the matrix without this pair.

pairs.drug_examples: glyceryl trinitrate spray, isosorbide mononitrate, isosorbide dinitrate
pairs.supplement_zh: L-精氨酸(以及L-瓜氨酸、甜菜根硝酸盐浓缩饮)
pairs.what_happens: In theory blood pressure could fall further than intended, giving dizziness, light-headedness on standing or headache. The one controlled study designed to detect exactly this did not find it.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 理论上血压可能比预期下降更多, 出现头晕、站起时眼前发黑或头痛。唯一一项专门为检出这种效应设计的对照研究并没有发现它。
pairs.mechanism: Arginine is the substrate for nitric oxide synthesis, so nitric oxide and cGMP-driven vasodilation could in principle add to the nitrate's effect
pairs.mechanism_zh: 精氨酸是一氧化氮合成的底物, 因此一氧化氮和cGMP驱动的血管扩张在原理上可以与硝酸酯的作用叠加
pairs.action: No restriction is needed on the current evidence. If you use GTN or isosorbide and start arginine, citrulline or beetroot shots, stand up slowly for the first few days and tell the prescriber if you get dizziness, light-headedness or fainting.
pairs.action_zh: 按现有证据不需要作出限制。如果在用GTN或isosorbide期间开始服用精氨酸、瓜氨酸或甜菜根饮, 头几天站起时放慢动作, 出现头晕、眼前发黑或晕倒要告知开药医生。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC ONLY. The single controlled volunteer study (Kernohan AF, McIntyre M, Hughes DM, Tam SW, Worcel M, Reid JL, Br J Clin Pharmacol 2005, oral yohimbine plus L-arginine as NMI 861 with intravenous GTN) found no significant difference in the hypotensive response between active treatment and placebo, and concluded that no significant hypotensive interaction with intravenous GTN was detected at the doses investigated. The previous version of this entry cited that trial as showing additive hypotension, which reversed its result. Dietary arginine also does not raise plasma nitrate the way nitrate drugs do.

pairs.supplement_zh: 约翰巴草提取物(yohimbine)以及未获批的草药助勃产品
pairs.what_happens: Unpredictable blood pressure swings, racing heart, anxiety and tremor; in people with heart disease this can precipitate chest pain.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血压波动难以预测, 心跳极快, 焦虑和手抖; 有心脏病的人可能因此诱发胸痛。
pairs.mechanism: Alpha-2 adrenoceptor blockade causes noradrenaline release and erratic blood pressure on top of PDE5-mediated vasodilation
pairs.mechanism_zh: 阻断alpha-2肾上腺素受体, 引起去甲肾上腺素释放和血压不稳, 叠加在PDE5介导的血管扩张之上
pairs.action: Do not take yohimbine or herbal erectile supplements with sildenafil or tadalafil. Assume unlicensed herbal sex supplements may already contain undeclared sildenafil, which makes an accidental double dose likely.
pairs.action_zh: 不要把yohimbine或草药助勃类补充剂与sildenafil或tadalafil合用。要假定未获批的草药性功能补充剂里可能已经掺入未标注的sildenafil, 这样很容易造成意外的双倍剂量。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC ONLY plus case reports; supported by regulator findings of PDE5 inhibitor adulteration in herbal sexual-enhancement products (FDA tainted sexual enhancement products list). No controlled interaction trial.

pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草(贯叶连翘, Hypericum perforatum)
pairs.what_happens: The tablet simply stops working as well, which is often mistaken for the condition worsening.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 药片的效果变差, 常被误认为是病情加重。
pairs.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction accelerates clearance of sildenafil and tadalafil
pairs.mechanism_zh: 诱导CYP3A4, 加快sildenafil和tadalafil的清除
pairs.action: If the tablet has stopped working and you take St John's wort, tell the prescriber rather than doubling the dose yourself.
pairs.action_zh: 如果药效变差而你在服用圣约翰草, 告知开药医生, 不要自行加倍剂量。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC ONLY, based on the well-documented CYP3A4 induction by St John's wort and the known CYP3A4 dependence of these drugs, plus small volunteer data. No dedicated outcome study.

pairs.drug_class: Combined oral contraceptives and progestogen-only pills
pairs.drug_class_zh: 复方口服避孕药与单纯孕激素避孕药
pairs.drug_examples: ethinylestradiol with levonorgestrel or desogestrel, desogestrel POP
pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草(贯叶连翘, Hypericum perforatum)
pairs.what_happens: Breakthrough bleeding and, more importantly, contraceptive failure and unplanned pregnancy.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 突破性出血, 更重要的是避孕失败和意外怀孕。
pairs.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction increases progestogen clearance: 3-ketodesogestrel exposure fell significantly in the randomised trial while ethinylestradiol AUC and Cmax were unchanged. Separate volunteer work (Hall SD et al, Clin Pharmacol Ther 2003) found the ethinylestradiol half-life roughly halved.
pairs.mechanism_zh: 诱导CYP3A4, 加快孕激素清除: 在随机试验中3-ketodesogestrel的暴露量显著下降, 而ethinylestradiol的AUC和Cmax没有变化。另一项志愿者研究(Hall SD et al, Clin Pharmacol Ther 2003)发现ethinylestradiol的半衰期缩短约一半。
pairs.action: Do not rely on the pill while taking St John's wort. Use condoms as well, or switch to a method that is not affected such as a copper coil or the injection, for the whole time you take it and for 4 weeks after stopping.
pairs.action_zh: 服用圣约翰草期间不要单靠口服避孕药。同时使用避孕套, 或改用不受影响的方式(如含铜宫内节育器或避孕针), 服用期间以及停用后4周内都要如此。
pairs.evidence: Randomised controlled crossover trial (Pfrunder et al, Br J Clin Pharmacol 2003, 18 women enrolled and 17 analysed): bleeding episodes rose from 6 of 17 (35%) in the control cycle to 13 of 17 (77%, P<0.015) and 15 of 17 (88%, P<0.001) in the St John's wort cycles, with 3-ketodesogestrel exposure significantly reduced while ethinyloestradiol AUC(0,24 h) and Cmax remained unchanged. No ovulation was seen in that trial, so AVOID rests on the bleeding data plus published pregnancies, and the halved ethinylestradiol half-life comes from Hall 2003 rather than Pfrunder. Backed by MHRA advice.

pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草(贯叶连翘, Hypericum perforatum)
pairs.what_happens: Drug levels fall sharply, the virus rebounds, and the virus can become resistant so that the whole regimen stops working permanently.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 药物浓度大幅下降, 病毒反弹, 并可能产生耐药, 导致整个方案永久失效。
pairs.mechanism: CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein induction increases clearance and reduces absorption
pairs.mechanism_zh: 诱导CYP3A4和P-glycoprotein, 加快清除并减少吸收
pairs.action: Never take St John's wort with HIV medicines. If you have taken any, tell the HIV clinic so a viral load can be checked; do not stop the antiretrovirals.
pairs.action_zh: 绝不可把圣约翰草与HIV药物合用。若已服用, 告知HIV门诊以便检测病毒载量; 不要停用抗逆转录病毒药。
pairs.evidence: Volunteer pharmacokinetic study (Piscitelli et al, Lancet 2000): indinavir AUC reduced by 57%. Contraindicated in FDA and EMA product information for affected agents.

pairs.supplement: Concentrated garlic capsules (aged garlic extract, allicin)
pairs.supplement_zh: 浓缩大蒜胶囊(陈蒜提取物、大蒜素)
pairs.what_happens: Drug levels can drop by about half, so the virus is less well suppressed and resistance becomes more likely. Unboosted protease inhibitor regimens are the ones most at risk.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 药物浓度可能下降约一半, 病毒抑制变差, 耐药风险上升。风险最大的是没有加用增效剂的蛋白酶抑制剂方案。
pairs.mechanism: Induction of CYP3A4 and effects on intestinal transporters increase clearance and reduce absorption
pairs.mechanism_zh: 诱导CYP3A4并影响肠道转运体, 加快清除并减少吸收
pairs.action: Garlic used in cooking is fine. Do not take concentrated garlic capsules with HIV medicines without asking the clinic, and ask for a viral load check if you have been taking them.
pairs.action_zh: 做菜用的大蒜没问题。未询问门诊前不要把浓缩大蒜胶囊与HIV药物合用, 若一直在吃, 要求检测病毒载量。
pairs.evidence: Volunteer pharmacokinetic study (Piscitelli et al, Clin Infect Dis 2002;34:234-8): unboosted saquinavir AUC fell 51%, trough 49%, Cmax 54%. A single-dose ritonavir study (PMC1894738) showed little effect. This entry sits one tier below St John's wort deliberately, and the reason is stated rather than implied: modern regimens are boosted with ritonavir or cobicistat, which are strong CYP3A4 inhibitors that blunt the induction, and garlic does not induce P-glycoprotein the way St John's wort does. SMALL VOLUNTEER PK STUDIES.

pairs.drug_class_zh: 抗逆转录病毒药(整合酶抑制剂)
pairs.supplement: Calcium supplements (also magnesium, iron, zinc and aluminium-containing products)
pairs.supplement_zh: 钙补充剂(以及镁、铁、锌和含铝的产品)
pairs.what_happens: Much less drug is absorbed, risking viral rebound and resistance, with nothing noticeable at the time.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 药物吸收大幅减少, 有病毒反弹和耐药的风险, 而当时不会有任何可察觉的表现。
pairs.mechanism: The drug's metal-binding pharmacophore is what chelates the two Mg2+ in the integrase active site, which is how the drug works. In the gut, calcium, magnesium, iron, zinc and aluminium chelate the drug at that same pharmacophore, forming an insoluble complex that is not absorbed.
pairs.mechanism_zh: 药物的金属结合药效基团本来是用于螯合整合酶活性位点里的两个Mg2+, 这正是它起效的方式。在肠道里, 钙、镁、铁、锌和铝反过来在同一个药效基团上螯合药物, 形成不能吸收的不溶性复合物。
pairs.action: Take the HIV tablet 2 hours before or 6 hours after calcium, magnesium, iron or zinc supplements. Alternatively the clinic may allow you to take both together with food, so ask which option applies to your tablet.
pairs.action_zh: HIV药片与钙、镁、铁、锌补充剂间隔为服药前2小时或服药后6小时。门诊也可能允许你与食物一起同服, 所以要问清你所用的药适用哪种方案。
pairs.evidence: Established chelation pharmacokinetic studies reflected in the dosing instructions of dolutegravir, bictegravir and raltegravir product information.

pairs.supplement: Ginkgo biloba (leaf extract; ginkgo seeds are worse)
pairs.supplement_zh: 银杏(叶提取物; 白果种子更危险)
pairs.what_happens: Breakthrough seizures despite taking the usual dose, with drug levels found below the treatment range. One published case was fatal, although that person was taking many other herbal products at the same time.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 按常规剂量服药仍出现癫痫发作, 检测发现药物浓度低于治疗范围。已发表病例中有一例死亡, 不过该患者当时同时服用大量其他草药产品。
pairs.mechanism: CYP2C19 induction is the proposed explanation for lower phenytoin levels, and it remains a hypothesis: phenytoin is cleared mainly by CYP2C9 with CYP2C19 secondary, and valproate is cleared mainly by glucuronidation and mitochondrial beta-oxidation, so CYP2C19 induction does not readily explain a subtherapeutic valproate level. Separately, ginkgotoxin (4'-O-methylpyridoxine), concentrated in the seeds, is pro-convulsant in its own right by depleting active vitamin B6.
pairs.mechanism_zh: 诱导CYP2C19是对phenytoin浓度下降提出的解释, 目前仍属假设: phenytoin主要由CYP2C9清除, CYP2C19为次要途径; valproate主要经葡萄糖醛酸化和线粒体beta-氧化清除, 因此CYP2C19诱导很难解释valproate浓度低于治疗范围。另外, 主要富集在白果种子里的ginkgotoxin(4'-O-methylpyridoxine)本身就有致惊厥作用, 机制是耗竭活性维生素B6。
pairs.action: Tell the neurology team before you start ginkgo, and if you already take it ask for an anticonvulsant level check. Avoid ginkgo seeds entirely. Never stop your anticonvulsant yourself.
pairs.action_zh: 开始服用银杏前告知神经科团队, 若已经在吃, 要求检测抗癫痫药浓度。白果种子完全不要吃。绝不可自行停用抗癫痫药。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS AND MECHANISTIC ONLY: one fatal case, a 55-year-old man with subtherapeutic phenytoin and valproate at autopsy who was self-medicating with a large range of herbal supplements (Kupiec and Raj, J Anal Toxicol 2005;29:755-8), and the paper itself notes only one other documented instance of ginkgo potentiating seizures during anticonvulsant therapy. Causal attribution is weak because of the co-ingestants, plus separate ginkgotoxin seizure reports. Downgraded from AVOID to MONITOR so that it no longer outranks the St John's wort entry, which has stronger evidence.

pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草(贯叶连翘, Hypericum perforatum)
pairs.what_happens: Drug levels can fall and seizure control can be lost; equally, stopping St John's wort after months can push levels up again.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 药物浓度可能下降, 癫痫控制可能失去; 反过来, 服用数月后停用圣约翰草又会让浓度回升。
pairs.mechanism: PXR-mediated induction of CYP3A4 and UGT enzymes, which clear several anticonvulsants
pairs.mechanism_zh: 通过PXR诱导CYP3A4和UGT酶, 而这些酶负责清除多种抗癫痫药
pairs.action: Do not start St John's wort if you take an anticonvulsant. If you already take it, do not stop abruptly either: tell the epilepsy team, ask for a drug level 2 to 4 weeks around any change, and do not adjust the anticonvulsant yourself.
pairs.action_zh: 服用抗癫痫药的人不要开始服用圣约翰草。如果已经在吃, 也不要突然停掉: 告知癫痫团队, 在任何变动前后2到4周内检测药物浓度, 不要自行调整抗癫痫药剂量。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC plus regulator advice: St John's wort is a proven PXR-mediated inducer of CYP3A4 and UGT enzymes, and UK MHRA/CSM 2000 advice was to stop St John's wort in patients taking anticonvulsants and to check levels. A volunteer study found no change in carbamazepine pharmacokinetics, which is expected since carbamazepine is already maximally autoinduced. No seizure outcome data. Raised from MONITOR to AVOID so the tier ordering matches the evidence, since this pair is better supported than the ginkgo pair.

pairs.supplement_zh: 叶酸
pairs.what_happens: Phenytoin blood levels fall after folate is replaced, and seizures can return in someone who was previously stable.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 补充叶酸后phenytoin血药浓度下降, 原本稳定的患者可能再次发作。
pairs.mechanism: Folate is a cofactor in phenytoin metabolism, so correcting phenytoin-induced folate deficiency accelerates phenytoin clearance
pairs.mechanism_zh: 叶酸是phenytoin代谢的辅因子, 纠正phenytoin所致的叶酸缺乏会加快phenytoin的清除
pairs.action: Do not start or stop folic acid on your own while taking phenytoin. If you need it, for example when planning a pregnancy, ask for a phenytoin level 2 to 4 weeks after starting.
pairs.action_zh: 服用phenytoin期间不要自行开始或停用叶酸。如确有需要, 例如准备怀孕, 在开始后2到4周检测phenytoin浓度。
pairs.evidence: Controlled human studies from the 1970s and 1980s showing phenytoin level falls and seizure recurrence on folate repletion. Consistent but an old evidence base, not revisited in modern trials.

pairs.supplement: Cannabidiol (CBD oils and capsules sold as supplements)
pairs.supplement_zh: 大麻二酚(以补充剂形式售卖的CBD油剂和胶囊)
pairs.what_happens: With clobazam, heavy sedation and unsteadiness as the active metabolite builds up. With valproate, liver enzymes (ALT and AST) rise, sometimes several times above normal, with no symptoms at first.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 与clobazam合用时, 活性代谢物蓄积, 出现明显嗜睡和步态不稳。与valproate合用时, 肝酶(ALT和AST)升高, 有时达到正常上限的数倍, 起初没有任何症状。
pairs.mechanism: CBD inhibits CYP2C19, which clears N-desmethylclobazam, so that active metabolite rises several-fold. The valproate problem is a hepatotoxicity signal from the combination rather than a change in valproate levels.
pairs.mechanism_zh: CBD抑制CYP2C19, 而该酶负责清除N-desmethylclobazam, 因此这个活性代谢物升高数倍。与valproate的问题是合用产生的肝毒性信号, 与valproate血药浓度变化无关。
pairs.action: Tell the epilepsy team before using any CBD product with clobazam or valproate. Ask for liver blood tests before starting and at about 1 and 3 months if you take valproate, and report drowsiness, unsteadiness, vomiting or yellow eyes.
pairs.action_zh: 在使用clobazam或valproate期间用任何CBD产品前, 先告知癫痫团队。服用valproate的人在开始前以及约1个月和3个月时查肝功能, 出现嗜睡、步态不稳、呕吐或眼白发黄要报告。
pairs.evidence: Randomised trial and product-information data from prescription cannabidiol (Epidyolex/Epidiolex): roughly a 3-fold rise in N-desmethylclobazam and dose-dependent transaminase elevations concentrated in patients on valproate. Unlicensed CBD supplements are lower in dose and unstandardised, so the size of the effect is uncertain.

pairs.drug_examples: co-careldopa (levodopa with carbidopa), co-beneldopa (levodopa with benserazide)
pairs.supplement: Iron (ferrous sulfate, fumarate, gluconate; also iron in multivitamins)
pairs.supplement_zh: 铁剂(硫酸亚铁、富马酸亚铁、葡萄糖酸亚铁; 也包括复合维生素中的铁)
pairs.what_happens: Much less levodopa is absorbed, so Parkinson's symptoms return between doses: stiffness, slowness, tremor and longer off periods.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 左旋多巴吸收大幅减少, 两次服药之间帕金森症状重新出现: 僵硬、动作变慢、手抖以及关期延长。
pairs.mechanism: Ferrous iron chelates the catechol group of levodopa and of carbidopa in the gut, forming a poorly absorbed complex
pairs.mechanism_zh: 亚铁在肠道内与左旋多巴和carbidopa的儿茶酚基团螯合, 形成难以吸收的复合物
pairs.action: Separate levodopa and iron by at least 2 hours, ideally longer, and keep the same routine every day. Tell the Parkinson's team if you start iron, because the levodopa dose will look inadequate.
pairs.action_zh: 左旋多巴与铁剂至少间隔2小时, 越长越好, 并每天保持同样的时间安排。开始服用铁剂要告知帕金森团队, 因为左旋多巴的剂量会显得不够。
pairs.evidence: Volunteer pharmacokinetic studies showing large falls in levodopa and carbidopa bioavailability with ferrous sulfate (Campbell and Hasinoff, Br J Clin Pharmacol 1989, roughly a halving of levodopa exposure), reflected in product information. CONTROLLED PK DATA, no outcome trial. Added because levodopa was an entire high-risk class missing from the matrix.

pairs.drug_class: Levodopa without a peripheral decarboxylase inhibitor
pairs.drug_class_zh: 不含外周脱羧酶抑制剂的左旋多巴
pairs.supplement: High-dose vitamin B6 (pyridoxine, 10 mg/day or more)
pairs.supplement_zh: 大剂量维生素B6(吡哆醇, 每天10 mg或以上)
pairs.what_happens: Parkinson's control is lost within days: stiffness, slowness and tremor return, because more of the dose is destroyed before it reaches the brain. Modern combinations with carbidopa or benserazide are not affected, since they already block the same step.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 数天内帕金森的控制就丧失: 僵硬、动作变慢和手抖重新出现, 原因是更多药物在到达大脑之前就被分解。含carbidopa或benserazide的现代复方不受影响, 因为它们已经阻断了同一个环节。
pairs.mechanism: Pyridoxine is the cofactor for aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase, so extra B6 accelerates peripheral conversion of levodopa to dopamine, which cannot cross the blood brain barrier
pairs.mechanism_zh: 吡哆醇是aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase的辅因子, 额外的B6会加快左旋多巴在外周转化为多巴胺, 而多巴胺无法透过血脑屏障
pairs.action: Do not take vitamin B6 supplements above the normal daily requirement with plain levodopa. If you take co-careldopa or co-beneldopa this does not apply, but still tell the Parkinson's team what you are taking. High-dose B6 also causes peripheral neuropathy in its own right.
pairs.action_zh: 服用不含脱羧酶抑制剂的左旋多巴时, 维生素B6不要超过日常需要量。服用co-careldopa或co-beneldopa的人不受此限, 但仍要告知帕金森团队你在吃什么。大剂量B6本身还会引起周围神经病。
pairs.evidence: Established pharmacology plus old clinical reports of levodopa reversal by pyridoxine; this interaction is the reason peripheral decarboxylase inhibitors were developed. No modern trial, and no interaction with the combination products.

pairs.supplement: Vitamin A (retinol or retinyl palmitate supplements, cod liver oil, high-dose multivitamins)
pairs.supplement_zh: 维生素A(视黄醇或棕榈酸视黄酯补充剂、鱼肝油、大剂量复合维生素)
pairs.what_happens: Additive vitamin A toxicity: dry cracked lips and skin, nosebleeds, headache, joint and bone pain, hair loss, raised liver enzymes and raised triglycerides. Severe cases include raised intracranial pressure with headache and visual changes.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 维生素A毒性叠加: 口唇和皮肤干裂、鼻出血、头痛、关节和骨骼疼痛、脱发、肝酶升高和甘油三酯升高。严重时出现颅内压升高, 伴头痛和视觉改变。
pairs.mechanism: Oral retinoids are vitamin A analogues acting on the same nuclear retinoid receptors, so supplemental retinol adds to the same toxicity pathway
pairs.mechanism_zh: 口服维A酸类是维生素A的类似物, 作用于同样的核内维A酸受体, 所以补充的视黄醇叠加在同一条毒性通路上
pairs.action: Do not take vitamin A supplements, cod liver oil or high-dose multivitamins containing retinol while on isotretinoin or acitretin, and check labels for retinol and retinyl palmitate. Report severe headache, visual changes or worsening bone and joint pain.
pairs.action_zh: 服用isotretinoin或acitretin期间, 不要吃维生素A补充剂、鱼肝油或含视黄醇的大剂量复合维生素, 并检查标签上是否有retinol和retinyl palmitate。出现剧烈头痛、视觉改变或骨关节疼痛加重要报告。
pairs.evidence: Label-level contraindication in isotretinoin and acitretin product information, plus established hypervitaminosis A pharmacology and case reports. Consistent and uncontroversial.

pairs.supplement: Green tea and green tea extract (catechins, EGCG)
pairs.supplement_zh: 绿茶与绿茶提取物(儿茶素, EGCG)
pairs.what_happens: Nadolol exposure falls by roughly 85 percent, so blood pressure and heart rate control are lost while the tablet is being taken exactly as prescribed.
pairs.what_happens_zh: nadolol的暴露量下降约85 percent, 患者完全按处方服药, 血压和心率控制却失效。
pairs.mechanism: Green tea catechins inhibit the intestinal uptake transporter OATP1A2, which nadolol needs in order to be absorbed
pairs.mechanism_zh: 绿茶儿茶素抑制肠道摄取转运体OATP1A2, 而nadolol的吸收依赖这个转运体
pairs.action: Do not drink green tea or take green tea extract in the hours around a nadolol dose; separate them by at least 4 hours and keep intake steady rather than variable. Tell the prescriber if blood pressure control has drifted. This is specific to nadolol and is not a class effect for every beta blocker.
pairs.action_zh: 服用nadolol前后几个小时内不要喝绿茶或吃绿茶提取物; 两者至少间隔4小时, 摄入量保持稳定。血压控制变差要告知开药医生。这一点只针对nadolol, 并非所有beta受体阻滞剂的类效应。
pairs.evidence: Controlled volunteer study (Misaka et al, Clin Pharmacol Ther 2014): green tea reduced nadolol AUC by about 85% with loss of the blood pressure lowering effect. One of the best-quantified supplement and drug pharmacokinetic interactions on record. Green tea also carries vitamin K, which matters separately for warfarin users.

pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草(贯叶连翘, Hypericum perforatum)
pairs.what_happens: Digoxin levels fall by around a quarter, so heart failure symptoms or a fast irregular pulse can return.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 地高辛浓度下降约四分之一, 心衰症状或快速不规则脉搏可能再次出现。
pairs.mechanism: Induction of intestinal P-glycoprotein pumps digoxin back into the gut, reducing absorption
pairs.mechanism_zh: 诱导肠道P-glycoprotein, 把地高辛泵回肠腔, 减少吸收
pairs.action: Do not start or stop St John's wort without telling the prescriber, and ask for a digoxin level 1 to 2 weeks after any change, because stopping it can push levels up towards toxicity.
pairs.action_zh: 开始或停用圣约翰草都要告知开药医生, 任何变动后1到2周检测地高辛浓度, 因为停用会让浓度回升到接近中毒的水平。
pairs.evidence: Volunteer pharmacokinetic study (Johne et al, 1999): digoxin AUC reduced by about 25% after 10 days of St John's wort. Well-replicated PK finding; no outcome trial.

pairs.supplement_zh: 甘草根/甘草酸(补充剂、茶饮、糖果)
pairs.what_happens: Digoxin toxicity at an unchanged dose: nausea, loss of appetite, yellow-green visual haloes, a slow or irregular pulse and confusion.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 剂量未变却出现地高辛中毒: 恶心、食欲下降、看东西有黄绿色光环、脉搏缓慢或不规则以及意识混乱。
pairs.mechanism: Glycyrrhizin-induced potassium loss (via 11-beta-HSD2 inhibition) increases myocardial sensitivity to digoxin at any given blood level
pairs.mechanism_zh: 甘草酸通过抑制11-beta-HSD2造成失钾, 使心肌在同样血药浓度下对地高辛更敏感
pairs.action: Avoid liquorice supplements and heavy liquorice sweet consumption. If you have been using them, ask for a potassium and digoxin check, and report nausea, visual haloes or a slow pulse the same day.
pairs.action_zh: 避免甘草类补充剂和大量吃甘草糖果。若一直在用, 要求查血钾和地高辛浓度, 出现恶心、视物光环或脉搏缓慢当天就报告。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC plus CASE REPORTS of digoxin toxicity precipitated by liquorice-induced hypokalaemia. No controlled interaction study.

pairs.supplement: High-dose vitamin D (with or without calcium)
pairs.supplement_zh: 大剂量维生素D(单独或与钙合用)
pairs.what_happens: If blood calcium rises, digoxin becomes more arrhythmogenic: palpitations, a slow or irregular pulse, nausea and confusion.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血钙升高后地高辛更容易引起心律失常: 心慌、脉搏缓慢或不规则、恶心和意识混乱。
pairs.mechanism: Digitalis toxicity is calcium dependent; hypercalcaemia potentiates its inotropic and arrhythmic effects
pairs.mechanism_zh: 洋地黄毒性依赖钙; 高钙血症增强其正性肌力和致心律失常作用
pairs.action: Stay within the usual vitamin D dose (typically 400 to 1000 IU a day) unless a doctor prescribes more and checks your blood calcium. Report palpitations or an irregular pulse.
pairs.action_zh: 维生素D保持在常规剂量(一般每天400到1000 IU), 除非医生开具更高剂量并监测血钙。出现心慌或脉搏不规则要报告。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC plus product-information warning (hypercalcaemia predisposes to digitalis toxicity) and case reports in hypercalcaemic patients. No trial data.

pairs.drug_class_zh: 噻嗪类及类噻嗪类利尿剂
pairs.supplement_zh: 钙补充剂(尤其是与维生素D同用时)
pairs.what_happens: Blood calcium can rise too high: nausea, constipation, excessive thirst, passing lots of urine, then confusion and kidney impairment.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血钙可能升得过高: 恶心、便秘、口渴明显、尿量增多, 继而出现意识混乱和肾功能受损。
pairs.mechanism: Thiazides reduce urinary calcium excretion, so supplemental calcium accumulates (milk-alkali syndrome in severe cases)
pairs.mechanism_zh: 噻嗪类减少尿钙排出, 补充的钙因此蓄积(严重时形成乳碱综合征)
pairs.action: Normal supplement doses are usually fine, but ask for a blood calcium test 4 to 6 weeks after starting the combination, and report nausea, constipation, thirst or confusion.
pairs.action_zh: 常规补充剂量通常没问题, 但合用开始后4到6周查血钙, 出现恶心、便秘、口渴或意识混乱要报告。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC (established thiazide effect on calcium handling) plus case reports of hypercalcaemia and milk-alkali syndrome; monitoring is advised in thiazide product information.

pairs.drug_class_zh: 噻嗪类及类噻嗪类利尿剂
pairs.supplement_zh: 甘草根/甘草酸
pairs.what_happens: Potassium falls further than the diuretic alone would cause: cramps, muscle weakness, palpitations, and rarely muscle breakdown or a dangerous rhythm.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血钾下降超过单用利尿剂的程度: 肌肉痉挛、乏力、心慌, 少数情况下出现肌肉分解或危险的心律。
pairs.mechanism: Additive potassium loss, from glycyrrhizin's mineralocorticoid-like effect on the distal tubule plus thiazide-induced kaliuresis
pairs.mechanism_zh: 失钾作用叠加: 甘草酸在远曲小管产生类盐皮质激素效应, 加上噻嗪本身促进尿钾排出
pairs.action: Stop liquorice supplements and cut down liquorice sweets. Ask for a potassium blood test if you have been taking them, and report cramps or unusual muscle weakness.
pairs.action_zh: 停用甘草类补充剂并减少甘草糖果。若一直在吃, 要求查血钾, 出现痉挛或异常肌肉无力要报告。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC plus CASE REPORTS of severe hypokalaemia and rhabdomyolysis with liquorice and diuretics. No controlled interaction trial.

pairs.supplement_zh: 硫胺素(维生素B1)
pairs.what_happens: Thiamine stores fall, which can worsen heart failure symptoms and cause tiredness, leg numbness or unsteadiness. The loss is through the urine, so gut absorption is not the problem.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 硫胺素储备下降, 可能加重心衰症状, 并造成乏力、下肢麻木或步态不稳。损失发生在尿中, 肠道吸收本身没有问题。
pairs.mechanism: Loop diuretics increase urinary thiamine excretion; the mechanism is renal loss and intestinal uptake is unaffected
pairs.mechanism_zh: 环利尿剂增加尿中硫胺素排出; 机制在于肾脏流失, 肠道摄取不受影响
pairs.action: If you take high-dose furosemide long term, ask the prescriber whether a thiamine supplement or a thiamine level is warranted, especially if you drink alcohol or eat poorly.
pairs.action_zh: 长期服用大剂量furosemide的人, 询问开药医生是否需要补充硫胺素或检测硫胺素水平, 尤其是饮酒或进食差的人。
pairs.evidence: Observational and small interventional studies in furosemide-treated heart failure patients showing thiamine deficiency and improved ventricular function on repletion (Seligmann et al, 1991). SMALL STUDIES, no large trial. Direction relabelled from REDUCES_SUPPLEMENT_ABSORPTION, which contradicted the renal mechanism this entry describes.

pairs.supplement_zh: 甘草根/甘草酸
pairs.what_happens: Potassium falls further than the diuretic alone would cause: cramps, muscle weakness, palpitations, and rarely muscle breakdown or a dangerous rhythm. If you also take digoxin, the low potassium raises the risk of digoxin toxicity.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血钾下降超过单用利尿剂的程度: 肌肉痉挛、乏力、心慌, 少数情况下出现肌肉分解或危险的心律。如果同时服用地高辛, 低钾会增加地高辛中毒的风险。
pairs.mechanism: Additive potassium loss, from glycyrrhizin's mineralocorticoid-like action on the distal tubule plus the loop diuretic's own potassium wasting
pairs.mechanism_zh: 失钾作用叠加: 甘草酸在远曲小管的类盐皮质激素作用, 加上环利尿剂本身的排钾效应
pairs.action: Stop liquorice supplements and cut down liquorice sweets. Ask for a potassium blood test if you have been taking them, and report cramps, unusual muscle weakness or palpitations.
pairs.action_zh: 停用甘草类补充剂并减少甘草糖果。若一直在吃, 要求查血钾, 出现痉挛、异常肌肉无力或心慌要报告。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC plus CASE REPORTS of severe hypokalaemia and rhabdomyolysis with liquorice and diuretics. No controlled interaction trial. Added because liquorice appeared with thiazides but not with loop diuretics.

pairs.supplement_zh: 镁
pairs.what_happens: Blood magnesium falls, causing cramps, tremor, tiredness, palpitations, and in severe cases fits. Oral magnesium often fails to correct it while the PPI continues.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血镁下降, 引起肌肉痉挛、手抖、乏力、心慌, 严重时抽搐。继续服用PPI时, 口服镁往往无法纠正。
pairs.mechanism: PPIs impair active magnesium uptake through intestinal TRPM6/TRPM7 channels and reduce passive paracellular absorption
pairs.mechanism_zh: PPI损害肠道TRPM6/TRPM7通道介导的主动摄镁, 并减少被动的细胞旁吸收
pairs.action: If you have been on a PPI for over a year, ask for a magnesium blood test. Report cramps, tremor or palpitations, and ask whether the PPI can be reduced or stopped, since supplements alone may not fix it.
pairs.action_zh: 服用PPI超过一年的人要求查血镁。出现痉挛、手抖或心慌要报告, 并询问PPI能否减量或停用, 因为单靠补充剂可能纠正不了。
pairs.evidence: Meta-analysis of PPI-associated hypomagnesaemia (Medicine 2019) plus mechanistic absorption studies (PMC9539870) and an FDA drug safety communication on PPI-associated low magnesium (2011). Risk rises after 1 year of use.

pairs.supplement_zh: 维生素B12(氰钴胺)
pairs.what_happens: Over years, B12 falls: tiredness, sore tongue, pins and needles in hands or feet, and low mood or poor memory.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 多年之后B12下降: 乏力、舌痛、手足针刺感, 以及情绪低落或记忆力变差。
pairs.mechanism: Gastric acid and pepsin are needed to release B12 from food protein before it can bind intrinsic factor; acid suppression blocks that step
pairs.mechanism_zh: B12必须先由胃酸和胃蛋白酶从食物蛋白中释放出来, 才能与内因子结合; 抑酸阻断了这一步
pairs.action: If you have taken a PPI for 2 years or more, ask for a B12 blood test. Sublingual or higher-dose oral B12 works, because it does not need stomach acid to be freed from food.
pairs.action_zh: 服用PPI满2年或以上的人要求查血B12。舌下含服或较大剂量口服B12有效, 因为这类补充剂不需要胃酸把它从食物中释放出来。
pairs.evidence: Cohort studies and long-term data in acid-hypersecretion patients (PMC11242121). Clinically significant deficiency is uncommon before about 2 years of use or unless dietary intake is low. OBSERVATIONAL.

pairs.supplement_zh: 铁剂(口服亚铁盐)
pairs.what_happens: Iron tablets work poorly: haemoglobin and ferritin fail to rise, and the tiredness and breathlessness of anaemia persist.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 铁剂效果不佳: 血红蛋白和铁蛋白不见上升, 贫血引起的乏力和气短持续存在。
pairs.mechanism: Gastric acid is needed to reduce dietary and supplemental ferric iron to the absorbable ferrous form and to keep it soluble
pairs.mechanism_zh: 胃酸负责把食物和补充剂中的三价铁还原为可吸收的二价铁, 并使其保持溶解状态
pairs.action: Recheck haemoglobin and ferritin after 3 months. If levels are not rising, ask about an iron infusion or whether the PPI is still needed. Taking iron with orange juice is often suggested on the grounds that acid aids absorption, but a randomised trial found added vitamin C made no difference, so treat that step as optional.
pairs.action_zh: 3个月后复查血红蛋白和铁蛋白。若数值没有上升, 询问是否需要静脉补铁, 或PPI是否还有必要继续。常有人建议铁剂配橙汁, 理由是酸有助吸收, 但一项随机试验显示加维生素C并无差别, 所以这一步可有可无。
pairs.evidence: OBSERVATIONAL cohorts showing lower iron indices and poorer response to oral iron in PPI users, plus the established acid-dependence of iron absorption. No randomised interaction trial. The vitamin C step is low-confidence: a randomised trial in iron-deficiency anaemia (Li N et al, JAMA Netw Open 2020) found oral iron alone equivalent to iron plus vitamin C.

pairs.drug_examples: insulin glargine, insulin aspart, gliclazide, glimepiride, glipizide
pairs.supplement_zh: 铬(吡啶甲酸铬)
pairs.what_happens: Blood glucose can fall too low: shakiness, sweating, hunger, confusion, and in severe cases loss of consciousness.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血糖可能降得过低: 发抖、出汗、饥饿感、意识混乱, 严重时昏迷。
pairs.mechanism: Chromium may enhance insulin receptor signalling and glucose uptake, adding to the drug's glucose-lowering effect
pairs.mechanism_zh: 铬可能增强胰岛素受体信号传导和葡萄糖摄取, 与药物的降糖作用叠加
pairs.action: Test your blood glucose more often for 2 weeks after starting, tell the diabetes team, and carry fast-acting glucose. The insulin or gliclazide dose may need reducing.
pairs.action_zh: 开始服用后2周内更频繁地测血糖, 告知糖尿病团队, 并随身带速效葡萄糖。胰岛素或gliclazide的剂量可能需要下调。
pairs.evidence: Randomised trials of chromium in type 2 diabetes show small and inconsistent glucose effects; the hypoglycaemia risk in combination rests on CASE REPORTS plus pharmacodynamic reasoning, not a safety trial.

pairs.supplement_zh: alpha-硫辛酸
pairs.what_happens: Extra glucose lowering with hypoglycaemia: sweating, tremor, palpitations and confusion, most often a few hours after a dose.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 额外的降糖作用造成低血糖: 出汗、手抖、心慌和意识混乱, 多发生在服药后几小时。
pairs.mechanism: Alpha-lipoic acid increases insulin-stimulated glucose uptake in skeletal muscle
pairs.mechanism_zh: alpha-硫辛酸增加骨骼肌中胰岛素刺激下的葡萄糖摄取
pairs.action: Ask the prescriber before starting it, monitor glucose closely for the first 2 weeks, and expect that the insulin or sulfonylurea dose may need lowering.
pairs.action_zh: 开始服用前询问开药医生, 头2周密切监测血糖, 并预料到胰岛素或磺脲类的剂量可能需要下调。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC plus small trials in diabetic neuropathy reporting hypoglycaemia as an adverse effect, and case reports. No dedicated interaction study.

pairs.drug_examples: diazepam, lorazepam, alprazolam, temazepam, zopiclone, zolpidem
pairs.supplement_zh: 卡瓦胡椒(Piper methysticum)
pairs.what_happens: Heavy sedation, disorientation and loss of coordination; one published case progressed to coma. Kava separately causes serious liver injury.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 明显嗜睡、定向力障碍和协调能力丧失; 已发表病例中有一例进展为昏迷。卡瓦另外还会造成严重肝损伤。
pairs.mechanism: Kavalactones modulate GABA-A receptors, giving additive central nervous system depression, and also inhibit CYP enzymes that clear benzodiazepines
pairs.mechanism_zh: 卡瓦内酯调节GABA-A受体, 产生中枢抑制的叠加作用, 同时抑制清除苯二氮类的CYP酶
pairs.action: Do not take kava with diazepam, lorazepam, zopiclone or zolpidem. Kava is restricted or banned in several countries because of liver failure cases, so do not use it at all without medical advice.
pairs.action_zh: 不要把卡瓦与diazepam、lorazepam、zopiclone或zolpidem合用。由于出现过肝衰竭病例, 卡瓦在多个国家受限或被禁, 所以没有医嘱就不要使用。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS plus mechanistic GABA-A data: a published case of coma in a man taking alprazolam who self-medicated with kava; hepatotoxicity led to regulatory withdrawal in the UK and elsewhere.

pairs.supplement_zh: 褪黑素
pairs.what_happens: More sedation and next-morning grogginess, with slower reactions and a higher chance of falls, especially in people over 65.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 镇静作用增强, 次日晨起昏沉, 反应变慢, 跌倒风险上升, 65岁以上尤其明显。
pairs.mechanism: Additive central nervous system depression and additive psychomotor impairment
pairs.mechanism_zh: 中枢抑制作用叠加, 精神运动功能损害也叠加
pairs.action: Take melatonin no more than 1 hour before bed, do not drive or use machinery the next morning until you know how the combination affects you, and tell the prescriber, particularly if you are over 65 or have fallen before.
pairs.action_zh: 褪黑素在睡前1小时内服用, 在了解合用后的反应之前, 次日上午不要开车或操作机械, 并告知开药医生, 65岁以上或有跌倒史的人尤其要说明。
pairs.evidence: SMALL CONTROLLED STUDIES of additive psychomotor impairment when melatonin was given with midazolam or zolpidem, plus falls data in older adults. No large safety trial.

pairs.supplement_zh: 南非醉茄(印度人参, Withania somnifera)
pairs.what_happens: More sedation than the prescribed dose alone gives, with next-morning grogginess and unsteadiness. Ashwagandha also carries its own liver injury signal, so jaundice or dark urine needs same-day advice.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 镇静程度超过单用处方剂量, 次日晨起昏沉、步态不稳。南非醉茄本身还带有肝损伤信号, 出现皮肤发黄或尿色深要当天就医。
pairs.mechanism: Withanolides have GABAergic and sedative activity in animal models, giving additive central nervous system depression
pairs.mechanism_zh: 动物模型显示醉茄内酯类具有GABA能和镇静活性, 产生中枢抑制的叠加作用
pairs.action: Ask the prescriber before combining ashwagandha with a sedative, do not drive the next morning until you know the effect, and stop it if you feel unusually drowsy or unsteady. Seek advice for jaundice, dark urine or pain under the right ribs.
pairs.action_zh: 把南非醉茄与镇静药合用前询问开药医生, 在了解反应之前次日上午不要开车, 感到异常嗜睡或步态不稳就停用。出现皮肤发黄、尿色深或右侧肋下疼痛要就医。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC plus animal sedation data and case reports of excess sedation; the hepatotoxicity signal is documented in published case series (LiverTox). No controlled interaction study.

pairs.supplement_zh: 洋车前子壳/ispaghula(容积性膳食纤维)
pairs.what_happens: The lithium blood level drops and mood symptoms can return, even though the dose has not changed.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 锂的血药浓度下降, 尽管剂量没变, 情绪症状仍可能复发。
pairs.mechanism: The hydrophilic fibre gel appears to trap lithium in the gut and impair its absorption
pairs.mechanism_zh: 亲水性纤维形成的凝胶似乎把锂困在肠道内, 妨碍其吸收
pairs.action: Leave at least 2 hours, ideally 4, between lithium and psyllium, and keep the same routine every day. Ask for a lithium level 1 to 2 weeks after starting or stopping the fibre. The same gap is sensible for other narrow-margin tablets such as levothyroxine, carbamazepine and digoxin.
pairs.action_zh: 锂与洋车前子壳至少间隔2小时, 最好4小时, 并每天保持同样的时间安排。开始或停用纤维补充剂后1到2周检测锂浓度。对levothyroxine、carbamazepine和digoxin这类治疗窗窄的药, 同样的间隔也是合理的。
pairs.evidence: SINGLE CASE REPORT: level fell from 0.53 to 0.40 mmol/L on psyllium despite dose increases, then rose to 0.76 mmol/L within 4 days of stopping it. Mechanism presumed, not proven.

pairs.supplement: Caffeine supplements (caffeine tablets, guarana, pre-workout powders)
pairs.supplement_zh: 咖啡因补充剂(咖啡因片、瓜拿纳、运动前粉剂)
pairs.what_happens: Lithium levels fall while caffeine intake is high, so symptoms can return; the bigger danger is stopping caffeine suddenly, which pushes levels up towards toxicity (tremor, vomiting, unsteadiness, confusion).
pairs.what_happens_zh: 咖啡因摄入量高时锂浓度下降, 症状可能复发; 更大的危险是突然停掉咖啡因, 这会让浓度上升到接近中毒(手抖、呕吐、步态不稳、意识混乱)。
pairs.mechanism: Caffeine increases renal lithium clearance, so lithium levels move inversely with caffeine intake
pairs.mechanism_zh: 咖啡因增加锂的肾清除, 因此锂浓度随咖啡因摄入量反向变化
pairs.action: Keep your caffeine intake roughly the same every day and tell the prescriber before you start or stop caffeine supplements, so a lithium level can be checked. Seek urgent help for coarse tremor, vomiting or unsteadiness.
pairs.action_zh: 每天的咖啡因摄入量大致保持一致, 开始或停用咖啡因补充剂前告知开药医生, 以便检测锂浓度。出现粗大震颤、呕吐或步态不稳要立即就医。
