pairs.evidence: SMALL PHARMACOKINETIC STUDIES showing altered lithium clearance with caffeine, plus a case report of lithium toxicity following abrupt caffeine withdrawal. No trial data.

pairs.supplement: Vitamin K1 (phytomenadione; also green-leaf/greens powders, some multivitamins)
pairs.supplement_zh: 维生素K1（phytomenadione；也存在于绿叶蔬菜粉、青汁粉和部分复合维生素中）
pairs.what_happens: The INR falls and the blood becomes less thin, so protection against clots and stroke is lost. There are no symptoms, only a lower INR on the blood test.
pairs.what_happens_zh: INR 下降，血液抗凝程度减弱，对血栓和中风的保护随之丧失。没有任何症状，只有验血时 INR 偏低。
pairs.mechanism: Warfarin blocks VKORC1, which recycles vitamin K. Extra vitamin K1 bypasses that block through a second reducing pathway (NQO1), so gamma-glutamyl carboxylase (GGCX) can again carboxylate factors II, VII, IX and X
pairs.mechanism_zh: 华法林抑制 VKORC1，该酶负责维生素K的循环再生。额外补充的维生素K1 通过另一条还原途径（NQO1）绕过这一抑制，使 gamma-glutamyl carboxylase (GGCX) 重新羧化凝血因子 II、VII、IX 和 X。
pairs.action: Do not stop or start a vitamin K containing supplement on your own. Tell the anticoagulant clinic before any change and ask for an INR check within 1 to 2 weeks; a steady daily intake is safer than swinging between none and a lot.
pairs.action_zh: 不要自行开始或停用含维生素K的补充剂。任何变动前先告知抗凝门诊，并在 1 到 2 周内复查 INR。每天摄入量稳定，比在完全不吃和大量吃之间摆动安全。
pairs.evidence: Established pharmacology plus randomised trials of low-dose vitamin K to stabilise anticoagulation (Sconce et al, Blood 2007;109:2419-23). Dose-dependent and reproducible.

pairs.supplement_zh: 维生素E（alpha-tocopherol，每天超过 400 IU）
pairs.what_happens: Easier bruising and prolonged bleeding from small cuts; at very high doses the INR itself can rise.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 更容易瘀青，小伤口出血时间延长；剂量非常高时 INR 本身也可能升高。
pairs.mechanism: High-dose alpha-tocopherol inhibits platelet aggregation, and its oxidation product tocopheryl quinone has anticoagulant activity that opposes vitamin K-dependent clotting factor carboxylation
pairs.mechanism_zh: 高剂量 alpha-tocopherol 抑制血小板聚集，其氧化产物 tocopheryl quinone 具有抗凝活性，对抗维生素K依赖的凝血因子羧化。
pairs.action: Stay at or below 200 to 400 IU a day, or simply the lowest dose you actually need. Tell the anticoagulant clinic if you start it and ask for an INR check 1 to 2 weeks later. Report bruising or bleeding that takes longer than usual to stop.
pairs.action_zh: 每天控制在 200 到 400 IU 以内，或者干脆只用你确实需要的最低剂量。开始服用要告知抗凝门诊，并在 1 到 2 周后复查 INR。出现瘀青或止血时间比平时长就报告。
pairs.evidence: Mechanistic plus small crossover studies and case reports; reviewed by Medsafe Prescriber Update, June 2022, Vol 43 No 2 (Can Vitamin E cause bleeding?), which frames the reference intake as 10 mg/day for men and 7 mg/day for women and attributes bleeding to tocopheryl quinone plus platelet inhibition. No dedicated randomised trial in warfarin users.

pairs.drug_class_zh: MAOI（不可逆、非选择性单胺氧化酶抑制剂）
pairs.drug_examples: phenelzine, tranylcypromine, isocarboxazid, oral selegiline above 10 mg/day
pairs.supplement: Preformed tyramine sources (yeast extract spreads and tablets, fermented soy such as miso, tempeh and soy sauce concentrates, aged protein concentrates)
pairs.supplement_zh: 含预成型酪胺（tyramine）的产品（酵母提取物酱和酵母片、发酵大豆制品如味噌、天贝、浓缩酱油，以及陈化蛋白浓缩物）
pairs.what_happens: Hypertensive crisis: sudden severe throbbing headache, neck stiffness, chest pain, racing heart, and risk of stroke.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 高血压危象：突发剧烈搏动性头痛、颈部僵硬、胸痛、心跳极快，有中风风险。
pairs.mechanism: MAO-A inhibition prevents gut and liver breakdown of preformed tyramine, which then displaces noradrenaline from nerve endings
pairs.mechanism_zh: 抑制 MAO-A 使肠道和肝脏无法分解已经存在的酪胺，酪胺随后把去甲肾上腺素从神经末梢置换出来。
pairs.action: Avoid the named products by product type, because supplement labels never declare tyramine content: yeast extract spreads and tablets, fermented soy concentrates, and aged protein concentrates, while on the MAOI and for 2 weeks after stopping it. Call emergency services for a sudden severe headache with a pounding heartbeat.
pairs.action_zh: 按产品类别回避以下具体产品，因为补充剂标签从不标示酪胺含量：酵母提取物酱和酵母片、浓缩发酵大豆制品、陈化蛋白浓缩物。服药期间及停用不可逆 MAOI 后 2 周内都要回避。突发剧烈头痛伴心跳强烈时呼叫急救。
pairs.evidence: Long-established pharmacology plus a large published case literature (the cheese reaction). Well characterised, though the modern evidence base is case reports rather than trials. Applies to the irreversible non-selective agents only; see the separate moclobemide and low-dose selegiline row.

pairs.drug_class_zh: MAOI（不可逆、非选择性单胺氧化酶抑制剂）
pairs.supplement: Broad bean (fava) pod extract, sold as a natural levodopa or dopamine source
pairs.supplement_zh: 蚕豆（fava）豆荚提取物，常作为天然左旋多巴或多巴胺来源销售
pairs.what_happens: Blood pressure surges with severe headache, flushing and palpitations, sometimes with nausea, agitation or confusion.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血压骤升，伴剧烈头痛、面部潮红和心悸，有时出现恶心、躁动或意识混乱。
pairs.mechanism: Broad bean pods contain levodopa, which raises catecholamine levels; MAO inhibition removes the route that would normally clear them. This is a levodopa effect and the tyramine mechanism does not describe it
pairs.mechanism_zh: 蚕豆豆荚含左旋多巴，会升高儿茶酚胺水平；MAO 被抑制后，正常清除这些儿茶酚胺的途径消失。这是左旋多巴的作用，用酪胺机制来解释并不成立。
pairs.action: Do not take broad bean or fava pod extract while on an MAOI, or for 2 weeks after stopping an irreversible one. Ordinary broad beans eaten as a vegetable are a much smaller load, but avoid large portions and any concentrated pod product.
pairs.action_zh: 服用 MAOI 期间，以及停用不可逆 MAOI 后 2 周内，不要服用蚕豆或蚕豆荚提取物。作为蔬菜吃的普通蚕豆负荷小得多，但仍要避免大份量和任何浓缩豆荚制品。
pairs.evidence: Established levodopa and MAOI pharmacology plus case reports. The broad bean restriction in MAOI dietary advice rests on levodopa content, which is why it was split out of the tyramine row.

pairs.supplement_zh: L-酪氨酸（L-tyrosine）补充剂
pairs.what_happens: In theory blood pressure could rise with headache and palpitations, but L-tyrosine has not been an established cause of hypertensive crisis.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 理论上可能出现血压升高伴头痛和心悸，但 L-酪氨酸并未被确立为高血压危象的原因。
pairs.mechanism: L-tyrosine is a catecholamine precursor and is a different molecule from tyramine; conversion to tyramine needs bacterial decarboxylation, so the pressor risk is indirect and far weaker than with preformed tyramine
pairs.mechanism_zh: L-酪氨酸是儿茶酚胺前体，与酪胺是不同的分子；转变为酪胺需要细菌脱羧，因此升压风险是间接的，远弱于已经成型的酪胺。
pairs.action: Tell the prescriber before taking L-tyrosine on an MAOI and check your blood pressure during the first week. Treat this as a lower-grade caution than the yeast extract and fermented soy restriction, which is the real one.
pairs.action_zh: 服用 MAOI 期间开始用 L-酪氨酸前先告知开药医生，第一周自测血压。把这一条当作等级较低的提醒，酵母提取物和发酵大豆的限制才是硬性的。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC ONLY and low grade. L-tyrosine is not an established cause of MAOI hypertensive crisis; it is swept into tyramine lists largely on name similarity.

pairs.drug_class: Reversible MAO-A and selective MAO-B inhibitors
pairs.drug_class_zh: 可逆性 MAO-A 抑制剂与选择性 MAO-B 抑制剂
pairs.drug_examples: moclobemide, oral selegiline up to 10 mg/day, transdermal selegiline 6 mg/24 h
pairs.supplement: Tyramine-containing foods and supplements (yeast extract, fermented soy)
pairs.supplement_zh: 含酪胺的食物和补充剂（酵母提取物、发酵大豆制品）
pairs.what_happens: A blood pressure rise is possible but uncommon at these doses and formulations, and the full MAOI diet is not required.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 在这些剂量和剂型下血压升高有可能但并不常见，无需执行完整的 MAOI 饮食限制。
pairs.mechanism: Moclobemide inhibits MAO-A reversibly, so tyramine can displace it from the enzyme; selegiline at 10 mg/day or less orally and at 6 mg/24 h transdermally is MAO-B selective and leaves gut MAO-A working
pairs.mechanism_zh: Moclobemide 可逆地抑制 MAO-A，酪胺可以把它从酶上置换下来；口服 selegiline 每天 10 mg 以内以及 6 mg/24 h 透皮贴剂为 MAO-B 选择性，肠道 MAO-A 仍在工作。
pairs.action: No general tyramine restriction is needed. On moclobemide, take doses after food and avoid a single large tyramine load such as a jar of yeast extract or a large helping of aged cheese. On selegiline, stay within 10 mg a day orally or the 6 mg/24 h patch, because higher doses lose MAO-B selectivity and the full restriction then applies. Report a sudden severe headache with palpitations.
pairs.action_zh: 不需要普遍限制酪胺。用 moclobemide 时饭后服药，避免一次性大量摄入酪胺，例如一整罐酵母提取物酱或大份陈年奶酪。用 selegiline 时口服不超过每天 10 mg，或使用 6 mg/24 h 贴剂，剂量更高会失去 MAO-B 选择性，那时完整限制就适用了。突发剧烈头痛伴心悸要报告。
pairs.evidence: Tyramine pressor dose studies show a much higher threshold for moclobemide than for irreversible MAOIs, and product information for low-dose oral and transdermal selegiline carries no dietary tyramine restriction. Split out because a blanket class restriction over-restricts these patients.

pairs.drug_examples: levothyroxine (liothyronine assumed by class, not studied)
pairs.supplement: Elemental calcium supplements (carbonate, citrate, acetate; includes calcium-based antacids)
pairs.supplement_zh: 元素钙补充剂（碳酸钙、柠檬酸钙、乙酸钙；含以钙为主的抗酸药）
pairs.what_happens: About 20 to 25 percent less thyroid hormone is absorbed, so TSH rises and tiredness, weight gain, constipation and cold intolerance return.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 甲状腺激素吸收减少约 20 到 25 个百分点，TSH 上升，疲乏、体重增加、便秘和怕冷重新出现。
pairs.mechanism: Calcium binds levothyroxine in the gut to form a poorly absorbed complex
pairs.mechanism_zh: 钙在肠道中与左甲状腺素结合，形成难以吸收的复合物。
pairs.action: Take levothyroxine with water on an empty stomach and leave at least 4 hours before any calcium supplement or calcium-containing antacid. Keep the same routine every day.
pairs.action_zh: 空腹用水送服左甲状腺素，与任何钙补充剂或含钙抗酸药间隔至少 4 小时。每天保持同一作息。
pairs.evidence: Two separate studies, previously conflated: Singh, Singh and Hershman, JAMA 2000;283:2822-5 was a prospective sequential (open, non-crossover) study in 20 hypothyroid patients taking 1200 mg elemental calcium as carbonate for 3 months, with an in vitro adsorption experiment, and reported falls in free and total T4 with a rise in TSH rather than an AUC figure. The 20 to 25 percent absorption reduction comes from Zamfirescu and Carlson, Thyroid 2011;21:483-6 (8 euthyroid adults, 500 mg elemental calcium as carbonate, citrate or acetate, 6-hour AUC). Reflected in the licensed product information.

pairs.supplement_zh: 铁剂（硫酸亚铁、富马酸亚铁、葡萄糖酸亚铁）
pairs.what_happens: Much less antibiotic is absorbed, so the infection or acne fails to clear and a second course is needed.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 抗生素吸收大幅减少，感染或痤疮无法清除，需要再用一个疗程。
pairs.mechanism: Iron chelates the tetracycline ring system, forming an insoluble complex that is not absorbed
pairs.mechanism_zh: 铁与四环素环系螯合，形成不被吸收的不溶性复合物。
pairs.action: Take the antibiotic either 2 hours before or 4 hours after any iron supplement, for the whole course. Check multivitamins too, most contain iron.
pairs.action_zh: 整个疗程中，抗生素都在任何铁剂之前 2 小时或之后 4 小时服用。复合维生素也要查，多数含铁。
pairs.evidence: Established chelation pharmacokinetics showing large falls in bioavailability; reflected in every product label. A frequently quoted NHS Scotland 2023 tetracycline and fluoroquinolone interaction guidance could not be verified, so rely on the label instruction as the citation.

pairs.supplement: Calcium supplements (including calcium-fortified drinks and antacids)
pairs.supplement_zh: 钙补充剂（含强化钙饮品和抗酸药）
pairs.what_happens: The antibiotic is largely wasted and the infection can persist or relapse.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 抗生素基本被浪费，感染可能持续或复发。
pairs.mechanism: Divalent calcium chelates the antibiotic in the gut, forming an unabsorbable complex
pairs.mechanism_zh: 二价钙在肠道中与抗生素螯合，形成无法吸收的复合物。
pairs.action: Take the antibiotic 2 hours before or 4 hours after calcium supplements, milk-based supplement drinks or calcium antacids. Plain water only with the tablet.
pairs.action_zh: 抗生素在钙补充剂、乳基补充饮品或含钙抗酸药之前 2 小时或之后 4 小时服用。服药只用清水。
pairs.evidence: Established chelation pharmacokinetics; standard label instruction, with documented treatment failure. The NHS Scotland 2023 guidance quoted for this pair could not be verified, so the product label is the source to rely on.

pairs.supplement: Magnesium, calcium, iron and zinc supplements (also magnesium-, aluminium- or calcium-containing antacids)
pairs.supplement_zh: 镁、钙、铁、锌补充剂（以及含镁、含铝或含钙的抗酸药）
pairs.what_happens: Almost the whole dose can be lost, and the infection is not treated.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 几乎整个剂量都可能损失，感染得不到治疗。
pairs.mechanism: Polyvalent cations chelate the 3-carboxyl and 4-oxo groups of the quinolone, forming an insoluble complex
pairs.mechanism_zh: 多价阳离子与喹诺酮的 3-羧基和 4-氧基螯合，形成不溶性复合物。
pairs.action: Use the interval for your own drug: ciprofloxacin 2 hours before or 6 hours after; levofloxacin 2 hours either side; moxifloxacin at least 4 hours before or 8 hours after. If you are unsure which you have, use the most conservative rule, 4 hours before or 8 hours after. Never swallow them at the same time.
pairs.action_zh: 按你自己用的药选间隔：ciprofloxacin 提前 2 小时或推后 6 小时；levofloxacin 前后各 2 小时；moxifloxacin 至少提前 4 小时或推后 8 小时。不确定用的是哪一种，就用最保守的规则，提前 4 小时或推后 8 小时。绝不要同时服用。
pairs.evidence: Pharmacokinetic studies showing ciprofloxacin Cmax and AUC each reduced by up to 85% when a magnesium and aluminium antacid was taken minutes before the dose; that 85% figure is ciprofloxacin-specific. The separation intervals are label instructions and differ by drug.

pairs.supplement: Calcium supplements (including calcium plus vitamin D combinations)
pairs.supplement_zh: 钙补充剂（含钙加维生素D的复方产品）
pairs.what_happens: The bisphosphonate tablet is effectively wasted, so bone protection is lost while you still believe you are treated.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 双膦酸盐片剂基本被浪费，骨保护作用丧失，而你还以为一直在接受治疗。
pairs.mechanism: Oral bisphosphonate bioavailability is under 1 percent and is abolished by binding to divalent cations in the gut
pairs.mechanism_zh: 口服双膦酸盐的生物利用度不足 1 个百分点，与肠道二价阳离子结合后即被完全抵消。
pairs.action: Take the bisphosphonate on an empty stomach with plain tap water and stay upright: wait at least 30 minutes before food or calcium for alendronate and immediate-release risedronate, and at least 60 minutes for ibandronate. Delayed-release risedronate has its own after-breakfast instruction, so follow its leaflet. Taking calcium at a different time of day is simplest.
pairs.action_zh: 空腹用白开水送服并保持直立：alendronate 和速释 risedronate 服药后至少等 30 分钟再进食或补钙，ibandronate 至少等 60 分钟。缓释 risedronate 有自己的早餐后服用说明，按其说明书执行。把钙放到一天中的其他时间最简单。
pairs.evidence: Established pharmacokinetics reflected in the dosing instructions of every oral bisphosphonate product information; not a matter of degree, the interaction is near total when taken together. The fasting interval is drug-specific, which is why ibandronate is called out separately.

pairs.drug_class: ACE inhibitors, ARBs and potassium-sparing diuretics
pairs.drug_class_zh: ACE 抑制剂、ARB 与保钾利尿剂
pairs.drug_examples: ramipril, lisinopril, losartan, candesartan, spironolactone, eplerenone, amiloride
pairs.supplement: Potassium supplements, potassium-based salt substitutes (LoSalt and similar), and potassium-containing electrolyte, rehydration or sports powders and coconut water concentrates
pairs.supplement_zh: 钾补充剂、以钾为基础的代盐产品（LoSalt 一类），以及含钾的电解质粉、口服补液粉、运动补剂粉和椰子水浓缩液
pairs.what_happens: Blood potassium rises, which can cause muscle weakness, palpitations, and a dangerous heart rhythm with no warning symptoms beforehand.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血钾升高，可导致肌肉乏力、心悸和危险的心律失常，且事先没有预警症状。
pairs.mechanism: ACE inhibitors and ARBs lower aldosterone, and spironolactone and eplerenone block the mineralocorticoid receptor, so renal potassium excretion falls; amiloride instead blocks the epithelial sodium channel that drives potassium secretion. An added potassium load is then not cleared, especially with reduced kidney function
pairs.mechanism_zh: ACE 抑制剂和 ARB 降低醛固酮，spironolactone 与 eplerenone 阻断矿皮质激素受体，肾脏排钾减少；amiloride 则直接阻断驱动钾分泌的上皮钠通道。额外摄入的钾因此无法排出，肾功能下降时尤其明显。
pairs.action: Do not take potassium supplements or potassium-containing salt substitutes with these medicines unless a doctor has specifically prescribed them and is checking your potassium. Get urgent help for new muscle weakness or palpitations.
pairs.action_zh: 除非医生专门开具并在监测你的血钾，服用这些药物期间不要用钾补充剂或含钾代盐。新出现肌肉乏力或心悸要立即就医。
pairs.evidence: Population data after RALES showed a rise in hyperkalaemia admissions and deaths when spironolactone was added to ACE inhibitors (Juurlink et al, N Engl J Med 2004). A meta-analysis of ACEi/ARB plus spironolactone (PMID 34013341, Am J Health Syst Pharm 2021, 20 RCTs, 1117 patients) measured a mean serum potassium rise of 0.19 mEq/L (95% CI 0.12-0.26), so it supports monitoring rather than quantifying event risk. A Medsafe prescriber reminder of September 2016 is often quoted for this pair but could not be verified.

pairs.drug_class_zh: 抗逆转录病毒药（整合酶抑制剂：dolutegravir 与 bictegravir）
pairs.supplement: Calcium, magnesium, iron, zinc and aluminium containing supplements, antacids, laxatives and sucralfate
pairs.supplement_zh: 含钙、镁、铁、锌、铝的补充剂、抗酸药、泻药和 sucralfate
pairs.what_happens: Much less drug is absorbed, risking viral rebound and resistance, with nothing noticeable at the time.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 药物吸收大幅减少，有病毒反弹和耐药风险，而当时不会有任何察觉。
pairs.mechanism: The same metal-binding group that lets the drug grip the two magnesium ions in the integrase active site also grips calcium, magnesium, iron, zinc and aluminium in the gut, forming an insoluble complex that is not absorbed
pairs.mechanism_zh: 药物用来抓住整合酶活性位点两个镁离子的同一个金属结合基团，在肠道中也会抓住钙、镁、铁、锌和铝，形成不被吸收的不溶性复合物。
pairs.action: Default: take the HIV tablet 2 hours before or 6 hours after any of these products. One exception: calcium or iron supplements may be taken at the same time as dolutegravir or bictegravir if both are taken with food. Use the 2-hour and 6-hour rule until the clinic confirms the with-food option applies to your tablet.
pairs.action_zh: 默认做法：HIV 药片在这些产品之前 2 小时或之后 6 小时服用。一个例外：如果两者都随餐服用，钙剂或铁剂可以与 dolutegravir 或 bictegravir 同时服用。在门诊确认随餐方案适用于你的药片之前，先按 2 小时和 6 小时的规则执行。
pairs.evidence: Established chelation pharmacokinetic studies reflected in the dosing instructions of dolutegravir and bictegravir product information, including the with-food exception for calcium and iron supplements. Raltegravir is handled in a separate row because timing does not solve its antacid interaction.

pairs.drug_examples: raltegravir 400 mg twice daily, raltegravir 1200 mg once daily
pairs.supplement_zh: 含铝和/或含镁的抗酸药
pairs.what_happens: Raltegravir exposure falls enough to risk viral rebound and resistance, and spacing the doses 2 hours apart does not fix it.
pairs.what_happens_zh: raltegravir 暴露量下降到足以带来病毒反弹和耐药风险，而且把两者错开 2 小时也解决不了。
pairs.mechanism: The drug's metal-binding pharmacophore chelates aluminium and magnesium in the gut lumen; with these antacids the effect persists despite staggering, so timing is not a workaround
pairs.mechanism_zh: 药物的金属结合药效基团在肠腔内与铝和镁螯合；对这类抗酸药，即使错开服药时间效应仍然存在，所以靠时间安排绕不过去。
pairs.action: Do not use aluminium or magnesium containing antacids with raltegravir at all, even spaced apart, and ask the clinic for a different acid treatment. A calcium carbonate antacid may be taken with raltegravir 400 mg twice daily with no dose adjustment, but that exception does not extend to the 1200 mg once-daily regimen.
pairs.action_zh: raltegravir 与含铝或含镁抗酸药完全不要合用，即使错开时间也不行，请门诊换用其他抑酸方案。碳酸钙抗酸药可与 raltegravir 400 mg 每天两次同用且无需调整剂量，但这一例外不适用于 1200 mg 每天一次的方案。
pairs.evidence: Raltegravir product information: co-administration with aluminium and/or magnesium containing antacids is not recommended even with 2-hour staggering, while calcium carbonate antacids may be co-administered with the 400 mg twice-daily regimen; the calcium exception is not licensed for the 1200 mg once-daily high-dose formulation. One severity cannot cover both halves of this behaviour, which is why the class row was split.

pairs.supplement: American ginseng (Panax quinquefolius; also Panax ginseng)
pairs.supplement_zh: 西洋参（Panax quinquefolius；也包括人参 Panax ginseng）
pairs.what_happens: The INR falls over about 2 weeks and clot protection is lost, with no symptoms to warn you.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 约 2 周内 INR 下降，抗血栓保护丧失，没有症状提示。
pairs.mechanism: Not fully established; ginsenosides appear to increase warfarin clearance, and a reduced warfarin peak concentration was measured alongside the lower INR
pairs.mechanism_zh: 机制尚未完全确立；人参皂苷似乎增加华法林清除，研究在 INR 降低的同时也测到华法林峰浓度下降。
pairs.action: Do not start ginseng while on warfarin. If you already take it, keep the dose constant, tell the anticoagulant clinic and ask for an INR check within 2 weeks.
pairs.action_zh: 服用华法林期间不要开始服用人参。已经在用的，保持剂量不变，告知抗凝门诊并在 2 周内复查 INR。
pairs.evidence: Randomised, placebo-controlled trial (Yuan et al, Ann Intern Med 2004;141:23-27): American ginseng significantly reduced INR and warfarin peak concentration. One of only a few randomised demonstrations of lost anticoagulation with a supplement; the crossover study cited for St John's wort (Jiang et al, 2004, PMID 15089812) also examined ginseng.

pairs.supplement: Coenzyme Q10 (ubiquinone, often taken for statin muscle aches)
pairs.supplement_zh: 辅酶Q10（ubiquinone，常因他汀引起的肌肉酸痛而服用）
pairs.what_happens: The INR can fall, so clot protection weakens with no symptoms. Co-use is common because CoQ10 is marketed to the same patients who take statins and warfarin together.
pairs.what_happens_zh: INR 可能下降，抗血栓保护减弱且无症状。合用很常见，因为辅酶Q10 的目标人群正是同时服用他汀和华法林的患者。
pairs.mechanism: Ubiquinone is structurally quinone-like and may act as a weak vitamin K substitute in clotting factor carboxylation
pairs.mechanism_zh: Ubiquinone 结构上属醌类，可能在凝血因子羧化中充当弱的维生素K 替代物。
pairs.action: Tell the anticoagulant clinic before starting or stopping CoQ10, keep the daily dose the same, and ask for an INR check within 1 to 2 weeks of any change.
pairs.action_zh: 开始或停用辅酶Q10 前告知抗凝门诊，每天剂量保持一致，任何变动后 1 到 2 周复查 INR。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS ONLY of reduced INR, plus structural reasoning. Small controlled studies have not confirmed a consistent effect, so this row is graded for monitoring rather than avoidance.

pairs.supplement_zh: 氨基葡萄糖（glucosamine），含或不含硫酸软骨素
pairs.what_happens: The INR rises, sometimes with bruising or bleeding. Use is common in the same age group that takes warfarin, because the supplement is sold for joint pain.
pairs.what_happens_zh: INR 升高，有时伴瘀青或出血。使用者与华法林人群年龄段重叠很大，因为这类产品以关节疼痛为卖点。
pairs.mechanism: Not established; an effect on warfarin response is suspected, and chondroitin is a heparin-like glycosaminoglycan
pairs.mechanism_zh: 机制未确立；推测影响华法林的作用强度，而硫酸软骨素属于类似肝素的糖胺聚糖。
pairs.action: Avoid starting glucosamine while on warfarin. If you already take it, tell the anticoagulant clinic, ask for an INR check within 1 to 2 weeks, and report bruising or bleeding.
pairs.action_zh: 服用华法林期间不要开始服用氨基葡萄糖。已经在用的，告知抗凝门诊，1 到 2 周内复查 INR，并报告瘀青或出血。
pairs.evidence: About 20 adverse-event reports to the FDA of raised INR and bleeding (Knudsen and Sokol, Pharmacotherapy 2008), with the same signal carried by Health Canada and the MHRA. CASE REPORTS ONLY, but prevalence of co-use is high.

pairs.supplement: Turmeric / curcumin supplements (as distinct from turmeric used as a cooking spice)
pairs.supplement_zh: 姜黄 / 姜黄素（curcumin）补充剂（与做菜用的姜黄香料不同）
pairs.what_happens: The INR rises, with bruising, nosebleeds or heavier periods. Curcumin products also carry a hepatotoxicity signal of their own.
pairs.what_happens_zh: INR 升高，伴瘀青、流鼻血或经量增多。姜黄素产品本身还带有肝毒性信号。
pairs.mechanism: Curcumin has antiplatelet activity and inhibits CYP2C9 and UGT in vitro; most products also contain piperine, which further raises drug exposure
pairs.mechanism_zh: 姜黄素具有抗血小板活性，并在体外抑制 CYP2C9 和 UGT；多数产品还含 piperine，会进一步提高药物暴露量。
pairs.action: Do not take turmeric or curcumin capsules while on warfarin. Turmeric used as a spice in cooking is not the problem. If you have been taking capsules, tell the anticoagulant clinic and ask for an INR check.
pairs.action_zh: 服用华法林期间不要服用姜黄或姜黄素胶囊。做菜作为香料用的姜黄不是问题。如果一直在服胶囊，告知抗凝门诊并复查 INR。
pairs.evidence: Regulator communication: Medsafe Prescriber Update, December 2022 (Warfarin: eat, drink and be wary) is built around this interaction; supported by case reports and in-vitro CYP2C9/UGT and antiplatelet data. No controlled trial. Graded AVOID because the products are high-prevalence in warfarin users, dose and curcuminoid content vary widely between brands, and most add piperine.

pairs.drug_class: Narrow-margin drugs cleared by CYP3A4 or UGT
pairs.drug_class_zh: 经 CYP3A4 或 UGT 清除的窄治疗窗药物
pairs.drug_examples: tacrolimus, ciclosporin, midazolam, carbamazepine, simvastatin, many oral oncology drugs
pairs.supplement: Curcumin with piperine (black pepper extract; sold as high absorption or bioavailability enhanced turmeric)
pairs.supplement_zh: 含 piperine 的姜黄素产品（黑胡椒提取物；以高吸收或高生物利用度姜黄为卖点）
pairs.what_happens: Blood levels of the prescribed drug rise, so its dose-related side effects appear even though the dose has not changed.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 处方药血药浓度升高，剂量未变却出现与剂量相关的不良反应。
pairs.mechanism: Piperine inhibits CYP3A4 and UGT-mediated glucuronidation and slows gut transit, raising exposure to many co-prescribed drugs; it is added to curcumin products for exactly this reason
pairs.mechanism_zh: Piperine 抑制 CYP3A4 和 UGT 介导的葡萄糖醛酸化，并减慢胃肠转运，提高许多合用药物的暴露量；姜黄素产品加入它正是为了这个目的。
pairs.action: Check whether your turmeric product lists piperine or black pepper extract, and tell the prescriber before starting it if you take any narrow-margin medicine. Do not treat a high absorption formula as interchangeable with kitchen turmeric.
pairs.action_zh: 查看姜黄产品是否标示 piperine 或黑胡椒提取物；若在服用任何窄治疗窗药物，开始前告知开药医生。不要把高吸收配方当作厨房姜黄的等价物。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC plus volunteer pharmacokinetic studies showing piperine raises substrate exposure. No outcome data, and piperine content is rarely quantified on the label, which is itself the practical problem.

pairs.supplement_zh: 姜黄素补充剂（含 piperine 时更明显）
pairs.what_happens: Levels of endoxifen, the active metabolite that does the anticancer work, fall, so the treatment is weaker with nothing noticeable at the time.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 发挥抗癌作用的活性代谢物 endoxifen 浓度下降，治疗效果减弱，而当时没有任何可察觉的变化。
pairs.mechanism: Curcumin, more so with piperine, reduces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6-dependent formation of endoxifen from tamoxifen
pairs.mechanism_zh: 姜黄素（加 piperine 时更强）减少依赖 CYP3A4 和 CYP2D6 的 endoxifen 生成。
pairs.action: Do not take curcumin supplements while on tamoxifen, and bring any turmeric product to the oncology team for review. Cooking with turmeric is not the issue.
pairs.action_zh: 服用 tamoxifen 期间不要服用姜黄素补充剂，并把任何姜黄产品带给肿瘤团队审阅。做菜用姜黄不是问题。
pairs.evidence: Patient pharmacokinetic study showing reduced endoxifen exposure with curcumin, more pronounced when piperine was added. PK endpoint only, no outcome trial; graded AVOID because the endpoint is anticancer efficacy and the supplement has no necessary role.

pairs.supplement: Danshen (Salvia miltiorrhiza) and dong quai (Angelica sinensis), including multi-herb Chinese formulations containing either
pairs.supplement_zh: 丹参（Salvia miltiorrhiza）和当归（Angelica sinensis），包括含有两者之一的中药复方
pairs.what_happens: The INR climbs, sometimes markedly, with bruising, nosebleeds or serious bleeding.
pairs.what_happens_zh: INR 升高，有时升幅很大，伴瘀青、流鼻血或严重出血。
pairs.mechanism: Danshen has antiplatelet activity and reduces warfarin clearance; dong quai contains natural coumarin derivatives that add to warfarin's effect
pairs.mechanism_zh: 丹参具有抗血小板活性并降低华法林清除；当归含天然香豆素衍生物，叠加在华法林的作用之上。
pairs.action: Do not take danshen or dong quai with warfarin, and check the ingredient list of any Chinese herbal formulation, which often contains one of them. If you have taken either, ask for an INR check now.
pairs.action_zh: 不要把丹参或当归与华法林同服，并核对任何中药复方的成分表，其中常含这两味药之一。如果已经服用过，现在就查 INR。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS ONLY, but repeated and consistent, including markedly raised INR and bleeding. No controlled trial. Graded AVOID because the reported effect sizes are large and multi-herb products rarely declare full content.

pairs.drug_class: Beta-blockers carried by intestinal OATP transporters
pairs.drug_class_zh: 经肠道 OATP 转运体吸收的 beta 受体阻滞剂
pairs.supplement: Green tea extract / EGCG (and strong green tea taken with the dose)
pairs.supplement_zh: 绿茶提取物 / EGCG（以及与服药同时饮用的浓绿茶）
pairs.what_happens: Almost the whole dose can be lost, so blood pressure and heart rate control fail while the tablet is being taken exactly as prescribed.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 几乎整个剂量都可能损失，按处方服药却仍然血压和心率控制失效。
pairs.mechanism: Green tea catechins inhibit the intestinal uptake transporters OATP1A2 and OATP2B1 that carry nadolol into the gut wall
pairs.mechanism_zh: 绿茶儿茶素抑制把 nadolol 转入肠壁的摄取转运体 OATP1A2 和 OATP2B1。
pairs.action: Do not take green tea extract, and do not drink green tea, around the time of your nadolol dose; separate them by several hours and keep your intake consistent day to day. Tell the prescriber if blood pressure control has drifted. High-dose EGCG also carries a liver injury signal.
pairs.action_zh: 服用 nadolol 前后不要服绿茶提取物，也不要喝绿茶；两者间隔数小时，并使每天摄入量保持一致。血压控制变差要告知开药医生。高剂量 EGCG 另有肝损伤信号。
pairs.evidence: Volunteer pharmacokinetic study (Misaka et al, Clin Pharmacol Ther 2014): nadolol AUC reduced by about 85% with green tea, the largest documented supplement pharmacokinetic effect in this area. EFSA has separately assessed a hepatotoxicity signal at 800 mg EGCG/day.

pairs.supplement_zh: 绿茶提取物 / EGCG
pairs.what_happens: The antitumour effect is blunted or abolished, with nothing noticeable to the patient at the time.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 抗肿瘤作用被削弱甚至完全抵消，患者当时不会有任何察觉。
pairs.mechanism: EGCG forms a direct chemical adduct with the boronic acid group of bortezomib, inactivating the drug before it reaches the proteasome
pairs.mechanism_zh: EGCG 与 bortezomib 的硼酸基团直接形成加合物，在药物到达蛋白酶体之前就使其失活。
pairs.action: Do not take green tea extract or EGCG supplements while on bortezomib, and tell the oncology team about any you have been taking.
pairs.action_zh: 使用 bortezomib 期间不要服用绿茶提取物或 EGCG 补充剂，并把此前服用过的产品告知肿瘤团队。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC, from in-vitro and animal work showing direct chemical inactivation and loss of antitumour activity. No human trial exists and none is likely; graded AVOID because the mechanism is chemical and complete, and the endpoint is cancer control.

pairs.drug_class_zh: 左甲状腺素与抗甲状腺药
pairs.supplement_zh: 南非醉茄 / 印度人参（Withania somnifera，ashwagandha）
pairs.what_happens: Thyroid hormone effect adds up: palpitations, tremor, weight loss and heat intolerance, with a suppressed TSH on the next blood test. Thyrotoxicosis has been reported.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 甲状腺激素效应叠加：心悸、颤抖、体重下降和怕热，下次验血 TSH 被抑制。已有甲状腺毒症报告。
pairs.mechanism: Ashwagandha raises T4 and T3 output, so it adds to the prescribed dose or works against an antithyroid drug; the effect is on hormone levels themselves
pairs.mechanism_zh: Ashwagandha 增加 T4 和 T3 的输出，因此叠加在处方剂量之上，或对抗抗甲状腺药；作用直接落在激素水平本身。
pairs.action: Tell the prescriber before taking ashwagandha with any thyroid medicine, and ask for TSH and free T4 6 to 8 weeks after starting or stopping it. Stop it and seek advice for palpitations, tremor or unexplained weight loss. It also carries a liver injury signal.
pairs.action_zh: 与任何甲状腺药物合用前告知开药医生，开始或停用后 6 到 8 周查 TSH 和游离 T4。出现心悸、颤抖或不明原因体重下降就停用并就医。该产品另有肝损伤信号。
pairs.evidence: CASE REPORTS of thyrotoxicosis with ashwagandha plus small studies showing rises in T4 and T3, and an accumulating hepatotoxicity signal in the literature. No interaction trial. Included because ashwagandha is one of the fastest-growing supplements in this patient group.

pairs.supplement_zh: 南非醉茄 / 印度人参（Withania somnifera，ashwagandha）
pairs.what_happens: In theory the immune suppression the transplant or autoimmune treatment depends on is opposed, risking rejection or a disease flare. Nothing is felt until that happens.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 理论上会对抗移植或自身免疫治疗所依赖的免疫抑制，带来排斥或病情复燃风险。在事件发生前没有任何感觉。
pairs.mechanism: Ashwagandha has documented immunostimulant activity (increased lymphocyte proliferation and cytokine output), which works against the purpose of the drug
pairs.mechanism_zh: Ashwagandha 有明确的免疫刺激活性（淋巴细胞增殖和细胞因子输出增加），与药物的治疗目的相反。
pairs.action: Do not take ashwagandha if you are on immunosuppressants after a transplant or for an autoimmune disease, and tell the team about any you have already taken.
pairs.action_zh: 移植后或因自身免疫病使用免疫抑制剂期间不要服用 ashwagandha，已经服用过的要告知治疗团队。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC ONLY, from immunostimulant pharmacology; no human interaction data. Graded AVOID because rejection is severe and often irreversible while the supplement has no necessary role, so the cost of caution is nil.

pairs.supplement: Iodine and kelp or seaweed supplements (including greens powders and multivitamins with iodine)
pairs.supplement_zh: 碘以及海带或海藻类补充剂（包括含碘的青汁粉和复合维生素）
pairs.what_happens: Thyroid control is destabilised in either direction: a large iodine load can trigger overactivity (palpitations, tremor, weight loss) or block hormone output and cause underactivity, so dose titration stops working.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 甲状腺控制向两个方向都可能失稳：大剂量碘负荷可诱发功能过强（心悸、颤抖、体重下降），也可阻断激素输出造成功能低下，剂量滴定因此失效。
pairs.mechanism: Excess iodine transiently blocks organification (Wolff-Chaikoff effect) or supplies substrate for excess hormone synthesis (Jod-Basedow), depending on the underlying thyroid state
pairs.mechanism_zh: 过量碘会暂时阻断有机化过程（Wolff-Chaikoff 效应），也可能为过量激素合成提供底物（Jod-Basedow），取决于基础甲状腺状态。
pairs.action: Do not take iodine or kelp supplements if you take levothyroxine, carbimazole or propylthiouracil. Check multivitamins, greens powders and seaweed products for iodine content, and ask for a thyroid function test if you have been taking any.
pairs.action_zh: 服用左甲状腺素、carbimazole 或 propylthiouracil 期间不要服用碘或海带类补充剂。核对复合维生素、青汁粉和海藻产品的含碘量，如果一直在服用就检查甲状腺功能。
pairs.evidence: Well-established iodine physiology plus a large case literature of iodine-induced hyperthyroidism and hypothyroidism, including from kelp supplements. In practice this destabilises more thyroid patients than the calcium timing rule, which is why it belongs in the thyroid block.

pairs.drug_class: Levodopa given without a decarboxylase inhibitor
pairs.drug_class_zh: 未合用脱羧酶抑制剂的左旋多巴
pairs.supplement_zh: 高剂量维生素B6（pyridoxine）
pairs.what_happens: Parkinson's symptoms return: more stiffness, slowness and tremor, because less levodopa reaches the brain.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 帕金森症状回来：僵硬、动作变慢和颤抖加重，因为到达脑内的左旋多巴减少。
pairs.mechanism: Pyridoxine is the cofactor for aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase, so it speeds peripheral conversion of levodopa to dopamine, which cannot cross the blood-brain barrier. Carbidopa and benserazide in modern combination products block this route
pairs.mechanism_zh: Pyridoxine 是 aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 的辅因子，会加快左旋多巴在外周转化为多巴胺，而多巴胺无法通过血脑屏障。现代复方产品中的 carbidopa 和 benserazide 阻断了这条途径。
pairs.action: Do not take high-dose B6 with plain levodopa. Check whether your product is a combination (co-careldopa, co-beneldopa), in which case this matters much less, and keep B6 to the amount in a standard multivitamin. High-dose B6 also causes peripheral neuropathy in its own right.
pairs.action_zh: 不要把高剂量 B6 与单方左旋多巴同服。先确认你的药是否为复方（co-careldopa、co-beneldopa），若是则影响小得多；B6 摄入量不要超过标准复合维生素的水平。高剂量 B6 本身还会引起周围神经病。
pairs.evidence: Established pharmacology from the era of plain levodopa, with controlled human studies showing loss of effect. Largely historical for combination products, which is why the drug definition in this row is narrow.

pairs.supplement_zh: 铁剂（口服亚铁盐）
pairs.what_happens: Less levodopa is absorbed, so off periods return: stiffness, slowness and tremor between doses.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 左旋多巴吸收减少，关期重新出现：两次服药之间僵硬、动作变慢和颤抖。
pairs.mechanism: Iron chelates levodopa and carbidopa in the gut, forming a poorly absorbed complex
pairs.mechanism_zh: 铁在肠道中与左旋多巴和 carbidopa 螯合，形成难以吸收的复合物。
pairs.action: Separate the iron tablet from every levodopa dose by at least 2 hours, and tell the prescriber if off periods have worsened since you started iron.
pairs.action_zh: 铁剂与每一次左旋多巴给药至少间隔 2 小时，如果开始补铁后关期加重要告知开药医生。
pairs.evidence: Volunteer pharmacokinetic studies showing substantial falls in levodopa and carbidopa bioavailability with ferrous sulfate; reflected in product information.

pairs.supplement: Protein, whey and branched-chain amino acid powders
pairs.supplement_zh: 蛋白粉、乳清蛋白和支链氨基酸（BCAA）粉
pairs.what_happens: Doses stop working reliably: visible off periods, freezing and returning tremor within an hour of a protein shake.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 给药效果变得不稳定：喝完蛋白饮品后一小时内出现明显关期、冻结和颤抖复现。
pairs.mechanism: Large neutral amino acids compete with levodopa for the LAT1 transporter in the gut wall and at the blood-brain barrier
pairs.mechanism_zh: 大分子中性氨基酸在肠壁和血脑屏障处与左旋多巴竞争 LAT1 转运体。
pairs.action: Take levodopa 30 to 60 minutes before, or at least 1 to 2 hours after, any protein or amino acid powder, and spread protein evenly through the day. This is a timing problem with a timing fix, so do not cut protein out of your diet.
pairs.action_zh: 左旋多巴在任何蛋白粉或氨基酸粉之前 30 到 60 分钟服用，或在其后至少 1 到 2 小时服用，并把蛋白摄入均匀分布到全天。这是靠时间安排就能解决的问题，不要因此把蛋白从饮食中去掉。
pairs.evidence: Controlled human studies of protein loading and levodopa response, plus the established LAT1 competition mechanism. Consistently reproducible and easily fixed, which is why it belongs in the matrix.

pairs.supplement: High-dose vitamin A / retinol (including stacked multivitamins and cod liver oil)
pairs.supplement_zh: 高剂量维生素A / 视黄醇（包括叠加服用的复合维生素和鱼肝油）
pairs.what_happens: Additive vitamin A toxicity: headache with blurred or double vision from raised pressure around the brain, dry cracked lips and skin, hair loss, bone and joint pain, and abnormal liver blood tests.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 维生素A 毒性叠加：因颅内压升高出现头痛伴视物模糊或重影，口唇和皮肤干裂，脱发，骨和关节疼痛，肝功能验血异常。
pairs.mechanism: Oral retinoids are vitamin A derivatives, so supplemental retinol adds to the same receptor-mediated toxicity (hypervitaminosis A)
pairs.mechanism_zh: 口服维A酸类本身是维生素A 衍生物，补充的视黄醇叠加在同一受体介导的毒性上（维生素A 过多症）。
pairs.action: Take no vitamin A or retinol supplement and no cod liver oil while on isotretinoin or acitretin, and check that no multivitamin you use contains retinol. Report headache with visual changes the same day.
pairs.action_zh: 服用 isotretinoin 或 acitretin 期间不要服用任何维生素A 或视黄醇补充剂，也不要吃鱼肝油，并核对所用复合维生素是否含视黄醇。出现头痛伴视觉改变当天就报告。
pairs.evidence: Established class pharmacology and a standard contraindication in retinoid product information, supported by the hypervitaminosis A case literature. No trial needed or done.

pairs.supplement_zh: 小檗碱（berberine）
pairs.what_happens: Statin levels rise, so muscle pain and weakness become more likely, with a rise in creatine kinase on blood tests.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 他汀浓度升高，肌肉疼痛和乏力更容易出现，验血 creatine kinase 升高。
pairs.mechanism: Berberine inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, reducing clearance of simvastatin and atorvastatin; the same inhibition that raises ciclosporin exposure operates here
pairs.mechanism_zh: 小檗碱抑制 CYP3A4 和 P-glycoprotein，降低 simvastatin 和 atorvastatin 的清除；与提高 ciclosporin 暴露量的是同一种抑制作用。
pairs.action: Tell the prescriber before adding berberine to simvastatin or atorvastatin, and report muscle pain or weakness. Pravastatin and rosuvastatin are less affected because they do not depend on CYP3A4.
pairs.action_zh: 在 simvastatin 或 atorvastatin 基础上加用小檗碱前告知开药医生，出现肌肉疼痛或乏力要报告。Pravastatin 和 rosuvastatin 受影响较小，因为它们不依赖 CYP3A4。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC, applying the same CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inhibition used to justify the ciclosporin row, plus small human studies of berberine with statins that measured lipids rather than safety. No myopathy outcome trial. Added because berberine is marketed to exactly the dyslipidaemic population taking statins.

pairs.drug_class: Timing-sensitive oral drugs taken with bulk fibre
pairs.drug_class_zh: 与容积性纤维同服的时间敏感型口服药
pairs.supplement: Psyllium / ispaghula husk and other soluble bulk fibre
pairs.supplement_zh: 车前子壳 / ispaghula 及其他可溶性容积纤维
pairs.what_happens: Blood levels drop at an unchanged dose, so thyroid symptoms, seizure control, heart failure symptoms or blood glucose can all slip depending on the drug.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 剂量未变而血药浓度下降，按药物不同，可能出现甲状腺症状、癫痫控制、心衰症状或血糖失控。
pairs.mechanism: The hydrophilic fibre gel traps the drug in the gut lumen and slows or reduces its absorption
pairs.mechanism_zh: 亲水性纤维凝胶把药物困在肠腔内，减慢或减少其吸收。
pairs.action: Leave at least 2 hours, ideally 4, between bulk fibre and any of these tablets, and keep the same routine daily. Where a blood level exists (levothyroxine via TSH, carbamazepine, digoxin), ask for a check 1 to 2 weeks after starting or stopping the fibre.
pairs.action_zh: 容积性纤维与这些药片至少间隔 2 小时，最好 4 小时，每天保持同一作息。凡有可测指标的（左甲状腺素看 TSH，carbamazepine，digoxin），在开始或停用纤维后 1 到 2 周复查。
pairs.evidence: Established gel-trapping mechanism plus per-drug case reports and small studies; strongest for levothyroxine, weakest for lithium (a single case report, kept in its own row). No controlled trial across the class, but the fix costs nothing and covers far more patients than the lithium row alone.

pairs.supplement: Self-supplemented folic acid or folinic acid (including in multivitamins)
pairs.supplement_zh: 自行补充的叶酸或亚叶酸（folinic acid），包括复合维生素中的成分
pairs.what_happens: The antifolate effect the treatment depends on is blunted, so the cancer is less well controlled. Nothing feels different at the time.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 治疗所依赖的抗叶酸作用被削弱，肿瘤控制变差。当时不会有任何感觉上的变化。
pairs.mechanism: Folate competes with the antifolate at dihydrofolate reductase and downstream folate-dependent enzymes; folinic acid is used deliberately as a rescue agent for exactly this reason
pairs.mechanism_zh: 叶酸在 dihydrofolate reductase 及其下游依赖叶酸的酶上与抗叶酸药竞争；正因如此，亚叶酸才被用作解救药物。
pairs.action: Do not self-supplement folic or folinic acid during high-dose antifolate chemotherapy, and hand over any multivitamin for review. The opposite rule applies to low-dose weekly methotrexate for rheumatoid arthritis or psoriasis, where folic acid is deliberately prescribed to reduce side effects: follow the prescription there, and never stop prescribed folate on the basis of this row.
pairs.action_zh: 高剂量抗叶酸化疗期间不要自行补充叶酸或亚叶酸，并把任何复合维生素交给团队审阅。类风湿关节炎或银屑病使用低剂量每周甲氨蝶呤时规则相反，叶酸是特意开出来减少不良反应的：那种情况下按处方执行，绝不要因这一条而停用处方叶酸。
pairs.evidence: Established antifolate pharmacology, with folinic acid rescue as the clinical proof of the mechanism. Pemetrexed is the deliberate exception, since scheduled folic acid and vitamin B12 are prescribed with it to reduce toxicity. A prescribed folate regimen always overrides self-supplementation advice, which is the direction-of-effect trap this row exists to name.

pairs.drug_examples: levothyroxine (liothyronine assumed by class, not studied)
pairs.supplement: Magnesium and zinc supplements (including combined mineral products and magnesium-containing antacids)
pairs.supplement_zh: 镁和锌补充剂（包括复合矿物质产品和含镁抗酸药）
pairs.what_happens: Less hormone is absorbed, so TSH drifts up and tiredness, weight gain and cold intolerance return, exactly as with calcium or iron.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 激素吸收减少，TSH 逐渐上升，疲乏、体重增加和怕冷重新出现，与钙或铁的情形一致。
pairs.mechanism: Divalent magnesium and zinc bind levothyroxine in the gut to form a poorly absorbed complex
pairs.mechanism_zh: 二价镁和锌在肠道中与左甲状腺素结合，形成难以吸收的复合物。
pairs.action: Leave at least 4 hours between levothyroxine and any magnesium or zinc supplement, keep the same daily routine, and ask for a TSH check 6 to 8 weeks after starting or stopping them.
pairs.action_zh: 左甲状腺素与任何镁或锌补充剂间隔至少 4 小时，每天保持同一作息，开始或停用后 6 到 8 周查 TSH。
pairs.evidence: Same chelation mechanism as the calcium and iron rows, supported by case reports of raised TSH with magnesium oxide and by product-information warnings on polyvalent cations. Less quantified than the calcium and iron data, but the advice is identical, so the gap was worth closing.

pairs.drug_examples: glyceryl trinitrate spray, isosorbide mononitrate, isosorbide dinitrate
pairs.supplement_zh: N-acetylcysteine（NAC，乙酰半胱氨酸）
pairs.what_happens: Blood pressure falls further and headache is worse than with the nitrate alone, with dizziness on standing and a risk of fainting.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血压比单用硝酸酯时降得更低，头痛更重，站起时头晕，有晕倒风险。
pairs.mechanism: NAC donates the sulfhydryl groups needed to convert nitrate to nitric oxide, potentiating the vasodilator effect
pairs.mechanism_zh: NAC 提供把硝酸酯转化为一氧化氮所需的巯基，增强血管扩张作用。
pairs.action: Tell the prescriber before combining them, stand up slowly, and stop the NAC if you get headache or light-headedness. Do not use NAC as a self-treatment for nitrate tolerance.
pairs.action_zh: 合用前告知开药医生，起身要慢，出现头痛或发昏就停用 NAC。不要把 NAC 当作自行对付硝酸酯耐受的办法。
pairs.evidence: Controlled human studies of NAC with nitroglycerin documenting potentiated hypotension and headache. Small studies, consistent direction. NAC previously appeared in this matrix only as a chemotherapy antioxidant.

pairs.drug_examples: glyceryl trinitrate spray, isosorbide mononitrate, nicorandil
pairs.supplement: Unlicensed herbal sexual-enhancement products (frequently adulterated with undeclared sildenafil or tadalafil)
pairs.supplement_zh: 未经批准的草药性功能增强产品（常掺入未申报的 sildenafil 或 tadalafil）
pairs.what_happens: Profound and prolonged collapse of blood pressure: fainting, heart attack or death. The label gives no warning, because the drug in the product is undeclared.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 血压深度且持续崩塌：晕倒、心肌梗死或死亡。标签不会给出任何警示，因为产品中的药物未申报。
pairs.mechanism: An undeclared PDE5 inhibitor plus a nitrate produces uncontrolled cGMP-mediated vasodilation, the one combination that is absolutely contraindicated
pairs.mechanism_zh: 未申报的 PDE5 抑制剂加硝酸酯会造成不受控的 cGMP 介导血管扩张，这是唯一绝对禁忌的组合。
pairs.action: Never take an unlicensed herbal erectile or sexual-performance product if you use any nitrate or nicorandil. If you want treatment for erectile dysfunction, ask the prescriber, who can check it against your nitrate. Call emergency services for collapse or chest pain after taking one.
pairs.action_zh: 使用任何硝酸酯或 nicorandil 期间，绝不要服用未经批准的草药助勃或性功能产品。需要治疗勃起功能障碍就找开药医生，他们可以对照你的硝酸酯用药来选择。服用后出现意识丧失或胸痛立即呼叫急救。
pairs.evidence: Regulator findings of PDE5 inhibitor adulteration in herbal sexual-enhancement products (FDA tainted sexual enhancement products list) combined with the absolute nitrate contraindication in every PDE5 inhibitor label, plus case reports of severe hypotension. Graded AVOID on consequence severity and on undeclared content: adulterated supplement plus nitrate is the combination in this matrix most likely to kill.

pairs.drug_class: Narrow-margin drugs cleared by CYP3A4, CYP2C19 or P-glycoprotein (consolidated St John's wort row)
pairs.drug_class_zh: 经 CYP3A4、CYP2C19 或 P-glycoprotein 清除的窄治疗窗药物（圣约翰草合并条目）
pairs.drug_examples: methadone, clozapine, olanzapine, voriconazole, itraconazole, oral targeted oncology agents, plus every drug named in the St John's wort rows above
pairs.supplement_zh: 圣约翰草（Hypericum perforatum，贯叶连翘）
pairs.what_happens: Any drug cleared by these routes loses effect within 1 to 2 weeks: methadone withdrawal, loss of antipsychotic or antifungal cover, or an underdosed cancer treatment. Stopping St John's wort is itself an interaction event, because levels climb again over the following 1 to 2 weeks and can reach toxicity.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 任何经这些途径清除的药物在 1 到 2 周内失效：出现美沙酮戒断、抗精神病或抗真菌覆盖丧失，或抗癌治疗剂量不足。停用圣约翰草本身也是一次相互作用事件，因为随后的 1 到 2 周内浓度会重新上升，可能达到中毒水平。
pairs.mechanism: PXR activation induces CYP3A4, CYP2C19, CYP1A2, UGT enzymes and intestinal P-glycoprotein; induction builds over about 10 to 14 days and takes a similar time to wear off
pairs.mechanism_zh: 激活 PXR 诱导 CYP3A4、CYP2C19、CYP1A2、UGT 酶以及肠道 P-glycoprotein；诱导作用在约 10 到 14 天内建立，消退所需时间相近。
pairs.action: Before starting or stopping St John's wort, list every prescription you take and have the prescriber or pharmacist check each one, not only the obvious ones. Expect a level check or a clinical review 1 to 2 weeks after either change for any narrow-margin drug. This is the row that resolves the apparent conflict between the do-not-stop-abruptly advice in the anticoagulant rows and the stop-2-weeks-before advice in the chemotherapy row: both follow from the same 1 to 2 week de-induction window.
pairs.action_zh: 开始或停用圣约翰草之前，把你在用的所有处方药列出来，让开药医生或药师逐一核查，不要只看明显相关的几种。任何窄治疗窗药物在这两种变动之后 1 到 2 周都应复查浓度或做临床评估。这一条也解释了抗凝条目里不要突然停用与化疗条目里提前 2 周停用之间的表面矛盾：两者都源于同一个 1 到 2 周的去诱导窗口。
pairs.evidence: Consolidated from the induction pharmacology and the individual pharmacokinetic studies cited in the rows above (indinavir AUC -57%, ciclosporin AUC -46%, SN-38 AUC -42%, digoxin AUC -25%, simvastatin hydroxy acid AUC ratio 0.48, ethinylestradiol half-life about 47% shorter). Substrate-specific human interaction data are missing for methadone, clozapine, olanzapine and the azoles, so those are mechanistic extrapolations from a proven inducer.

pairs.drug_class_zh: MAOI（不可逆、非选择性单胺氧化酶抑制剂）
pairs.supplement: Bitter orange (Citrus aurantium, synephrine) and high-caffeine pre-workout stimulant blends
pairs.supplement_zh: 苦橙（Citrus aurantium，synephrine 辛弗林）及高咖啡因的运动前兴奋剂配方
pairs.what_happens: Hypertensive crisis: sudden severe throbbing headache, chest pain, racing heart and stroke risk.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 高血压危象：突发剧烈搏动性头痛、胸痛、心跳极快，有中风风险。
pairs.mechanism: Synephrine is an indirect sympathomimetic whose pressor effect is unopposed when monoamine oxidase is inhibited; added caffeine amplifies it
pairs.mechanism_zh: 辛弗林是间接拟交感药，单胺氧化酶被抑制时其升压作用无从对抗；配方中的咖啡因会放大这一效应。
pairs.action: Do not take bitter orange, synephrine or pre-workout stimulant blends while on an MAOI, or for 2 weeks after stopping an irreversible one. Call emergency services for a sudden severe headache with a pounding heartbeat.
pairs.action_zh: 服用 MAOI 期间，以及停用不可逆 MAOI 后 2 周内，不要服用苦橙、辛弗林或运动前兴奋剂配方。突发剧烈头痛伴心跳强烈时呼叫急救。
pairs.evidence: MECHANISTIC, from established indirect sympathomimetic pharmacology, plus case reports of hypertensive events with synephrine-containing products. No controlled interaction study. Added because pre-workout powders were already named in the lithium row, so the products are in scope.

pairs.supplement: Bitter orange (synephrine), high-dose caffeine and pre-workout stimulant blends
pairs.supplement_zh: 苦橙（synephrine 辛弗林）、高剂量咖啡因及运动前兴奋剂配方
pairs.what_happens: Blood pressure and heart rate rise again despite the tablets, sometimes with palpitations, so readings look worse with no change in medication.
pairs.what_happens_zh: 尽管在服药，血压和心率仍回升，有时伴心悸，用药没变而测量值变差。
pairs.mechanism: Synephrine and caffeine raise blood pressure and heart rate through sympathetic stimulation, working against the antihypertensive
pairs.mechanism_zh: 辛弗林和咖啡因通过交感刺激升高血压和心率，与抗高血压药的作用相反。
pairs.action: Stop pre-workout and bitter orange products if your blood pressure is drifting up, and take a week of home readings before and after so the prescriber can see the difference. Keep caffeine intake steady rather than swinging.
pairs.action_zh: 血压逐渐上升就停用运动前补剂和苦橙类产品，并在停用前后各做一周家庭血压记录，让开药医生看到差异。咖啡因摄入保持稳定，不要大幅波动。
pairs.evidence: Volunteer studies showing pressor effects of synephrine and caffeine, plus case reports of hypertensive events in users of stimulant blends. MECHANISTIC plus small studies, no interaction trial.
